canonical_tags.zh: 极致努力与超强韧性
canonical_tags.desc: Outwork everyone, endure hardship, stay gritty

canonical_tags.zh: 克服恐惧、敢于承担风险
canonical_tags.desc: Take big swings early, manage downside, act despite fear

canonical_tags.zh: 先干起来、执行力胜过空想
canonical_tags.desc: Stop overthinking and start immediately with what you have

canonical_tags.zh: 拥抱失败与拒绝、快速复盘
canonical_tags.desc: Treat failure and 'no' as tuition and stepping stones

canonical_tags.zh: 热爱与极致专注、保持饥饿感
canonical_tags.desc: Love the craft or process, stay relentlessly curious

canonical_tags.zh: 诚信立身、珍惜长期声誉
canonical_tags.desc: Keep your word, build trust, never burn bridges

canonical_tags.zh: 信仰、感恩与回馈社会
canonical_tags.desc: Stay grounded in faith, gratitude, humility, or charity

canonical_tags.zh: 自信笃定、打破自我设限
canonical_tags.desc: Ignore doubters and raise your mental ceiling

canonical_tags.zh: 精通销售、沟通与说服力
canonical_tags.desc: Learn how to sell, pitch, close deals, and persuade

canonical_tags.zh: 经营高质量人脉与圈子
canonical_tags.desc: Surround yourself with winners, build genuine relationships

canonical_tags.zh: 寻找顶级导师、向过来人借智
canonical_tags.desc: Get a mentor, work close to successful people, model winners

canonical_tags.zh: 终身学习、阅读与持续精进
canonical_tags.desc: Read voraciously, learn new skills, never stop studying

canonical_tags.zh: 精通财务、看懂现金流与数字
canonical_tags.desc: Understand accounting, cash flow, margins, and taxes

canonical_tags.zh: 长期自律、保持作息与健康
canonical_tags.desc: Show up daily, protect physical health, stay disciplined

canonical_tags.zh: 利用自媒体与个人品牌杠杆
canonical_tags.desc: Create content, build audience distribution and personal brand

canonical_tags.zh: 选对人生伴侣与支持型配偶
canonical_tags.desc: Marry a supportive partner aligned on values and long-term ambition

canonical_tags.tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
canonical_tags.zh: 解决真实痛点、创造超预期价值
canonical_tags.desc: Focus on solving problems for customers; money follows value

canonical_tags.tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
canonical_tags.zh: 选对高天花板赛道与趋势
canonical_tags.desc: Pick growing/scalable industries with high margins and tailwinds

canonical_tags.zh: 招比自己强的人、打造团队与授权
canonical_tags.desc: Hire great people, build systems, empower and delegate

canonical_tags.tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
canonical_tags.zh: 追求股权与资产，而非纯出卖时间
canonical_tags.desc: Seek ownership, equity, scalable assets over hourly wages

canonical_tags.zh: 高度聚焦主业、对诱惑说不
canonical_tags.desc: Go deep on one thing until it works; avoid shiny-object syndrome

canonical_tags.zh: 极致客户体验与口碑复购
canonical_tags.desc: Overdeliver for clients, treat customers with extreme care

canonical_tags.zh: 轻资产起步、利润滚雪球再投入
canonical_tags.desc: Keep overhead low early and plow profits back into growth

canonical_tags.zh: 深耕“无聊但稳赚”的传统现金流生意
canonical_tags.desc: Trades, home services, B2B logistics, infrastructure, insurance

canonical_tags.tag: Work Under a Winner First Before Starting
canonical_tags.zh: 先在高水平团队打工攒经验再创业
canonical_tags.desc: Get paid to learn in a great company before launching your own

canonical_tags.zh: 配置房地产获取现金流与增值
canonical_tags.desc: Buy cash-flowing properties, commercial/residential real estate

canonical_tags.zh: 长期坚持投资、让时间与复利发酵
canonical_tags.desc: Invest early in equities/index/assets and hold long-term

canonical_tags.tag: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep
canonical_tags.zh: 量入为出、克制消费膨胀
canonical_tags.desc: Keep expenses low, save aggressively, don't inflate lifestyle

canonical_tags.tag: Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)
canonical_tags.zh: 善用良性杠杆、远离消费负债
canonical_tags.desc: Use debt only for cash-flowing assets, avoid consumer debt

canonical_tags.zh: 建立多元化收入与被动现金流
canonical_tags.desc: Diversify cash flow so you don't rely on a single paycheck

canonical_tags.zh: 警惕暴富诱惑与短视投机
canonical_tags.desc: Avoid hype, crypto/get-rich-quick schemes, build real value

canonical_tags.tag: Don't Neglect Health & Family for Money
canonical_tags.zh: 别为赚钱牺牲健康与家人陪伴
canonical_tags.desc: Regretting working too much at cost of health, spouse, or kids

canonical_tags.tag: Be Careful Who You Partner With
canonical_tags.zh: 慎选合伙人，谨防利益与价值观错位
canonical_tags.desc: Vet business partners thoroughly or keep full control

canonical_tags.tag: Don't Wait Too Long to Start / Invest
canonical_tags.zh: 后悔起步创业或开始投资太晚
canonical_tags.desc: Wish I had taken risks, bought assets, or started earlier

canonical_tags.zh: 切忌为虚荣买豪车奢侈品透支自己
canonical_tags.desc: Stop buying status symbols/watches/cars to impress strangers

canonical_tags.tag: Don't Surround Yourself With Toxic / Negative People
canonical_tags.zh: 远离消耗型圈子与负能量人群
canonical_tags.desc: Cut off doubters, haters, and unmotivated peers

quotes.guest_name: Beverly Hills Finance & Real Estate Investor
quotes.role_or_title: Finance Executive & Real Estate Investor (50+ LLCs)
quotes.wealth_detail: $1B business figure stated; owns 50+ real estate LLCs
quotes.video_title: Asking Billionaire Women How They Got RICH!
quotes.quote: Working really, really hard.
quotes.summary_zh: 通过极度努力工作积累财富
quotes.summary_en: Work extremely hard to build wealth.

quotes.guest_name: Los Angeles Software Engineer & Marketing Agency Founder
quotes.role_or_title: Marketing Agency Founder & Former Software Engineer
quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich
quotes.quote: early on I always just was like I hustled I figured out how to like get stuff done and I never uh I never took any shortcuts
quotes.summary_zh: 早期拼命实干解决难题，绝不走捷径
quotes.summary_en: Hustle hard early on, figure out how to get things done, and never take shortcuts.

quotes.guest_name: Los Angeles Former Model & Real Estate Developer
quotes.role_or_title: Real Estate Developer & Home Builder (Former Model)
quotes.wealth_detail: $3.5M profit on last property
quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich
quotes.quote: I'm a great believer in hard work pays off
quotes.summary_zh: 坚信努力付出终有回报
quotes.summary_en: Maintain a strong work ethic because consistent hard work pays off over time.

quotes.wealth_detail: Billionaire; built company worth $2.2B-$3.3B enterprise value (sold to Hilton)
quotes.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got Rich! (Beverly Hills)
quotes.quote: There's no free lunch, there's no lottery... you have to earn it the old-fashioned way: work hard.
quotes.summary_zh: 世上没有免费午餐与捷径，必须靠努力踏实赚钱
quotes.summary_en: Reject get-rich-quick luck—there is no free lunch, and lasting wealth must be earned through hard work.

quotes.wealth_detail: Made first $1B at age 39; sold AI company for over $1B
quotes.video_title: Asking Middle Eastern Billionaires How They Got Rich!
quotes.quote: It's like eating glass and staring into the void every day... You have to chew cactus, and working with governments is the ultimate cactus.
quotes.summary_zh: 创业如同每天嚼仙人掌，必须做好承受极大艰难的准备
quotes.summary_en: Expect extreme daily hardship in entrepreneurship and selling to major enterprises or governments.

quotes.wealth_detail: First million at age 22; within the $10M+ single-year income range
quotes.video_title: Asking Middle Eastern Billionaires How They Got Rich!
quotes.quote: Commitment, repeating, and don't give up. The future is going to be there one day. It's going to work.
quotes.summary_zh: 保持承诺并持续投入，绝不轻言放弃
quotes.summary_en: Stay committed, keep repeating the effort, and never give up until it works.

quotes.guest_name: Dubai Property Developer & Shark Tank Dubai Judge
quotes.role_or_title: Real Estate Developer & Shark Tank Dubai Judge
quotes.wealth_detail: Sold over $10B of real estate last year; runs billion-dollar private property development company
quotes.video_title: Asking Middle Eastern Billionaires How They Got Rich!
quotes.quote: It requires a special spark, a special determination and an ability to persist beyond all odds.
quotes.summary_zh: 创业需要非凡的决心，在逆境与自我怀疑中死磕到底
quotes.summary_en: Persist through moments of doubt with extraordinary determination and belief that your work matters.

quotes.wealth_detail: $4M-$5M/yr (current year); multiple 7-figure entrepreneur
quotes.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich! (Florida)
quotes.quote: Starting a business is hard... Well, it's hard being broke... So, you got to choose what hard you want.
quotes.summary_zh: 创业难、穷困也难，选择你愿意承担的困难
quotes.summary_en: Building a business is hard, but staying broke year after year is also hard—choose which hard you want.

quotes.wealth_detail: $300M net worth; $100M personal annual income
quotes.video_title: Asking Dubai Moguls How They Got Rich!
quotes.quote: if everyone wants to leave I go there and work overnight right you just don't give up you just keep going
quotes.summary_zh: 团队下班后依然通宵死磕，绝不轻言放弃
quotes.summary_en: Outwork everyone, stay late overnight when needed, and refuse to give up.

quotes.guest_name: Las Vegas Convention Center Lamborghini Real Estate Investor
quotes.wealth_detail: Tens of millions of dollars in annual revenue (multiple 8-figure entrepreneur)
quotes.video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH! (Las Vegas)
quotes.quote: I sacrificed my health, I sacrificed my friend groups, I sacrificed my family, I sacrificed my sanity... every single part of my life, and I look back now and I'm grateful that I did.
quotes.summary_zh: 成大事需极度投入，甘愿为目标承受牺牲
quotes.summary_en: Be willing to endure extreme sacrifice and total commitment to build extraordinary wealth.

quotes.wealth_detail: $5B cumulative company sales; $850M revenue last year and projecting $1B this year
quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich
quotes.quote: Sales doesn't require talent... I'm going to work my ass off. I'm going to invest in leads and I'm going to invest in me.
quotes.summary_zh: 销售不靠天赋，全靠加倍努力与大量获客
quotes.summary_en: Beat talent in sales by outworking competitors and investing heavily in leads.

quotes.role_or_title: Founder, Logic Electronic Cigarettes (formerly Personal Trainer)
quotes.wealth_detail: $100M peak single-year revenue; started with $10K and sold company to Japan Tobacco via Goldman Sachs in under 5 years
quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich
quotes.quote: My secret was going store to store, mouth to mouth... every week I log 140 hours.
quotes.summary_zh: 每周工作140小时，挨家门店街头地推
quotes.summary_en: Outwork everyone with 140-hour weeks doing door-to-door store outreach.

quotes.guest_name: Boca Raton Private Equity Executive's Spouse
quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich
quotes.quote: I say work hard. Work hard. Follow your dreams.
quotes.summary_zh: 努力工作，坚持追逐自己的梦想
quotes.summary_en: Work hard and follow your dreams.

quotes.wealth_detail: 10 billion dirhams max single-year earnings; billionaire (owns 6 Rolls-Royces)
quotes.video_title: Asking Dubai Billionaires How They Got RICH!
quotes.quote: for you to make money you don't need to have money you can make it on your own provided you have proper ideas proper work culture and some special Innovative things which you want to do
quotes.summary_zh: 白手起家靠的是好创意、工作文化与创新
quotes.summary_en: Most billionaires are first-generation; you do not need starting capital if you bring strong ideas, work culture, and innovation.

quotes.role_or_title: Investor & Former Army Green Beret (PE, VC & Investment Banking)
quotes.wealth_detail: $11M/yr peak revenue
quotes.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich! (Scottsdale)
quotes.quote: stay in the fight stay in the fight stay in the fight man
quotes.summary_zh: 无论遭遇何种逆境都要坚持战斗绝不退缩
quotes.summary_en: Stay in the fight and never quit when facing adversity.

quotes.role_or_title: Phoenix Suns Owner & Mortgage Company CEO
quotes.wealth_detail: Billionaire (became billionaire around age 40-41; company had $3B+ year)
quotes.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got So Rich! (Scottsdale)
quotes.quote: Every day. In early, stay late, grinding. That's what it takes to be great... my work ethic has been my greatest asset because I'm willing to do things that others are unwilling to do.
quotes.summary_zh: 早到晚走每天拼尽全力不松懈
quotes.summary_en: Come in early, stay late, never relax, and outwork competitors every single day.

quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Dallas)
quotes.quote: you got to want to hustle right you gotta want to work harder the next guy
quotes.summary_zh: 具备拼搏精神，比别人更加努力工作
quotes.summary_en: Have the drive to hustle and consistently outwork the person next to you.

quotes.role_or_title: Founder / Industrialist, Dangote Group (Oil & Gas Refinery, Petrochemicals, Fertilizer)
quotes.wealth_detail: $30B net worth (Forbes at time of interview; $50B+ post-listing per host); $40B+ refinery; $10B Q1 revenue
quotes.video_title: Asking Africa’s Richest Man How He Made $30 Billion!
quotes.quote: Don't get discouraged... There must be ups and downs even in life. Today you are healthy, tomorrow you have challenges of health. But once you are focused, you know what you are doing, you'll get there.
quotes.summary_zh: 直面健康与人生起伏，专注目标不轻言放弃
quotes.summary_en: Stay focused and refuse to get discouraged through life's inevitable ups, downs, and health challenges.

quotes.role_or_title: Oil and Gas Entrepreneur / Business Owner
quotes.wealth_detail: Company revenues >$1B/yr; closed >$1B oil & gas transaction
quotes.video_title: Asking Africa’s Richest Man How He Made $30 Billion!
quotes.quote: Once you can drive yourself with the zeal, determination, you can always make a difference and be a good entrepreneur.
quotes.summary_zh: 靠热情与决心驱动自己做好创业者
quotes.summary_en: Drive yourself with zeal and determination to succeed as an entrepreneur.

quotes.wealth_detail: $30M in a single year (this year); bought $600k Rolls-Royce in cash
quotes.video_title: Asking Dubai Supercar Owners How They Got RICH!
quotes.quote: whatever you want you can have it as long as you're willing to bleed for what you're asking
quotes.summary_zh: 想拥有梦想生活，必须愿为目标流血并付出代价
quotes.summary_en: You can achieve anything you want if you are willing to bleed and pay the price for it.

quotes.guest_name: Dubai World's Largest Water Park Owner ('Aquaman')
quotes.role_or_title: Owner of the world's largest water park
quotes.wealth_detail: Eight figures in a single year (stated by host); previously $1.8M–$4M in debt
quotes.video_title: Asking Dubai Supercar Owners How They Got RICH!
quotes.quote: I was bankrupt twice, sued 24 times... the genius thing I [did] is never quit
quotes.summary_zh: 永不放弃，经历破产与官司仍坚持到底
quotes.summary_en: Never quit even after going bankrupt twice and facing 24 lawsuits.

quotes.video_title: Asking Miami Moguls How They Got Rich!
quotes.quote: There's never financial freedom, you always got to work harder and you always got to thrive to get more and more.
quotes.summary_zh: 永不懈怠，必须不断努力追求更高目标
quotes.summary_en: Never become complacent; keep working harder and striving for growth.

quotes.video_title: Asking Miami Moguls How They Got Rich!
quotes.quote: If you want to put in the work you can make it, but you got to be able to sleep at the business.
quotes.summary_zh: 要想做成生意就得做好睡在店里的准备
quotes.summary_en: Be willing to outwork everyone and live at your business until it succeeds.

quotes.wealth_detail: $150M/yr in business (Jewel cigarettes)
quotes.video_title: Asking Miami Moguls How They Got Rich!
quotes.quote: I started over again out of the trunk of a car at 40.
quotes.summary_zh: 绝境不屈，40岁也能在汽车后备箱里东山再起
quotes.summary_en: Refuse to quit after near-bankruptcy and be willing to rebuild from rock bottom.

quotes.role_or_title: Entrepreneur & Systems Creator (Direct Sales & Digital Products)
quotes.wealth_detail: Over $2B in sales
quotes.video_title: Asking Miami Moguls How They Got Rich!
quotes.quote: Work your ass off in your vehicle and your business.
quotes.summary_zh: 在赚钱的主业中拼尽全力深耕打拼
quotes.summary_en: Work relentlessly in your primary income vehicle to fuel your asset investments.

quotes.role_or_title: Founder & Owner, 2nd Largest US Recycling Company
quotes.video_title: Asking Houston Moguls How They Got Rich!
quotes.quote: I probably could have gone broke probably four times in the last 30 years and it just you got to keep finding a way
quotes.summary_zh: 濒临破产也要保持韧性，想方设法找资金活下去
quotes.summary_en: Get creative with financing—including customer capital—and relentlessly find a way when near bankruptcy.

quotes.role_or_title: Digital Marketing Company Owner & Licensed Realtor
quotes.wealth_detail: $4.3M highest single year
quotes.video_title: Asking Houston Moguls How They Got Rich!
quotes.quote: you cannot give up even if you don't get the ratings you don't get the support you need you got to keep on going
quotes.summary_zh: 即使没有流量和支持也别放弃，坚持下去才有突破
quotes.summary_en: Keep pushing even without immediate traction or support, because one breakthrough moment can change everything.

quotes.guest_name: Scott (Public Business Services Company Former CEO)
quotes.role_or_title: Former CEO (Public Business Services Company, 42,000-43,000 Employees)
quotes.wealth_detail: Host cites $12B+ net worth; led multi-billion dollar/yr revenue public company for 18 years as CEO
quotes.video_title: Asking Palm Beach Billionaires How They Got So RICH!
quotes.quote: Every day I went to my boss at the end of the day and I said, 'I'm done with what I had to do today. Is there anything else you want me to do?' ... my advice is be your boss's right-hand person... You got to work your butt off.
quotes.summary_zh: 每天主动找上司领额外任务，拼命干成其得力助手
quotes.summary_en: Volunteer for extra work daily, execute at a high level, and become your boss's right-hand person.

quotes.wealth_detail: $1M in a single day; $1M per artwork edition
quotes.video_title: Asking NY Billionaires If They Believe in God!
quotes.quote: I'm always comfortably uncomfortable. When you're an entrepreneur, you're never comfortable. You know why? Because no success nor failure is ever final.
quotes.summary_zh: 习惯保持危机感，胜败皆非终点
quotes.summary_en: Stay comfortably uncomfortable as an entrepreneur because neither success nor failure is ever final.

quotes.wealth_detail: Sold Freshly for $1.5B (owned 10% at exit); $550M in annual sales
quotes.video_title: Asking NY Billionaires If They Believe in God!
quotes.quote: They work harder than everyone else. At the end of the day there's no shortcut. You got to be willing to put in the work.
quotes.summary_zh: 没有捷径，唯有比所有人都更拼命
quotes.summary_en: There are no shortcuts; outworking everyone else compounds into success over time.

quotes.wealth_detail: $650M biggest company; $600M made in a single year
quotes.video_title: Asking NY Billionaires If They Believe in God!
quotes.quote: Don't ever give up. Everybody can succeed in this country. Work hard, play hard.
quotes.summary_zh: 永远不要放弃，拼命工作也尽情生活
quotes.summary_en: Never give up regardless of doubters; work hard and play hard.

quotes.wealth_detail: 80M/yr best year
quotes.video_title: Asking Hong Kong Billionaires How They Got Rich!
quotes.quote: Every moment you need to think of your business... Every day I would go to my office. No matter it's holiday, I need to go back to office and read some of the documents.
quotes.summary_zh: 全天候投入工作，节假日也持续钻研业务
quotes.summary_en: Be willing to sacrifice personal time, think about your business day and night, and keep fighting even on holidays.

quotes.role_or_title: Founder & Former CEO of Cable TV Company
quotes.wealth_detail: Sold cable TV company for over $3B in 1999
quotes.video_title: Inside America's Billionaire Neighborhood (Beverly Hills)
quotes.quote: Never give up. Be true to yourself and stick with your ideas. Never, ever give up and pursue those ideas.
quotes.summary_zh: 忠于自我与想法，面对质疑永不放弃
quotes.summary_en: Stay true to yourself, stick with your ideas, and never give up even when people think you are crazy.

quotes.wealth_detail: Sold company to PepsiCo for $2 billion
quotes.video_title: Asking Billionaires If They Believe In God!
quotes.quote: Everybody wants what people don't have. But the question is, are you willing to do what others won't do to get it? ... to be an entrepreneur and have the things that others can't get, like there's no balance.
quotes.summary_zh: 想要超越常人的成就，就得做别人不愿做的事
quotes.summary_en: Achieving extraordinary entrepreneurial results requires doing what others won't and accepting no early work-life balance.

quotes.guest_name: Austin Marine Veteran & Tech Investor (The Veteran Fund)
quotes.role_or_title: Managing Partner at The Veteran Fund & Portfolio Owner
quotes.wealth_detail: Portfolio of 120 companies generating billions in annual revenue across the board
quotes.video_title: Asking Billionaires If They Believe In God!
quotes.quote: At the early stage, when you're a startup founder, it's hard. You need that resilience. You need that grit to carry on.
quotes.summary_zh: 初创期极度艰难，需要极强韧性与毅力坚持下去
quotes.summary_en: Early-stage startup founders need resilience and grit to endure hardship and keep going.

quotes.wealth_detail: Sold tech company for several hundred million dollars
quotes.video_title: Asking Billionaires If They Believe In God!
quotes.quote: I get rich? ... worked hard.
quotes.summary_zh: 靠努力工作积累财富
quotes.summary_en: Attributed his wealth from tech exits to hard work.

quotes.wealth_detail: >$30M in best single year; bought $25M mansion; $623,000 in June from 18 Kick streams
quotes.video_title: I Asked Adin Ross How He Made $100 Million
quotes.quote: I've been doing it for a long time, a long time before anyone really knew who I was on and off for 10 years.
quotes.summary_zh: 成名前默默坚持十年，成功需要长期积累
quotes.summary_en: Overnight success takes years of unrecognized grinding before momentum and luck finally compound.

quotes.guest_name: Lugano Switzerland Family Office Manager in Coral Gables
quotes.wealth_detail: Manages $1.2B (family office); started with a few million dollars
quotes.video_title: I Asked Adin Ross How He Made $100 Million
quotes.quote: Determination, focus, determination... Never give up.
quotes.summary_zh: 白手起家需要决心、专注与永不放弃
quotes.summary_en: For anyone who does not come from family wealth, success requires relentless determination, focus, and never giving up.

quotes.wealth_detail: Almost $5 billion in a single year; multi-billion-dollar real estate business
quotes.video_title: Asking One of the Richest Men in Dubai How He Got Rich!
quotes.quote: Comfort is the most dangerous drug. You got to learn to be comfortable being uncomfortable because the moment you become complacent and comfortable is the moment you have no drive to achieve more success in life.
quotes.summary_zh: 安逸是最危险的毒药，要学会在不适中保持冲劲
quotes.summary_en: Treat comfort as dangerous and stay comfortable being uncomfortable so complacency never kills your drive.

quotes.wealth_detail: First $1M at 23; lost $55M overnight; scaled company to $150M
quotes.video_title: Asking London Billionaires How They Got Rich!
quotes.quote: Everyone knows the formula but they can't execute it. You have to be continually focused... have the stomach for the sacrifice.
quotes.summary_zh: 执行力胜过天赋点子，持续专注并愿承受牺牲
quotes.summary_en: Execution and focus beat natural talent and great ideas—put the work in and have the stomach for sacrifice.

quotes.wealth_detail: Over $100M/yr (9 digits) in company revenue
quotes.video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH!
quotes.quote: I worked at least six seven jobs every summer I'd be busy you know I'd never just be chilling at home

quotes.summary_en: Treat daily rejection and embarrassment as normal proof that you are pushing hard and taking risks.

quotes.summary_en: Never feel sorry for yourself when hitting rock bottom; take full responsibility, save yourself, and keep pushing forward.

quotes.summary_en: Let go of past mistakes and regrets, forgive, and keep all your focus on the present and future.

quotes.summary_en: Do not give up after a short-term flop or backlash; keep releasing work and give your creations years to pay off.

quotes.summary_en: Do not fear failure; take your losses, learn from them, and let each one lead to your next win.

quotes.summary_en: Everyone experiences failures daily; recall your past successes and move past setbacks quickly rather than dwelling on them.

quotes.quote: Be intentional about what it is that you want to accomplish... if you're intentional, you're zeroed in, laser focused on your goal, then you're probably going to get there.
quotes.summary_zh: 明确目标并保持极度专注，切忌摇摆不定
quotes.summary_en: Be intentional and laser-focused on your goal rather than drifting without direction.

advice_rankings.tag: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep
advice_rankings.tag_zh: 量入为出、克制消费膨胀
advice_rankings.desc: Keep expenses low, save aggressively, don't inflate lifestyle

quotes.wealth_detail: Company valued at $3B when sold in 2018 (100% ownership prior)
quotes.video_title: Asking Billionaire Women How They Got RICH!
quotes.quote: Don't start spending money left and right. When I started, I was driving a beat up car that I spent $200. ... I had a bigger goals and it was important for me to save every penny to put into my business.
quotes.summary_zh: 初期拒绝虚荣消费，开200美元破车省钱创业
quotes.summary_en: Avoid status spending and drive a cheap car to save every penny early on.

quotes.wealth_detail: $200M annual revenue
quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich
quotes.quote: I would split my check three ways and I would live on a third of it one would go towards IRS and savings and then the other one would go towards a reserve account
quotes.summary_zh: 收入三等分，只用三分之一生活并留备用金
quotes.summary_en: Divide every paycheck into thirds: live on one-third, set aside one-third for taxes/savings, and lock one-third in an untouched reserve.

quotes.role_or_title: Hollywood Actor & Former WWE Professional Wrestler
quotes.wealth_detail: Over $10M in a single year
quotes.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich! (Florida)
quotes.quote: Always live beneath your means... I don't need a Bugatti. I'm not paying $3 $5 million for a car cuz I don't need one.
quotes.summary_zh: 始终量入为出，避免为不需要的奢侈品挥霍
quotes.summary_en: Live below your means and keep cash in the bank instead of buying extravagant wants after losing everything once to foreclosure.

quotes.wealth_detail: $1.5B company valuation ($100M+ raised)
quotes.video_title: Asking Dubai Moguls How They Got Rich!
quotes.quote: it's actually good to be broke when you're starting up because you realize the importance of money even when you make a lot of money you don't spend that much money
quotes.summary_zh: 经历过贫穷更懂金钱价值，富了也保持节制
quotes.summary_en: Starting broke teaches you the value of money so you avoid overspending even after becoming wealthy.

quotes.wealth_detail: $12M annual turnover
quotes.video_title: Asking Dubai Moguls How They Got Rich!
quotes.quote: my mindset was no okay you know what I have to save save save invest and once we reach a certain threshold then we can get something to reward ourselves
quotes.summary_zh: 初期砍掉非必要订阅消费，先储蓄再投资
quotes.summary_en: Cut out unnecessary subscriptions and lifestyle expenses early on to aggressively save and invest first.

quotes.role_or_title: Phoenix Suns Owner & Mortgage Company CEO
quotes.wealth_detail: Billionaire (became billionaire around age 40-41; company had $3B+ year)
quotes.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got So Rich! (Scottsdale)
quotes.quote: Live beneath your means. People think always, you make money, you want to go spend it... I lived beneath my means the whole time... driving around on a used, you know, Explorer
quotes.summary_zh: 始终量入为出拒绝铺张消费
quotes.summary_en: Live well below your means and avoid inflating your lifestyle even as income grows.

quotes.wealth_detail: $11M peak single-year NFL income
quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Dallas)
quotes.quote: you got to get the right Financial advice around you... because you know you like nice things you'll spend but you need somebody that's gonna be that backbone to be like hey hold on... got to put this away
quotes.summary_zh: 聘请靠谱财务顾问约束消费，强制储蓄
quotes.summary_en: Get trustworthy financial advisors who act as a backbone to stop overspending on luxuries and force savings.

quotes.role_or_title: Former COO of Health Management Systems & Angel Investor
quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Dallas)
quotes.quote: spend about half of what you make and always keep your powder dry because there's always an investment that you could use a little bit of money on... always keep enough cash on the sideline
quotes.summary_zh: 只花收入的一半，保留充足现金把握低价投资机会
quotes.summary_en: Spend roughly half of your income and keep liquid cash ('dry powder') ready to deploy when undervalued investment opportunities arise.

quotes.role_or_title: Former Addiction Treatment Business Founder & Real Estate Investor
quotes.wealth_detail: Sold business for $115M; sold ~$40M underlying real estate; $20M home; $100M+ in a single year
quotes.video_title: Asking Miami Moguls How They Got Rich!
quotes.quote: Reduce your lifestyle a little bit, save your money, take your savings and put that savings into an appreciating, cash-flowing asset.
quotes.summary_zh: 降低生活消费并攒钱投入升值生息资产
quotes.summary_en: Trim lifestyle spending, save aggressively, and buy appreciating cash-flowing assets.

quotes.role_or_title: Entrepreneur & Systems Creator (Direct Sales & Digital Products)
quotes.wealth_detail: Over $2B in sales
quotes.video_title: Asking Miami Moguls How They Got Rich!
quotes.quote: Don't spend your earned income, invest it in assets.
quotes.summary_zh: 别把主动收入花掉，要将其投入资产
quotes.summary_en: Avoid spending earned income on luxuries until passive asset cash flow covers your goals.

quotes.role_or_title: Entrepreneur & Executive (RV Industry / Bed Bath & Beyond Buyer)
quotes.wealth_detail: Became a millionaire at 27; public company made $900M in single-year bottom-line profit
quotes.video_title: Inside America's Billionaire Neighborhood (Beverly Hills)
quotes.quote: I hang with people that like to invest in themselves, in their employees, in their business, and what they're doing. ... They'd rather live house poor and business rich.
quotes.summary_zh: 坚持住房节俭而企业富足，避免生活膨胀
quotes.summary_en: Live house poor and business rich by keeping personal lifestyle modest while compounding capital in your business and people.

quotes.role_or_title: California Real Estate Investor & NBA Courtside Superfan
quotes.wealth_detail: Mansion reportedly worth $100M+; owns 1961 Rolls-Royce worth $1M (bought for $12K); declined to confirm billionaire status
quotes.video_title: Inside America's Billionaire Neighborhood (Beverly Hills)
quotes.quote: I just make it a priority. I'm pretty good at figuring out how to spend as little as possible for the best seats.
quotes.summary_zh: 把钱花在热爱之事上，并精打细算追求高性价比
quotes.summary_en: Allocate spending intentionally toward your top priorities while figuring out how to pay as little as possible for maximum quality.

quotes.guest_name: Miami Design District Midwest Real Estate Developer
quotes.role_or_title: Retired Real Estate Developer & Former Banker
quotes.wealth_detail: Middle eight figures (~$50M) in biggest single year
quotes.video_title: I Asked Adin Ross How He Made $100 Million
quotes.quote: If you're young and you start making money, keep your hands out of your pockets.
quotes.summary_zh: 年轻开始赚钱时管住花钱的手
quotes.summary_en: When you start earning money while young, keep your hands out of your pockets and avoid spending it prematurely.

quotes.wealth_detail: Over $100M in a single year; drives a $520K Rolls-Royce bought at auction for $175K and states he could buy 100 brand new
quotes.video_title: Asking Beverly Hills Billionaires How They Got So RICH!
quotes.quote: The best financial advice in the world, save your money and don't waste it on stupid stuff. This car was 520 grand. I bought it at an auction for 175.
quotes.summary_zh: 攒住钱别乱挥霍，豪车也只买拍卖低价款
quotes.summary_en: Save aggressively, avoid wasteful spending, and buy luxury assets at deep discounts.

quotes.wealth_detail: $20M peak single-year income (2018)
quotes.video_title: Asking Monaco Billionaires How They Got Rich!
quotes.quote: When you make millions, you got to have escrow accounts and you got to put money up where it makes money for you and you can't touch... You got to save money, bro.
quotes.summary_zh: 把赚到的钱锁进不可动用的账户并储蓄生钱
quotes.summary_en: Lock money in untouchable escrow accounts that generate returns instead of blowing it young.

quotes.wealth_detail: Over $1B/year in sales; sold Kind company; confirmed billionaire
quotes.video_title: I Asked Tom Cruise How He Made $600 Million
quotes.quote: A man that's too proud to pick up a penny is not worth a penny... Mind the pennies, and the dollars will mind themselves.
quotes.summary_zh: 保持节俭谦逊重视并省下每一分钱
quotes.summary_en: Stay humble, appreciate every penny, and stretch every dollar.

quotes.wealth_detail: $23M revenue last year; projected $32M-$35M revenue this year (13 years in business)
quotes.video_title: Asking Texan Billionaires How They Got Rich!
quotes.quote: Make more money than you spend. Invest that money. Save that money. Invest that money.
quotes.summary_zh: 入大于出，存钱并持续投资
quotes.summary_en: Spend less than you earn, save the difference, and consistently invest that money.

quotes.wealth_detail: $15M/yr; $5.5M in a single day
quotes.video_title: I Was Broke.. Found God.. Now I Make $15M/Year
quotes.quote: I upgraded my lifestyle way too soon... if you can live off of 10% of your income, now you're in a place where the bottom can fall out and you're still going to be okay.
quotes.summary_zh: 切忌过早消费升级，只花收入的一成留足缓冲
quotes.summary_en: Resist upgrading your lifestyle too early; live on a small fraction of your income to stay resilient.

quotes.wealth_detail: $50M yacht; company revenue close to $1B/year ($100M in first 2 years)
quotes.video_title: Asking Billionaire Women How They Got RICH!
quotes.quote: Save money. Stop wasting money on the fancy shoes. I didn't buy all the fancy shoes. I didn't buy the cars... We did not ever even buy a house until we could afford to have that same amount of money in the bank.
quotes.summary_zh: 克制奢侈消费、坚持存钱，直到存款远超资产价格再买
quotes.summary_en: Delay luxury spending and save aggressively until you have matching cash reserves in the bank.

quotes.guest_name: Palm Beach Private Equity Founder (84 Companies)
quotes.role_or_title: Private Equity Investor & Multi-Business Owner (82-84+ Companies)
quotes.wealth_detail: Became millionaire at 26; earned six figures/month in mid-20s; owns 82-84+ companies including one personally owned business generating over $3B
quotes.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich! (Palm Beach)
quotes.quote: If you spend a dollar, you have to go make two... Don't spend, discipline yourself to stack it up.
quotes.summary_zh: 自律減少花費，明白花一元得賺兩元來補齊
quotes.summary_en: Discipline yourself not to overspend and focus on stacking capital.

quotes.wealth_detail: $550K peak single-month earnings; previously lost $12M in one year
quotes.video_title: Asking Miami Millionaires How to Get RICH!
quotes.quote: don't go crazy with the money cuz nothing ever lasts... save your money
quotes.summary_zh: 赚钱后切忌挥霍，学会储蓄留存本金
quotes.summary_en: Don't blow your earnings on lifestyle because nothing lasts forever; save your money.

quotes.role_or_title: Franchise Owner (Formerly 155 Five Guys Locations) & NBA Legend
quotes.wealth_detail: Became a millionaire at age 18
quotes.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews SHAQ
quotes.quote: One piece of advice was to save 75% and have fun with 25%.
quotes.summary_zh: 将75%收入存下，只用25%消费享乐
quotes.summary_en: Save 75% of your earnings and limit fun or lifestyle spending to 25%.

quotes.wealth_detail: $16M highest single year (2020)
quotes.video_title: I Interviewed 30 Billionaires... Here’s What I Learned
quotes.quote: Stay small enough long enough, you'll be big enough soon enough. That means keep the expenses low. Whenever your money is high, don't be in a rush to actually get the color in and all the jewelry and everything like that.
quotes.summary_zh: 保持低消费不炫耀，避免生活方式膨胀
quotes.summary_en: Keep living expenses low and resist buying jewelry or luxury status symbols even when income spikes.

quotes.wealth_detail: $25M single-year peak income; became a millionaire at age 21; 11-year NFL career
quotes.video_title: Asking NY Billionaires How They Got Rich!
quotes.quote: I just let it sit. I really worked off my endorsement money. I didn't really touch my game money.
quotes.summary_zh: 只花代言收入，绝不动用比赛薪水本金
quotes.summary_en: Live off secondary/endorsement income and leave your primary earnings untouched so you avoid going broke.

quotes.guest_name: Houston ER Doctor & Medical Facility Founder (Rolls-Royce Owner)
quotes.role_or_title: Emergency Medicine Physician & Medical Facility Entrepreneur
quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich
quotes.quote: you might start saving up money then you're like well let me buy this first let me buy that first and now you don't have the capital but if you can focus and just save as much as you can
quotes.summary_zh: 克制早期消费欲望，专注攒下创业本金
quotes.summary_en: Resist buying discretionary items early on and focus on saving capital to fund your first venture.

quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich
quotes.quote: I lived with enough money just to make ends meet and all the rest of it went to pay down debt once you get out of debt now you become much freer
quotes.summary_zh: 保持极简开销，把余钱全力用于还债
quotes.summary_en: Live strictly on what you need to make ends meet and put all extra cash toward paying off business and personal debt.

quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich
quotes.quote: you have to live below your means and if you can live below your means I think you could endure bad times you're pretty safe
quotes.summary_zh: 量入为出才能在艰难时期安然度过
quotes.summary_en: Living below your means protects you from overextending and keeps you safe during downturns.

quotes.video_title: Asking Wall Street Moguls How They Got Rich!
quotes.quote: Best money advice I can give, save. Save everything you possibly can... You can save your way to being financially secure in the future.
quotes.summary_zh: 尽全力存钱，这是通往未来财务安全的基石
quotes.summary_en: Save aggressively early on to establish future financial security.

quotes.video_title: A 60 Year Old Millionaire Shares What Actually Made Him RICH!
quotes.quote: never just assuming that the spigot is never going to, you know, get shut off or run dry... sock some away for a rainy day because that that rainy day can turn into a rainy decade.
quotes.summary_zh: 居安思危留足储备，防范漫长低谷期
quotes.summary_en: Never assume good income will last forever; save aggressively because a rainy day can become a rainy decade.

quotes.guest_name: Wall Street Auto Industry Analyst (42-Year Veteran)
quotes.role_or_title: Finance & Auto Industry Analysis Firm Owner (42 years on Wall Street)
quotes.wealth_detail: Became a millionaire at age 35; peak single-year revenue "in the millions"
quotes.video_title: I Asked Wall Street Millionaires How They Got RICH!
quotes.quote: save every Penny you can ... of course [invest] but save your money ... save more money
quotes.summary_zh: 尽一切可能攒下每一分钱并去投资
quotes.summary_en: Save every penny you can while investing, especially when you are young.

quotes.guest_name: Brickell Software Engineer & App Company Owner
quotes.role_or_title: Software Engineer & App Development Company Owner
quotes.wealth_detail: ~$2M/yr (peak single year)
quotes.video_title: Asking Miami Millionaires How They Got Rich
quotes.quote: understanding the whole 70 30 rule whatever you earn you know you want to be able to save 70 of it and pretty much operate off of 30
quotes.summary_zh: 遵循70/30法则，存下七成收入运转
quotes.summary_en: Follow the 70/30 rule by saving 70% of everything you earn and operating strictly off the remaining 30%.

quotes.wealth_detail: $100M+ exit (nine-figure exit); millionaire in 20s, liquidity event at 50
quotes.video_title: Asking Billionaires What To Invest In!
quotes.quote: When I got my exit, when the wire came through, I was sitting at Taco Bell ordering a number three. Stay small enough long enough, you'll be big enough soon enough.
quotes.summary_zh: 保持谦逊简朴，长期稳扎稳打终会做大做强
quotes.summary_en: Stay grounded and stay lean long enough without chasing flashy spending even after a massive exit.

quotes.wealth_detail: Couple billion dollars/year revenue (under $3B); billionaire before launching Arnold Palmer (host cites $6B+ net worth)
quotes.video_title: Asking the RICHEST People in the World How They Got RICH!
quotes.quote: You don't have to be a billionaire. You have to be happy, right? And too often... when costs rise and our profits shrink. I say sometimes you got to tighten your belt.
quotes.summary_zh: 成本上升时勒紧腰带不盲目追求奢华
quotes.summary_en: Prioritize happiness over chasing wealth metrics and tighten your belt when margins compress.

quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Philadelphia)
quotes.quote: It's not how much you earn, it's how much you save and invest... I lived relatively conservative considering how much I earned.
quotes.summary_zh: 决定财富的是储蓄投资率，保守消费早退休
quotes.summary_en: Wealth comes from how much you save and invest, not just income; living conservatively lets you retire early.

quotes.wealth_detail: Company worth $300M-$500M; made $30M-$50M in a single year
quotes.video_title: Asking Mega Mansion Owners How They Got Rich!
quotes.quote: You have to manage your money. You don't live above your means... protect what you have... when things are getting tough, you need to figure out how to stop it, how to control it.
quotes.summary_zh: 量入为出控制开支，用信托妥善保护资产
quotes.summary_en: Manage your money prudently, avoid living above your means, protect wealth in trusts, and tighten spending quickly when times get tough.

quotes.role_or_title: Founder & Owner, Effects Management Solutions (Labor Force Management)
quotes.wealth_detail: $300M/yr revenue company (100% owned); $21M car collection
quotes.video_title: I Had to Beg Borrow & Steal.. Now I Make $300 Million
quotes.quote: No matter how much money you make, you still got to live within your means.
quotes.summary_zh: 无论赚多少钱，都必须坚持量入为出
quotes.summary_en: Maintain strict personal spending discipline regardless of how high your income rises.

quotes.role_or_title: Labor Force Management Founder ("The Houston Mogul")
quotes.wealth_detail: ~$375M annual business revenue (up ~25% from ~$300M previously)
quotes.video_title: Inside Texas’s Billionaire Town (Highland Park)
quotes.quote: Get rid of all your Amazon deliveries, get rid of your $8 a day coffees. You need to be using money to expand your future.
quotes.summary_zh: 戒掉日常无效消费，把钱用于投资未来增长
quotes.summary_en: Eliminate frivolous daily spending and treat money as a tool to invest aggressively in big opportunities.

quotes.role_or_title: Entrepreneur & Investor (Life Insurance, Real Estate, Waste Management)
quotes.wealth_detail: $752M annual revenue (2023); tens of millions personal annual income; $100M company exits
quotes.video_title: I Was Bankrupt… Now I’ve Made $3 Billion
quotes.quote: I got a Honda Accord, but I got tens of millions of dollars in equity over here.
quotes.summary_zh: 保持朴素生活，把钱留给股权增值而非消费
quotes.summary_en: Practice delayed gratification and drive a modest car while building tens of millions in business equity.

quotes.role_or_title: Venture Capitalist & Founder of RxList / Medable
quotes.wealth_detail: Millionaire at 28; sold RxList (33x); Medable at $2.1B valuation (close to billionaire)
quotes.video_title: Asking San Francisco Millionaires How They Got Rich!
quotes.quote: started saving my money I got good jobs I moved around yeah so I just hustled
quotes.summary_zh: 早期坚持储蓄并全力拼搏积累
quotes.summary_en: Save money early, land good jobs, stay mobile for opportunity, and hustle relentlessly.

quotes.wealth_detail: $40M/yr top-line revenue; $10M+ liquid capital
quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Dallas)
quotes.quote: during times of good be the guy that stacks cash, when times are great be the one that constantly puts money away... waiting for opportunities
quotes.summary_zh: 顺境时积极储备现金，等待低谷抄底机会
quotes.summary_en: Stack cash aggressively during good economic times so you have dry powder to buy discounted assets when others are forced to sell.

quotes.guest_name: Miami E-Commerce, M&A & Real Estate Founder
quotes.wealth_detail: $5M gross ($3.9M net) last year; $6M YTD on track for $10M gross ($7.9M net) this year
quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Miami)
quotes.quote: I know more millionaires who have sat back live below their means and built their funds over time... the best financial advice I could do is live below your means
quotes.summary_zh: 保持量入为出，避免生活方式膨胀
quotes.summary_en: Live below your means and steadily build your reserves over time instead of inflating your lifestyle.

quotes.wealth_detail: $100M net worth (title); added ~$85M to net worth in 3-4 years; $5M+ private jet ($2M+/yr to operate)
quotes.video_title: I Had $78... Now I’m Worth $100 Million
quotes.quote: You can never forget about what things cost in business cuz then you'll overspend.
quotes.summary_zh: 时刻牢记事物真实成本，避免过度消费
quotes.summary_en: No matter how wealthy you become, never lose sight of fair market value or overpay out of convenience.

quotes.guest_name: Orlando Soap & Feminine Hygiene Brand Founder
quotes.role_or_title: Founder, Eight-Figure Soap & Feminine Hygiene Brand
quotes.wealth_detail: Strong eight figures/year (over $20M/yr); first million at age 25
quotes.video_title: Asking Self-Made Female Billionaires How They Got Rich!
quotes.quote: Your business money is not your lifestyle money... I was a multi-millionaire driving a Nissan Altima and living in a 700-sq-ft apartment.
quotes.summary_zh: 严格区分公司资金与个人消费，成名后仍保持节俭
quotes.summary_en: Strictly separate business revenue from personal lifestyle spending even after becoming a multi-millionaire.

quotes.role_or_title: Luxury Jeweler & Hypercar Dealer (Former Watch Dealer)
quotes.wealth_detail: Made ~$25M in a single year during COVID; drives a £4.5M hypercar
quotes.video_title: Asking Billionaires How Much They Pay In Taxes!
quotes.quote: Broke is if you overspent your money or you up somewhere in life.
quotes.summary_zh: 量入为出，避免过度消费导致财务崩盘
quotes.summary_en: Avoid overspending what you earn; reckless spending is what keeps people broke.

quotes.guest_name: Mr. Tony (Nigerian Banking & Family Office Billionaire)
quotes.role_or_title: Founder of Ezodings (Family Office: Banking, Oil & Gas, Power, Hospitality, Real Estate; Age 63)
quotes.wealth_detail: Confirmed billionaire; business valuation over $16B; committed $100M+ to young African entrepreneurs; owns 4th private jet
quotes.video_title: Asking Nigerian Billionaires How They Got RICH!
quotes.quote: Deciding first time not to buy a car and rather save the money and use the money to acquire a property... I didn't have a car for a long time.
quotes.summary_zh: 延迟消费，先攒钱买资产而非买车
quotes.summary_en: Skip early status purchases like cars and direct your savings into appreciating property assets.

quotes.wealth_detail: Became a billionaire ~7-8 years ago; Flexjet operates ~370 planes with ~5,000 employees worldwide
quotes.video_title: Asking Beverly Hill Billionaires How They Got Rich!
quotes.quote: when you have 25 times your annual spend... So, it's more of a function of how you live and not a function of what you have.
quotes.summary_zh: 拥有年支出25倍资产即实现财富自由
quotes.summary_en: Define wealth as having 25x your annual spending rather than chasing an arbitrary dollar number.

quotes.role_or_title: Biotech Entrepreneur & Investor (Former Cancer Biotech Company Owner)
quotes.wealth_detail: $10B-$14B net worth; sold biotech company for $21B; made $1B in a single day
quotes.video_title: Inside the Life of a 82-Year-Old Billionaire in Miami
quotes.quote: I don't have jewelry... I fly private but I don't own a jet. I really don't overspend. I always have enough money if things go wrong in the company that I can fund it.
quotes.summary_zh: 绝不过度消费，保留充足备用资金
quotes.summary_en: Avoid overspending on status symbols and keep enough reserves to fund your company if things go wrong.

quotes.wealth_detail: $38M in a single year
quotes.video_title: Asking Luxury Shoppers How They Got RICH! (Dallas)
quotes.quote: save bread don't spend... hold on to it and just wait for the right circumstances... the trick is is to make it sustainable over a long period of time
quotes.summary_zh: 把钱存下来切忌乱花，让财富长期可持续
quotes.summary_en: Save your money, avoid overspending, and wait for the right opportunities so your wealth lasts long term.

quotes.wealth_detail: Over $10M in a single year; built 35 companies since age 21
quotes.video_title: Asking Salt Lake City Millionaires How They Got RICH!
quotes.quote: you should learn how to downgrade your lifestyle so you can upgrade your life most people live paycheck to paycheck... because they refuse to downgrade their lifestyle for a moment
quotes.summary_zh: 先主动降级生活方式以换取长期跃升

quotes.summary_en: Wealth is determined by how you structure your finances and save 20–25% of your income, not just hitting a high income number.

quotes.summary_en: Be disciplined with your spending when you are young and choose comparable value over expensive status items.

quotes.summary_en: Treat finance as choices rather than math: prioritize your essential needs first before pursuing your wants.

quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Houston)
quotes.quote: the importance of saving early on and invest as soon as you can
quotes.summary_zh: 趁早养成储蓄习惯并尽早开始投资复利
quotes.summary_en: Start saving early in your career and begin investing as soon as possible.

quotes.wealth_detail: In excess of $2M in a single year
quotes.video_title: Asking Luxury Shoppers How They Got RICH! (Miami)
quotes.quote: the power of compounding interest so early on you make sure that you invest and you allow the money to work for you
quotes.summary_zh: 尽早开始投资，让复利为你赚钱
quotes.summary_en: Start investing early to harness the power of compounding interest and let your money work for you.

quotes.role_or_title: Founder & CEO, Met Group (Residential & Commercial Solar)
quotes.wealth_detail: ~$30M annual company revenue (targeting $100M in 2-3 years); millionaire at age 24 ("eight-figure entrepreneur")
quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Austin)
quotes.quote: number one rule of money is don't lose it... let's just be basic let's be boring and stack money take my main source of income and put it into something that can compound and grow over the next 10 20 30 years
quotes.summary_zh: 保护本金长期定投稳健复利
quotes.summary_en: Protect principal and steadily funnel income into assets that can compound consistently over 10 to 30 years.

quotes.wealth_detail: Hundreds of millions AUM; over 1M sq ft under construction (~$2.5B fully developed over next 4 years); described as "nine figure entrepreneur"
quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Austin)
quotes.quote: go find an index fund that spreads along the equity markets and automate money and put it aside... you start doing that in your 20s in your 60s it's millions
quotes.summary_zh: 趁早定投指数基金吃复利
quotes.summary_en: Automate regular contributions into broad equity index funds starting in your 20s so long-term compounding builds millions.

quotes.video_title: Asking One of Hollywood's Biggest Stars How He Got Rich!
quotes.quote: you can't go wrong with tax frees, man, and just T-bills. Like it's not sexy, but if you're consistent like year after year after year, you're going to wake up one day and you're going to say, hey, I'm doing pretty good
quotes.summary_zh: 年复一年坚持稳健投资免税资产与国债
quotes.summary_en: Invest consistently year after year in safe assets like tax-frees and T-bills.

quotes.wealth_detail: $120M peak single-year earnings; owns ~20 businesses
quotes.video_title: Inside Giannis Antetokounmpo’s $120M NBA Empire
quotes.quote: If I just keep on investing my money, your money doubles every 7 years... if you invest it in the market.
quotes.summary_zh: 坚持市场投资享受长期复利翻倍
quotes.summary_en: Invest consistently in the market so long-term compounding doubles your capital roughly every seven years.

quotes.wealth_detail: $15M/yr peak income; first $1M at age 28 (~$4M-$5M inflation-adjusted)
quotes.video_title: I Asked Logan Paul How He Built a Billion-Dollar Business
quotes.quote: You have to stay in investments because of compounds. Compounding money is like, you know, the eighth wonder of the world.
quotes.summary_zh: 长期持有投资资产以发挥复利威力
quotes.summary_en: Stay invested long-term in the market (such as the S&P 500) to let compounding multiply your wealth.

quotes.wealth_detail: Seven-digit single-year income ($1M-$9.9M/yr); two tech exits (Intel, TIAA)
quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaires How To Make $1,000,000!
quotes.quote: you have to have a long-term investment Horizon so you have to be willing to put some money away that you won't need for maybe 10 years
quotes.summary_zh: 坚持十年以上的长期投资视角
quotes.summary_en: Adopt a 10-year-plus investment horizon and only invest capital you will not need soon.

quotes.guest_name: 30-Year LAPD Veteran & Celebrity Wedding Security Specialist
quotes.role_or_title: LAPD Police Officer (30 Years) & Celebrity Wedding Security
quotes.wealth_detail: $300,000+/yr (highest single-year income)
quotes.video_title: Asking Strangers How Much MONEY They Make (Austin, Texas)
quotes.quote: invest my training officer when I first came on advised me to not only just depend on the pension but invest in diversity... so you have two little buckets that you can pull out when you get older
quotes.summary_zh: 别只依赖单一养老金，尽早进行多元化投资储蓄
quotes.summary_en: Don't rely solely on a pension; diversify early into investments and deferred compensation plans so you have multiple buckets for retirement.

quotes.guest_name: Austin Biotech & Commercial Real Estate Investor
quotes.role_or_title: Pharmaceutical Biotech & Commercial Real Estate Investor
quotes.video_title: I Asked Texan Millionaires Their Best Financial Decision
quotes.quote: it takes time yeah I became rich but it took time that's an ingredient
quotes.summary_zh: 积累财富需要时间沉淀，切忌急功近利
quotes.summary_en: Accept that building wealth takes time and patience is an essential ingredient.

quotes.video_title: I Asked Texan Millionaires Their Best Financial Decision
quotes.quote: invest in I.T stocks early... Microsoft... 20 plus [years]
quotes.summary_zh: 早期投资科技股并长期持有二十余年
quotes.summary_en: Invest in IT stocks like Microsoft early and hold long-term.

quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaires What They Are Investing in
quotes.quote: mostly in conservative for the most part High dividend stocks that will not do as well in good times and they won't do as badly in bad times... compounding is your
quotes.summary_zh: 投资稳健高股息股票，依靠长期复利积累财富
quotes.summary_en: Invest in conservative high-dividend stocks and let compounding work over time rather than expecting overnight wealth.

quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaires What They Are Investing in
quotes.quote: equities and then annuities bonds and you know things that pay you every year for the rest of your life
quotes.summary_zh: 配置股票、年金和债券，打造终身每年稳定派息的现金流组合
quotes.summary_en: Build a portfolio of equities, annuities, and bonds that generates reliable annual cash flow for life.

quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaires What They Are Investing in
quotes.quote: just the basics in mutual funds as well as a few other companies
quotes.summary_zh: 以共同基金等基础资产为主进行稳健投资
quotes.summary_en: Stick to foundational investing in mutual funds and select companies alongside minimal crypto exposure.

advice_rankings.tag_zh: 轻资产起步、利润滚雪球再投入
advice_rankings.desc: Keep overhead low early and plow profits back into growth

quotes.wealth_detail: Company valued at $3B when sold in 2018 (100% ownership prior)
quotes.video_title: Asking Billionaire Women How They Got RICH!
quotes.quote: Every money I will generate I will put back into the business.
quotes.summary_zh: 将赚到的每一分钱全部复投进业务扩张
quotes.summary_en: Reinvest all generated profits back into growing the business.

quotes.guest_name: Los Angeles Former Model & Real Estate Developer
quotes.role_or_title: Real Estate Developer & Home Builder (Former Model)
quotes.wealth_detail: $3.5M profit on last property
quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich
quotes.quote: I was able to reinvest my profit over and over and over and what that did was that allowed me to get larger and larger
quotes.summary_zh: 把利润反复再投资以做大规模
quotes.summary_en: Continuously reinvest profits back into your business to scale from six to seven figures and beyond.

quotes.wealth_detail: Nine-figure annual revenue; takes $4M-$5M/yr in distributions; millionaire at age 17
quotes.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got Rich! (Beverly Hills)
quotes.quote: I try not to make more than four or 5 million a year max in distributions because I rather reinvest majority of the profits... into buying more companies, expanding, hiring more people.
quotes.summary_zh: 控制个人分红，把大部分利润再投入扩张与并购
quotes.summary_en: Take only enough distributions to cover expenses and reinvest the bulk of profits into growth, talent, and acquisitions.

quotes.guest_name: Dubai Property Developer & Shark Tank Dubai Judge
quotes.role_or_title: Real Estate Developer & Shark Tank Dubai Judge
quotes.wealth_detail: Sold over $10B of real estate last year; runs billion-dollar private property development company
quotes.video_title: Asking Middle Eastern Billionaires How They Got Rich!
quotes.quote: Go into a service business where you could generate cash flows based on service. You don't need massive capital. Use those cash flows to reinvest into things that require capital.
quotes.summary_zh: 低成本从服务业起家赚现金流，再复投地产或AI项目
quotes.summary_en: Start with a low-capital service business or AI prototype, then reinvest cash flow into real estate or tech.

quotes.wealth_detail: Nearly $7M generated last year; ~$400k first calendar year; became a millionaire at 20
quotes.video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH! (Las Vegas)
quotes.quote: If you don't have the means to buy, that's perfectly fine, you can start off by renting your first property... it's a numbers game, just continue scaling as long as you find winning properties.
quotes.summary_zh: 前期租房轻资产启动，跑通后不断复制扩张
quotes.summary_en: Start lean by renting your first property rather than buying, then systematically scale winning properties.

quotes.role_or_title: Founder, Logic Electronic Cigarettes (formerly Personal Trainer)
quotes.wealth_detail: $100M peak single-year revenue; started with $10K and sold company to Japan Tobacco via Goldman Sachs in under 5 years
quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich
quotes.quote: I started with 10 grand... I got paid upfront. I always say no consignment commitment.
quotes.summary_zh: 仅用一万美元起步，坚持先款后货拒绝寄售
quotes.summary_en: Start lean with $10K, refuse consignment, and insist on getting paid upfront.

quotes.role_or_title: Tech Entrepreneur & Angel Investor (4 Active Companies)
quotes.wealth_detail: Sold last tech company for $235M; started with $10K loan from grandmother; invested in 150+ companies
quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich
quotes.quote: I used the $10,000 and I bootstrapped it from my kitchen table.
quotes.summary_zh: 借一万美元在自家餐桌起步，自力更生不融资
quotes.summary_en: Bootstrap lean from your kitchen table instead of raising outside capital prematurely.

quotes.role_or_title: Founder & CEO (Retired Doctor), Healthcare & Software Companies
quotes.wealth_detail: $500M-$700M net worth; $100M/yr revenue (company worth ~$1B)
quotes.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich! (Scottsdale)
quotes.quote: I'm the only owner no other banks no other personal or private Equity nothing it's just me
quotes.summary_zh: 保持独资不举债，把利润留存公司内部
quotes.summary_en: Retain 100% ownership without outside debt or investors and keep profits inside the business.

quotes.role_or_title: Phoenix Suns Owner & Mortgage Company CEO
quotes.wealth_detail: Billionaire (became billionaire around age 40-41; company had $3B+ year)
quotes.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got So Rich! (Scottsdale)
quotes.quote: company made $60 million and I would take out less than a million. 59 goes back into the company and I grind 59 back in... Keep betting on yourself.
quotes.summary_zh: 把公司利润持续投入再生产
quotes.summary_en: Keep your personal draw small and reinvest business profits back into growth to compound.

quotes.video_title: Asking Miami Moguls How They Got Rich!
quotes.quote: They went into the high dollar district... their rent's $38,000 a month... they have no money in the bank to back them, they're setting themselves up for failure from the very get-go.
quotes.summary_zh: 创业初期别盲目高额租店和花光储备现金
quotes.summary_en: Avoid oversized rent and equipment spending early on so you keep cash reserves in the bank.

quotes.wealth_detail: $250M peak single-year revenue; exited insurance company for >$240M (more than 2x a $120M offer); purchased a $25.2M property in cash
quotes.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews Patrick Bet-David
quotes.quote: I didn't buy my first Rolex till I was 35... I'm not spending all the money, I'm reinvesting into the company.
quotes.summary_zh: 延迟个人享乐消费，将利润再投资于公司
quotes.summary_en: Delay luxury purchases and lifestyle creep early on, reinvesting profits back into the business.

quotes.guest_name: Nationwide Vacuum Truck & Liquid Storage Tank Founder
quotes.role_or_title: Founder (Nationwide Vacuum Truck & Liquid Storage Tank Businesses; Sold to 4 Public Companies)
quotes.wealth_detail: North of $100M/yr revenue (sold to 4 public companies); bought first vacuum truck for $180,000
quotes.video_title: Asking Palm Beach Billionaires How They Got So RICH!
quotes.quote: All organically growing. It was just kind of like you got the profits, put it back into the business, and just kept growing it.
quotes.summary_zh: 不融资借债，把利润滚雪球再投入业务
quotes.summary_en: Grow organically without outside debt by reinvesting profits back into the business.

quotes.wealth_detail: Sold Freshly for $1.5B (owned 10% at exit); $550M in annual sales
quotes.video_title: Asking NY Billionaires If They Believe in God!
quotes.quote: If I was doing it today, I would 100% do it on Shopify... we spent close to 40 million building our own platform. I would have gladly taken that 40 million and invested in other ways.
quotes.summary_zh: 善用现成平台轻资产启动，省下研发费
quotes.summary_en: Use plug-and-play platforms like Shopify instead of wasting tens of millions building custom infrastructure early.

quotes.role_or_title: Entrepreneur & Executive (RV Industry / Bed Bath & Beyond Buyer)
quotes.wealth_detail: Became a millionaire at 27; public company made $900M in single-year bottom-line profit
quotes.video_title: Inside America's Billionaire Neighborhood (Beverly Hills)
quotes.quote: Sometimes people make it and they go out and buy a fancy car, they buy a fancy plane instead of reinvesting it in their employees and their business and growing their business.
quotes.summary_zh: 赚钱后拒绝炫耀消费，将利润再投向团队
quotes.summary_en: Reinvest profits back into your employees and business growth instead of spending on luxury status items like planes or cars.

quotes.wealth_detail: Over $100M in a single year; drives a $520K Rolls-Royce bought at auction for $175K and states he could buy 100 brand new
quotes.video_title: Asking Beverly Hills Billionaires How They Got So RICH!
quotes.quote: Never had a line of credit, never had a mortgage, never borrowed money in 44 years... Just kept putting the profit back in. Just reinvest and reinvest.
quotes.summary_zh: 不借债创业，靠高利润滚雪球再投资
quotes.summary_en: Operate without debt and continually reinvest profits back into growth.

quotes.guest_name: Joy (Atlanta Attorney & Hair Salon Franchise Founder)
quotes.wealth_detail: $5M highest single-year income
quotes.video_title: Asking Atlanta Billionaires How They Got Rich!
quotes.quote: You can bootstrap it. Start small. You want to first get what's called proof of concept. Can you go sell your product or service to a stranger?... You bootstrap it, you own more equity in your business.
quotes.summary_zh: 先低成本自筹资金跑通产品验证并保留股权，再融资放大
quotes.summary_en: Bootstrap early to prove strangers will pay and retain equity before raising capital to scale what works.

quotes.guest_name: River Oaks Labor Force Management Founder
quotes.role_or_title: Founder & Owner of a Labor Force Management Company
quotes.wealth_detail: $300M/yr company revenue; $3M/yr income at age 28
quotes.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH!
quotes.quote: Every dollar that you're making, if you're doing the right thing, it's got to stay in that company to be able to grow.
quotes.summary_zh: 将公司盈利全部留存再投入以实现持续扩张
quotes.summary_en: Leave every dollar of profit inside the business to build retained earnings and fund growth.

quotes.wealth_detail: $15M/yr; $5.5M in a single day
quotes.video_title: I Was Broke.. Found God.. Now I Make $15M/Year
quotes.quote: Keep the expenses low even when the margins and the profits are high... you want to make sure that the business is sustained first.
quotes.summary_zh: 高利润时仍要压低开支，优先留存资金养业务
quotes.summary_en: Keep business overhead low even during high-margin periods and retain capital to sustain growth.

quotes.wealth_detail: Built multiple eight-figure businesses; most made in a single year: "a couple million in a year"
quotes.video_title: Meet The Most Interesting Man On The Planet
quotes.quote: You got to keep account how much goes to taxes and how much you're going to reinvest for growth... so it's not like I want to spend it right away.
quotes.summary_zh: 预留税款并将利润再投入企业增长
quotes.summary_en: Account for taxes and reinvest profits back into business growth rather than spending peak-year earnings right away.

quotes.guest_name: The School of Hard Knocks Host
quotes.role_or_title: Founder of The School of Hard Knocks, Marketing Agency & Consulting Company
quotes.wealth_detail: Over $700,000/month; well over $6M/year business
quotes.video_title: I Interviewed 30 Billionaires... Here’s What I Learned
quotes.quote: When my partners and I were making $30,000 a month in profit. We were only paying ourselves $2,000... we were saving like crazy and we were reinvesting in our businesses like champions.
quotes.summary_zh: 早期保持低薪并把利润再投入增长
quotes.summary_en: Pay yourself barely enough to cover living expenses early on and reinvest profits back into the business.

quotes.wealth_detail: $16M highest single year (2020)
quotes.video_title: I Interviewed 30 Billionaires... Here’s What I Learned
quotes.quote: I was making $30,000 a month with about three or $4,000 overhead. It wasn't until I had millions saved where I was forced to go from a Kia Optima to a Maserati in that same year.
quotes.summary_zh: 创业早期严控运营成本，保持精益经营
quotes.summary_en: Run lean with minimal overhead until you have millions saved before upgrading your lifestyle.

quotes.wealth_detail: Eight figures single-year income; $15M Miami mansion
quotes.video_title: I Asked Miami Millionaires How They Got Rich
quotes.quote: I focus on my practices that grow that gives me the cash flow so I don't really need outside investors
quotes.summary_zh: 聚焦核心诊所盈利，无需外部投资
quotes.summary_en: Grow a high-cash-flow core business so you can fund expansion without needing outside investors.

quotes.wealth_detail: Company valued at ~$3.5B when sold; had $1B net worth before selling
quotes.video_title: A 60 Year Old Millionaire Shares What Actually Made Him RICH!
quotes.quote: what delivery did is allowed me to pay B and C rent and do A sales cuz I went out and hustled and I went out giving out samples literally on college campuses
quotes.summary_zh: 租便宜铺面控成本，靠外送地推冲业绩
quotes.summary_en: Rent affordable B/C locations and generate A-level revenue by hustling with delivery and disciplined sampling.

quotes.wealth_detail: Probably a billionaire; ~$850M in real estate (all cash); $300M made at Ramsey this year
quotes.video_title: A 60 Year Old Millionaire Shares What Actually Made Him RICH!
quotes.quote: we began to save and watch the cash flow, and company was growing, and just kept dumping everything we made into this concrete thing here
quotes.summary_zh: 严控现金流并把利润持续复投实体资产
quotes.summary_en: Save carefully, monitor cash flow, and continually reinvest business profits into hard assets.

quotes.wealth_detail: $3.5M/yr personal income; $14M/yr business revenue
quotes.video_title: Asking Miami Millionaires How They Got Rich
quotes.quote: you don't need a Mac you just need this you need the Internet
quotes.summary_zh: 轻资产起步，有普通电脑和网络即可创业
quotes.summary_en: Start lean without expensive status gear like a Mac; a basic computer and an internet connection are all you need.

quotes.wealth_detail: Runs multi-billion dollar UFC ($7.7B Paramount deal); video title cites $500M made
quotes.video_title: I Asked Dana White How He Made $500 Million!
quotes.quote: non-stop grinding, working, taking your own money and reinvesting in your business and reinvesting in yourself
quotes.summary_zh: 持续把赚来的钱再投资到自身成长和事业扩张中
quotes.summary_en: Reinvest your own money back into your business and yourself rather than cashing out early.

quotes.wealth_detail: Couple billion dollars/year revenue (under $3B); billionaire before launching Arnold Palmer (host cites $6B+ net worth)
quotes.video_title: Asking the RICHEST People in the World How They Got RICH!
quotes.quote: I own it all. I don't have any zero debt... if you want to buy it, buy it with cash... we built a factory in New Jersey. Spent over 400 million bucks. We paid for it.
quotes.summary_zh: 坚持零负债现金流自驱扩张并自有产线
quotes.summary_en: Avoid outside investors and debt; fund factories and vertical operations with cash from retained profits.

quotes.wealth_detail: $25M/yr projected annual earnings; turned down $50M buyout offer for music rights
quotes.video_title: Asking the RICHEST People in the World How They Got RICH!
quotes.quote: My number one investment is the music. I've never seen an ROI like music. For example, I've spent $9 on a song and made 2 million off of it.
quotes.summary_zh: 低成本独立启动并复投核心音乐创作
quotes.summary_en: Start ultra-lean with DIY production and distribution, and reinvest your capital into your highest-ROI craft.

quotes.wealth_detail: Multi-billion dollar company; peak single-year income well into the nine figures
quotes.video_title: Day in the Life of a Billionaire
quotes.quote: We started with $12,000... worked other jobs, bartending, side hustles... the first couple years we lived in the back of our store.
quotes.summary_zh: 无融资精益起步，睡店里并靠兼职副业撑过前期
quotes.summary_en: Start lean without outside investors and work side jobs to keep overhead minimal while building the business.

quotes.wealth_detail: Sold Vitaminwater to Coca-Cola for $4B–$4.1B (2007) and BodyArmor to Coca-Cola for $8B (2021)
quotes.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH! (Florida)
quotes.quote: I took money from friends, family, my partner had money... we didn't try to grow quick... If you want to build a billion dollar company, you have to build a $100 company first, then a $1,000 company, then a $100,000 company.
quotes.summary_zh: 稳扎稳打从百元生意起步，切忌急于做大
quotes.summary_en: Start small with lean capital and scale step-by-step from $100 to $100,000 to $1 million rather than trying to grow overnight.

quotes.role_or_title: Founder of Samuel Adams (Boston Beer Company)
quotes.wealth_detail: $2B (stated as peak single-year earnings)
quotes.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH! (Boston)
quotes.quote: What is the absolute minimum I need to start this business?... I didn't have an office for a year. I did everything from pay phone booths... invested all your money back into the business for the first like 15 years.
quotes.summary_zh: 极简轻资产起步，前15年利润全部再投入
quotes.summary_en: Strip startup costs to the absolute minimum—using contract production and no office—and reinvest profits back into the business for years.

quotes.role_or_title: Founder & Owner, Effects Management Solutions (Labor Force Management)
quotes.wealth_detail: $300M/yr revenue company (100% owned); $21M car collection
quotes.video_title: I Had to Beg Borrow & Steal.. Now I Make $300 Million
quotes.quote: Every dollar I made every week had to stay in the company to reduce my debt liabilities... then I still had to build my balance sheet and retained earnings to be able to grow.
quotes.summary_zh: 把每周利润全额留存企业降负债、筑资产
quotes.summary_en: Keep profits inside the business early on to pay down debt, build retained earnings, and self-fund scale.

quotes.role_or_title: Business Consultant & Former US Army Battle Captain
quotes.wealth_detail: $15M/yr peak annual income; $2.1M earned in 1 hour from a stage talk
quotes.video_title: Asking Black Millionaires How They Got Rich! (Atlanta)
quotes.quote: I decided to start a business that didn't need funding. It just needed me to step up to the plate and use my voice.
quotes.summary_zh: 无需等待融资，靠自身技能轻资产起步
quotes.summary_en: Start a lean business using your own knowledge and voice instead of waiting for outside funding.

quotes.role_or_title: Entrepreneur & Investor (Life Insurance, Real Estate, Waste Management)
quotes.wealth_detail: $752M annual revenue (2023); tens of millions personal annual income; $100M company exits
quotes.video_title: I Was Bankrupt… Now I’ve Made $3 Billion
quotes.quote: It came in, I went back in the business. It came in, I went back in the business. I funded the hell out of my businesses. My businesses were eating, thus they were growing.
quotes.summary_zh: 克制个人分红，将利润持续反哺企业扩张
quotes.summary_en: Reinvest profits back into the company rather than taking money out prematurely so the business can compound.

quotes.wealth_detail: North of $20B net worth; $400M highest single-year income; owns 91-92% of Raising Cane's (900+ locations)
quotes.video_title: How I Turned $50,000 Into $20 Billion
quotes.quote: Once I raised a lot of my own personal equity, about $50,000, I was able to go in and get a small SBA loan for $50,000 and get this dilapidated old restaurant space and do the work myself.
quotes.summary_zh: 苦干攒首笔本金，借SBA贷款低成本自装修起家
