quotes.wealth_detail: Sold business for $115M; sold ~$40M underlying real estate; $20M home; $100M+ in a single year
quotes.video_title: Asking Miami Millionaires How to Get RICH!
quotes.quote: you guys think it happens fast and then you don't look at the long term you need to have macro patience and micro urgency
quotes.summary_zh: 保持宏观耐心与微观紧迫感忌暴富
quotes.summary_en: Don't underestimate how long success takes; pair macro patience with micro urgency.

quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich
quotes.quote: if you look for the easy way you're never gonna find
quotes.summary_zh: 切勿妄想走捷径或寻找轻松致富路
quotes.summary_en: Stop looking for shortcuts or easy ways to build wealth because they do not exist.

quotes.role_or_title: Entrepreneur & Investor (Life Insurance, Real Estate, Waste Management)
quotes.wealth_detail: $752M annual revenue (2023); tens of millions personal annual income; $100M company exits
quotes.video_title: I Asked Miami Millionaires How They Got Rich
quotes.quote: a lot of people get into business to get rich right away I got into business to get free... they're frustrated... they're like I can't buy that $400,000 car
quotes.summary_zh: 创业初期别急着暴富买豪车，保持耐心
quotes.summary_en: Don't start a business expecting to buy a $400k car immediately; build for long-term freedom with patience.

quotes.wealth_detail: Probably a billionaire; ~$850M in real estate (all cash); $300M made at Ramsey this year
quotes.video_title: A 60 Year Old Millionaire Shares What Actually Made Him RICH!
quotes.quote: y'all are always looking for an easy button... the best barbecue is cooked the whole weekend not in a microwave.
quotes.summary_zh: 别总想找捷径求快，好成果需要时间慢炖
quotes.summary_en: Stop searching for an easy button or fast shortcuts; lasting wealth takes slow, patient cooking.

quotes.guest_name: The Einstein of Wall Street (NYSE Floor Trader)
quotes.role_or_title: Stock Exchange Floor Trader, Board Member (5 companies) & Operator (7 companies)
quotes.video_title: I Asked Wall Street Millionaires How They Got RICH!
quotes.quote: do your homework don't look for the shortcut it's not about a get-rich quick scheme
quotes.summary_zh: 做足研究功课，切忌寻找一夜暴富捷径
quotes.summary_en: Do your homework and avoid shortcuts or get-rich-quick schemes.

quotes.role_or_title: Multi-Business Owner & Commercial Real Estate Investor
quotes.wealth_detail: Owns ~4 eight-figure businesses; has made tens of millions of dollars
quotes.video_title: Asking Scottsdale Millionaires How They Got Rich
quotes.quote: it's not going to happen on your time frame it's much more difficult than you think and if you're a mental [__] it's not for you bow out now
quotes.summary_zh: 创业远比想象艰难，不急于求成者方能胜出
quotes.summary_en: Do not expect overnight results on your own timeline; business is far harder than expected.

quotes.video_title: Asking Miami Millionaires How They Got Rich
quotes.quote: look at what's going on where is their traction and then invest in there it's not a fly-by-night company
quotes.summary_zh: 避开昙花一现的公司，投有增长的项目
quotes.summary_en: Avoid fly-by-night companies; invest only where you can see real, sustained traction.

quotes.wealth_detail: $9B net worth (referred to as worth $9 billion by host)
quotes.video_title: Asking Billionaires What To Invest In!
quotes.quote: Biggest challenge when you're young is you want to make money really fast. That's almost in investing a guaranteed bad outcome.
quotes.summary_zh: 年轻时切忌急功近利想赚快钱，投资中这几乎必败
quotes.summary_en: Trying to get rich quickly as a young investor almost guarantees poor investment outcomes.

quotes.role_or_title: Real Estate Investor, Entrepreneur & Author (Cardone Capital / 10X)
quotes.wealth_detail: Billionaire; $5B real estate portfolio (12,000 units), $1.1B raised via crowdfunding, $155M/yr revenue
quotes.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews Billionaire Grant Cardone
quotes.quote: people want to win something right I want to get lucky but you're not going to get lucky
quotes.summary_zh: 别指望买彩票碰运气，致富靠实力而非侥幸
quotes.summary_en: Do not waste money or time hoping to get lucky on lotteries or shortcuts; build real value instead.

quotes.role_or_title: Owner, Africa's Largest Noodle Company (Indomie Nigeria)
quotes.wealth_detail: Company revenue exceeds $2B with 25,000 employees
quotes.video_title: Inside Africa’s Billionaire City (Lagos)
quotes.quote: It's not a short term business, you know, it's not a tech business or AI business where you make quick bucks. This is a consumer business. Consumer business you have to build over time.
quotes.summary_zh: 不追逐快钱，消费品生意需长期深耕
quotes.summary_en: Avoid short-term quick-buck thinking; durable consumer businesses take decades to build.

quotes.role_or_title: Retail Shopping Center Owner & Real Estate Entrepreneur
quotes.wealth_detail: Made "a lot more" than $10M in a single year
quotes.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH! (Florida)
quotes.quote: It's just an illusion. Nobody gets there quick... whether you're going to be the best lawyer, the best architect, the best real estate guy, whatever it is, it's going to take a lot of time.
quotes.summary_zh: 社交媒体炫富多为假象，任何成功都无法速成
quotes.summary_en: Don't fall for the illusion of overnight wealth on social media; mastering any field and building real wealth takes years.

quotes.wealth_detail: Company on track for $100M+ annual revenue; became a millionaire by age 24
quotes.video_title: Asking Mega Mansion Owners How They Got Rich!
quotes.quote: Fast money never lasts. And if you keep building and be patient, that's what a real entrepreneur is, is it's longevity and endurance.
quotes.summary_zh: 快钱难以长久，创业重在耐心与持久耐力
quotes.summary_en: Avoid chasing fast money because it never lasts; true entrepreneurship is about patience, longevity, and endurance.

quotes.role_or_title: Labor Force Management Founder ("The Houston Mogul")
quotes.wealth_detail: ~$375M annual business revenue (up ~25% from ~$300M previously)
quotes.video_title: Inside Texas’s Billionaire Town (Highland Park)
quotes.quote: Don't get caught up in all the hype and 99% of what you see on social media is absolute BS.
quotes.summary_zh: 远离社交媒体虚妄炒作，别轻信一夜暴富
quotes.summary_en: Ignore online hype and fabricated social media success narratives.

quotes.guest_name: Miami E-Commerce, M&A & Real Estate Founder
quotes.wealth_detail: $5M gross ($3.9M net) last year; $6M YTD on track for $10M gross ($7.9M net) this year
quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Miami)
quotes.quote: poor people think in weeks and months rich people think in years and decades... that get rich quick stuff is going to get you broke real quick
quotes.summary_zh: 坚持十年以上的长期思维，远离暴富盘
quotes.summary_en: Think in years and decades rather than weeks and months; chasing get-rich-quick schemes will make you broke fast.

quotes.wealth_detail: $100M+ NBA career earnings; compounded 2x-3x through business & investments
quotes.video_title: I Asked Mark Wahlberg for His Best Life Advice!
quotes.quote: No shortcuts. What you put in, what you get out, right?... Never have shortcuts. They have a shortcuts. That's where there's room for failure
quotes.summary_zh: 永远不要走捷径，投机取巧只会带来失败
quotes.summary_en: Never take shortcuts; what you put in is what you get out, and shortcuts invite failure.

quotes.role_or_title: Founder of Kendra Scott (Jewelry & Accessories Brand)
quotes.wealth_detail: Founded a billion-dollar brand (~170 retail stores); donated nearly $100M to charity over 10 years
quotes.video_title: Asking Self-Made Female Billionaires How They Got Rich!
quotes.quote: Don't try to get that really quick fast win. You've got to be able to really build something over time that means something, that has value, that is profitable. And all the opportunities will come, but be patient.
quotes.summary_zh: 切忌追求一夜暴富，保持耐心打磨长期有价值的基业
quotes.summary_en: Avoid chasing instant overnight wins; patiently build a profitable business of lasting value and foundation.

quotes.role_or_title: Founder of Morgan & Morgan (Largest Personal Injury Law Firm in North America)
quotes.wealth_detail: $1.5B net worth (Forbes); $2B annual firm fees; $5B annual settlements and verdicts
quotes.video_title: Asking A Billionaire Lawyer How To Make $1,000,000!
quotes.quote: It's hard to make money. It's harder to keep money. When I've lost money is when greed has taken over... if it's too good to be true, it's too good to be true.
quotes.summary_zh: 克制贪婪，远离好得不真实的暴富诱惑
quotes.summary_en: Control greed to protect your capital; walk away from anything that sounds too good to be true.

quotes.wealth_detail: 7-figure single-year income
quotes.video_title: Asking Luxury Shoppers How They Got RICH! (Dallas)
quotes.quote: nothing comes easy yeah nothing comes overnight and be patient... a lot of people they want to instantly they want to get rich quick you got to trust your path
quotes.summary_zh: 没有一夜暴富，别追快钱要耐心相信积累
quotes.summary_en: Nothing comes overnight; avoid get-rich-quick expectations, be patient, and trust your path.

quotes.wealth_detail: Brands have done over $1B in revenue
quotes.video_title: Meet The Kid Who Interviews Billionaires For a Living
quotes.quote: no one gets Rich overnight... that's one tenth of one tenth of 1%
quotes.summary_zh: 别指望一夜暴富，靠运气赚快钱的人万中无一
quotes.summary_en: Stop chasing overnight riches; lucky windfalls are vanishingly rare compared to long-term execution.

quotes.role_or_title: Oil & Gas Mogul / Founder of Rise Capital
quotes.wealth_detail: $40M/yr company revenue
quotes.video_title: I Investigated the $1 Trillion Industry Nobody Talks About
quotes.quote: It takes a lot of loss, a lot of headaches in oil and gas. And it's not just a get-rich-quick deal. You have to be consistent. You have to diversify. And you got to have a risk tolerance.
quotes.summary_zh: 没有一夜暴富，需长期坚持与风险承受力
quotes.summary_en: Oil and gas is not a get-rich-quick scheme; it demands consistency, diversification, and high risk tolerance through losses.

quotes.role_or_title: TV Show Creator/Producer & Finance/Real Estate Investor
quotes.wealth_detail: $40M-$50M single-year peak income
quotes.video_title: I Asked Logan Paul How He Built a Billion-Dollar Business
quotes.quote: Patience. It's a long game. Instant gratification when you're young. I stumbled all along the way cuz I thought it needed to be next week, next year.
quotes.summary_zh: 摒弃年轻时的急功近利，把事业当成长期博弈
quotes.summary_en: Success is a long game; chasing instant gratification and quick timelines leads to stumbling early on.

quotes.wealth_detail: $15M/yr peak income; first $1M at age 28 (~$4M-$5M inflation-adjusted)
quotes.video_title: I Asked Logan Paul How He Built a Billion-Dollar Business
quotes.quote: Invest early, invest confidently, don't speculate. Buy the S&P 500.
quotes.summary_zh: 切忌短线投机或频繁交易，应耐心定投指数
quotes.summary_en: Avoid speculation and frequent trading; be patient and invest steadily in broad index funds like the S&P 500.

quotes.guest_name: Winter Park Commercial Real Estate Mogul (Trey's Grandfather)
quotes.role_or_title: Commercial Real Estate Owner & Apartment Management Executive (45,000 Units)
quotes.video_title: Asking Orlando Millionaires How They Got Rich
quotes.quote: start in the bottom and work yourself up step by step by step it's a two-point game... there's no fast way to this
quotes.summary_zh: 致富没有捷径，要从底层一步一个脚印稳扎稳打
quotes.summary_en: There are no shortcuts to wealth; start at the bottom and grind step by step like scoring two-pointers instead of chasing three-pointers.

quotes.role_or_title: Sales Closer at Gym Launch (Alex Hormozi)
quotes.wealth_detail: Over $250,000/yr in sales
quotes.video_title: 5 Sales Tips To Start Closing Deals Ft: Alex Hormozi’s Closer Jacob Hopkins
quotes.quote: When I first started entrepreneurship I tried to become a millionaire in 90 days... if you want a safe bet on becoming a millionaire, think in 10 years.
quotes.summary_zh: 戒除暴富幻想，坚持十年长期主义
quotes.summary_en: Bet on yourself with a 10-year time horizon rather than chasing unrealistic 90-day riches.

quotes.video_title: Asking Denver Millionaires How Much Money They Make
quotes.quote: Focus on delayed gratification... I wanted results immediately and I took a lot of shortcuts... building a brand that's going to last long term doesn't happen overnight.
quotes.summary_zh: 戒掉走捷径心态，用延迟满足打造长久品牌
quotes.summary_en: Avoid shortcuts and instant-result thinking; focus on delayed gratification to build a lasting brand.

quotes.video_title: I Asked Texan Millionaires Their Best Financial Decision
quotes.quote: Robin Hood Reddit and meme stocks that is just gambling which is very different from investing just go for the slow and steady
quotes.summary_zh: 迷因股炒作等同赌博，应坚持稳扎稳打
quotes.summary_en: Avoid meme stock hype which is just gambling, and stick to slow and steady investing.

quotes.video_title: Exclusive Interview with Former Nike President: Life Lessons and Advice for Success
quotes.quote: when you listen to someone tell you hey there's this can't miss investment I've had a few of those and I've missed almost every time
quotes.summary_zh: 警惕所谓“稳赚不赔”的投资，别偏离计划
quotes.summary_en: Avoid 'can't-miss, for-sure' investment pitches—they rarely work out and will pull you off track from your financial plan.

advice_rankings.tag: Work Under a Winner First Before Starting
advice_rankings.tag_zh: 先在高水平团队打工攒经验再创业
advice_rankings.desc: Get paid to learn in a great company before launching your own

quotes.guest_name: Atlanta Tech Founder & Former Wall Street Banker
quotes.role_or_title: Tech Company Founder & Former Wall Street Professional
quotes.wealth_detail: Just shy of $10M in a single year; owns an eight-figure tech company; millionaire at 33
quotes.video_title: Asking Billionaire Women How They Got RICH!
quotes.quote: My job was to keep rich people rich for a living. I came up with the idea in 2013, but we didn't make our money until 2017 as a business.
quotes.summary_zh: 先在华尔街近距离服务顶级富豪，再辞职创业
quotes.summary_en: Learn wealth mechanics working with billionaires on Wall Street before launching.

quotes.role_or_title: Author of Rich Dad Poor Dad & Real Estate Investor
quotes.wealth_detail: Hundreds of millions of dollars in real estate; 30M+ copies of Rich Dad Poor Dad sold
quotes.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got So Rich! (Scottsdale)
quotes.quote: I told you I had to learn to sell. I got a job at Xerox. I got knocked back and I couldn't stop until I was number one in sales for Xerox.
quotes.summary_zh: 去优秀公司历练直到做到第一名
quotes.summary_en: Take a job at a top company to master a foundational skill like sales and reach #1.

quotes.guest_name: Scott (Public Business Services Company Former CEO)
quotes.role_or_title: Former CEO (Public Business Services Company, 42,000-43,000 Employees)
quotes.wealth_detail: Host cites $12B+ net worth; led multi-billion dollar/yr revenue public company for 18 years as CEO
quotes.video_title: Asking Palm Beach Billionaires How They Got So RICH!
quotes.quote: there's a lot to be said for working in one place as long as it's a good company. Doesn't matter what they do. It's got to have an opportunity and it's got to have a culture that's going to allow people to succeed.
quotes.summary_zh: 选一家有好文化与上升机会的公司长期深耕
quotes.summary_en: Commit to one great company with strong growth opportunity and a culture that lets people succeed.

quotes.role_or_title: Founder, Adam Smith Institute & Serial Entrepreneur
quotes.wealth_detail: More than 1M, less than 10M in a single year; exited a company
quotes.video_title: Asking London Billionaires How They Got Rich!
quotes.quote: Join a firm, learn the trade for a couple of years and then with a colleague or two, set up your own version.
quotes.summary_zh: 先入行学本领并攒客源，再合伙创业做大出售
quotes.summary_en: Join a firm to learn the trade first, launch your own version with colleagues, build a client base, and sell for a multiple.

quotes.guest_name: Wall Street Private Equity Firm Founder
quotes.wealth_detail: $500k peak single-year earnings
quotes.video_title: Asking Wall Street Millionaires How To Make $1 Million
quotes.quote: I feel like I knew enough, knew enough people, might as well start building.
quotes.summary_zh: 先在行业内摸透规则并攒够人脉再出来单干创业
quotes.summary_en: Learn the playbook and build relationships in the industry before launching your own firm.

quotes.role_or_title: Co-founder of LinkedIn, VC & AI Startup Co-founder (Former PayPal Executive)
quotes.wealth_detail: Sold LinkedIn to Microsoft for $26B (LinkedIn $16B annual revenue); PayPal acquired by eBay for $1.5B; became a billionaire around age 38
quotes.video_title: Meet the Billionaire Who Created LinkedIn (Then Sold It for $26B)
quotes.quote: You need to go prove your credentials at launching products first... I actually went and ended up working at Apple Computer.
quotes.summary_zh: 融资前先去优秀企业推出产品，证明战绩并积累人脉
quotes.summary_en: Before trying to raise capital without a track record, work at a strong company to prove you can launch products and build a network.

quotes.wealth_detail: Company valued at over $4B (co-founded in 2019)
quotes.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich!
quotes.quote: I was working for a developer and my partner was working for my direct competitor for about 10 years and we said you know what time to take a risk go on our own.
quotes.summary_zh: 先在行业开发商深耕十年积累经验再独立创业
quotes.summary_en: Spend years learning the industry inside an established developer before launching your own firm.

quotes.role_or_title: Private Equity Executive, Real Estate Investor & Sports Team Co-Owner (76ers & Devils)
quotes.wealth_detail: Company manages ~$80B in private equity assets; described as a billionaire
quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Philadelphia)
quotes.quote: Not everyone needs to be a founder. Sometimes you can be an entrepreneur in somebody else's business too.
quotes.summary_zh: 不必人人都去创业，可在他人公司创造价值
quotes.summary_en: Not everyone is wired for startup chaos—you can build wealth by being an entrepreneurial driver inside someone else's business.

quotes.video_title: Asking 90 Year Old Billionaires If Getting Rich Was Worth It
quotes.quote: No, I got a job first.
quotes.summary_zh: 毕业后先找份工作积累经验，再谋求独立发展
quotes.summary_en: Get a job first after school to gain experience before going out on your own.

quotes.guest_name: Fiber Optic & Data Center Infrastructure Founder
quotes.wealth_detail: Selling company for $2.5B; completed multi-billion dollar IPO on July 1st
quotes.video_title: Inside Texas’s Billionaire Town (Highland Park)
quotes.quote: I started as a front line as a technician right out of high school... worked my way to start partnering with the founder... really learning the business from the ground up.
quotes.summary_zh: 从一线基层做起，跟随优秀创始人学透业务
quotes.summary_en: Start on the front lines, learn every detail from the ground up, and partner with proven founders.

quotes.role_or_title: Software Entrepreneur (35 Companies) & Venture Capitalist (Former Army Ranger)
quotes.wealth_detail: $670M biggest company exit; 68x highest single investment return
quotes.video_title: Inside Texas’s Billionaire Town (Highland Park)
quotes.quote: I spent some time actually right here at The Boston Consulting Group and working on strategy and really learning more and kind of developing my experience set.
quotes.summary_zh: 创业前先在顶尖机构积累战略与实战工具箱
quotes.summary_en: Develop your strategic toolkit and experience inside top organizations before founding your own ventures.

quotes.role_or_title: Labor Force Management Founder ("The Houston Mogul")
quotes.wealth_detail: ~$375M annual business revenue (up ~25% from ~$300M previously)
quotes.video_title: Inside Texas’s Billionaire Town (Highland Park)
quotes.quote: Go work for someone else in a large industry, and see what they're missing... Let them pay you while you get educated to outdo them.
quotes.summary_zh: 先到大行业带薪学本领，抓住巨头忽视的漏洞
quotes.summary_en: Get paid to learn inside an established industry, spot what incumbents are missing, and out-execute them in that gap.

quotes.wealth_detail: Around $50M net worth (confirmed >$30M); sold insurance company for tens of millions
quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Chicago)
quotes.quote: Start looking at your job today as paid training... If you look at your job in the industry that you're in, look around. What could you do better?... Could you offer the same service that your employer is currently offering and doing it in a more efficient way?
quotes.summary_zh: 把当前工作当带薪培训，吃透行业低效处再创业
quotes.summary_en: Treat your current job as paid training to learn an industry inside out and spot inefficiencies before launching on your own.

quotes.wealth_detail: Sold 7-Eleven for "many billions of dollars" (company sale as CEO)
quotes.video_title: Asking Billionaire Texans How They Got Rich!
quotes.quote: Not everybody is an entrepreneur. And the corporate world provides an entrepreneurial opportunity. You still have to be an entrepreneur to be successful in the corporate world. I call it being a corporate entrepreneur.
quotes.summary_zh: 若不适合单干，可在大企业内部做创业者
quotes.summary_en: Leverage corporate structure by acting as a corporate entrepreneur.

quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got Rich! (Silicon Valley)
quotes.quote: It was the only place that you could do the great work that we did... Did a great job.
quotes.summary_zh: 加入顶尖平台并做到极致卓越
quotes.summary_en: Join an extraordinary company where top-tier work is possible and execute exceptionally well.

quotes.wealth_detail: $8M-$10M/yr personal income ($500k salary, $250k bonus, $7M-$8M equity dividends)
quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Dallas)
quotes.quote: I learned my trade in 10 years working for the big firms and then next 20, 25 years I built my own companies
quotes.summary_zh: 先在大公司磨炼十年再出来创业二十年
quotes.summary_en: Spend years learning your trade at established firms before launching and building your own companies.

quotes.wealth_detail: North of $20B net worth; $400M highest single-year income; owns 91-92% of Raising Cane's (900+ locations)
quotes.video_title: How I Turned $50,000 Into $20 Billion
quotes.quote: I worked in the business so I knew exactly what I needed to do.
quotes.summary_zh: 创业前先在目标行业打工摸清门道，再动手单干
quotes.summary_en: Work inside your target industry first to learn operations hands-on before starting your own company.

quotes.wealth_detail: $1.4M peak single-year income; first million at age 35
quotes.video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH! (Florida)
quotes.quote: Before I made any real money I was making the copies and making the coffee for people and I just ended up being a really good copy maker and coffee maker.
quotes.summary_zh: 入行先从端茶复印等小事做起做到极致
quotes.summary_en: Excel at humble entry-level tasks while learning the business before launching your own practice.

quotes.role_or_title: Real Estate Entrepreneur & Investor (Hotels, Retail & Multifamily)
quotes.wealth_detail: $500M net worth (stated by host/title; owns $30M mansion, sold $90M+ property package and $34M hotel)
quotes.video_title: He Made $500 Million Playing Real Life Monopoly
quotes.quote: It came to me that this was all possible when I went to work for the guy that had all this... You can only grow to what you're exposed to.
quotes.summary_zh: 先替成功者打工以打开眼界和认知上限
quotes.summary_en: Work alongside someone who already has what you want so their success expands your belief in what is achievable.

quotes.wealth_detail: Sold HomeServe in 2023 for £4.1 billion (~$5B); paid nearly £100M in taxes
quotes.video_title: Asking Billionaires How Much They Pay In Taxes!
quotes.quote: Go and work for a big company in an industry that you like and get experience for two or three years. Then go and work for a smaller entrepreneurial company in that same role.
quotes.summary_zh: 先在大厂和创业公司打工攒经验，再独立掌舵
quotes.summary_en: Master a core skill by working 2-3 years at a large company and 2-3 years at a smaller entrepreneurial firm before going out on your own.

quotes.wealth_detail: 7-figure single-year income
quotes.video_title: Asking Luxury Shoppers How They Got RICH! (Dallas)
quotes.quote: go learn from somebody that's done it but understand that while you're learning you're not going to make what that person has and then take that knowledge and go do it
quotes.summary_zh: 先跟成功者学习沉淀，学成后再独立单干
quotes.summary_en: Learn from someone who has already done it—accepting lower pay during the learning phase—then go execute on your own.

quotes.guest_name: Houston ER Doctor & Lake Home Developer
quotes.role_or_title: Emergency Room Doctor & Real Estate Developer
quotes.wealth_detail: $4M-$5M in a single good year
quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Houston)
quotes.quote: you should only have a job long enough to learn what you can from it at that point it's time to move on
quotes.summary_zh: 打工只为学习，学成后应果断离开创业
quotes.summary_en: Keep a job only long enough to learn everything you can, then move on to build your own thing.

quotes.role_or_title: Owner of Peter Marco (Beverly Hills Luxury Jeweler)
quotes.wealth_detail: Worth hundreds of millions of dollars; nearly 10-figure business
quotes.video_title: Asking Beverly Hills Millionaires How They Got RICH!
quotes.quote: I just got a break when I was 15 to clean bathrooms for a jewelry company in Manhattan and then they hired me to be a messenger boy and then I was promoted to a jeweler and a Setter and a polisher
quotes.summary_zh: 从基层做起跟随强者学习手艺与行业经验
quotes.summary_en: Take whatever entry-level break you can get inside an established company and master every craft on the way up.

quotes.role_or_title: Entertainment Agent, Manager & TV Show Creator
quotes.wealth_detail: Millions of dollars in a single year
quotes.video_title: Asking Beverly Hills Millionaires How They Got RICH!
quotes.quote: at 15 years old I got a job at inter scope that then turned into a job at UTA and turned into a job of me owning my own management production company
quotes.summary_zh: 先在行业头部公司历练，再独立创立公司
quotes.summary_en: Start young inside major industry institutions to learn the ropes and build pedigree before launching your own company.

quotes.wealth_detail: Over $8M max in a single year; became a millionaire at 23; owns 26+ properties (bought 125+ total)
quotes.video_title: I Asked Californian Millionaires How Much Money They LOST
quotes.quote: the exposure I had with that entrepreneur that I went to work for at 15 he did absolutely nothing... had conversations with his leadership team for like 30 minutes to an hour
quotes.summary_zh: 早年到成功企业家手下工作学习管理模式
quotes.summary_en: Work for a successful entrepreneur early to observe firsthand how leaders delegate and run businesses.

quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Houston)
quotes.quote: young people they all want to like try to make it as fast as they can spend four or five years understanding your discipline and then go out and do it yourself
quotes.summary_zh: 花四五年深耕专业打好基础再自主创业
quotes.summary_en: Avoid rushing for quick riches; spend four to five years mastering your discipline before launching on your own.

quotes.guest_name: Wine & Spirits Brand Partner (Former LVMH Executive)
quotes.role_or_title: Partner, Wine & Spirits Brand (Former Luxury Executive)
quotes.video_title: Asking Luxury Shoppers How They Got RICH! (Miami)
quotes.quote: most importantly you've got to get an awesome boss you have to look at their credentials just as much as they scrutinize yours... that experience that I gained from working for these individuals I could never replicate in a lifetime
quotes.summary_zh: 先去为顶尖大佬和好老板工作，积累无价经验
quotes.summary_en: Scrutinize your boss's credentials and work under elite industry titans to gain irreplaceable experience before running your own brand.

quotes.wealth_detail: Sold first company (Waveset) for $150M in 2005; second company (SailPoint) >$500M revenue and $7B go-private PE deal
quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Austin)
quotes.quote: my first job was at IBM and computer sales... we founded that in 2000 after working for big tech for a long time... I didn't start that first business until I was 38 so thankfully I'd learned a few things
quotes.summary_zh: 先在大厂历练再出来创业
quotes.summary_en: Gain real-world experience inside major tech companies—including roles outside your comfort zone like sales—before launching your own venture.

quotes.video_title: Asking Orlando Millionaires How They Got Rich
quotes.quote: when you're young go work for some young companies that are willing to give you some equity and then give them everything you've got
quotes.summary_zh: 年轻时加入肯给股权的早期公司并全力以赴
quotes.summary_en: When young, join early-stage companies willing to grant sweat equity and give them everything you have.

quotes.role_or_title: Former CEO of PostUp (Sold to Upland Software)
quotes.wealth_detail: Sold PostUp to Upland Software for ~$38M
quotes.video_title: Asking Golf Course Millionaires How They Got Rich
quotes.quote: I worked at Sony first at my first job, seven years at Sony and then I went to Dell Computers for seven years and then I got into software.
quotes.summary_zh: 先在索尼、戴尔等大厂深耕十余年，再投身软件创业管理
quotes.summary_en: Build foundational industry and operational experience at established tech leaders before leading your own software company.

quotes.role_or_title: Commercial Real Estate Broker & Brokerage Founder
quotes.wealth_detail: $2M best year (brokerage)
quotes.video_title: How to Make $2 Million in Commercial Real Estate
quotes.quote: I spent 10 years of my career at that firm until I left in 2009 to start my own
quotes.summary_zh: 先在老牌强企深耕十年再独立创业
quotes.summary_en: Spend years learning inside an established, reputable firm before launching your own company.

quotes.role_or_title: President, Industrial IoT Edge Device Management Software Company
quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaires How To Make $1,000,000!
quotes.quote: I had to do it again I would have probably first gone to work for a large company to get exposed to kind of best practices and how things should be done and then going back to a smaller company
quotes.summary_zh: 先去大厂学最佳实践再去小公司
quotes.summary_en: Start at a large company to learn best practices before moving to a smaller company or startup.

quotes.wealth_detail: 8 figures ($10M+) in a single year (cashed out stock options)
quotes.video_title: Asking A Tech Millionaire How To Start & Scale a Tech Company
quotes.quote: You'll learn early and take your learnings and go do a business of your own from what you've learned... only after you've built the base of knowledge.
quotes.summary_zh: 先在好公司打好知识基础再自立门户
quotes.summary_en: Build a strong foundation of industry knowledge working for someone else first, then take those learnings to start your own business.

quotes.role_or_title: Insurance Agency Owner & Top Underwriter (sfg austin.com)
quotes.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Insurance CEO Lavon Perrin
quotes.quote: working for other companies definitely helped me learn how businesses work and be able to take some of those skills and just use them to my advantage
quotes.summary_zh: 先替他人打工积累商业经验，再创业
quotes.summary_en: Work for other companies first to learn business operations and build skills before going out on your own.

quotes.role_or_title: Founder, E-commerce & Digital Marketing Entrepreneur, Investor
quotes.wealth_detail: $15M+ revenue this year; projected $20M-$25M next year; $50M AUM target
quotes.video_title: Day in the Life of a 25 Year Old Millionaire
quotes.quote: Before winning this one I had won it six times for other people... so I was like you know what screw it I'm gonna go do it and get the award for myself
quotes.summary_zh: 先帮赢家打工积累战绩再独立创业
quotes.summary_en: Build a proven track record winning for clients or mentors before launching your own venture.

advice_rankings.tag_zh: 深耕“无聊但稳赚”的传统现金流生意
advice_rankings.desc: Trades, home services, B2B logistics, infrastructure, insurance

quotes.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got Rich! (Beverly Hills)
quotes.quote: Transport is always going to be there, no electronic, no robot or anything like that is going to change it... it's recession proof and people can't replace it.
quotes.summary_zh: 选择抗衰退且难被科技取代的传统刚需行业
quotes.summary_en: Focus on essential, recession-proof businesses like transport and trucking that technology cannot easily replace.

quotes.wealth_detail: Nine-figure annual revenue; takes $4M-$5M/yr in distributions; millionaire at age 17
quotes.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got Rich! (Beverly Hills)
quotes.quote: I would go buy a business from someone who's retiring in a boring, ugly field like roofing, plumbing, HVAC... put in technology... and grow the business.
quotes.summary_zh: 收购退休者手中的传统实业并做数字化升级增长
quotes.summary_en: Acquire profitable, boring service businesses from retiring owners and modernize them with basic software and local SEO.

quotes.wealth_detail: $50M+ best single year
quotes.video_title: Asking Dubai Moguls How They Got Rich!
quotes.quote: mortgage Tech I know it sounds boring but boring businesses are really really great businesses to invest in
quotes.summary_zh: 枯燥但刚需的传统垂直行业往往最赚钱
quotes.summary_en: Boring businesses like mortgage tech are often among the most profitable and reliable investments.

quotes.role_or_title: Phoenix Suns Owner & Mortgage Company CEO
quotes.wealth_detail: Billionaire (became billionaire around age 40-41; company had $3B+ year)
quotes.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got So Rich! (Scottsdale)
quotes.quote: People think it's boring, but it's blocking and tackling, executing every day, and just, you know, try to be the best in one thing.
quotes.summary_zh: 在传统枯燥行业做到极致执行
quotes.summary_en: Succeed in a so-called boring industry through daily execution and aiming to be the best at one thing.

quotes.role_or_title: Founder / Industrialist, Dangote Group (Oil & Gas Refinery, Petrochemicals, Fertilizer)
quotes.wealth_detail: $30B net worth (Forbes at time of interview; $50B+ post-listing per host); $40B+ refinery; $10B Q1 revenue
quotes.video_title: Asking Africa’s Richest Man How He Made $30 Billion!
quotes.quote: We went into real physical businesses, you know, so that actually these are things that we need... I tried to do what you call backward integration to now produce what we used to import.
quotes.summary_zh: 深耕实体刚需产业，通过本土生产替代进口
quotes.summary_en: Build essential physical businesses like cement, sugar, and refining via backward integration.

quotes.role_or_title: Musician & Entrepreneur (Owner of 13 businesses and ~65 car washes)
quotes.wealth_detail: $30M in a single year; hundreds of millions over career (host-stated); owns 13 businesses & ~65 car washes
quotes.video_title: Asking Dubai Supercar Owners How They Got RICH!
quotes.quote: everybody washes their car... even during the pandemic people were washing their cars... it's been recession proof
quotes.summary_zh: 投资洗车店等刚需现金流生意，穿越经济周期
quotes.summary_en: Build everyday essential cash-flow businesses like car washes that stay resilient in recessions and pandemics.

quotes.role_or_title: Entrepreneur & Business Investor (Tech Services, Construction, Supplements; ~10 Companies)
quotes.wealth_detail: $90M-$100M/yr company revenue; $25M/yr personal income; $50M Beverly Hills mansion
quotes.video_title: I Was on Food Stamps... Now I Make $100M/Year
quotes.quote: The focus is getting stuff that cash flows, so laundromat, pool companies, I like the vending machine business... they're recession proof.
quotes.summary_zh: 聚焦抗衰退、重现金流的传统刚需生意
quotes.summary_en: Target recession-proof, low-labor traditional businesses with reliable cash flow such as laundromats, pool companies, and vending machines.

quotes.role_or_title: Former Addiction Treatment Business Founder & Real Estate Investor
quotes.wealth_detail: Sold business for $115M; sold ~$40M underlying real estate; $20M home; $100M+ in a single year
quotes.video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH!
quotes.quote: you're gonna go out and focus on how to make income... I don't care if that's through starting a cleaning business
quotes.summary_zh: 先从务实的清洁或服务业生意赚取收入
quotes.summary_en: Focus on generating strong income first through practical service or sales businesses.

quotes.role_or_title: Founder & Former Owner, NextG Air Conditioning & Plumbing
quotes.wealth_detail: Made over $100M in 2022; sold plumbing/AC/electrical company for $100M+ ($100M+ revenue)
quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaire Mansion Owners How They Got RICH
quotes.quote: We've been through recessions. We've been through the pandemic. In the pandemic, I went from $30 million in revenue to over $100 million in just a 2-year span.
quotes.summary_zh: 传统技工行业抗周期且能规模化做到上亿美元
quotes.summary_en: Traditional trades like plumbing, HVAC, and electrical are resilient through recessions and pandemics and can scale past $100M.

quotes.guest_name: Wall Street Private Equity Firm Founder
quotes.wealth_detail: $500k peak single-year earnings
quotes.video_title: Asking Wall Street Millionaires How To Make $1 Million
quotes.quote: I'm a fan of businesses that make real cash flow... boring businesses as well as financial services businesses that can achieve scale.
quotes.summary_zh: 投资能产生真实稳定现金流的传统实体与金融业务
quotes.summary_en: Focus on scalable financial services and boring real-asset businesses like data centers and waste management that produce real cash flow.

quotes.role_or_title: Founder & Franchise Owner / Commercial Real Estate Investor
quotes.wealth_detail: Over $100M net worth; 270 tanning salon franchise locations
quotes.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich!
quotes.quote: Go find you a boring business from somebody who's looking to retire... the pest control guy, the HVAC company, all those people are making real money.
quotes.summary_zh: 收购婴儿潮退休者出让的无聊但赚钱的传统生意
quotes.summary_en: Buy profitable boring businesses like pest control or HVAC from retiring baby boomers instead of chasing flashy trends.

quotes.wealth_detail: $240M/yr revenue with >20% bottom-line profit (nine-figure business)
quotes.video_title: Asking Scottsdale Millionaires How They Got Rich
quotes.quote: I have a garage door company called A1 Garage Door Service so blue collar home service industry best decision I've ever made... good things come to those who wait
quotes.summary_zh: 深耕蓝领家居服务等传统现金流行业
quotes.summary_en: Build a blue-collar home service business and commit to it for the long haul.

quotes.role_or_title: Private Equity Executive, Real Estate Investor & Sports Team Co-Owner (76ers & Devils)
quotes.wealth_detail: Company manages ~$80B in private equity assets; described as a billionaire
quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Philadelphia)
quotes.quote: AI is not going to fix somebody's toilet or wire their house... these old line businesses... can you modernize something like that?
quotes.summary_zh: 用现代方法改造水电建筑等传统服务业
quotes.summary_en: Target traditional, AI-proof service businesses like plumbing, electrical, and construction and modernize their operations.

quotes.role_or_title: Founder of Military-Base Lawn Mowing Company & Real Estate/Stock Investor
quotes.wealth_detail: Sold company for $10M; owns 2,600 apartments; donated >$10M
quotes.video_title: Asking 90 Year Old Billionaires If Getting Rich Was Worth It
quotes.quote: Started with a lawn mower, became the largest mowing company of individually mowing military bases all over the country.
quotes.summary_zh: 把传统割草这类“无聊生意”做到全美规模化第一
quotes.summary_en: Build scale in an unsexy traditional service business like mowing military bases.

quotes.guest_name: Fiber Optic & Data Center Infrastructure Founder
quotes.wealth_detail: Selling company for $2.5B; completed multi-billion dollar IPO on July 1st
quotes.video_title: Inside Texas’s Billionaire Town (Highland Park)
quotes.quote: We install fiber optic cables for all the major companies and all the data centers... Tons of data centers, tons of needs. It's absolutely a great position to be in right now.
quotes.summary_zh: 抓住数据中心基建刚需，在细分赛道深耕
quotes.summary_en: Position yourself in essential infrastructure niches riding massive real-world demand like fiber optics for data centers.

quotes.role_or_title: Entrepreneur & Investor (Life Insurance, Real Estate, Waste Management)
quotes.wealth_detail: $752M annual revenue (2023); tens of millions personal annual income; $100M company exits
quotes.video_title: I Was Bankrupt… Now I’ve Made $3 Billion
quotes.quote: The majority of us have to go good at sales, service business, do something that's customer-centric, and understand how to scale it.
quotes.summary_zh: 切入可规模化的传统服务与现金流行业
quotes.summary_en: Build and scale customer-centric service businesses instead of banking on rare viral tech inventions.

quotes.role_or_title: Founder of ATM of America & Payment Processing Business
quotes.wealth_detail: Over $10M made in payment processing business
quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Chicago)
quotes.quote: I wanted residual income.
quotes.summary_zh: 选择支付与ATM等刚需业务，打造持续现金流
quotes.summary_en: Build practical recurring-revenue businesses like ATM networks and credit card processing that generate residual cash flow.

quotes.role_or_title: Serial Entrepreneur & Investor (Founder of 17 companies, sold 9 including 3 to Berkshire Hathaway)
quotes.wealth_detail: Over $100M/yr (best year); founded 17 companies, sold 9 (3 to Berkshire Hathaway)
quotes.video_title: Asking Billionaire Texans How They Got Rich!
quotes.quote: Car wash, man... it's like an ATM machine, a legal ATM machine. It's recession proof. It's depression proof.
quotes.summary_zh: 选择洗车行等抗衰退的传统现金流生意
quotes.summary_en: Choose recession-proof traditional cash-flow businesses like car washes.

quotes.guest_name: Silicon Valley Serial Founder & Switchgear Investor
quotes.wealth_detail: Exited companies for $70M+ and ~$285M
quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got Rich! (Silicon Valley)
quotes.quote: I'm in the energy and infrastructure space more now in manufacturing... getting software money out of freaking manufacturing.
quotes.summary_zh: 切入低技术高毛利的实体基建制造
quotes.summary_en: Target capacity-constrained, low-tech traditional infrastructure and manufacturing sectors like switchgear with software-like margins.

quotes.wealth_detail: Sold HomeServe in 2023 for £4.1 billion (~$5B); paid nearly £100M in taxes
quotes.video_title: Asking Billionaires How Much They Pay In Taxes!
quotes.quote: My advice to any aspiring entrepreneur would be, first of all, copy a business model... copy and then improve slightly. Don't reinvent the wheel.
quotes.summary_zh: 深耕刚需传统行业，复制并微调成熟商业模式
quotes.summary_en: Don't reinvent the wheel; look at proven models in unsexy industries like home services, copy one yourself, and improve it slightly.

quotes.role_or_title: E-commerce & Multi-Business Entrepreneur (Founder of For The Low Clothing, @goat_vicc)
quotes.wealth_detail: Over $10M net worth; $6M half-year ($12M/yr per title)
quotes.video_title: From $0 To $12M A Year At 26Years Old. Here’s How
quotes.quote: start a short form business car detailing or something like that just to stack up my funds ... once I stack that up that I can dive back into like digital
quotes.summary_zh: 从零起步先做汽车精洗攒现金流再转线上
quotes.summary_en: If starting from zero, launch a quick cash-flow service business like car detailing to stack capital before scaling into digital ventures.

quotes.role_or_title: Oil & Gas Mogul / Founder of Rise Capital
quotes.wealth_detail: $40M/yr company revenue
quotes.video_title: I Investigated the $1 Trillion Industry Nobody Talks About
quotes.quote: Nobody talks about natural gas. Well, that's exactly why you should do it. You should always go for things the media is not talking about.
quotes.summary_zh: 避开媒体喧嚣，深耕无人问津的传统赛道
quotes.summary_en: Focus on overlooked, unglamorous traditional sectors like natural gas that the mainstream media ignores.

quotes.role_or_title: Founder & CEO, Met Group (Residential & Commercial Solar)
quotes.wealth_detail: ~$30M annual company revenue (targeting $100M in 2-3 years); millionaire at age 24 ("eight-figure entrepreneur")
quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Austin)
quotes.quote: pick something that's boring that you can be amazing at... they have a plumbing company a roofing company a flooring company... Master a craft and then scale it
quotes.summary_zh: 深耕枯燥传统行业并规模化
quotes.summary_en: Choose a proven, unglamorous service or trade business, master the craft, and scale it into a major cash-flow engine.

quotes.guest_name: Marina District Wall Street Finance Veteran
quotes.role_or_title: Founder / Owner, Jail Cell Manufacturing Business
quotes.wealth_detail: 8 figures ($10M+) in a single year
quotes.video_title: Asking A Tech Millionaire How To Start & Scale a Tech Company
quotes.quote: Find a niche, work hard, get the right people—I don't see how you could not be successful.
quotes.summary_zh: 深耕无竞争对手的冷门实体细分行业
quotes.summary_en: Pick an uncrowded niche industry with little competition, work hard, and hire the right team.

advice_rankings.tag: Don't Surround Yourself With Toxic / Negative People
advice_rankings.tag_zh: 远离消耗型圈子与负能量人群
advice_rankings.desc: Cut off doubters, haters, and unmotivated peers

quotes.wealth_detail: Billionaire; built company worth $2.2B-$3.3B enterprise value (sold to Hilton)
quotes.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got Rich! (Beverly Hills)
quotes.quote: You got to stay out of one zip code: the zip code of bad people. If they're around your life, make them go away.
quotes.summary_zh: 果断远离不良圈子与品行不端之人
quotes.summary_en: Cut bad or untrustworthy people out of your life immediately and stay out of their circle.

quotes.role_or_title: Author of Rich Dad Poor Dad & Real Estate Investor
quotes.wealth_detail: Hundreds of millions of dollars in real estate; 30M+ copies of Rich Dad Poor Dad sold
quotes.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got So Rich! (Scottsdale)
quotes.quote: Don't hang out with them, losers... If they're not number one, get somebody else.
quotes.summary_zh: 远离失败者只与顶尖赢家同行
quotes.summary_en: Avoid hanging out with losers; only surround yourself with top performers.

quotes.role_or_title: Former Addiction Treatment Business Founder & Real Estate Investor
quotes.wealth_detail: Sold business for $115M; sold ~$40M underlying real estate; $20M home; $100M+ in a single year
quotes.video_title: Asking Miami Moguls How They Got Rich!
quotes.quote: Your circle matters more than you realize. I see too many young people... hanging out with losers doing loser stuff.
quotes.summary_zh: 果断疏远不思进取的损友圈层
quotes.summary_en: Distance yourself from unmotivated peers and stay ruthlessly loyal to your future.

quotes.role_or_title: Construction Company Owner & Real Estate Investor
quotes.wealth_detail: $5M/yr peak take-home; $35M/yr business revenue; 400+ real estate doors (became a millionaire at 31-32)
quotes.video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH!
quotes.quote: be kind to those people... respectfully go your own Direction and don't put yourself around them if they're not on the same path as you
quotes.summary_zh: 礼貌远离不同频且不理解你的人，走自己的路
quotes.summary_en: Stay polite toward doubters close to you, but distance yourself from people who are not on your path.

quotes.role_or_title: Real Estate Investor, Lender & Creative Finance Entrepreneur
quotes.wealth_detail: $500M portfolio; $115M company revenue; $15M/yr personal net
quotes.video_title: Asking Bugatti Owners How They Got RICH!
quotes.quote: stop trying to convince the world around you to believe in your vision... if they don't believe in you today they're never going to believe in you move on
quotes.summary_zh: 停止浪费时间说服怀疑者，远离不认可你的人
quotes.summary_en: Stop wasting years trying to convince skeptics and move on to people who believe in you.

quotes.role_or_title: Boxer, Content Creator, Entrepreneur & Startup Investor
quotes.wealth_detail: Became millionaire around age 20; projected close to nine figures ($100M) net income in a single year
quotes.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich! (Palm Beach)
quotes.quote: A lot of these people are pushing their own limitations... on to you... Not a single successful person has ever said anything hating on me... It's the losers who try to drag you down to their level.
quotes.summary_zh: 別理會比你差的人的酸言酸語，他們只是在投射自身侷限
quotes.summary_en: Ignore haters and doubters who project their own insecurities and try to drag you down.

quotes.wealth_detail: Over $10M/yr in recent years (age 36)
quotes.video_title: Asking Atlanta Millionaires How They Got RICH!
quotes.quote: The biggest way to kill a big dream is to introduce it to a small mind. Be very guarded who you share your goals and dreams with.
quotes.summary_zh: 别把大梦想告诉格局小的人，谨防被否定
quotes.summary_en: Guard your goals closely and do not share big dreams with small-minded people or unmotivated peers.

quotes.video_title: A 60 Year Old Millionaire Shares What Actually Made Him RICH!
quotes.quote: there definitely people that do have those hidden intentions... more than I should probably have been subjected to or worse to suffer.
quotes.summary_zh: 警惕别有用心之人，避免被恶意伤害
quotes.summary_en: Stay alert to people with hidden motives, even while recognizing most people are well-intentioned.

quotes.guest_name: Wall Street Finance Veteran (15-16 Years, Age 45)
quotes.video_title: I Asked Wall Street Millionaires How They Got RICH!
quotes.quote: you are the sum total of the five people you hang around with so be careful of the people you have around you be very selective
quotes.summary_zh: 你是最常相处的五人的总和，精选朋友圈
quotes.summary_en: Be very selective about your inner circle because you become the sum total of the five people you spend time with.

quotes.wealth_detail: $100M+ exit (nine-figure exit); millionaire in 20s, liquidity event at 50
quotes.video_title: Asking Billionaires What To Invest In!
quotes.quote: Surround yourself with givers, get the toxicity out of your life... If you hang around nine broke people, you'll be the tenth.
quotes.summary_zh: 远离消耗型人群，与付出者同行才能提升圈层
quotes.summary_en: Remove toxic takers from your circle and surround yourself with givers, as proximity shapes your outcome.

quotes.role_or_title: Real Estate Investor, Entrepreneur & Author (Cardone Capital / 10X)

quotes.summary_en: Never ignore relationship red flags and choose partners and people who genuinely love you back.

quotes.summary_en: Stop taking financial advice from broke peers who act like crabs in a bucket pulling you down.

quotes.summary_en: Cut off people who cannot see your vision or hold you back, even if they are otherwise good people.

quotes.video_title: Meet The Kid Who Interviews Billionaires For a Living
quotes.quote: there were brand deals there was starting a Content agency there was building a private Community there was ad Revenue there's all these different streams
quotes.summary_zh: 围绕核心资产叠加品牌合作、代理、社群与广告等多元收入
quotes.summary_en: Layer multiple complementary revenue streams—brand deals, agency, community, and ads—on one core asset.

quotes.wealth_detail: $22M single-year income (2021); ~$4.5B annual real estate sales; $195M single residential sale; became a millionaire at ~28
quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (New York City)
quotes.quote: work for yourself have 10 streams of income doing whatever you want whenever you want
quotes.summary_zh: 为自己工作，打造多元收入来源
quotes.summary_en: Reject the outdated student-debt-to-9-to-5 script; work for yourself and build multiple streams of income.

quotes.wealth_detail: $18M best single year; crossed Funnel Hacking Live stage doing over $25M
quotes.video_title: Asking Orlando Millionaire’s How They Got RICH!
quotes.quote: any business that you have should make money three or four ways... you should have at least four verticals to your business always
quotes.summary_zh: 构建至少四条变现业务线，打造抗衰退模式
quotes.summary_en: Build a recession-proof business with at least four revenue verticals: digital products, in-person events, core services, and high-ticket mentorship.

quotes.wealth_detail: Hundreds of millions of dollars
quotes.video_title: I Asked Celebrities How They Got Rich!
quotes.quote: It's called 'multiples'. Why not? You got to give yourself the opportunity. I don't close the doors on myself. Leave the door open.
quotes.summary_zh: 保持收入多元化，不给自己关上任何机会门
quotes.summary_en: Embrace diversification and build multiple income streams while keeping every opportunity door open.

quotes.role_or_title: Content Creator, WWE Wrestler & Co-Founder of Prime
quotes.wealth_detail: First $1M at age 21; $25M-$30M/yr ($50M+ in a single year at age 22); Prime did $1.2B in year 2
quotes.video_title: I Asked Logan Paul How He Built a Billion-Dollar Business
quotes.quote: It's so important. I have a unique, diverse set of interests, and I get to do all of them because I started with this.
quotes.summary_zh: 在核心优势基础上围绕多元兴趣拓展收入版图
quotes.summary_en: Diversify across ventures aligned with your interests once your core audience or platform is established.

quotes.guest_name: San Antonio Audi R8 Real Estate & Exotic Car Rental Owner
quotes.role_or_title: Real Estate / Airbnb Investor (~38-40 Units) & Exotic Car Rental Owner
quotes.wealth_detail: $1.3M/yr gross; ~38-40 properties/units; 6-car fleet
quotes.video_title: Asking Entrepreneurs How They Got RICH! (San Antonio)
quotes.quote: for me it was just something to be another layer on top of something else already had
quotes.summary_zh: 在现有资产之上叠加新业务，打造多元收入
quotes.summary_en: Layer complementary cash-flowing businesses—like exotic car rentals for Airbnb guests—on top of existing assets.

quotes.guest_name: Military Veteran Consultant & Real Estate Investor
quotes.role_or_title: Consultant, Project Manager & Real Estate Investor
quotes.wealth_detail: $500,000-$600,000/yr (highest single-year income); owns 4 properties
quotes.video_title: Asking Strangers How Much MONEY They Make (Austin, Texas)
quotes.quote: the whole time I always had something on the side I always had some form of entrepreneurial mindset no matter what I do
quotes.summary_zh: 工作之余坚持发展副业，始终保持创业者思维
quotes.summary_en: Maintain an entrepreneurial side hustle alongside your main career to build additional income streams.

quotes.role_or_title: Founder of Web Analytics Company (Web trans)
quotes.wealth_detail: Sold company for $1.03B ($1 billion 30 million) at age 33
quotes.video_title: I Asked Texan Millionaires Their Best Financial Decision
quotes.quote: doing something that creates revenue for you when you're not actually working... as long as you've got passive income... you're going to do very well
quotes.summary_zh: 打造不亲自工作也能创收的被动收入体系
quotes.summary_en: Create passive income streams that generate revenue even when you're not working.

quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaires What They Are Investing in
quotes.quote: go through it with the military serve the military get your pension then get your second job as a doctor collect a pension for the rest of your life through the military
quotes.summary_zh: 医疗从业者可通过军队服役获得终身养老金，叠加第二份职业收入
quotes.summary_en: For medical/dental careers, consider serving through the military to secure a lifetime pension alongside your second career income.

quotes.role_or_title: Co-owner of Teifke Real Estate (TRE) & Real Estate Investor
quotes.video_title: From Minimum Wage to Real Estate Millionaire
quotes.quote: You should be the true real estate professional and not just limit yourself to one thing because if the market shifts... you're going to be limited in how much money you can make.
quotes.summary_zh: 掌握地产全链条技能，实现多元变现并抵御波动
quotes.summary_en: Master every facet of real estate rather than one niche so market shifts cannot cap your income.

advice_rankings.tag: Don't Neglect Health & Family for Money
advice_rankings.tag_zh: 别为赚钱牺牲健康与家人陪伴
advice_rankings.desc: Regretting working too much at cost of health, spouse, or kids

quotes.guest_name: Boca Raton Multifamily Real Estate Investor
quotes.wealth_detail: Bought a $72M deal with zero money down via creative financing; lost $250M in equity and cash in one down-market year
quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich
quotes.quote: My businesses becomes my identity versus I have my own identity... workaholism... it's a sedation because we don't want to be in the present moment.
quotes.summary_zh: 别把工作当成麻痹逃避，更别将身份绑定生意
quotes.summary_en: Do not let workaholism sedate you or allow your business to become your entire identity.

quotes.role_or_title: Founder & CEO (Retired Doctor), Healthcare & Software Companies
quotes.wealth_detail: $500M-$700M net worth; $100M/yr revenue (company worth ~$1B)
quotes.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich! (Scottsdale)
quotes.quote: I never saw my kids go wake up I never saw them go to bed... I sacrificed a lot of my children's youth
quotes.summary_zh: 过度工作牺牲陪伴孩子成长的时光
quotes.summary_en: Working six days a week meant sacrificing time with his kids during their youth.

quotes.role_or_title: Serial Entrepreneur & Private Jet / Beverage Company Founder
quotes.wealth_detail: Sold 4 companies including a private jet company with $5B+ in sales; made hundreds of millions of dollars; became a millionaire at 26
quotes.video_title: Asking Atlanta Billionaires How They Got Rich!
quotes.quote: Put more on your plate of what it is you love to do with the people you love to do it with... we tend to over index in the energy we put into the financial side, but we tend to sometimes neglect the spiritual side.
quotes.summary_zh: 别只顾赚钱而忽略挚爱之人、友情与生活体验
quotes.summary_en: Don't over-index on money at the expense of adventure, friendships, and the people you love.

quotes.role_or_title: Founder of Braintree/Venmo & Rejuvenation Olympics Competitor
quotes.wealth_detail: Sold Braintree/Venmo for $800M
quotes.video_title: Asking Texan Billionaires How They Got Rich!
quotes.quote: Make health your number one life priority... I really traded health for wealth and it hurt my ability to create wealth.
quotes.summary_zh: 别为赚钱透支健康，健康排第一
quotes.summary_en: Regrets trading health for wealth during his startup grind, noting that peak health yields better entrepreneurial performance.

quotes.wealth_detail: Built multiple eight-figure businesses; most made in a single year: "a couple million in a year"
quotes.video_title: Meet The Most Interesting Man On The Planet
quotes.quote: Don't get so caught up that you forget the fact that you've got health and your family's got health.
quotes.summary_zh: 别为逐利忽视健康与家人
quotes.summary_en: Don't get so caught up pursuing business and money that you neglect your health and family.

quotes.guest_name: Houston Private Chef & Former Touring Musician
quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich
quotes.quote: it's all about balance so you got to make time for it if you burn yourself out and you let life pass you by sure you have a lot of money but you know don't take that with you
quotes.summary_zh: 注重工作生活平衡，别因透支错过人生
quotes.summary_en: Maintain work-life balance and avoid burning out for money because you cannot take wealth with you.

quotes.role_or_title: Commercial Real Estate Entrepreneur & Downtown Property Owner
quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Philadelphia)
quotes.quote: Spend as much time as you can with your family.
quotes.summary_zh: 人生苦短，尽可能多花时间陪伴家人
quotes.summary_en: Prioritize spending as much time as possible with your family, recognizing how fragile life can be.

quotes.role_or_title: Founder of Morgan & Morgan (Largest Personal Injury Law Firm in North America)
quotes.wealth_detail: $1.5B net worth (Forbes); $2B annual firm fees; $5B annual settlements and verdicts
quotes.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH! (Florida)
quotes.quote: On our last day, we're not going to be talking about money or what deal we didn't do. We're going to be talking about and thinking about the time we didn't spend with the people we love.
quotes.summary_zh: 临终只会遗憾陪伴挚爱太少，而非少做一笔交易
quotes.summary_en: Remember what matters at the end of life—you will care about missed time with loved ones, not the deals or money you missed.

quotes.role_or_title: Founder of a Billion-Dollar Satellite Company
quotes.wealth_detail: Built a billion-dollar company; won multi-billion-dollar US government contract
quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got Rich! (Silicon Valley)
quotes.quote: I worked six or seven days a week for years. Didn't get to see my son's football games and stuff like that.
quotes.summary_zh: 创业拼搏常需牺牲陪伴家人时间
quotes.summary_en: Working nonstop for years comes with personal sacrifice, such as missing your children's milestones.

quotes.guest_name: Former TGI Fridays CEO & Golden Chick Franchisee
quotes.role_or_title: Former TGI Fridays CEO & Golden Chick Franchisee (age 70+)
quotes.wealth_detail: ~$1B biggest annual revenue across businesses
quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Dallas)
quotes.quote: if you're just working to work then your health will be crap
quotes.summary_zh: 别只顾着盲目工作而拖垮自己的健康
quotes.summary_en: Do not work endlessly just for the sake of working at the expense of your health.

quotes.wealth_detail: Estimated hundreds of millions (host-stated); owns ~6 businesses
quotes.video_title: I Asked Mark Wahlberg for His Best Life Advice!
quotes.quote: family is more important than anything. It's like, what good are you if you're successful in business and fail as a father or husband? What's it all for?
quotes.summary_zh: 家庭比事业更重要，别为赚钱忽视家人平衡
quotes.summary_en: Maintain balance and put family first; business success is hollow if you fail as a spouse or parent.

quotes.wealth_detail: Billionaire; $189M peak single-year personal income (pre-tax); ~$15B lifetime case results; $13M & $15.5M homes; $27M art collection; $8M jet
quotes.video_title: A Day in the Life Of a Texas Billionaire!
quotes.quote: Even when I was working 18 hours a day, I would set aside an hour and a half, 2 hours to go home, have dinner with my children.
quotes.summary_zh: 再忙也要优先陪伴家人和孩子
quotes.summary_en: Never let extreme work hours cost you your family; intentionally carve out daily time for your kids.

quotes.guest_name: San Antonio Former Wealth Manager, CEO & Construction Owner
quotes.role_or_title: Former Wealth Manager, Company President/CEO & Construction Company Owner
quotes.wealth_detail: Over $500k/yr (peak single year)
quotes.video_title: Asking Entrepreneurs How They Got RICH! (San Antonio)
quotes.quote: you gotta have a happy and good personal life to be successful in your business life if it's all about business at the end of the road you won't be happy
quotes.summary_zh: 经营好家庭生活，勿为赚钱忽略幸福
quotes.summary_en: Prioritize a happy marriage and personal life; pure business focus leaves you unhappy at the end.

quotes.role_or_title: Insurance Agency Owner & Top Underwriter (sfg austin.com)
quotes.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Insurance CEO Lavon Perrin
quotes.quote: I was in the car business right and everybody knows what happens in a car business right four or five divorces... I didn't want that but I wanted to be able to see my kids
quotes.summary_zh: 不为赚钱牺牲家庭与陪伴孩子的时间
quotes.summary_en: Avoid career paths or work habits that cost you your marriage and time with your children.

quotes.role_or_title: Tech Entrepreneur & Information Security Pioneer (New Startup Founder)
quotes.wealth_detail: Sold tech company for over $1 billion; owned 95% with partner at 1999 IPO; grew to $120M in annual sales within 4 years
quotes.video_title: How I Turned $1,000 Into $1 Billion
quotes.quote: I would tell myself to take care of my health better because I think that's the first and easiest thing to let go as an entrepreneur.
quotes.summary_zh: 切勿为事业拼命而忽略健康与家庭
quotes.summary_en: Protect your physical health and meaningful relationships instead of letting 60-70 hour workweeks cause burnout or divorce.

quotes.role_or_title: Founder, E-commerce & Digital Marketing Entrepreneur, Investor
quotes.wealth_detail: $15M+ revenue this year; projected $20M-$25M next year; $50M AUM target
quotes.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Founder & E-commerce Entrepreneur Robert Miller
quotes.quote: I've gone the full burnout way where you working 16 hours a day... health is very very serious
quotes.summary_zh: 切勿为工作过度透支身体，失去健康一切归零
quotes.summary_en: Don't burn yourself out with 16-hour days and sleep deprivation; a severe health scare proved physical health must come first.

quotes.role_or_title: Investor, Board Member & Former CEO/COO of HMS Holdings
quotes.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Investor & Executive Doug Williams
quotes.quote: They haven't built family relationships and all they have is money. Money by itself is not very fun.
quotes.summary_zh: 别为赚钱忽视家庭，退休只剩钱并无乐趣
quotes.summary_en: Be fully present with family when you are home; professionals who only chase work end up rich at 65 without real relationships.

quotes.guest_name: Cedar Park Event Expert Panelist (Young Entrepreneur Advisor)
quotes.video_title: School of Hard Knocks First Speaking Event!
quotes.quote: take time to enjoy life while you're doing it um it's a lonely Place burnout is rampant
quotes.summary_zh: 创业途中也要享受生活，警惕孤独与倦怠
quotes.summary_en: Make time to enjoy life while building your venture, as entrepreneurship can be lonely and burnout is widespread.

advice_rankings.tag: Don't Wait Too Long to Start / Invest
advice_rankings.tag_zh: 后悔起步创业或开始投资太晚
advice_rankings.desc: Wish I had taken risks, bought assets, or started earlier

quotes.role_or_title: Franchise Owner (Formerly 155 Five Guys Locations) & NBA Legend
quotes.wealth_detail: Became a millionaire at age 18
quotes.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews SHAQ
quotes.quote: Not pulling the trigger when I had the opportunity to... Howard Schultz wanted to open Starbucks in the hood... I didn't pull the trigger.
quotes.summary_zh: 后悔当年犹豫未投资星巴克，错失良机
quotes.summary_en: Regrets hesitating and failing to pull the trigger on partnering with Starbucks early on.

quotes.role_or_title: Founder of The Corcoran Group & Shark Tank Investor
quotes.wealth_detail: Sold The Corcoran Group for $66M cash in one day
quotes.video_title: She Turned $1,000 Into a $66M Empire at 76 Years Old!
quotes.quote: I got scared and I purposely failed the board. Do you know it took me eight years to catch up to the market?
quotes.summary_zh: 莫因恐惧错失首次买房良机，尽早上车积累筹码
quotes.summary_en: Don't back out of buying your first property out of fear—getting in early gives you equity to trade up.

quotes.wealth_detail: Made over $100M in a single year and career; $2B in career sales; $50M in California tax-free bonds
quotes.video_title: I Asked Dana White How He Made $500 Million!
quotes.quote: They wanted me to put $5,000 into the search engine... I should have taken that five grand and bought his stock and it'll be worth a lot of money today.
quotes.summary_zh: 后悔当年错过花5000美元投资谷歌早期股权的机会
quotes.summary_en: Regrets passing on an early $5,000 investment in Google stock when given the chance.

quotes.role_or_title: Real Estate Investor, Entrepreneur & Author (Cardone Capital / 10X)
quotes.wealth_detail: Billionaire; $5B real estate portfolio (12,000 units), $1.1B raised via crowdfunding, $155M/yr revenue
quotes.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews Billionaire Grant Cardone
quotes.quote: one of my downfalls was I didn't use it correctly I saved it I just stored it stacked it over and over and over again... I wouldn't stack money at all
quotes.summary_zh: 后悔早期只顾存现金，未及时投入自我与资产
quotes.summary_en: Regrets letting cash sit idle in savings instead of deploying it sooner into self-development, business growth, and real assets.

quotes.role_or_title: Bank Owner & Executive (44 years in banking)
quotes.wealth_detail: ~$500M/year (most made in a single year)
quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Dallas)
quotes.quote: go out on my own sooner than I did
quotes.summary_zh: 后悔没有比当年更早出来独立创业
quotes.summary_en: He wishes he had gone out on his own and started his own business sooner.

quotes.wealth_detail: Billionaire; $35M LA house, $515K+ Rolls-Royce
quotes.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich! (Hollywood)
quotes.quote: So don't wait too long starting now because you're already getting old because when you get into your 30s and your 40s, it slides down the hill. So do it.
quotes.summary_zh: 趁年轻立刻行动别等老了再后悔
quotes.summary_en: Life moves fast—start now while young instead of waiting until your 30s or 40s.

quotes.role_or_title: Founder, Commercial Real Estate Company (~$1B AUM)
quotes.wealth_detail: Eight-figure commercial real estate portfolio; closed a $25M shopping center deal; first $575K property refinanced at $800K generating $5,000/mo free cash flow
quotes.video_title: He Turned $100k Into $25M
quotes.quote: I very rarely ever hear of a person saying I don't want to own a second they say I should have done it sooner so start early
quotes.summary_zh: 买房投资要趁早，人们只会后悔起步太晚
quotes.summary_en: Start buying assets as early as possible; almost nobody regrets starting, only waiting too long.

quotes.role_or_title: Oscar-Winning Actor, Author & Pantalones Tequila Co-Founder
quotes.video_title: Asking One of Hollywood's Biggest Stars How He Got Rich!
quotes.quote: And I say I wish I had taken more risk as a kid. I look back, I took quite a few risks as a kid. I still wish I would have taken more.
quotes.summary_zh: 遗憾年轻时冒的风险不够多，鼓励趁早搏
quotes.summary_en: Take more risks when you are young; even after taking many, you may wish you had taken more.

quotes.role_or_title: Project Architect at a High-End Design Firm
quotes.video_title: Asking Golf Course Millionaires How They Got Rich
quotes.quote: They understood that they needed to invest. So, if you can invest your money early on, the earlier the better.
quotes.summary_zh: 越早开始投资越好，不要等到错过最佳复利期
quotes.summary_en: Start investing your money as early as possible rather than waiting after graduation.

quotes.video_title: These Millionaires Gave Us Life Changing Advice...
quotes.quote: I think I would have invested more in like real estate and in stocks and stuff rather than just leaving it in cash and things like that or spending it on you know trips and stuff... still want to have maybe some targets right to shoot for
quotes.summary_zh: 后悔未尽早投资房产股票，别只留现金或享乐
quotes.summary_en: Set clear financial targets and invest earlier in real estate and stocks instead of sitting in cash or overspending on trips.

quotes.video_title: Asking Denver Millionaires How Much Money They Make
quotes.quote: Honestly if I could go back I could start learning sales like 14, 15, 16 years old, I would.
quotes.summary_zh: 后悔没在十四五岁就开始学习销售技能
quotes.summary_en: Wishes he had started learning sales as early as ages 14 to 16.

quotes.role_or_title: Insurance Agency Owner & Top Underwriter (sfg austin.com)
quotes.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Insurance CEO Lavon Perrin
quotes.quote: personal growth and development is probably the biggest things that I would do differently I would start doing personal development at a younger age
quotes.summary_zh: 后悔年轻时未早点开始自我提升与阅读
quotes.summary_en: Do not delay personal development; start reading and investing in self-growth as early as possible.

quotes.role_or_title: Co-owner of Teifke Real Estate (TRE) & Real Estate Investor
quotes.video_title: From Minimum Wage to Real Estate Millionaire
quotes.quote: The worst financial decision was to not take more risks.
quotes.summary_zh: 后悔过去没有更早承担更大风险去投资布局
quotes.summary_en: Regrets not taking even bigger risks earlier on in his investing and business journey.

quotes.role_or_title: Investor, Board Member & Former CEO/COO of HMS Holdings
quotes.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Investor & Executive Doug Williams
quotes.quote: The worst decision I made was not buying enough Bitcoin or Tesla—invested in both, but not enough.
quotes.summary_zh: 遗憾早期对看好的资产下注不够重
quotes.summary_en: His biggest financial regret was not investing enough into high-conviction bets like Bitcoin and Tesla when he bought them.

advice_rankings.tag_zh: 选对人生伴侣与支持型配偶
advice_rankings.desc: Marry a supportive partner aligned on values and long-term ambition

quotes.role_or_title: Fitness & Health Entrepreneur / Fit TV Founder
quotes.wealth_detail: Sold Fit TV to News Corp for over $100M
quotes.video_title: I Asked Robert Herjavec How He Made $500 Million
quotes.quote: The most important thing is you have to have a partner who's with you all the way.
quotes.summary_zh: 选择全力支持你的人生伴侣
quotes.summary_en: Having a committed life partner who stands by you is essential.

quotes.wealth_detail: Over $5M/yr law firm revenue
quotes.video_title: Asking Black Millionaires How They Got Rich! (Atlanta)
quotes.quote: How important is a decision to choose the right life partner? It's everything. This decision is everything.
quotes.summary_zh: 选择契合的人生伴侣对成功至关重要
quotes.summary_en: Recognize that choosing the right life partner is one of the most critical decisions for success.

quotes.wealth_detail: Close to $2M in a single year from preschools
quotes.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich! (Atlanta)
quotes.quote: The number one thing, period. I couldn't have done nothing without it.
quotes.summary_zh: 选对人生伴侣是成功的头等大事
quotes.summary_en: Choosing the right spouse is the single most important decision for long-term success.

quotes.guest_name: Former TGI Fridays CEO & Golden Chick Franchisee
quotes.role_or_title: Former TGI Fridays CEO & Golden Chick Franchisee (age 70+)
quotes.wealth_detail: ~$1B biggest annual revenue across businesses
quotes.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Dallas)
quotes.quote: choose the right life partner... you got to have support at home
quotes.summary_zh: 选对支持自己的人生伴侣至关重要
quotes.summary_en: Choose a supportive life partner, because misery at home ruins your work life and health.

quotes.wealth_detail: $2.5M peak single-year income
quotes.video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH! (Florida)
quotes.quote: It's one of the most important things cuz if you marry the wrong person it take you in the opposite direction of what you're trying to go.
quotes.summary_zh: 选对伴侣至关重要，错的人会拖垮你的方向
quotes.summary_en: Marrying the right partner propels your growth, whereas the wrong spouse pulls you away from your goals.

quotes.role_or_title: Founder & CEO, B2B SaaS Marketing Tech Company
quotes.wealth_detail: Sold last B2B SaaS company for $235M
quotes.video_title: Asking Self-Made Female Billionaires How They Got Rich!
quotes.quote: Life's a team sport, and if you have someone that believes in you and supports you and helps you to achieve your dreams, you can do anything.
quotes.summary_zh: 选择无条件支持并相信你梦想的人生伴侣
quotes.summary_en: Marry a supportive partner who believes in your vision, because life and business are a team sport.
