zero_start_playbook.guest_name: Beverly Hills Finance & Real Estate Investor
zero_start_playbook.role_or_title: Finance Executive & Real Estate Investor (50+ LLCs)
zero_start_playbook.wealth_detail: $1B business figure stated; owns 50+ real estate LLCs
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 极度努力工作，只投资自己理解的资产（如住宅房产），通过LLC保护资产并深入理解税务，同时别忘了享受生活。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Work relentlessly, invest only in assets you truly understand such as residential real estate, and master taxes while protecting your assets through LLCs. Above all, remember to enjoy life along the way.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: Asking Billionaire Women How They Got RICH!

zero_start_playbook.wealth_detail: Company valued at $3B when sold in 2018 (100% ownership prior)
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 不要害怕开始并坚持自信，初期绝不乱花钱虚荣攀比，盯紧现金流与利润并把赚到的钱不断复投，同时拥抱社媒与AI等新变化。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Do not be afraid to start and stay confident, avoid spending recklessly early on to show off, and watch cash flow and profit closely while constantly reinvesting earnings. At the same time, embrace new shifts like social media and AI.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: Asking Billionaire Women How They Got RICH!

zero_start_playbook.guest_name: Atlanta Tech Founder & Former Wall Street Banker
zero_start_playbook.role_or_title: Tech Company Founder & Former Wall Street Professional
zero_start_playbook.wealth_detail: Just shy of $10M in a single year; owns an eight-figure tech company; millionaire at 33
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 财富始于内心信念，先相信自己配得上进入顶级圈层；不要只靠省钱和打工，要通过拥有公司股权或自己创业并积极投资让钱生钱。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Wealth starts with believing you deserve a seat in top circles. Instead of relying solely on saving or a paycheck, build equity or start your own business and invest aggressively to make your money work for you.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: Asking Billionaire Women How They Got RICH!

zero_start_playbook.wealth_detail: Sold Spanx for $1.2B; made hundreds of millions in a single year
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 解决一个真实痛点，赌上自己并保持乐趣；在想法刚萌芽最脆弱的头一年先悄悄打磨，不要急于听亲友意见，同时把无数次拒绝当成通往成功的必经之路。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Solve a real pain point, bet on yourself, and keep things fun. Protect your fragile idea in its first year by refining it quietly without seeking friends' or family's opinions, and treat constant rejection as a normal step toward success.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: Asking Billionaire Women How They Got RICH!

zero_start_playbook.guest_name: Los Angeles Former Model & Real Estate Developer
zero_start_playbook.role_or_title: Real Estate Developer & Home Builder (Former Model)
zero_start_playbook.wealth_detail: $3.5M profit on last property
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 起步时要敢于冒险并相信自己，把赚到的利润不断再投资并善用1031置换延税以做大规模。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Be willing to take risks and believe in yourself when starting out. Continuously reinvest your profits and leverage 1031 exchanges to defer taxes and scale faster.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich

zero_start_playbook.guest_name: Los Angeles Software Engineer & Marketing Agency Founder
zero_start_playbook.role_or_title: Marketing Agency Founder & Former Software Engineer
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 不要过度思考、果断决策行动，脚踏实地拼命干且绝不走捷径；同时努力工作、精明投资并坚持储蓄。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Stop overthinking, make decisive moves, and outwork everyone on the ground without taking shortcuts, all while investing wisely and saving consistently.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich

zero_start_playbook.wealth_detail: $200M annual revenue
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 条件尚未齐备时就先行动并投入资源逼自己一把，坚持将收入三等分（1/3生活、1/3缴税储蓄、1/3设为绝对不动的备用金），靠自己彻底改写家族命运。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Take action and commit resources before everything feels ready to force yourself forward, and divide your income strictly into thirds: one-third for living, one-third for taxes and savings, and one-third as an untouchable reserve. Take full responsibility to rewrite your family's destiny.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich

zero_start_playbook.wealth_detail: Nine-figure annual revenue; takes $4M-$5M/yr in distributions; millionaire at age 17
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 若从零起步要在一年内赚100万美元，会利用卖家融资加SBA贷款收购60岁退休老板的屋顶、管道或暖通（HVAC）等传统枯燥实业，再通过表格自动化开票与Google本地排名优化实现增长。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: To make $1 million in a year starting from zero, he recommends combining seller financing with an SBA loan to buy a "boring" traditional business like roofing, plumbing, or HVAC from a 60-year-old retiring owner. Then drive rapid growth by automating invoicing with spreadsheets and optimizing local Google rankings.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got Rich! (Beverly Hills)

zero_start_playbook.wealth_detail: First million at age 22; within the $10M+ single-year income range
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 瞄准2026年及未来的AI行业机遇，借助阿布扎比成熟的基础设施与无障碍投资环境起步。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Target the AI opportunities emerging in 2026 and beyond, and take advantage of Abu Dhabi's mature infrastructure and friction-free investment environment to launch.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: Asking Middle Eastern Billionaires How They Got Rich!

zero_start_playbook.wealth_detail: Made first $1B at age 39; sold AI company for over $1B
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 走出家乡和居家舒适区，去全球有机会的地方建立连接，并先从小事入手从无到有创造作品。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Step outside your hometown and domestic comfort zone to build connections wherever global opportunities exist. Start small and focus on creating something tangible from nothing.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: Asking Middle Eastern Billionaires How They Got Rich!

zero_start_playbook.wealth_detail: $300M/month in payment processing volume
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 每天保持学习新知，在销售中深入研究客户并把拒绝当作沟通起点，投资上坚持恐慌期低吸并长期持有。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Commit to learning something new every day, research your clients deeply in sales, and treat every "no" as the starting point of a conversation. As an investor, buy during periods of panic and hold for the long term.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: Asking Middle Eastern Billionaires How They Got Rich!

zero_start_playbook.guest_name: Dubai Property Developer & Shark Tank Dubai Judge
zero_start_playbook.role_or_title: Real Estate Developer & Shark Tank Dubai Judge
zero_start_playbook.wealth_detail: Sold over $10B of real estate last year; runs billion-dollar private property development company
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 从无需大额启动资金的服务业起步积累现金流，再用利润复投土地开发或借助AI工具快速做出商业计划与原型去融资。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Start in a service business that requires minimal upfront capital to build cash flow. Then reinvest those profits into land development, or use AI tools to rapidly build business plans and prototypes to raise funding.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: Asking Middle Eastern Billionaires How They Got Rich!

zero_start_playbook.wealth_detail: $12M annual turnover
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 有想法就立刻去执行，不要听信不懂商业的人的质疑；初期砍掉所有不必要订阅消费，拼命存钱并持续投资，同时牢牢掌控公司资金流向。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Execute on your ideas immediately without listening to skeptics who know nothing about business. Early on, cut every unnecessary subscription, save aggressively to keep investing, and keep a tight grip on where every dollar in your company goes.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: Asking Dubai Moguls How They Got Rich!

zero_start_playbook.wealth_detail: $1.5B company valuation ($100M+ raised)
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 选择处于正确风口的行业（当前看好AI与区块链/Web3），从一无所有起步反而没有包袱且更懂金钱价值，不要把钱存在银行定期，而是投资高增长且高流动性的资产。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Pick an industry with strong tailwinds, such as AI and blockchain/Web3, and recognize that starting with nothing gives you zero baggage and a sharper appreciation for money. Don't leave cash sitting in bank CDs; put it into high-growth, liquid assets.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: Asking Dubai Moguls How They Got Rich!

zero_start_playbook.wealth_detail: $50M+ best single year
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 不要害羞，走出屏幕主动社交并制造“碰撞时刻”，以非功利交友的方式结交高端人脉；同时选择可无限复制的数字/科技产品，盯着5年后的未来趋势提前布局。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Don't be shy; step away from your screen to network in person, engineer serendipitous encounters, and build genuine, non-transactional friendships with high-caliber people. Focus on infinitely scalable digital or tech products positioned for trends five years ahead.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: Asking Dubai Moguls How They Got Rich!

zero_start_playbook.wealth_detail: $300M net worth; $100M personal annual income
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 没钱时要孤注一掷拼命干并组建顶尖团队，失败了也不要放弃而是把经验用到下一个项目；有钱后要做好多元化配置，不要只存钱，要持续投资自己的健康、大脑、事业以及股票和区块链资产。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: When you have nothing, go all-in, build an A-list team, and carry every lesson from failure into your next venture. Once you build wealth, diversify beyond cash by investing continuously in your health, mind, business, stocks, and blockchain assets.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: Asking Dubai Moguls How They Got Rich!

zero_start_playbook.wealth_detail: $1.5M highest single year; became a millionaire at 21
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 有想法就立刻执行，别花两周纠结Logo等细节，在行动中边做边调整；同时尽早学会授权，高薪善待优秀团队成员。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Execute on ideas immediately and adjust on the fly instead of spending two weeks agonizing over details like a logo. Learn to delegate early and pay great team members well.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH! (Las Vegas)

zero_start_playbook.wealth_detail: $5.4M highest single year
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 不要只为个人短期利益奔波，要放眼长远为家族后代种树乘凉；同时保持开放进取的心态，哪怕从收发室做起也要力争上游。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Think beyond short-term personal gain and plant trees whose shade future generations of your family can enjoy. Stay open-minded and hungry to advance, even if you have to start in the mailroom.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH! (Las Vegas)

zero_start_playbook.guest_name: Las Vegas Convention Center Lamborghini Real Estate Investor
zero_start_playbook.wealth_detail: Tens of millions of dollars in annual revenue (multiple 8-figure entrepreneur)
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 不要抱怨缺乏背景资源，鼓起勇气谦卑向能帮你的人开口；戒掉酒精与消费娱乐等麻痹野心的习惯，专注提高赚钱能力并用现金买入收租房产。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Stop complaining about lacking connections or resources, and muster the courage and humility to ask people who can help you. Cut out ambition-numbing habits like alcohol and consumer entertainment, focus on raising your earning power, and buy cash-flowing rental properties with cash.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH! (Las Vegas)

zero_start_playbook.wealth_detail: Nearly $7M generated last year; ~$400k first calendar year; became a millionaire at 20
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 若手头没有大笔本金，可用现有工作收入或研究商业信用（Business Credit）启动能带来被动收入的生意；做Airbnb不一定要先买房，可从租下第一套房源轻资产起步，跑通盈利模型后当作数字游戏持续复制扩张。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: If you don't have big savings, use your current job income or learn business credit to launch a passive-income venture. You don't need to buy property to start on Airbnb; lease your first unit asset-light, prove the profitable model, and treat expansion like a numbers game.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH! (Las Vegas)

zero_start_playbook.role_or_title: Founder, Logic Electronic Cigarettes (formerly Personal Trainer)
zero_start_playbook.wealth_detail: $100M peak single-year revenue; started with $10K and sold company to Japan Tobacco via Goldman Sachs in under 5 years
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 从1万美元起家，靠街头地推和精准提问发现市场痛点，用最简单直白的包装和商标策略打开销路，拒绝寄售、坚持先款后货。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Start with $10,000, hit the streets, and ask sharp questions to uncover market pain points. Break into shelves with simple, straightforward packaging and branding, and refuse consignment by insisting on payment upfront.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich

zero_start_playbook.role_or_title: Tech Entrepreneur & Angel Investor (4 Active Companies)
zero_start_playbook.wealth_detail: Sold last tech company for $235M; started with $10K loan from grandmother; invested in 150+ companies
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 找准早期市场趋势和需求，小资金白手起家并靠自身能力建立团队（不懂编程就找最顶尖的CTO），并主动用一句“一起喝杯咖啡”结交各行各业的导师。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Spot early market trends and customer demand, bootstrap lean, and build a strong team around your gaps (if you can't code, recruit the best CTO you can find). Don't hesitate to invite mentors across industries out with a simple "let's grab coffee."
zero_start_playbook.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich

zero_start_playbook.role_or_title: Founder, Specialty Finance Company & Former Wall Street Broker
zero_start_playbook.wealth_detail: Sold specialty finance company for almost $100M in 2018; 95% in equities and 25% in a crypto fund
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 不要只为大公司打工，在全职工作期间先做副业起步，敢于押注自己并独立创业，同时着眼长远愿景。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Don't spend your career just working for big corporations; start a side hustle while keeping your day job. Bet on yourself, build your own business, and stay focused on a long-term vision.

zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 用10年而非90天的长期视角押注自己，先聚焦掌握销售等高变现能力并攒下几十万美元本金，再购入下一阶段的技能；起步阶段用超大工作量（海量拨号、复盘录音）和专注日常行动来克服焦虑与不确定性。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Bet on yourself with a 10-year horizon instead of 90 days, first mastering a high-income skill like sales and saving several hundred thousand dollars before buying into the next level of skills. Early on, overcome anxiety and uncertainty through massive volume (endless dialing and reviewing call recordings) and relentless focus on daily execution.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: 5 Sales Tips To Start Closing Deals Ft: Alex Hormozi’s Closer Jacob Hopkins

zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 利用自身技能和专业知识重新创业，并通过融资获取启动资金，再用杠杆将其转化为利润。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Rebuild from scratch using your own skills and expertise, raise financing for startup capital, and use that leverage to turn it into profit.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: Asking Denver Millionaires How Much Money They Make

zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 依靠已掌握的营销与品牌技能，从零启动服务型业务，将独特技能打包卖给有需求的企业并解决实际问题。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Use the marketing and branding skills you already have to launch a service business from zero, packaging your unique expertise to solve real problems for businesses that need it.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: Asking Denver Millionaires How Much Money They Make

zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 举办聚会激活人脉网络，倾听大家在销售、客服、招聘或企业文化上的共性痛点，随后针对这些痛点打造产品。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Host gatherings to activate your network and listen for common pain points in sales, customer service, hiring, or company culture. Then build a product specifically designed to solve those problems.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: Asking Denver Millionaires How Much Money They Make

zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 联系拥有高客单价产品的朋友，主动提出在一周内帮他们销售现有的潜在客户名单（lead list）快速变现。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Reach out to friends who sell high-ticket products and offer to work their existing lead list within a week for fast cash.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: Asking Denver Millionaires How Much Money They Make

zero_start_playbook.role_or_title: Insurance Agency Owner & Top Underwriter (sfg austin.com)
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 要有近乎盲目的自信与野心，先行动再去研究数字并不断推进；不必非要从热爱的工作起步，可以先做能赚钱的行业积累资金来支撑梦想；年轻时多去尝试、旅行和攒钱，只要不放弃就不会输。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Carry almost blind confidence and ambition, take action first, figure out the numbers along the way, and keep pushing forward. You do not have to start with your passion; work in a lucrative field to build the capital that funds your dreams, and spend your youth experimenting, traveling, and saving, because you cannot lose if you never quit.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Insurance CEO Lavon Perrin

zero_start_playbook.role_or_title: Tech Entrepreneur & Information Security Pioneer (New Startup Founder)
zero_start_playbook.wealth_detail: Sold tech company for over $1 billion; owned 95% with partner at 1999 IPO; grew to $120M in annual sales within 4 years
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 科技新人建议切入高增长的网络安全/信息安全领域；若有10万美元启动资金，可先做服务业快速产生现金流，或凭技术能力全职投入一年自己打造产品；选择能热爱并深耕3-5年以上的赛道，专注熟悉领域，并在经济衰退期低成本布局或保持现金储备。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Tech newcomers should target fast-growing cybersecurity, while anyone with $100,000 in seed capital can start a service business for fast cash flow or spend a full year building a product if they have technical skills. Choose a field you love enough to stick with for 3-5+ years, stay in areas you know, and keep cash reserves to buy cheap or position yourself during recessions.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: How I Turned $1,000 Into $1 Billion

zero_start_playbook.role_or_title: Head of Sales & Partner at Virtus Insurance (Former Insurance PE Roll-Up Executive)
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 如果账户明天归零，会立刻重返全职销售岗位，靠比别人更拼、更努力（out-hustle/outwork）快速赚取佣金支票；随后将资金分散投资于股市、房地产、私募股权/初创公司及个人热爱并熟悉的收藏爱好领域。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: If his bank account hit zero tomorrow, he would immediately take a full-time sales role and out-hustle and outwork everyone to earn commission checks quickly. From there, he would diversify across stocks, real estate, private equity/startups, and collectible hobbies he genuinely knows and loves.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: Asking a Private Equity Millionaire How He Got Rich

zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 先通过上千次对话与实际销售验证想法；跨行创业时寻找热爱该领域的专家合伙，并通过高频拓展人脉、地推获客和清晰的品牌故事打开市场。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Validate your idea through thousands of conversations and real sales before scaling. When entering an unfamiliar industry, partner with passionate domain experts and break into the market through relentless networking, door-to-door outreach, and a clear brand story.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: Entrepreneurs Guide To Start and Scale ANY Business

zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 趁早存钱并投资科技股，不要超前消费，建立多元化投资组合，长期持有401K养老金绝不提前支取。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Save early, invest in tech stocks, and live within your means rather than overspending. Build a diversified portfolio and hold onto your 401(k) for the long haul without ever withdrawing from it early.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: I Asked Texan Millionaires Their Best Financial Decision

zero_start_playbook.role_or_title: CEO of Technical Legal Services Company
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 认清自身作为价值创造者的定位；扩展业务要善用杠杆、资金和现金流为王的理念，确保服务交付；创业不要事必躬亲，要主动向他人请教和求助。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Recognize your worth as a value creator, scale with leverage and capital while treating cash flow as king, and never compromise on service delivery. Don't try to do everything yourself; actively seek advice and ask for help.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: I Asked Texan Millionaires Their Best Financial Decision

zero_start_playbook.role_or_title: Founder of Web Analytics Company (Web trans)
zero_start_playbook.wealth_detail: Sold company for $1.03B ($1 billion 30 million) at age 33
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 寻找别人没做过的独特创意，联合认同你愿景的伙伴创业；建立无需亲自劳动的被动收入，并将资金配置到长期房地产和科技股中。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Look for original ideas nobody else is pursuing and partner with people who share your vision. Build passive income streams that don't require your daily labor, and allocate capital into long-term real estate and tech stocks.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: I Asked Texan Millionaires Their Best Financial Decision

zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 投资前务必先做深入研究，不要盲从散户炒作迷因股或追逐泡沫市场；坚持稳健投资与量入为出，并做好面对全球高强度竞争、全力以赴的准备。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Do thorough research before investing, and avoid chasing bubbles or blindly following retail hype into meme stocks. Invest conservatively, live within your means, and prepare to give everything you have in an intensely competitive global market.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: I Asked Texan Millionaires Their Best Financial Decision

zero_start_playbook.guest_name: Austin Biotech & Commercial Real Estate Investor
zero_start_playbook.role_or_title: Pharmaceutical Biotech & Commercial Real Estate Investor
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 敢于承担风险去争取机会，但也要理解变富需要时间；想做房地产投资，要向真正懂行的前辈学习，并建立良好人脉以发现机会。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Be willing to take calculated risks to seize opportunities while recognizing that building wealth takes time. If you want to invest in real estate, learn from seasoned pros and build strong networks to uncover deals.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: I Asked Texan Millionaires Their Best Financial Decision

zero_start_playbook.role_or_title: Assistant City Manager for the City of Austin
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 年轻时尽早购置多户住宅，找专业理财顾问制定适合个人的财务规划；敢于冒险，不要被眼前顾虑或他人看法束缚，追随自己的内心。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Buy a multi-family property early in life and work with a financial advisor to build a personalized financial plan. Take risks, ignore short-term worries or others' opinions, and follow your own path.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: I Asked Texan Millionaires Their Best Financial Decision

zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 年轻时不要指望一年内财务自由，应靠复利稳健投资高股息股票并保持独立判断。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Don't expect to achieve financial freedom in a single year while you're young. Rely on compound growth by steadily investing in high-dividend stocks and maintaining independent judgment.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: Asking Millionaires What They Are Investing in

zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 大学毕业步入社会最重要的是培养才智、坚守诚信品格、保持主动性并彻底掌握自律。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: When stepping into the workforce after college, focus on sharpening your intellect, upholding unwavering integrity, taking initiative, and mastering self-discipline.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: Asking Millionaires What They Are Investing in

zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 不必盲目追求复杂理财，先明确个人核心价值观并据此规划消费与基础基金投资。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Don't chase overly complicated financial strategies. Clarify your core personal values first, then plan your spending and basic fund investments around them.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: Asking Millionaires What They Are Investing in

zero_start_playbook.role_or_title: Former Professional DJ & Major Label Executive/Veteran
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 年轻时应更加认真对待学业，同时追随热爱进入喜欢的行业。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Take your studies more seriously when you're young, and follow your passion into an industry you genuinely love.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: Asking Millionaires What They Are Investing in

zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 打破自我设限，积极投资自己、房地产和可信赖的伙伴，在充满机遇的城市争取大份额。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Break past self-imposed limits and invest actively in yourself, real estate, and trustworthy partners to claim a bigger stake in a city full of opportunity.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: Asking Millionaires What They Are Investing in

zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 先向内探索自己独特的道路，并思考如何将哪怕不给钱也热爱的事商业化变现。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Look inward first to discover your own unique path, then figure out how to monetize what you love doing even if nobody pays you for it.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: Asking Millionaires What They Are Investing in

zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 在利率上升的棘手市场环境中，宁可持币观望也不要盲目入场。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: In a tough rising-interest-rate market, it's better to sit on cash and wait than jump in blindly.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: Asking Millionaires What They Are Investing in

zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 利用大学暑假尝试不同工作，多拓展人脉请教前辈，并通过股票、年金和债券建立长期现金流。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Use college summers to try different jobs, network and learn from mentors, and build long-term cash flow through stocks, annuities, and bonds.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: Asking Millionaires What They Are Investing in

zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 如果从零开始且必须在一年内赚到100万美元，会选择在奥斯汀批发土地（Wholesale Land）：寻找优质地块并以好价格签下合同，再转售给愿意出更高价的开发商或买家，做成一两笔即可轻松赚到100万。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: If starting from zero with one year to make $1 million, they would wholesale land in Austin: lock up great parcels under contract at a strong price and assign them to developers or buyers willing to pay more, clearing $1 million easily in one or two deals.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: Here’s How Real Estate Millionaires Spend Their Day

zero_start_playbook.role_or_title: Founder & CEO, Met Group (Residential & Commercial Solar)
zero_start_playbook.wealth_detail: ~$30M annual company revenue (targeting $100M in 2-3 years); millionaire at age 24 ("eight-figure entrepreneur")
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 先评估自己适合独立创业还是在好公司做内部创业者；早期别盲目多元化，先选定未来20年大势行业，靠大量电销地推练就硬核沟通力，打透一件事、赚到第一桶金后再分散布局。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: First assess whether you are better suited to founding a company or being an intrapreneur at a great one, and avoid premature diversification early on. Pick an industry poised for growth over the next 20 years, build hardcore communication skills through high-volume cold calling and door-to-door sales, and diversify only after dominating one thing and making your first fortune.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Founder & Investor Grant Mitt

zero_start_playbook.role_or_title: Co-owner of Teifke Real Estate (TRE) & Real Estate Investor
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 不要找任何借口，只要足够渴望就能找到办法并愿意为此牺牲；戒除不必要的消费与享乐，屏蔽他人与社会的限制性言论，对自己100%负责，并把赚到的钱持续复投进房产与事业中。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Make zero excuses, because if you want it badly enough you will find a way and accept the sacrifices. Cut unnecessary spending and indulgences, tune out limiting beliefs from others and society, take 100% responsibility for yourself, and keep compounding earnings into real estate and your business.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: From Minimum Wage to Real Estate Millionaire

zero_start_playbook.role_or_title: Founder, E-commerce & Digital Marketing Entrepreneur, Investor
zero_start_playbook.wealth_detail: $15M+ revenue this year; projected $20M-$25M next year; $50M AUM target
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 不必盲目依赖大学学历，创业核心在于解决实际问题；应优先掌握内容流量营销与销售成交能力，并搞懂企业现金流运作；同时持续打造个人品牌，把早期利润投入自我教育、优质课程与导师私董会，用金钱换取时间、专注深耕单一核心业务并严选价值观一致的合伙人。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Do not rely blindly on a college degree, since entrepreneurship is about solving real problems; prioritize mastering content traffic marketing, sales closing, and business cash flow. Build a personal brand continuously, reinvest early profits into self-education, quality courses, and mentor masterminds, trade money to buy back time, go deep on one core business, and choose partners strictly for shared values.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Founder & E-commerce Entrepreneur Robert Miller

zero_start_playbook.role_or_title: Coach for Top Entrepreneurs & Content Creators / Content Creator
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 先确定当下最想做的小事及愿付出的代价，自信迈出最小一步；留出独处静思空间激发灵感，戒除过度刺激，并通过饮食与呼吸管理身体状态。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Decide on the smallest thing you want to do right now and what you're willing to pay for it, then take that first step with confidence. Carve out quiet solitude for inspiration, cut out overstimulation, and manage your physical state through diet and breathwork.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: HOW TO GET EVERYTHING YOU WANT IN LIFE Ft. Josh Terry

zero_start_playbook.role_or_title: Investor, Board Member & Former CEO/COO of HMS Holdings
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 不要总想着自己如何出人头地，而要多问“我能帮别人做些什么”；专心学好并享受当下岗位的工作，真心关心并主动托举身边的同事与合作伙伴，当你不断成就他人时，贵人与机会自然会回到你身上。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Stop obsessing over how to get ahead and ask instead, "What can I do to help others?" Focus on mastering and enjoying your current role while genuinely caring for and lifting up colleagues and partners, because when you consistently help others succeed, champions and opportunities naturally come back to you.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Investor & Executive Doug Williams

zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 零资金起步可先开车扫街寻找破旧或空置房产（Driving for Dollars），无需房产执照即可开始，先通过批发合约积累资金并规避翻修负债，同时可借助有经验的团队合作成交。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: With zero capital, start by driving for dollars to spot rundown or vacant properties, which requires no real estate license. Build initial capital through wholesaling contracts to avoid renovation debt, and partner with experienced teams to help close deals.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: How to Wholesale Real Estate for Beginners

zero_start_playbook.role_or_title: Martial Arts Coach & Men's Mentor / Content Creator
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 年轻男性应掌握五项核心能力：学习格斗防身并保持体魄、克服恐惧迈出行动第一步、在现实中寻找良师（如武术教练）、成家前及早培养养家能力、修习情绪与言行自控（节制），以及保持对自我和更高力量的信念。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Young men should build five core pillars: learn martial arts for self-defense and stay fit, overcome fear to take the first step, find real-world mentors like a martial arts coach, develop the ability to provide before starting a family, and master emotional and verbal self-control while keeping faith in themselves and a higher power.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: 5 SKILLS Every Young Man Should Know in 2023

zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 半开玩笑称若性命攸关一年内赚100万美元，会开酒吧或发起GoFundMe众筹页面向大家求助。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Half-jokingly, they said that if their life depended on making $1 million in a year, they would open a bar or launch a GoFundMe page and ask everyone for help.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: Exclusive Interview with Former Nike President: Life Lessons and Advice for Success

zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 坦言不知道如何在一年内从零赚到100万美元，自嘲可能会破产
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Candidly admitted having no idea how to go from zero to $1 million in a single year, joking that they would probably go broke trying.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: Asking Texan’s Their Best Life Advice (DALLAS!)

zero_start_playbook.guest_name: Chris (K-12 Education Consulting & Real Estate Entrepreneur)
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice: 利用他人资金（OPM）投资大都市外围40英里等尚未开发的潜力区房产（商业、住宅或翻新），再融资后循环复投。
zero_start_playbook.zero_start_advice_en: Use other people's money (OPM) to invest in undeveloped growth areas about 40 miles outside major metros across commercial, residential, or fix-and-flip properties, then refinance and reinvest the capital in a continuous cycle.
zero_start_playbook.video_title: School of Hard Knocks First Speaking Event!

guests.role_or_title: Entrepreneur & Investor (Life Insurance, Real Estate, Waste Management)
guests.wealth_detail: $752M annual revenue (2023); tens of millions personal annual income; $100M company exits
guests.first_money_or_break: 早年在贫困单亲家庭长大，当过警察（后被解雇）和年薪5.8万美元的社工，年轻时买房失败破产；后重塑信用从当地银行拿到100万美元授信开发地产小区，并创办垃圾处理公司及人寿保险分销企业，靠销售能力与利润持续再投入滚雪球做大。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Raised in a poor single-parent household, he worked as a police officer (later fired) and a social worker earning $58,000 a year before going bankrupt from a failed young home purchase. After rebuilding his credit, he secured a $1 million credit line from a local bank to develop a real estate subdivision, then founded a waste disposal company and a life insurance distribution business, snowballing them through sales skill and continuous profit reinvestment.
guests.zero_start_advice: 从零起步应切入最不需要资本门槛的“销售”行业，选定认可的产品拼命卖并学会教人销售；主动向成功者、导师、顶尖律师和会计师请教，克制消费并持续把钱投回生意，直面不适感并聚焦可控的解决方案。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Start from zero in sales, the industry with the lowest capital barrier, pick a product you believe in, sell relentlessly, and learn to teach others to sell. Proactively seek advice from successful people, mentors, top lawyers, and accountants, curb spending to reinvest profits into the business, face discomfort head-on, and focus on controllable solutions.

advice_items.summary_en: Focus all your energy on the one thing generating money; premature diversification spreads founders too thin.
advice_items.quote: I just spent all my time doing the one thing that made me money... diversity kills most people in business cuz they're spread so thin.
advice_items.video_title: I Was Bankrupt… Now I’ve Made $3 Billion

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.summary_zh: 追求企业股权与杠杆，而非仅靠出卖时间赚钱
advice_items.summary_en: Focus on building equity and leverage inside businesses rather than chasing short-term personal paychecks.
advice_items.quote: I wasn't trying to make a certain amount of money. I was trying to build real leverage, real equity, real wealth.
advice_items.video_title: I Was Bankrupt… Now I’ve Made $3 Billion

advice_items.summary_zh: 切入可规模化的传统服务与现金流行业
advice_items.summary_en: Build and scale customer-centric service businesses instead of banking on rare viral tech inventions.
advice_items.quote: The majority of us have to go good at sales, service business, do something that's customer-centric, and understand how to scale it.
advice_items.video_title: I Was Bankrupt… Now I’ve Made $3 Billion

advice_items.summary_zh: 克制个人分红，将利润持续反哺企业扩张
advice_items.summary_en: Reinvest profits back into the company rather than taking money out prematurely so the business can compound.
advice_items.quote: It came in, I went back in the business. It came in, I went back in the business. I funded the hell out of my businesses. My businesses were eating, thus they were growing.
advice_items.video_title: I Was Bankrupt… Now I’ve Made $3 Billion

advice_items.canonical_tag: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持朴素生活，把钱留给股权增值而非消费
advice_items.summary_en: Practice delayed gratification and drive a modest car while building tens of millions in business equity.
advice_items.quote: I got a Honda Accord, but I got tens of millions of dollars in equity over here.
advice_items.video_title: I Was Bankrupt… Now I’ve Made $3 Billion

advice_items.summary_zh: 别被豪车表象迷惑，更别为面子过度消费
advice_items.summary_en: Never confuse flashy cars or social media perception with actual net worth.
advice_items.quote: Just cuz somebody drives a nice car don't mean that they have any real net worth in any capacity.
advice_items.video_title: I Was Bankrupt… Now I’ve Made $3 Billion

advice_items.summary_zh: 打破自我设限，建立强大的自我信念
advice_items.summary_en: Build genuine self-belief and reject limiting narratives about your background or potential.
advice_items.quote: The biggest thing I want to sell people is belief in themselves... I believe in myself. You give me a product, if people need it and I believe in it, I will sell it.
advice_items.video_title: I Was Bankrupt… Now I’ve Made $3 Billion

advice_items.summary_zh: 多数人不愿吃苦，努力是最大优势
advice_items.summary_en: Outwork the competition because most people simply refuse to put in the hard work.
advice_items.quote: most people won't work... you can build the belief in yourself but people don't want to work hard
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Miami Millionaires How They Got Rich

advice_items.summary_zh: 24小时内必回消息，言出必行建立绝对信任
advice_items.summary_en: Return every call and message within 24 hours, be brutally honest, and always keep your word.
advice_items.quote: I return every phone call and message within 24 hours... Do what you say you're going to do.
advice_items.video_title: I Was Bankrupt… Now I’ve Made $3 Billion

advice_items.summary_zh: 主动做分外之事，超预期服务客户与伙伴
advice_items.summary_en: Consistently go beyond contractual obligations; doing what you do not have to do is the real currency of trust.
advice_items.quote: Do things that you don't have to do. That's how you build relationships. The currency is everything I don't have to do.
advice_items.video_title: I Was Bankrupt… Now I’ve Made $3 Billion

advice_items.summary_zh: 心怀感恩与信仰，乐善好施反而带来更大回报
advice_items.summary_en: Stay grounded in faith and generosity; giving money away and doing good multiplies wealth.
advice_items.quote: The bigger deal is how much we given away... the better things you do with your money, the more you make.
advice_items.video_title: I Was Bankrupt… Now I’ve Made $3 Billion

advice_items.summary_zh: 抓住机会向强者疯狂提问，虚心向导师求教
advice_items.summary_en: Get in rooms with people further ahead than you, ask relentless questions, and listen without interrupting.
advice_items.quote: If you leave me in a room with somebody doing better than me, I will ask him questions for like literally until they have to tell me to shut up.
advice_items.video_title: I Was Bankrupt… Now I’ve Made $3 Billion

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.summary_zh: 坚持“三条腿凳子”原则，兼顾客户与团队共赢
advice_items.summary_en: Apply the three-legged stool rule: every decision must benefit customers, benefit your team, and protect the company.
advice_items.quote: Any decision you're making has to be great for your client or your consumer... Second, it has to be great for your agent or your employee... third, it can't harm the company.
advice_items.video_title: I Was Bankrupt… Now I’ve Made $3 Billion

advice_items.summary_zh: 创业初期别急着暴富买豪车，保持耐心
advice_items.summary_en: Don't start a business expecting to buy a $400k car immediately; build for long-term freedom with patience.
advice_items.quote: a lot of people get into business to get rich right away I got into business to get free... they're frustrated... they're like I can't buy that $400,000 car
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Miami Millionaires How They Got Rich

advice_items.canonical_tag: Don't Surround Yourself With Toxic / Negative People
advice_items.summary_zh: 远离消耗自己的人，别听未达目标者的负面建议
advice_items.summary_en: Cut off anchors who drag you down and ignore advice from people who are not where you want to be.
advice_items.quote: If people are weighing you down, dude, you get the anchor off... I will help you, but the minute you're trying to drown me, dude, I'm out.
advice_items.video_title: I Was Bankrupt… Now I’ve Made $3 Billion

advice_items.summary_zh: 保持学生心态，不懂就问并坚持每天精进
advice_items.summary_en: Stay a humble student and never let pride stop you from asking when you do not understand something.
advice_items.quote: When I don't know something, I ask. The dumbest people in the world are people that somebody says something and they go, it would be dumb for me to ask... No, it's dumb for you not to ask.
advice_items.video_title: I Was Bankrupt… Now I’ve Made $3 Billion

advice_items.summary_zh: 别一人包揽所有角色，招揽高管授权以专注长板
advice_items.summary_en: Stop trying to fill every executive role yourself; hire capable specialists and delegate so you can focus on your strengths.
advice_items.quote: Please don't try to wear too many hats... getting them to delegate things because that freed me up to do what I'm good at.
advice_items.video_title: I Was Bankrupt… Now I’ve Made $3 Billion

advice_items.summary_zh: 销售是最大的平等器，精通销售再教他人裂变
advice_items.summary_en: Master sales as the ultimate equalizer regardless of background, then scale by teaching others to sell.
advice_items.quote: The greatest equalizer is sales because anybody can do it. Find a product that you love and work your ass off selling it. Get really good at selling it and then find other people you can teach to sell it.
advice_items.video_title: I Was Bankrupt… Now I’ve Made $3 Billion

advice_items.summary_zh: 把破产与挫折当作强迫自己专注的最好一课
advice_items.summary_en: Treat painful setbacks like bankruptcy as valuable lessons that force discipline and sharper focus.
advice_items.quote: Greatest thing that ever happened to me in business, going bankrupt... It hurt. It made me focus. I paid attention.
advice_items.video_title: I Was Bankrupt… Now I’ve Made $3 Billion

advice_items.canonical_tag: Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)
advice_items.summary_zh: 善用良性负债和金融杠杆，用低息资金创造高回报
advice_items.summary_en: Stop fearing debt blindly; use borrowed capital as leverage whenever you can earn returns well above the borrowing cost.
advice_items.quote: They never understood the power of leveraging money. Me, I was never afraid of debt... they charged me 3% but I'm making eight and it's their money.
advice_items.video_title: I Was Bankrupt… Now I’ve Made $3 Billion

advice_items.summary_zh: 尽早结交顶尖律师、会计师及高价值专业伙伴
advice_items.summary_en: Surround yourself early with top-tier professionals such as great attorneys, accountants, and capital partners.
advice_items.quote: I found a really good attorney, really good accountant early on... connect yourself with good people early.
advice_items.video_title: I Was Bankrupt… Now I’ve Made $3 Billion

advice_items.summary_zh: 主动拥抱不适感，敢于跨出舒适区才能实现增长
advice_items.summary_en: Lean into discomfort rather than staying safe; feeling uncomfortable is the clearest sign of growth.
advice_items.quote: Every time it's uncomfortable you're on to something. Every time it's uncomfortable accept it you're growing.
advice_items.video_title: I Was Bankrupt… Now I’ve Made $3 Billion

guests.role_or_title: Real Estate Investor, Entrepreneur & Author (Cardone Capital / 10X)
guests.wealth_detail: Billionaire; $5B real estate portfolio (12,000 units), $1.1B raised via crowdfunding, $155M/yr revenue
guests.first_money_or_break: 25岁戒掉恶习后连续三年半每天早出晚归做销售积累本领；随后涉足房产投资，前两套独栋房产月现金流仅200美元，30岁时在无信用记录和自有资金的情况下募资35万美元拿下第3笔48套公寓项目，净赚370万美元实现财富跃迁。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: After quitting bad habits at age 25, he spent three and a half years working long days in sales to build his skills before entering real estate. While his first two single-family properties netted only $200 a month in cash flow, at 30 he raised $350,000 with no credit history or personal capital to buy his third deal, a 48-unit apartment complex, netting $3.7 million and transforming his wealth.
guests.zero_start_advice: 消除空闲时间以杜绝懒散与诱惑，学会通过人脉建立连接（财富通过人流向你）；初期别死存现金，将赚到的每一分钱再投资于个人能力、品牌和业务，积累后尽早转向规模化的现金流房产等实体资产。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Eliminate idle time to avoid laziness and temptation, and build connections through networking because wealth flows through people. Do not hoard cash early on; reinvest every dollar you earn into your skills, brand, and business, then transition as soon as possible into scalable cash-flowing physical assets like real estate.

advice_items.summary_zh: 连续三年半早出晚归拼命工作
advice_items.summary_en: Show up early and stay late every single day with relentless work ethic.
advice_items.quote: all I did every single day without exaggeration I showed up at work early and I stayed late I was the first one there and the last one to leave
advice_items.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews Billionaire Grant Cardone

advice_items.summary_zh: 消除空闲时间，保持规律作息与紧迫感
advice_items.summary_en: Take care of your health, keep urgency in your schedule, and eliminate idle free time that breeds trouble.
advice_items.quote: you need to eat good you need to take care of yourself and you need to stay out of no free time because free time is where drug dealers live free time is where depression and the devil live
advice_items.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews Billionaire Grant Cardone

advice_items.summary_zh: 年轻时远离毒品、色情和女色诱惑专注赚钱
advice_items.summary_en: Eliminate distractions like drugs, pornography, and chasing romance while young so you can focus entirely on building wealth.
advice_items.quote: stay off the drugs off the porn off the chicks you're a young guy hustling you leave women alone save all that for later get rich
advice_items.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews Billionaire Grant Cardone

advice_items.canonical_tag: Don't Surround Yourself With Toxic / Negative People
advice_items.summary_zh: 彻底换掉损友圈子与不良社交场所
advice_items.summary_en: Cut off negative peers, unproductive hangouts, and wrong crowds when turning your life around.
advice_items.quote: I changed all my friends changed everywhere I went gave up a girlfriend gave up all the buddies quit going to those places
advice_items.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews Billionaire Grant Cardone

advice_items.summary_zh: 别只跟身边人比，要对标全球流通货币总量
advice_items.summary_en: Stop limiting yourself to $1M or middle-class benchmarks; calibrate your goals against the abundance of global capital.
advice_items.quote: you got to quit comparing yourself to everybody else what I do is I compare myself to the amount of money on the planet
advice_items.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews Billionaire Grant Cardone

advice_items.summary_zh: 随时算清财务与成本账，用数字驱动决策
advice_items.summary_en: Constantly run the numbers on costs, margins, and scale so you understand what big wealth actually requires.
advice_items.quote: what's that cost what does it take to do that... I started doing the math I play with my phone all the time doing the math
advice_items.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews Billionaire Grant Cardone

advice_items.summary_zh: 财富通过人流向你，学会与人建立连接
advice_items.summary_en: Learn to connect and build relationships with people because all money flows through other human beings.
advice_items.quote: you got to attach yourself to people because you cannot get money there's no money that will ever come to another human being without going through another human being
advice_items.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews Billionaire Grant Cardone

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.summary_zh: 打造能跨代延续的品牌与资产，而非死工资
advice_items.summary_en: Build enduring brands and scalable assets that outlive you rather than relying solely on a high-paying active income.
advice_items.quote: wealth does not stop Rich stops when you die you pay your estate taxes the kids split it up money's gone wealthy people just keeps going
advice_items.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews Billionaire Grant Cardone

advice_items.summary_zh: 把赚来的每一分钱再投入品牌与自我成长
advice_items.summary_en: Don't hoard savings for retirement—reinvest every penny you earn into your business, marketing, brand, skills, and speed.
advice_items.quote: do not save money don't plan for retirement take every penny you earn from every person you meet and reinvest that money reinvest it in something that it's your business your marketing your brand your information getting better faster more confident
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Miami)

advice_items.summary_zh: 持续发声打造个人品牌，吸引市场关注
advice_items.summary_en: Actively build a personal brand and consistently put yourself out there until the market recognizes you.
advice_items.quote: build a brand you're building one anyway... I'm gonna make some noise and if you keep getting out there making noise you're going to figure out
advice_items.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews Billionaire Grant Cardone

advice_items.summary_zh: 允许初期笨拙和被嘲笑，坚持每天上场
advice_items.summary_en: Accept looking awkward and facing ridicule early on, and keep showing up anyway until you master it.
advice_items.quote: in the beginning you're going to be awkward and you're going to be an idiot and you're going to be made fun of
advice_items.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews Billionaire Grant Cardone

advice_items.summary_zh: 投入时间精力深度学习房产等专业知识
advice_items.summary_en: Invest dedicated time, energy, and resources into studying your target asset class before swinging big.
advice_items.quote: my third deal it took three years I learned I went and started spending time and energy and resources and learning real estate
advice_items.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews Billionaire Grant Cardone

advice_items.summary_zh: 先下定决心行动，别找借口等待资金或信用
advice_items.summary_en: Commit first and stop making excuses about lacking capital or credit—figure out how after committing.
advice_items.quote: you need a commitment you need to quit making all these excuses what you need is a commitment
advice_items.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews Billionaire Grant Cardone

advice_items.canonical_tag: Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)
advice_items.summary_zh: 用实体资产主体借好债，而非依赖个人信用分
advice_items.summary_en: Finance income-producing assets through business entities so the property's cash flow supports the loan rather than personal credit.
advice_items.quote: the bank doesn't lend Grant the money the bank lends the LLC the apartment complex... wealthy people don't have credit scores they got assets
advice_items.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews Billionaire Grant Cardone

advice_items.summary_zh: 用富余资金购入房地产等实物资产
advice_items.summary_en: Once you have surplus capital left over from reinvesting in yourself and your business, put it into real assets like real estate.
advice_items.quote: when something's left over start investing in other real assets... start buying real estate next 18 months is gonna be the greatest real estate opportunity in your lifetime
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Miami)

advice_items.summary_zh: 别指望买彩票碰运气，致富靠实力而非侥幸
advice_items.summary_en: Do not waste money or time hoping to get lucky on lotteries or shortcuts; build real value instead.
advice_items.quote: people want to win something right I want to get lucky but you're not going to get lucky
advice_items.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews Billionaire Grant Cardone

advice_items.summary_zh: 盯紧并效仿十亿富豪的做法，跟着钱走
advice_items.summary_en: Study and model what billionaires and top winners actually do, and follow where big money concentrates.
advice_items.quote: when I started looking at billionaires I'm like okay how many are there... if there's 10 of them what do they do all I'm going to do is go track what that cat did
advice_items.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews Billionaire Grant Cardone

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.summary_zh: 避开天花板极低的小赛道，选百亿级大市场
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid tiny niche verticals with low ceilings and choose massive, scalable markets.
advice_items.quote: my first business couldn't scale it just it was in a very tiny vertical... now we're in 10x health that thing's scalable to the hundreds of billions of dollars
advice_items.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews Billionaire Grant Cardone

advice_items.summary_zh: 把团队做大并用职业经理人管理，摆脱琐事
advice_items.summary_en: Scale your organization and put capable managers in place so you are not held hostage by a handful of employees or clients.
advice_items.quote: if you've got 3 000 employees you don't have a problem... you have a manager or two that has 3 000 problems but you don't have them anymore
advice_items.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews Billionaire Grant Cardone

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.summary_zh: 先免费提供海量价值吸粉，再转化付费客户
advice_items.summary_en: Give massive free value upfront to build a large audience funnel, then serve them with paid offers when they are ready.
advice_items.quote: 80 percent of everything we do here is free now the 20 percent that pay me you know this year will pay me 150 million dollars... they came into my funnel... can I serve them when they're ready to pay
advice_items.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews Billionaire Grant Cardone

advice_items.summary_zh: 成交才是服务客户的开始，并持续促进复购
advice_items.summary_en: Reframe closing a sale as the first moment you truly serve the customer, and focus on earning repeat business.
advice_items.quote: closing people is when you service them for the first time... when somebody actually buys your product service offer whatever your offer is that's when you finally service them
advice_items.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews Billionaire Grant Cardone

advice_items.canonical_tag: Don't Wait Too Long to Start / Invest
advice_items.summary_zh: 后悔早期只顾存现金，未及时投入自我与资产
advice_items.summary_en: Regrets letting cash sit idle in savings instead of deploying it sooner into self-development, business growth, and real assets.
advice_items.quote: one of my downfalls was I didn't use it correctly I saved it I just stored it stacked it over and over and over again... I wouldn't stack money at all
advice_items.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews Billionaire Grant Cardone

advice_items.summary_zh: 业务稳定后将利润配置到外部实体资产增收
advice_items.summary_en: Once your active business generates surplus cash, diversify into external real assets that create separate income streams.
advice_items.quote: at some point you want to quit investing in you in the business you want to invest in a third thing you want to invest in some real asset something outside of this thing that you're doing
advice_items.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews Billionaire Grant Cardone

guests.role_or_title: Founder of Morgan & Morgan (Largest Personal Injury Law Firm in North America)
guests.wealth_detail: $1.5B net worth (Forbes); $2B annual firm fees; $5B annual settlements and verdicts
guests.first_money_or_break: 出身肯塔基州普通家庭，7岁起靠卖贺卡和做全年无休的送报童磨炼出创业韧性；大学期间因哥哥遭遇事故瘫痪却未获公正对待而立志学法律，最终与哥哥及合伙人共同创办北美最大的人身伤害律所Morgan & Morgan。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Born into a modest family in Kentucky, he developed entrepreneurial grit from age 7 selling greeting cards and working year-round as a paperboy. After his brother was paralyzed in an accident while he was in college and failed to receive fair treatment, he decided to study law and eventually co-founded Morgan & Morgan, North America's largest personal injury law firm, with his brother and partners.
guests.zero_start_advice: 不要做按小时计费的打工模式，要选择按结果抽成、拥有高回报上限的平台或加入赢家团队；别拿“早该开始”当借口，今天就种下第一棵树；保持零债务和现金储备，绝不投机自己不懂的领域，并恪守黄金法则与无私给予来积累长期信任。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Avoid trading hours for wages and instead choose a commission-based, high-upside platform or join a winning team. Stop using "I should have started earlier" as an excuse and plant your first tree today; stay debt-free with cash reserves, never speculate in areas you do not understand, and build long-term trust through the Golden Rule and selfless giving.

advice_items.summary_zh: 充分授权并与可信赖的合伙人共享利润
advice_items.summary_en: Scale by delegating to reliable 'send-delete' partners and sharing profits so great people build wealth with you.

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.summary_zh: 不要按小时出卖时间，要追求高上限回报
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid trading time for hourly wages; choose contingency or ownership models with high upside.
advice_items.quote: I would not be a lawyer charging by the hour. There's just not enough upside for that for you.
advice_items.video_title: Asking A Billionaire Lawyer How To Make $1,000,000!

advice_items.summary_zh: 谈判中先开口者输，学会倾听后再出牌
advice_items.summary_en: In negotiations, whoever speaks first loses; listen carefully and size up the other party before speaking.
advice_items.quote: Master class in negotiating is this. Whoever speaks first loses. You got to listen and learn and then negotiate.

advice_items.summary_zh: 金钱终究属于上帝，常怀感恩切勿居功自傲
advice_items.summary_en: Stay humble and grateful rather than taking sole credit for success, remembering that wealth is a stewardship, not yours alone.
advice_items.quote: I don't pat myself on the back... I go, 'Thank you, God, for letting me have this great life.' ... The money does not belong to you. The money belongs to God.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH! (Florida)

advice_items.summary_zh: 创业要信守承诺、善待并回馈团队才能长久
advice_items.summary_en: Keep your promises, hire great talent, and share rewards generously by loving and taking care of your team.
advice_items.quote: Keep your word and hire great people and share... Why the lions don't eat him? Cuz he loves them and feeds them.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH! (Florida)

advice_items.canonical_tag: Don't Surround Yourself With Toxic / Negative People
advice_items.summary_zh: 远离不良朋友与消耗者，近墨者黑会毁掉人生
advice_items.summary_en: Cut off toxic, destructive influences for yourself and your family; associating with bad company inevitably drags you down.
advice_items.quote: Your children are one friend away from total disaster... When you lay and sleep with pigs, you get pig [ __ ] on you. You cannot sleep with pigs and get up without pig [ __ ].
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH! (Florida)

advice_items.summary_zh: 犯错时坦诚承担并全力保障客户利益
advice_items.summary_en: Admit mistakes openly to clients and take full financial responsibility to make them whole.
advice_items.quote: I admit it... You were my client. You came to me. I'm going to take care of you now.
advice_items.video_title: Asking A Billionaire Lawyer How To Make $1,000,000!

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.summary_zh: 打造全天候、零门槛触达的极致服务体验
advice_items.summary_en: Build frictionless, 24/7 accessibility nationwide so customers can easily get help whenever they need it.
advice_items.quote: What would Google do if it was a law firm? ... Google be everywhere for everyone, all 50 states, 24/7... you can be my client in 2 minutes.
advice_items.video_title: Asking A Billionaire Lawyer How To Make $1,000,000!

advice_items.summary_zh: 克制贪婪，远离好得不真实的暴富诱惑
advice_items.summary_en: Control greed to protect your capital; walk away from anything that sounds too good to be true.
advice_items.quote: It's hard to make money. It's harder to keep money. When I've lost money is when greed has taken over... if it's too good to be true, it's too good to be true.
advice_items.video_title: Asking A Billionaire Lawyer How To Make $1,000,000!

advice_items.summary_zh: 别拿错过时机当借口，今天就立刻行动
advice_items.summary_en: Stop making lazy excuses about not starting earlier; plant your tree today and nurture it.
advice_items.quote: The best time to plant a tree was 20 years ago. The next best time to plant a tree today... Should have, would have, could have. That's an excuse.
advice_items.video_title: Asking A Billionaire Lawyer How To Make $1,000,000!

advice_items.summary_zh: 研读投资与风险管理经典书籍建立认知
advice_items.summary_en: Study classic investing and risk books such as A Random Walk Down Wall Street and The Black Swan.
advice_items.quote: I tell you viewers, read these books. A Random Walk Down Wall Street and Black Swan.
advice_items.video_title: Asking A Billionaire Lawyer How To Make $1,000,000!

advice_items.summary_zh: 长期配置指数基金与国债且绝不轻易动用
advice_items.summary_en: Invest in index funds, tax-free bonds, and US treasuries, and hold them permanently without touching them.
advice_items.quote: Index funds for equities. Tax-free bonds... and US treasuries... once my money goes into my investments, I never touch it. It's there forever.
advice_items.video_title: Asking A Billionaire Lawyer How To Make $1,000,000!

advice_items.summary_zh: 将现金流投入房地产与实体资产开发
advice_items.summary_en: Deploy business cash into tangible commercial real estate, apartments, hotels, and attractions.
advice_items.quote: I take my capital invest in me. I own attractions. I own hotels. I develop shopping centers. I build apartments.
advice_items.video_title: Asking A Billionaire Lawyer How To Make $1,000,000!

advice_items.canonical_tag: Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持零债务和充足现金以应对黑天鹅
advice_items.summary_en: Prepare for unexpected Black Swan crises by keeping cash reserves and operating with zero debt.
advice_items.quote: Be ready for the black swan... All your money in savings, no debt. Debt and leverage is the death of most business people.
advice_items.video_title: Asking A Billionaire Lawyer How To Make $1,000,000!

advice_items.summary_zh: 敢于挑战行业巨头，以强大实力正面迎战
advice_items.summary_en: Do not fear challenging industry giants when you have built the capability to fight and win.
advice_items.quote: I'm suing the biggest drug manufacturers in the world, the tobacco industry, the insurance industry... My hero in history was David who took down Goliath.
advice_items.video_title: Asking A Billionaire Lawyer How To Make $1,000,000!

advice_items.summary_zh: 用幽默创意做品牌宣传并赢得长期信任
advice_items.summary_en: Differentiate your brand with creative, self-deprecating advertising while earning long-term trust as a proven winner.
advice_items.quote: You got to be willing to kind of make fun of yourself a little bit... Make your creative creative, but you got to build a brand that people can trust for the long haul.
advice_items.video_title: Asking A Billionaire Lawyer How To Make $1,000,000!

advice_items.summary_zh: 走出舒适区积极社交，机会和运气不会自己上门
advice_items.summary_en: Leave your desk, go to lunches, conventions, and events to actively network—opportunity and luck require stepping outside your comfort zone.
advice_items.quote: Read a book called Never Eat Alone. If you're just going to sit at your desk and not get out your comfort zone... you're not going to do [ __ ]. Luck comes when you're looking for opportunity. You got to leave the cage.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH! (Florida)

advice_items.summary_zh: 享受创业过程本身，专注建业务而非只盯赚钱
advice_items.summary_en: Focus on enjoying the process of building a real business rather than chasing money; the journey itself is the reward.
advice_items.quote: It wasn't a sacrifice. The journey is the reward. It was all fun. I wasn't looking to get rich. I was just looking to build a business.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH! (Florida)

advice_items.canonical_tag: Don't Neglect Health & Family for Money
advice_items.summary_zh: 临终只会遗憾陪伴挚爱太少，而非少做一笔交易
advice_items.summary_en: Remember what matters at the end of life—you will care about missed time with loved ones, not the deals or money you missed.
advice_items.quote: On our last day, we're not going to be talking about money or what deal we didn't do. We're going to be talking about and thinking about the time we didn't spend with the people we love.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH! (Florida)

advice_items.summary_zh: 如走钢丝般极度专注，是成事不坠的关键
advice_items.summary_en: Maintain relentless, high-stakes focus on your core craft like a tightrope walker without a net.
advice_items.quote: When you see the great Wallenda up on the wire walking without a net, you know why he didn't fall. Focus. Focus.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH! (Florida)

guests.role_or_title: Founder, E-commerce & Digital Marketing Entrepreneur, Investor
guests.wealth_detail: $15M+ revenue this year; projected $20M-$25M next year; $50M AUM target
guests.first_money_or_break: 19岁读大学时，在朋友影响下于2015-2016年早期接触加密货币，将1500至2000美元本金投入比特币、以太坊及NEO（AntShares），四个月内资产增值至约25万美元，由此获得人生第一笔大额启动资金，并借此转向免费授课、演讲及电商与数字营销创业。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: At age 19 in college, influenced by a friend, he got into crypto early in 2015-2016 and invested $1,500 to $2,000 into Bitcoin, Ethereum, and NEO (AntShares), growing it to roughly $250,000 within four months. That first major stake enabled him to pivot into free teaching, speaking, e-commerce, and digital marketing ventures.
guests.zero_start_advice: 不必盲目依赖大学学历，创业核心在于解决实际问题；应优先掌握内容流量营销与销售成交能力，并搞懂企业现金流运作；同时持续打造个人品牌，把早期利润投入自我教育、优质课程与导师私董会，用金钱换取时间、专注深耕单一核心业务并严选价值观一致的合伙人。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Do not rely blindly on a college degree, since entrepreneurship is about solving real problems; prioritize mastering content traffic marketing, sales closing, and business cash flow. Build a personal brand continuously, reinvest early profits into self-education, quality courses, and mentor masterminds, trade money to buy back time, go deep on one core business, and choose partners strictly for shared values.
recommended_books_or_mentors: The History of Central Banking and the Enslavement of Mankind
The Road Less Stupid by Keith Cunningham

Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Miami)

advice_tags: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
