advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.summary_zh: 创业先做服务业解决痛点再谈规模化
advice_items.summary_en: Start in services and focus on solving real problems before worrying about branding or scaling.
advice_items.quote: Everyone has problems if you can solve those problems the digital side and making it super sexy isn't the first place to start you want to actually solve a problem first and then... you can go to scale it
advice_items.video_title: Day in the Life of a 25 Year Old Millionaire

advice_items.summary_zh: 掌握营销引流与销售，直接绑定公司营收
advice_items.summary_en: Connect yourself directly to revenue by mastering marketing (lead flow) and sales so every business needs your skillset.
advice_items.quote: the best advice I got was connecting yourself to revenue... if you can control the lead flow then everyone's gonna want you... if you understand marketing and then sales... any business will be able to want you
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Miami)

advice_items.summary_zh: 区分资本利得与现金流，必须搞懂企业财务运作
advice_items.summary_en: Understand how business cash flows work rather than confusing one-off capital gains with sustainable cash flow.
advice_items.quote: Finance understanding how your cash flows work
advice_items.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Founder & E-commerce Entrepreneur Robert Miller

advice_items.summary_zh: 商业模式会变，但长期积累的个人品牌永远跟随你
advice_items.summary_en: Build a strong personal brand and content distribution because offers and markets change, while your reputation stays.
advice_items.quote: the way that you get more sales is always going to change your personal Brand's not going anywhere
advice_items.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Founder & E-commerce Entrepreneur Robert Miller

advice_items.canonical_tag: Be Careful Who You Partner With
advice_items.summary_zh: 合伙贵精不贵多，须各具核心价值且价值观一致
advice_items.summary_en: Keep partnerships small (2-3 max) and only partner with people who bring crucial capabilities and share your core values.
advice_items.quote: you need to have partners that are essentially crucial to the business... being with someone that you actually have the same values and aligned with
advice_items.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Founder & E-commerce Entrepreneur Robert Miller

advice_items.summary_zh: 面对失败要放下傲慢与过往身份，才能看清现实
advice_items.summary_en: Approach failure by dropping your ego and attachment to past ventures so you can see reality objectively.
advice_items.quote: when it comes to failure is if you can set aside your ego your pride and the identity of what you found in that prior Venture then you can actually start to see things for what they really are
advice_items.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Founder & E-commerce Entrepreneur Robert Miller

advice_items.summary_zh: 个人无法单打独斗，必须依靠优秀的团队共同执行
advice_items.summary_en: Build a loyal, execution-focused team and align their efforts because you cannot scale a business alone.
advice_items.quote: it's having a great team behind you man I can't do it all by myself
advice_items.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Founder & E-commerce Entrepreneur Robert Miller

advice_items.summary_zh: 持续阅读与学习，自认全懂就输了
advice_items.summary_en: Never stop reading and taking courses to build an internal library of solutions for future business problems.
advice_items.quote: I think if you think that you know it all you've already lost... what's your internal library that you can actually draw from those are typically courses
advice_items.video_title: Day in the Life of a 25 Year Old Millionaire

advice_items.summary_zh: 别试图精通所有领域，应该专注深耕一项核心业务
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid trying to become an expert in everything; stick primarily to one core focus while keeping only 2-3 side interests.
advice_items.quote: I think you should stick to one thing primarily
advice_items.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Founder & E-commerce Entrepreneur Robert Miller

advice_items.summary_zh: 没钱时用时间帮导师干活换取人脉
advice_items.summary_en: Get into the room with mentors—if you lack money, trade your time and labor to help them.
advice_items.quote: Invest in the mentors get into the room whatever it is whether it's you don't really have a lot of money that time so give your time to the actual mentor to help them
advice_items.video_title: Day in the Life of a 25 Year Old Millionaire

advice_items.summary_zh: 投资所处环境与圈层，结交高价值人脉
advice_items.summary_en: Invest in your physical environment and move to cities where ambitious entrepreneurs congregate so you can network with high-level peers.
advice_items.quote: I believe in investing into your environment so it first starts with the home... second is the people that you surround yourself around... it's really great to go Network and communicate and connect with people
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Miami)

advice_items.canonical_tag: Don't Neglect Health & Family for Money
advice_items.summary_zh: 切勿为工作过度透支身体，失去健康一切归零
advice_items.summary_en: Don't burn yourself out with 16-hour days and sleep deprivation; a severe health scare proved physical health must come first.
advice_items.quote: I've gone the full burnout way where you working 16 hours a day... health is very very serious
advice_items.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Founder & E-commerce Entrepreneur Robert Miller

advice_items.summary_zh: 持续押注自己并追逐潜能，不断突破人生天花板
advice_items.summary_en: Evolve your "why" from survival to betting on yourself and chasing your highest human and multifaceted potential.
advice_items.quote: become a different version of myself that I know that I can become and so chasing potential
advice_items.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Founder & E-commerce Entrepreneur Robert Miller

advice_items.summary_zh: 信仰需深入理解缘由而非盲目跟从
advice_items.summary_en: Explore and truly understand the moral foundation behind your faith rather than following blindly.
advice_items.quote: Instead of just blindly going into a faith or religion like understanding why and also what that connection means
advice_items.video_title: Day in the Life of a 25 Year Old Millionaire

advice_items.canonical_tag: Work Under a Winner First Before Starting
advice_items.summary_zh: 先帮赢家打工积累战绩再独立创业
advice_items.summary_en: Build a proven track record winning for clients or mentors before launching your own venture.
advice_items.quote: Before winning this one I had won it six times for other people... so I was like you know what screw it I'm gonna go do it and get the award for myself
advice_items.video_title: Day in the Life of a 25 Year Old Millionaire

advice_items.summary_zh: 坚持早起运动阅读冥想等每日习惯
advice_items.summary_en: Maintain a disciplined daily routine with early mornings, exercise, reading, and meditation.
advice_items.quote: First thing I wake up anywhere between five to six in the morning... I'll read I'll meditate... then I'll go down we'll go on a walk
advice_items.video_title: Day in the Life of a 25 Year Old Millionaire

advice_items.summary_zh: 销售重在真诚利他与建立长期信任
advice_items.summary_en: Treat sales as relationship-building rather than a transaction by genuinely prioritizing the customer's best interest.
advice_items.quote: A lot of people are in it for the transaction... try to at least build community and build trust and really understand that you have their best interest at mind or at heart
advice_items.video_title: Day in the Life of a 25 Year Old Millionaire

advice_items.summary_zh: 起步阶段每天高强度工作十余小时
advice_items.summary_en: Expect to grind relentlessly (6 AM to 10 PM daily) across every part of the business when starting out.
advice_items.quote: In the beginning of starting out I was very like I was 6 a.m until 10 P.M every single day grinding on every single part of the business
advice_items.video_title: Day in the Life of a 25 Year Old Millionaire

advice_items.summary_zh: 用高现金流业务矩阵供养资产投资
advice_items.summary_en: Operate a portfolio of cash-generating businesses to consistently fund investments in appreciating assets.
advice_items.quote: throughout the portfolio of businesses that I have right now it's really a cash generation machine to then invest into digital currencies
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Miami)

guests.role_or_title: Cybersecurity & AI Entrepreneur / Shark Tank Investor
guests.wealth_detail: $500M highest single-year total (including business sale capital gains); ~$18M/yr income
guests.first_money_or_break: 出身贫寒随父母偷渡到加拿大，21岁投身当时尚存质疑的互联网与网络安全领域抢占先机，靠自身实力创造价值，最终出售公司单年斩获约5亿美元（含资本利得）。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Born into poverty and having fled with his parents to Canada, he entered the then-doubted internet and cybersecurity sectors at age 21 to seize an early edge. By creating value through his own effort, he eventually sold his company and made roughly $500 million in a single year (including capital gains).
guests.zero_start_advice: 若保留人脉从零开始会创立AI公司（看好AI数据基础设施）；若完全无资金则从电商切入打造线上品牌，通过提供价值和积极情绪赢得客户与人脉。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: If starting from zero while keeping his network, he would launch an AI company focused on AI data infrastructure. If starting with zero capital at all, he would start in e-commerce to build an online brand, winning customers and connections by delivering value and positive energy.
guests.primary_video_title: I Asked Robert Herjavec How He Made $500 Million

appearances.video_title: I Asked Robert Herjavec How He Made $500 Million
I Asked Celebrities How They Got Rich!
I Interviewed 30 Billionaires... Here’s What I Learned

advice_tags: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.summary_zh: 顺应趋势能致富，引领趋势成巨富
advice_items.summary_en: Create or get ahead of emerging industry trends like cybersecurity or AI to build true wealth.
advice_items.quote: You can get rich by following a trend. You can get wealthy by creating a trend.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Robert Herjavec How He Made $500 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 不做出改变，生活就永远原地踏步
advice_items.summary_en: Take different actions today if you want your life and financial situation to change.
advice_items.quote: Nothing changes unless you change. If you're not willing to do something different today, you're going to lead the life you had yesterday.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Robert Herjavec How He Made $500 Million

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.summary_zh: 靠高薪难成巨富，必须打造可出售股权
advice_items.summary_en: Build sellable equity and capital gains rather than relying solely on high annual income.
advice_items.quote: It's very hard to get wealthy making a big income. You got to have capital gains. You got to build something of value that you can sell.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Robert Herjavec How He Made $500 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 别沉溺痛苦太久，跌倒后迅速起身
advice_items.summary_en: Minimize how long you dwell on setbacks and get right back up to keep going.
advice_items.quote: The difference between successful people and others is how long they wallow in misery... 5 minutes later, I just got to get up and do it again.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Robert Herjavec How He Made $500 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 买下房产长期持有十年以上切勿轻卖
advice_items.summary_en: Buy real estate and hold properties for at least 10 years without selling prematurely.
advice_items.quote: Never sell a house. Always keep every house... if you can hang on to a property for 10 years, for sure you'll make money.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Robert Herjavec How He Made $500 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 销售前先洞察客户需求，切忌套用话术
advice_items.summary_en: Stop using a generic pitch; learn who the buyer is and uncover their specific need first.
advice_items.quote: Biggest mistake people make in sales is they have a pitch and they apply that pitch to every single person... Before you sell, find out the need.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Robert Herjavec How He Made $500 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 先让自己变得有价值，成功者自会来结交
advice_items.summary_en: Focus on becoming successful and valuable first so high-value people naturally want to connect with you.
advice_items.quote: If you don't know anybody, you got to become the person other people want to know... You want to network with successful people, become successful.
advice_items.video_title: I Interviewed 30 Billionaires... Here’s What I Learned

advice_items.summary_zh: 激情会消退，唯有极度执着才能持久
advice_items.summary_en: Cultivate deep obsession with your craft, because motivation and passion fade while obsession endures.
advice_items.quote: Motivation is easy. Passion is easy. But all that stuff fades. Obsession lasts.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Robert Herjavec How He Made $500 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 保持身材与健康才是财富最大的炫耀
advice_items.summary_en: Invest your time and resources into staying physically fit, as health is the ultimate flex.
advice_items.quote: The biggest flex of wealth today is being in shape... If you're not using your money to stay healthy, what's the point?
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Robert Herjavec How He Made $500 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 没本钱可从电商切入打造线上品牌
advice_items.summary_en: Start with low-capital e-commerce and build a strong online brand if you lack starting money.
advice_items.quote: If you have no money, e-commerce... It depends on your brand. I think it's easy to build a brand today online.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Robert Herjavec How He Made $500 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 投人胜过投点子，优秀人才可化腐朽
advice_items.summary_en: Bet on exceptional people rather than ideas, since A-players elevate any business.
advice_items.quote: A great person can make a bad idea good. A bad person can take a great business and completely screw it up.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Robert Herjavec How He Made $500 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 别靠名牌撑门面，实力够强无需讨好
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid dressing or spending to impress others; build real leverage so people come to you.
advice_items.quote: Beware the man in the t-shirt because that guy worked his ass off to a point that he can wear whatever he want. He doesn't have to dress to impress.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Robert Herjavec How He Made $500 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 向客户传递快乐与好感，重视情绪价值
advice_items.summary_en: Win clients over by selling joy, warmth, and making people feel great when dealing with you.
advice_items.quote: Sell joy... It's not what you say, it's how you make people feel. The less you have, the nicer and the more engaging you have to be.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Robert Herjavec How He Made $500 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 怀抱信仰与好奇心真诚对待每个人
advice_items.summary_en: Stay grounded in faith and approach every person with genuine curiosity about their story.
advice_items.quote: You'll never find anything in life as fascinating as another human being. And I'm deeply Christian and so I try to approach every human being that way.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Robert Herjavec How He Made $500 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 每天识别并推进两三件能推动进展的事
advice_items.summary_en: Maintain constant forward momentum by identifying and executing the two or three daily tasks that move the ball forward.
advice_items.quote: Constant forward momentum. Every day, there are two or three things that advance the ball. Know what those are.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Celebrities How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 人生总有导师出现，关键在于用心倾听
advice_items.summary_en: Always stay attentive to mentors around you and internalize wisdom from proven leaders.
advice_items.quote: There's always a mentor in your life. You just have to listen for it.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Celebrities How They Got Rich!

guests.role_or_title: Founder & Owner, Effects Management Solutions (Labor Force Management)
guests.wealth_detail: $300M/yr revenue company (100% owned); $21M car collection
guests.first_money_or_break: 出身农场且曾靠救济金生活；创业首个大单年化营收达900万美元，因30天账期需垫付约100万美元周转资金，靠21%高息应收账款保理垫资撑过前5周并坚持不分红全额留存再投资。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Raised on a farm and having once lived on welfare, he landed a first major contract worth $9 million in annualized revenue that required fronting about $1 million in working capital for 30-day payment terms. He survived the first five weeks using 21% high-interest accounts receivable factoring and reinvested 100% of earnings without taking dividends.
guests.zero_start_advice: 不要空手套白狼找早期投资人（否则会被拿走51%-70%股权），先低成本跑通最小营收和商业验证；尽量不给自己发工资、过极简生活，用现金流小步滚雪球；尽早与银行建立信任关系，加入不互相推销的创始人同行交流圈，并坚定自信、永不放弃。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Do not raise money from early investors empty-handed (or you will give up 51%-70% equity); instead, prove minimum revenue and business viability at low cost first. Skip paying yourself as much as possible, live minimally to snowball cash flow, build bank trust early, join non-promotional founder peer groups, stay confident, and never quit.

advice_items.summary_zh: 学会授权与培养团队，靠自己只能做小生意
advice_items.summary_en: Master delegation and build an empowered team; doing everything yourself caps growth at a fraction of your potential.
advice_items.quote: My company will do 300 million this year in revenue, right? If I were still doing it all myself, we might do three.
advice_items.video_title: I Had to Beg Borrow & Steal.. Now I Make $300 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 心态、激情与驱动力比单纯的技能更关键
advice_items.summary_en: Mindset matters more than skillset because technical skills can be taught, while passion and drive cannot.
advice_items.quote: I can give you skills, but I can't control your mindset. I can't give you passion, I can't give you drive.
advice_items.video_title: I Had to Beg Borrow & Steal.. Now I Make $300 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 别把钱浪费在豪车名表等无回报消费品上
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid blowing money or taking on debt for watches, supercars, and consumables that generate zero ROI.
advice_items.quote: Don't go out and blow money on that new Rolex, that new Patek, that Ferrari, the new Lambo... invest that money in something that's going to give you an ROI.
advice_items.video_title: I Had to Beg Borrow & Steal.. Now I Make $300 Million

advice_items.canonical_tag: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep
advice_items.summary_zh: 无论赚多少钱，都必须坚持量入为出
advice_items.summary_en: Maintain strict personal spending discipline regardless of how high your income rises.
advice_items.quote: No matter how much money you make, you still got to live within your means.
advice_items.video_title: I Had to Beg Borrow & Steal.. Now I Make $300 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 把每周利润全额留存企业降负债、筑资产
advice_items.summary_en: Keep profits inside the business early on to pay down debt, build retained earnings, and self-fund scale.
advice_items.quote: Every dollar I made every week had to stay in the company to reduce my debt liabilities... then I still had to build my balance sheet and retained earnings to be able to grow.
advice_items.video_title: I Had to Beg Borrow & Steal.. Now I Make $300 Million

advice_items.canonical_tag: Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)
advice_items.summary_zh: 营收未稳切勿借大额贷款一次性承担高风险
advice_items.summary_en: Do not take on large lump-sum loans before you have consistent revenue to support the risk; grow cash flow in small chunks.
advice_items.quote: Rather than going taking out this loan, you took on all that risk at once and you didn't have the revenue to support it.
advice_items.video_title: I Had to Beg Borrow & Steal.. Now I Make $300 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 严守财务纪律，夯实公司资产负债表
advice_items.summary_en: Develop rigorous financial discipline and build a strong balance sheet rather than pulling cash out prematurely.
advice_items.quote: I've learned financial discipline... I learned how to build up a balance sheet in a business, which is imperative.
advice_items.video_title: I Had to Beg Borrow & Steal.. Now I Make $300 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 先自己跑通小规模营收，再谈融资扩张
advice_items.summary_en: Start hustling and generating small initial revenue to prove your concept before seeking outside growth capital.
advice_items.quote: I want to see that you already started hustling, you already started turning some revenue, maybe at a very small level... now we've got proof of concept.
advice_items.video_title: I Had to Beg Borrow & Steal.. Now I Make $300 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 一切以客户利益为中心，用信任滚大订单
advice_items.summary_en: Prioritize what is best for existing clients so they expand their contracts and trust you with more business.
advice_items.quote: I made it all about our customer... by focusing on what was best for our customers, they continue to turn over more and more of their business to us.
advice_items.video_title: I Had to Beg Borrow & Steal.. Now I Make $300 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 采用顾问式销售，先帮客户提升利润再成交
advice_items.summary_en: Use a consultative sales approach focused on making the prospect's business more profitable and competitive.
advice_items.quote: Coming in with more of a consultative sales approach where I'm here to see how I can make your business better... make you more profitable and make you more competitive.
advice_items.video_title: I Had to Beg Borrow & Steal.. Now I Make $300 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 尽早与银行建立信任关系，为扩张铺平融资路
advice_items.summary_en: Build relationships with bankers early and let them guide your balance-sheet milestones before you urgently need credit.
advice_items.quote: Establish relationships with bankers as fast as possible. You're going to need them if you're going to scale... start establishing those relationships before you have the need.
advice_items.video_title: I Had to Beg Borrow & Steal.. Now I Make $300 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 用诚信与靠谱记录赢得银行和伙伴的信任
advice_items.summary_en: Establish unimpeachable integrity and follow through on milestones so lenders and partners are willing to bet on you.
advice_items.quote: Got them to believe in me, believe in my integrity, my credibility, because they want to be taking risk with people that they believe have strong credibility.
advice_items.video_title: I Had to Beg Borrow & Steal.. Now I Make $300 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 尽早加入纯粹互助、不互相推销的创始人社群
advice_items.summary_en: Join a non-soliciting peer group of founders and CEOs to learn from others' experience instead of spending 40 hours solving problems alone.
advice_items.quote: Get into a group where we're all there to learn and grow and collaborate and share experience with one another. That's probably the one thing if I were to go back to me at 24, 25 years old I would tell myself to do.
advice_items.video_title: I Had to Beg Borrow & Steal.. Now I Make $300 Million

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.summary_zh: 谈判遇到压价时，改签与长期业绩挂钩的方案
advice_items.summary_en: In tough price negotiations, concede short-term price and tie future margins to measurable ROI and cost savings you deliver.
advice_items.quote: Let them have that win, okay, but now start looking long term... let's make it results driven... allow me to earn my margins... by making your business better.
advice_items.video_title: I Had to Beg Borrow & Steal.. Now I Make $300 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 成功后不忘回馈社会，积极指导下一代创业者
advice_items.summary_en: Use your success and passions as a platform to inspire and mentor younger people coming up behind you.
advice_items.quote: Now I'm at a place where I really want to give back. I love mentoring other people.
advice_items.video_title: I Had to Beg Borrow & Steal.. Now I Make $300 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 坚信自己的梦想，永远不要轻言放弃
advice_items.summary_en: Hold onto a clear vision regardless of humble beginnings, believe in yourself, and refuse to quit.
advice_items.quote: I had a dream, I had a vision for something that I wanted for myself and at the end of the day it's the number one thing I tell people all the time: believe in yourself and just don't quit.
advice_items.video_title: I Had to Beg Borrow & Steal.. Now I Make $300 Million

guests.role_or_title: Biotech Entrepreneur & Investor (Former Cancer Biotech Company Owner)
guests.wealth_detail: $10B-$14B net worth; sold biotech company for $21B; made $1B in a single day
guests.first_money_or_break: 早年时薪仅50美分，大学时靠5000美元本金在导师指导下投资起步，滚雪球至360万美元（一度回撤至60万美元后重新聚焦）；后来因儿子患胶质母细胞瘤转入生物医药领域抗癌，并将生物科技公司以210亿美元出售。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Having started out earning just 50 cents an hour, he began investing in college with $5,000 under a mentor's guidance, growing it to $3.6 million (before drawing down to $600,000 and refocusing). Later, after his son was diagnosed with glioblastoma, he pivoted into biopharma to fight cancer and eventually sold his biotech company for $21 billion.
guests.zero_start_advice: 把注意力放在赚钱和未来成功上，而不是担心亏钱；找一位真正懂行的导师，先把商业与财务认知放在首位；保持热情与行动力，拒绝内耗焦虑，在失败后坚持到底并持续创造价值。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Focus on making money and future success rather than worrying about losing money, find a genuinely knowledgeable mentor, and put business and financial literacy first. Stay passionate and action-oriented, refuse anxious overthinking, push through failure, and keep creating value.
recommended_books_or_mentors: Clint Eastwood (Never let the old man in)

advice_tags: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep
Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value

advice_items.canonical_tag: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep
advice_items.summary_zh: 绝不过度消费，保留充足备用资金
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid overspending on status symbols and keep enough reserves to fund your company if things go wrong.
advice_items.quote: I don't have jewelry... I fly private but I don't own a jet. I really don't overspend. I always have enough money if things go wrong in the company that I can fund it.
advice_items.video_title: Inside the Life of a 82-Year-Old Billionaire in Miami

advice_items.summary_zh: 把商业与财务认知放在首位
advice_items.summary_en: Make business literacy and thoroughly understanding how a business works your top priority.
advice_items.quote: I realized that literacy and understanding the business is the first priority.
advice_items.video_title: Inside the Life of a 82-Year-Old Billionaire in Miami

advice_items.summary_zh: 寻找真正懂行且有成果的导师
advice_items.summary_en: Find a mentor who genuinely knows what they are doing and has a proven track record.
advice_items.quote: It's really great to have a mentor, someone that really knows what they're doing and that has worked.
advice_items.video_title: Inside the Life of a 82-Year-Old Billionaire in Miami

advice_items.summary_zh: 戒掉散漫玩乐，重新聚焦核心目标
advice_items.summary_en: Cut out distractions and get yourself back on purpose with laser focus when performance slips.
advice_items.quote: I was goofing around and I got down to 600,000. I said, 'That's it. I got to get myself back on purpose and focus.'
advice_items.video_title: Inside the Life of a 82-Year-Old Billionaire in Miami

advice_items.summary_zh: 心怀信仰与感恩，低谷时仍懂得回馈
advice_items.summary_en: Stay grounded in faith and generosity, giving back even when you are recovering from a setback.
advice_items.quote: Of the 600,000 I had left, I gave 200 to a church. And I said, 'They're going to use it better than I was.'
advice_items.video_title: Inside the Life of a 82-Year-Old Billionaire in Miami

advice_items.summary_zh: 出身不决定上限，改变心态就能改命
advice_items.summary_en: Growing up poor does not cap your potential—success comes down to ideas and changing the attitude within your control.
advice_items.quote: It's just ideas. It's an attitude. That's it. It's an attitude. You can change your attitude about anything that's under your control.
advice_items.video_title: Inside the Life of a 82-Year-Old Billionaire in Miami

advice_items.summary_zh: 聚焦把钱赚到，别把精力耗在怕亏钱
advice_items.summary_en: Focus your energy on making money and planning for what could go right instead of fearing loss.
advice_items.quote: Put your attention on making the money, not worrying about losing it.
advice_items.video_title: Inside the Life of a 82-Year-Old Billionaire in Miami

advice_items.summary_zh: 停止内耗焦虑，用热情立刻投入行动
advice_items.summary_en: Stop wasting energy on worry—adopt an enthusiastic 'I can and will make it happen' mindset and get busy executing.
advice_items.quote: What's the ROI for worry? ... You've got to take the viewpoint with enthusiasm. I can and will make it happen... and get busy doing it.
advice_items.video_title: Inside the Life of a 82-Year-Old Billionaire in Miami

advice_items.summary_zh: 绝不说谎，始终坚持残酷的坦诚
advice_items.summary_en: Never tell a lie and commit to total honesty, even when it means delivering the brutal truth.
advice_items.quote: Never tell a lie. Always be honest. Whatever it is, the brutal truth.
advice_items.video_title: Inside the Life of a 82-Year-Old Billionaire in Miami

advice_items.summary_zh: 客户第一，股东第二，自己排在最后
advice_items.summary_en: Put your customers first, your shareholders second, and yourself third in any business you build.
advice_items.quote: Care about my customers first and my shareholders second, and I come in third.
advice_items.video_title: Inside the Life of a 82-Year-Old Billionaire in Miami

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.summary_zh: 持有公司长期股权，不搞短线投机
advice_items.summary_en: Build and hold ownership in your businesses for the long game instead of trading in and out of stocks.
advice_items.quote: When I start a business and I own it... I never sell until we sell the whole company. I'm not into trading my stocks in and out. I played the long game and that's what works.
advice_items.video_title: Inside the Life of a 82-Year-Old Billionaire in Miami

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.summary_zh: 商业本质是帮人解决问题并超额交付价值
advice_items.summary_en: Make your business self-sustaining by helping others and delivering more value than customers pay you.
advice_items.quote: The purpose of business is to help others... get to self-sustaining. And let's prove that by giving people enough value that they give us more for what we give them.
advice_items.video_title: Inside the Life of a 82-Year-Old Billionaire in Miami

advice_items.summary_zh: 靠近有进取心的创造者与顶级圈层
advice_items.summary_en: Place yourself in environments filled with ambitious creators who actively deploy their resources to build.
advice_items.quote: Miami is... the accumulation of people that are going somewhere with their money and their resource... they're creators. That's what you want to be.
advice_items.video_title: Inside the Life of a 82-Year-Old Billionaire in Miami

advice_items.summary_zh: 坚持每日冷水浴与运动，保持年轻态
advice_items.summary_en: Maintain disciplined daily health habits like cold plunges, cycling, and swimming, and refuse to adopt an aging mindset.
advice_items.quote: I go for it every day... Clint... said, 'Bob, never let the old man in.'
advice_items.video_title: Inside the Life of a 82-Year-Old Billionaire in Miami

advice_items.summary_zh: 甘愿长时间拼搏，对事业全力以赴
advice_items.summary_en: Cultivate a strong desire to work hard and long, giving everything you have to your projects and fellow human beings.
advice_items.quote: Geniuses have a strong desire to work hard and long. They're willing to give all they got to a project.
advice_items.video_title: Inside the Life of a 82-Year-Old Billionaire in Miami

advice_items.summary_zh: 别沉溺于失败，赢家输二十次依然在场
advice_items.summary_en: Learn from your losses without dwelling on them—winners actually lose more times than losers because they never quit.
advice_items.quote: Focus on your future success and keep going. Don't introvert on your losses... A loser loses three times, he's out. A winner loses 20, he's still in.
advice_items.video_title: Inside the Life of a 82-Year-Old Billionaire in Miami

guests.role_or_title: Founder & CEO, Met Group (Residential & Commercial Solar)
guests.wealth_detail: ~$30M annual company revenue (targeting $100M in 2-3 years); millionaire at age 24 ("eight-figure entrepreneur")
guests.first_money_or_break: 从倒卖球鞋、在eBay卖货以及在DirecTV和沃尔玛做销售起步，每周定投500-1000美元比特币、以太坊和优质股票，24岁成为百万富翁，后白手起家创办太阳能公司Met Group（年营收约3000万美元）。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Starting out reselling sneakers, selling on eBay, and working sales at DirecTV and Walmart, he dollar-cost averaged $500-$1,000 weekly into Bitcoin, Ethereum, and quality stocks to become a millionaire at 24. He later built the solar company Met Group from scratch, reaching roughly $30 million in annual revenue.
guests.zero_start_advice: 先评估自己适合独立创业还是在好公司做内部创业者；早期别盲目多元化，先选定未来20年大势行业，靠大量电销地推练就硬核沟通力，打透一件事、赚到第一桶金后再分散布局。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: First assess whether you are better suited to founding a company or being an intrapreneur at a great one, and avoid premature diversification early on. Pick an industry poised for growth over the next 20 years, build hardcore communication skills through high-volume cold calling and door-to-door sales, and diversify only after dominating one thing and making your first fortune.
guests.primary_video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Founder & Investor Grant Mitt

appearances.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Founder & Investor Grant Mitt
Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Austin)

advice_tags: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market

advice_items.summary_zh: 别拿年龄当借口，市场只看输赢不看资历
advice_items.summary_en: Age is irrelevant once you enter the market; treating it as a barrier is just a mental excuse.
advice_items.quote: If you choose to think that that's an issue all it is is your brain trying to give you some reason to justify why you're not as successful as you are.
advice_items.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Founder & Investor Grant Mitt

advice_items.summary_zh: 条件具备就果断行动，宁可试错归零也别拖延后悔
advice_items.summary_en: Once your preparation, capital, and timing align, pull the trigger and accept the risk of failure rather than staying stuck.
advice_items.quote: I just had to pull the trigger but I knew that I was okay losing absolutely every single penny knowing that I tried.
advice_items.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Founder & Investor Grant Mitt

advice_items.summary_zh: 先在一件事上赚到大钱，没成功前切忌盲目多元化
advice_items.summary_en: Do not diversify early; focus all energy on becoming great at one core business until you build a big pile of wealth, then allocate.
advice_items.quote: There's no point to diversify if you got no money that means you're just going to be kind of good at a bunch of things and really great at nothing.
advice_items.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Founder & Investor Grant Mitt

advice_items.summary_zh: 靠免费干货打造个人品牌，能带来人才、信任与机会
advice_items.summary_en: Build a personal brand by giving away free value to help people; it attracts top talent, media credibility, and business connections.
advice_items.quote: It helps with building your brand it builds connections when you can build an individual brand and you're not there to just make money but you just want to actually help people.
advice_items.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Founder & Investor Grant Mitt

advice_items.summary_zh: 敢于承担风险投资自己，同时做好风雨准备
advice_items.summary_en: Risk-taking is essential to success—bet on yourself and invest in your own development while staying smart about preparing for downturns.
advice_items.quote: Risk taking is everything... there's times you need to be risk on risk off you need to prepare for a rainy day... if you're not investing in yourself and your career and your development you're not going to be successful.
advice_items.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Founder & Investor Grant Mitt

advice_items.summary_zh: 经受无数次拒绝与辱骂仍保持心态，才是真本事
advice_items.summary_en: Real resilience cannot be learned from textbooks; you build it by enduring repeated rejection while maintaining your composure and attitude.
advice_items.quote: Until you've been told no until you've been cussed out until you've been screamed at... and you still have to have that same attitude... you won't get it.
advice_items.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Founder & Investor Grant Mitt

advice_items.summary_zh: 先精通销售再投身创业
advice_items.summary_en: Build a strong foundation in direct sales early on to generate cash flow and develop persuasion skills before launching a company.
advice_items.quote: when I first got my first sales job I first started selling on DirecTV and Walmart... a combination of that on top of being really successful in sales and then becoming an entrepreneur helped me reach that target
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Austin)

advice_items.summary_zh: 规模化靠的是比你更强的团队，放权别事必躬亲
advice_items.summary_en: You cannot scale with software alone; hire specialists smarter than you in specific areas and empower them without micromanaging.
advice_items.quote: Scaling is people at the end of the day we're going to need thousands of people... that know what they're doing that are as smart or smarter than me in different single areas.
advice_items.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Founder & Investor Grant Mitt

advice_items.summary_zh: 做好精力与情绪管理，学会拒绝低价值事务
advice_items.summary_en: Prevent burnout through energy management, saying no to low-value drains, emotional control, reliable systems, and timely rest.
advice_items.quote: It's all about just staying extremely level-headed through the highs and through the low energy management emotional control and being consistent and just knowing when to take a break.
advice_items.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Founder & Investor Grant Mitt

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.summary_zh: 逆向布局未来二十年增长的新兴行业抢占先机
advice_items.summary_en: Target emerging industries poised to be much bigger in 20 years and move counter to the crowd to capture early disruption.
advice_items.quote: I was looking at what are the emerging industries... what is going to be bigger in the next 20 years than it is today.
advice_items.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Founder & Investor Grant Mitt

advice_items.summary_zh: 看重可塑谦逊与坚持，没有退路的人终会成功
advice_items.summary_en: Prioritize coachability, humility, and persistence—people with no safety net who must succeed always find a way through.
advice_items.quote: Are you coachable are you humble and are you persistent... if they have a backup plan... they almost never succeed so someone that has to make it no matter what always will find a way out.
advice_items.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Founder & Investor Grant Mitt

advice_items.summary_zh: 精简启动并将利润再投资
advice_items.summary_en: Start small by flipping goods and saving cash to bootstrap your own company from scratch before scaling nationwide.
advice_items.quote: started flipping sneakers selling stuff online selling things on eBay to ultimately just saving up bootstrapping everything and starting this company from scratch
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Austin)

advice_items.summary_zh: 保护本金长期定投稳健复利
advice_items.summary_en: Protect principal and steadily funnel income into assets that can compound consistently over 10 to 30 years.
advice_items.quote: number one rule of money is don't lose it... let's just be basic let's be boring and stack money take my main source of income and put it into something that can compound and grow over the next 10 20 30 years
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Austin)

advice_items.summary_zh: 先投资学习提升自我认知
advice_items.summary_en: Invest in your own knowledge, mindset, and consistency first so you become capable of earning and keeping a million dollars.
advice_items.quote: first focus on yourself invest and learn and create yourself into a person that's capable of receiving a million dollars and being consistent at it
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Austin)

advice_items.summary_zh: 深耕枯燥传统行业并规模化
advice_items.summary_en: Choose a proven, unglamorous service or trade business, master the craft, and scale it into a major cash-flow engine.
advice_items.quote: pick something that's boring that you can be amazing at... they have a plumbing company a roofing company a flooring company... Master a craft and then scale it
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Austin)

advice_items.summary_zh: 用利润购入收租升值资产
advice_items.summary_en: Take the profits from your core business and buy appreciating real estate assets that generate recurring rent.
advice_items.quote: take that same money that you're making from what you've mastered and then invested into assets that appreciate and pay you rents and repeat
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Austin)

guests.industry_zh: 营销代理与高客单销售
guests.wealth_detail: $15M/yr; $5.5M in a single day
guests.first_money_or_break: 早年曾做垃圾清运工（时薪6.25美元），16岁受父亲辞职单干启发立志创业；45岁赚到第一个百万美元，却因过早升级消费且遭遇家庭变故亏光；后通过重金跟随导师学习一对多舞台销售，并转向积累资产而非出卖时间，最终实现年入1500万美元。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: After starting as a garbage collector earning $6.25 an hour and being inspired at 16 by his father leaving a job to go independent, he made his first $1 million at 45 only to lose it all from premature lifestyle inflation and family setbacks. He bounced back by investing heavily in mentors to master one-to-many stage selling and shifting from trading time to building assets, eventually reaching $15 million a year.
guests.zero_start_advice: 拒绝设定“90天暴富”类带死线的目标（避免未达预期引发挫败感而放弃），建议从专注解决他人真实痛点入手，用免费高价值内容获取注意力、向具备支付能力的高净值人群提供高客单方案，并花钱进入高水平圈层学习与链接。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Reject "get rich in 90 days" deadline goals that cause discouragement and quitting when unmet, and start by solving real pain points for others. Use free high-value content to earn attention, offer high-ticket solutions to high-net-worth buyers who can pay, and pay to enter higher-level rooms to learn and network.
recommended_books_or_mentors: Robert G Allen (Multiple Streams of Income)

advice_items.summary_zh: 高度专注核心意图，屏蔽一切无关干扰
advice_items.summary_en: Stay hyper-focused on actions that move the needle and ruthlessly ignore distractions.
advice_items.quote: Hyper focus on intention and ignore distraction. Intention is anything that moves the needle in your favor.
advice_items.video_title: I Was Broke.. Found God.. Now I Make $15M/Year

advice_items.summary_zh: 别为取悦他人而透支信用去买面子消费品
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid going into debt or buying status symbols to impress strangers.
advice_items.quote: Middle-class people think the primary purpose of money is to maintain good credit so they can buy things they can't afford to impress people they don't know or like.
advice_items.video_title: I Was Broke.. Found God.. Now I Make $15M/Year

advice_items.summary_zh: 把钱当成资本滚雪球，追求十倍百倍增值
advice_items.summary_en: Treat every dollar as capital meant to multiply rather than be spent.
advice_items.quote: Rich people believe the primary purpose of money is to turn into more money... when I get a dollar I want to turn it into 10 or preferably 100.
advice_items.video_title: I Was Broke.. Found God.. Now I Make $15M/Year

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.summary_zh: 聚焦解决他人的真实痛点，金钱自然随之而来
advice_items.summary_en: Focus entirely on solving other people's problems and creating value; income follows.
advice_items.quote: You have to solve somebody else's problem in order to solve your money problem, and you can't be focused on your money problem when you're solving it.
advice_items.video_title: I Was Broke.. Found God.. Now I Make $15M/Year

advice_items.canonical_tag: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep
advice_items.summary_zh: 切忌过早消费升级，只花收入的一成留足缓冲
advice_items.summary_en: Resist upgrading your lifestyle too early; live on a small fraction of your income to stay resilient.
advice_items.quote: I upgraded my lifestyle way too soon... if you can live off of 10% of your income, now you're in a place where the bottom can fall out and you're still going to be okay.
advice_items.video_title: I Was Broke.. Found God.. Now I Make $15M/Year

advice_items.summary_zh: 高利润时仍要压低开支，优先留存资金养业务
advice_items.summary_en: Keep business overhead low even during high-margin periods and retain capital to sustain growth.
advice_items.quote: Keep the expenses low even when the margins and the profits are high... you want to make sure that the business is sustained first.
advice_items.video_title: I Was Broke.. Found God.. Now I Make $15M/Year

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.summary_zh: 顺应当前AI时代浪潮，在风口行业创造财富
advice_items.summary_en: Build in the defining industry of your current economic era, such as AI today.
advice_items.quote: It's easier to create wealth in the economic era that you're living in... right now we are in the AI age.
advice_items.video_title: I Was Broke.. Found God.. Now I Make $15M/Year

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.summary_zh: 停止用时间换薪酬，转向购买和打造生息资产
advice_items.summary_en: Shift from trading time for wages to buying and building assets like books that pay you repeatedly.
advice_items.quote: Income follows assets, so I stopped focusing on 8 hours work for 8 hours pay... how can I put more assets in my asset column.
advice_items.video_title: I Was Broke.. Found God.. Now I Make $15M/Year

advice_items.summary_zh: 投资自身大脑是核心，持续学习掌握未知能力
advice_items.summary_en: Prioritize investing in your own mind and skills to unlock new capabilities.
advice_items.quote: The most important thing I've ever invested in is my own mind to learn the things I don't know so I can do the things I couldn't do before.
advice_items.video_title: I Was Broke.. Found God.. Now I Make $15M/Year

advice_items.summary_zh: 花钱请教导师是最快捷径，直接吸收前人经验
advice_items.summary_en: Pay for proven mentors to compress decades of trial and error into an actionable shortcut.
advice_items.quote: Mentorship is like the ultimate shortcut. Somebody's already spent their whole life figuring out how to do something and they charge you some money to teach you.
advice_items.video_title: I Was Broke.. Found God.. Now I Make $15M/Year

advice_items.summary_zh: 打破思维局限，学会看见并接纳更大的财富体量
advice_items.summary_en: Expand your mental ceiling and train yourself to recognize abundant opportunities around you.
advice_items.quote: You have to think a lot bigger and you have to learn to perceive the big things that are already there all around you.
advice_items.video_title: I Was Broke.. Found God.. Now I Make $15M/Year

advice_items.summary_zh: 花钱挤进高净值圈层，在顶级社群中获得回报
advice_items.summary_en: Invest to get into high-level masterminds and rooms where wealthier peers recognize your value.
advice_items.quote: You pay to be in the room, you buy your way into the room, and you get paid on the way out of the room.
advice_items.video_title: I Was Broke.. Found God.. Now I Make $15M/Year

advice_items.summary_zh: 向有钱且有需求的人销售高客单价值方案
advice_items.summary_en: Sell high-ticket value offers upfront to affluent buyers who already want and can afford them.
advice_items.quote: If you want to get rich, sell to rich people... it takes no more energy to sell a million-dollar offer than it does to sell a $1,000 offer.
advice_items.video_title: I Was Broke.. Found God.. Now I Make $15M/Year

advice_items.summary_zh: 持续免费输出高价值内容，用注意力换取变现
advice_items.summary_en: Consistently publish free helpful content to earn audience attention, which later converts into paying clients.
advice_items.quote: Prove to people that you can help them by actually helping them... people pay you long enough with their attention, they'll eventually pay you with their assets.
advice_items.video_title: I Was Broke.. Found God.. Now I Make $15M/Year

advice_items.summary_zh: 心怀感恩并服务大众，把每一天都当成礼物
advice_items.summary_en: Stay grounded in gratitude, love the people around you, and serve as many people as possible.
advice_items.quote: Live every day with gratitude in your heart... everything good in my life is a gift.
advice_items.video_title: I Was Broke.. Found God.. Now I Make $15M/Year

guests.wealth_detail: North of $20B net worth; $400M highest single-year income; owns 91-92% of Raising Cane's (900+ locations)
guests.first_money_or_break: 高中大学在餐厅打工积累行业经验，因商业计划被教授打全班最低分且遭当地银行悉数拒贷，只身赴阿拉斯加住帐篷做商业捕鱼攒下约5万美元启动资金，再申请5万美元SBA小企业贷款，亲手翻修破旧店面于1996年创立Raising Cane's。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: After working in restaurants through high school and college, his business plan received the lowest grade in his class and every local bank rejected his loan, so he went alone to Alaska, lived in a tent, and worked commercial fishing to save about $50,000. Combining that with a $50,000 SBA small business loan, he renovated a rundown storefront by hand and founded Raising Cane's in 1996.
guests.zero_start_advice: 若一无所有重启，会继续选择自己熟悉的餐饮业，寻找另一款让人上瘾的爆款单品，聚焦单点做到极致并围绕它组建团队后规模化扩张；没钱且借不到钱时要靠体力劳动自攒本金，并善用SBA贷款、SBDC和SCORE等政府及导师资源。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Starting over with nothing, he would return to the familiar restaurant industry, find another addictive breakout single item, perfect that one focus, build a team around it, and scale. When you have no money and cannot borrow, raise seed capital through physical labor and leverage government and mentor resources like SBA loans, SBDC, and SCORE.

advice_items.canonical_tag: Work Under a Winner First Before Starting
advice_items.summary_zh: 创业前先在目标行业打工摸清门道，再动手单干
advice_items.summary_en: Work inside your target industry first to learn operations hands-on before starting your own company.
advice_items.quote: I worked in the business so I knew exactly what I needed to do.
advice_items.video_title: How I Turned $50,000 Into $20 Billion

advice_items.summary_zh: 把拒绝和质疑当成燃料，坚信自己并证明给别人看
advice_items.summary_en: Use rejection and doubters as fuel, believe in yourself, and prove your business concept works.
advice_items.quote: I use rejection as fuel. Every time somebody told me, 'Hey, this will never work,' I was like, you know what? I'll prove it to you... believe in yourself.
advice_items.video_title: How I Turned $50,000 Into $20 Billion

advice_items.summary_zh: 苦干攒首笔本金，借SBA贷款低成本自装修起家
advice_items.summary_en: Earn your initial startup capital through hard work, leverage SBA loans and advisory programs like SBDC and SCORE, and renovate leanly yourself.
advice_items.quote: Once I raised a lot of my own personal equity, about $50,000, I was able to go in and get a small SBA loan for $50,000 and get this dilapidated old restaurant space and do the work myself.
advice_items.video_title: How I Turned $50,000 Into $20 Billion

advice_items.summary_zh: 吃透盈亏平衡与高中低财务预测，熟知所有数字
advice_items.summary_en: Know your financial numbers inside and out, including low (break-even), medium, and high projections.
advice_items.quote: You have to know your numbers inside and out. You have to believe in them. Low, mediums, and highs.
advice_items.video_title: How I Turned $50,000 Into $20 Billion

advice_items.summary_zh: 谈判时笃定自身数据不被压价，不合适就换下一家
advice_items.summary_en: In negotiations, believe in your numbers, refuse to be talked down if the math works, and take the deal elsewhere if needed.
advice_items.quote: Best negotiation advice I can give anybody is believe in what you're doing and know your numbers inside and out. And don't let people talk you down on your numbers.
advice_items.video_title: How I Turned $50,000 Into $20 Billion

advice_items.canonical_tag: Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)
advice_items.summary_zh: 切忌过度加杠杆负债扩张，优先用自有股权稳健成长
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid overleveraging with excessive debt; after Hurricane Katrina nearly broke the business, grow primarily with equity.
advice_items.quote: I almost broke our business. I overlevered it... since that day, I've never overleveraged our business. I don't take on too much debt. I grow with more equity.
advice_items.video_title: How I Turned $50,000 Into $20 Billion

advice_items.summary_zh: 聚焦单一核心业务做到极致，每日精进再规模化
advice_items.summary_en: Focus on one core offering and execute it better than anyone else every day instead of branching out prematurely.
advice_items.quote: Do one thing and do it better than anybody else. Focus on that. Know what you're good at and execute on a daily basis. Then scale.
advice_items.video_title: How I Turned $50,000 Into $20 Billion

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.summary_zh: 必须打造让人上瘾的卓越核心产品，平庸产品必败
advice_items.summary_en: Build an exceptional, cravable core product and service; a mediocre product will never succeed long-term.
advice_items.quote: You have to have an amazing product and service... something that's cravable. If you have a mediocre product, you'll never make it.
advice_items.video_title: How I Turned $50,000 Into $20 Billion

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.summary_zh: 紧握控股权，才能做长期正确决策而非迎合短期利益
advice_items.summary_en: Retain controlling equity ownership (91-92%) so you can prioritize long-term crew and customer health over short-term investor pressure.
advice_items.quote: Since I own the business, I get to make the right decisions based on the long-term success of the business... I don't have to make short-term decisions to do short-term gains.
advice_items.video_title: How I Turned $50,000 Into $20 Billion

advice_items.summary_zh: 怀抱回馈社会与服务的使命感，才能永不懈怠
advice_items.summary_en: Stay driven by faith and purpose—creating great jobs, serving people, giving back to communities, and leaving the world better.
advice_items.quote: What I can do with hiring people and having a great place to work and what I can do for the money I can give back to communities. That for me just drives me.
advice_items.video_title: How I Turned $50,000 Into $20 Billion

advice_items.summary_zh: 从错误和挫折中学到的永远比从成功中学到的更多
advice_items.summary_en: Expect constant setbacks and learn from mistakes, which teach far more than successes.
advice_items.quote: I think you learn more from your mistakes than you do from your successes, and we're constantly getting knocked back.
advice_items.video_title: How I Turned $50,000 Into $20 Billion

advice_items.canonical_tag: Be Careful Who You Partner With
advice_items.summary_zh: 警惕想占便宜的人，信任但要核实，被坑即刻止损
advice_items.summary_en: Surround yourself with good people, trust but verify, and cut ties immediately with anyone who takes advantage of you.
advice_items.quote: There's some bad people out there that want to take advantage of you. Surround yourself by good people. Trust, but verify. And if they screw you over, then move on.
advice_items.video_title: How I Turned $50,000 Into $20 Billion

advice_items.summary_zh: 重进步而非求完美，先推第一版再持续迭代优化
advice_items.summary_en: Prioritize progress over perfection; launch version one and iterate instead of stalling your business.
advice_items.quote: Concentrate more on progress rather than perfection... That one training program can be version one. You can be on version 100 a year from now.
advice_items.video_title: How I Turned $50,000 Into $20 Billion

advice_items.summary_zh: 创业要承受极高压力与牺牲，狂热执着且绝不放弃
advice_items.summary_en: Accept extreme hours, pressure, and high risk tolerance early on, pursue your vision fanatically, and never give up.
advice_items.quote: My best advice I can give a young entrepreneur when they're getting started is never ever ever ever give up... Nothing ever happens unless somebody pursues a vision fanatically.
advice_items.video_title: How I Turned $50,000 Into $20 Billion

advice_items.summary_zh: 薄利靠规模销量取胜，宁可多花成本也要保品质服务
advice_items.summary_en: In tight-margin businesses (5-10 cents on the dollar), drive high sales volume while staying profit-smart and never cutting quality or service.
advice_items.quote: Always better quality, better service. Even if it cost you more, pays off in the end. So one of our values is sales driven, but still being profit smart.
advice_items.video_title: How I Turned $50,000 Into $20 Billion

guests.wealth_detail: $100M net worth (title); added ~$85M to net worth in 3-4 years; $5M+ private jet ($2M+/yr to operate)
guests.first_money_or_break: 只有高中学历、在20多岁双亲因癌去世且刚经历离婚、带着两个年幼孩子并背负信用卡债务的困境下，于2012年在自家厨房穿着睡衣用一台苹果电脑创办Blackstone Medical Services；他通过向亲友筹资，每天发邮件联系医保公司谈合作、上门拜访医生拉业务，随后租下500美元月租的小办公室起步，最终在2019年订单量超越行业巨头成为全美第一。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: With only a high school diploma, in his 20s after losing both parents to cancer and going through a divorce while raising two young kids with credit card debt, he founded Blackstone Medical Services in 2012 in pajamas from his kitchen using one Apple computer. Raising money from friends and family, emailing insurers daily for partnerships, and pitching doctors in person, he moved into a $500-a-month office and surpassed industry giants by 2019 to become number one in the U.S. by order volume.
guests.zero_start_advice: 从仅剩78美元的低谷翻身，第一步是真正下定决心并甘愿为成功牺牲一切（包括睡眠和时间）、绝不放弃；具体路径上要敢于冒大风险创业，打造能持续多年产生高额现金流和营收的实体生意，同时前30年专注学习、中间30年全力赚钱、最后30年回馈社会。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Climbing back from a $78 low starts with truly making up your mind, willing to sacrifice everything (including sleep and time) and never quitting. Practically, take big entrepreneurial risks to build a real business generating strong cash flow and revenue for years, spending your first 30 years learning, your middle 30 years earning, and your final 30 years giving back.

advice_items.summary_zh: 全力以赴并甘愿牺牲一切去达成目标
advice_items.summary_en: Commit completely to your goals and be willing to sacrifice and work as hard as needed.
advice_items.quote: There was nothing more important to me than being successful in accomplishing my goals... I was willing to sacrifice everything.
advice_items.video_title: I Had $78... Now I’m Worth $100 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 做真正热爱的事业才能熬过艰难时刻
advice_items.summary_en: Solve a problem you genuinely care about so passion keeps you going through inevitable hurdles.
advice_items.quote: I found a problem that I wanted to solve that I was passionate about. I don't believe that you can just make money without passion.
advice_items.video_title: I Had $78... Now I’m Worth $100 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 好产品必须配顶级服务才能胜出
advice_items.summary_en: A great product alone isn't enough; pair it with superior customer service to beat competitors.
advice_items.quote: Yes, I want to have a great product, but if I don't have great service, it's not going to win. You got to have both combinations.
advice_items.video_title: I Had $78... Now I’m Worth $100 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 保持专注并识别真正推动增长的关键
advice_items.summary_en: Stay focused and identify the high-leverage drivers that actually move the needle.
advice_items.quote: Just because I've stayed focused. You got to be able to figure out what moves the needle.
advice_items.video_title: I Had $78... Now I’m Worth $100 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 重金投资顶尖团队并学会放权扩张
advice_items.summary_en: Invest heavily in an A-player team—even paying key staff more than yourself early on—to scale beyond yourself.
advice_items.quote: Investing in the right team. You got to have a team. If you don't have a team, you got nothing. You can't do it all yourself.
advice_items.video_title: I Had $78... Now I’m Worth $100 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 坚定押注自己，至暗时刻也绝不放弃
advice_items.summary_en: Bet on yourself and refuse to quit through dark days regardless of self-doubt.
advice_items.quote: You got to bet on you. You got to believe in yourself. You got to never quit, no matter how dark it gets.
advice_items.video_title: I Had $78... Now I’m Worth $100 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 保持账目精准清晰，确保具备融资资质
advice_items.summary_en: Hire a great accountant and keep spotless books so your business stays bankable and sellable.
advice_items.quote: In order to be bankable, you need to have the right accounting. Your numbers have to be perfect cuz nobody's going to give you any money if they're not.
advice_items.video_title: I Had $78... Now I’m Worth $100 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 永远保持学徒心态，不断学习新事物
advice_items.summary_en: Maintain a lifelong student mindset; believing you know everything is when growth ends.
advice_items.quote: The most successful people always look at life as if they are a student. I'm always trying to learn something new.
advice_items.video_title: I Had $78... Now I’m Worth $100 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 每天稳定零失误交付，靠一致性胜出
advice_items.summary_en: Outlast and overtake bigger incumbents through relentless daily consistency and zero-error delivery.
advice_items.quote: In order to be successful in life you have to be consistent on everything. So we've had to deliver over and over and over again all the time.
advice_items.video_title: I Had $78... Now I’m Worth $100 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 谈判绝不先出价，销售靠真诚不靠套路
advice_items.summary_en: Never name the first number in negotiations, and sell authentically rather than relying on gimmicks.
advice_items.quote: If you're negotiating something, don't ever give them the first number. Make them make the offer.
advice_items.video_title: I Had $78... Now I’m Worth $100 Million

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.summary_zh: 专注创造自身价值，让客户主动选择你
advice_items.summary_en: Don't chase or beg clients—focus daily on delivering undeniable value so prospects come to you.
advice_items.quote: I want to show you how valuable I am... every day all I do is focus on value.
advice_items.video_title: I Had $78... Now I’m Worth $100 Million

advice_items.canonical_tag: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep
advice_items.summary_zh: 时刻牢记事物真实成本，避免过度消费
advice_items.summary_en: No matter how wealthy you become, never lose sight of fair market value or overpay out of convenience.
advice_items.quote: You can never forget about what things cost in business cuz then you'll overspend.
advice_items.video_title: I Had $78... Now I’m Worth $100 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 专业知识与人脉并重，主动靠近对的人
advice_items.summary_en: Pair domain knowledge with high-value relationships and actively invest in getting in the room with the right people.
advice_items.quote: You got to know the information, but then you got to know the right person to talk to... Invest in getting in front of the right people.
advice_items.video_title: I Had $78... Now I’m Worth $100 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 舍得投资自己以换取顶级导师的人脉
advice_items.summary_en: Invest in yourself and create access to much bigger mentors whose knowledge cannot be taken from you.
advice_items.quote: Buying a plane allowed me to get in front of bigger mentors that I wouldn't have been able to.
advice_items.video_title: I Had $78... Now I’m Worth $100 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 敢于冒大风险创业，持续多年复利现金流
advice_items.summary_en: Take big risks, launch a business, and consistently compound cash flow and revenue year over year.
advice_items.quote: Take a lot of risk, start a business, build it up, create an immense amount of cash flow and revenue.
advice_items.video_title: I Had $78... Now I’m Worth $100 Million

guests.role_or_title: Insurance Agency Owner & Top Underwriter (sfg austin.com)
guests.first_money_or_break: 早年在MCI销售长途电话业务起步并成为最年轻的主管之一，后来做过名人专职司机；疫情期间重新投身保险行业，成为顶级核保人并建立自己的保险代理团队。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: He started out selling long-distance phone service at MCI, becoming one of its youngest supervisors, and later worked as a private chauffeur for celebrities. During the pandemic, he returned to the insurance industry, became a top underwriter, and built his own insurance agency team.
guests.zero_start_advice: 要有近乎盲目的自信与野心，先行动再去研究数字并不断推进；不必非要从热爱的工作起步，可以先做能赚钱的行业积累资金来支撑梦想；年轻时多去尝试、旅行和攒钱，只要不放弃就不会输。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Carry almost blind confidence and ambition, take action first, figure out the numbers along the way, and keep pushing forward. You do not have to start with your passion; work in a lucrative field to build the capital that funds your dreams, and spend your youth experimenting, traveling, and saving, because you cannot lose if you never quit.
recommended_books_or_mentors: Go for No by Richard Fenton and Andrea Waltz

advice_items.summary_zh: 近朱者赤，多与成功人士为伍
advice_items.summary_en: Surround yourself with successful people who live the lifestyle you aspire to achieve.
advice_items.quote: if you hang around nine broke friends you're going to be the tenth one right so if I hang around nine guys that drives Ferraris I have a lot better chance
advice_items.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Insurance CEO Lavon Perrin

advice_items.canonical_tag: Work Under a Winner First Before Starting
advice_items.summary_zh: 先替他人打工积累商业经验，再创业
advice_items.summary_en: Work for other companies first to learn business operations and build skills before going out on your own.
advice_items.quote: working for other companies definitely helped me learn how businesses work and be able to take some of those skills and just use them to my advantage
advice_items.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Insurance CEO Lavon Perrin

advice_items.canonical_tag: Don't Neglect Health & Family for Money
advice_items.summary_zh: 不为赚钱牺牲家庭与陪伴孩子的时间
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid career paths or work habits that cost you your marriage and time with your children.
advice_items.quote: I was in the car business right and everybody knows what happens in a car business right four or five divorces... I didn't want that but I wanted to be able to see my kids
advice_items.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Insurance CEO Lavon Perrin

advice_items.summary_zh: 保持近乎盲目的野心与信念，相信自己无所不能
advice_items.summary_en: Cultivate unwavering self-belief and bold ambition that you can achieve anything you set your mind to.
advice_items.quote: the belief I've always had in my mind that I can be and do anything I want to do that belief and sometimes blind ambition that you just go for some things and kind of figure it out later
advice_items.video_title: These Millionaires Gave Us Life Changing Advice...

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.summary_zh: 为客户量身定制方案，你的成就取决于助人多少
advice_items.summary_en: Tailor solutions to your customer's specific needs and budget; your level of success is determined by the impact you make on others.
advice_items.quote: take the time to find what works for the customer also what works for their budget instead of just giving them one solution to their problem... the impact you make on others is going to determine how successful you are
advice_items.video_title: These Millionaires Gave Us Life Changing Advice...

advice_items.summary_zh: 别怕迈出第一步，边行动边算账看清数据规律
advice_items.summary_en: Don't be afraid to approach new opportunities—look at the numbers, go for it, and figure things out along the way.
advice_items.quote: just really start looking at the numbers go for it and see what you find so some of that has helped me not be scared not to be afraid to approach things
advice_items.video_title: These Millionaires Gave Us Life Changing Advice...

advice_items.summary_zh: 坚持大量阅读，持续投入自我成长
advice_items.summary_en: Commit to personal development and read books consistently to sharpen your thinking and sales edge.
advice_items.quote: I believe that the personal development side has been huge I think last year I read probably 15 books
advice_items.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Insurance CEO Lavon Perrin

advice_items.canonical_tag: Don't Wait Too Long to Start / Invest
advice_items.summary_zh: 后悔年轻时未早点开始自我提升与阅读
advice_items.summary_en: Do not delay personal development; start reading and investing in self-growth as early as possible.
advice_items.quote: personal growth and development is probably the biggest things that I would do differently I would start doing personal development at a younger age
advice_items.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Insurance CEO Lavon Perrin

advice_items.summary_zh: 保持行动一致性，坦然面对商业起伏
advice_items.summary_en: Stay consistent as a business owner and accept that ups and downs are inevitable in any industry.
advice_items.quote: understanding what it takes to be consistent... knowing that you're gonna have ups and downs I don't care what business you're in that's what you're going to have
advice_items.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Insurance CEO Lavon Perrin

advice_items.summary_zh: 不惧犯错，从每次失误和挫折中学习
advice_items.summary_en: Accept that mistakes are part of business and treat every setback as a learning experience rather than a loss.
advice_items.quote: if you learn from your mistakes I believe that's one of the biggest things you can do learn that you're going to make some mistakes
advice_items.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Insurance CEO Lavon Perrin

advice_items.summary_zh: 避免过度分析导致瘫痪，果断付诸行动
advice_items.summary_en: Do not let fear and overthinking trap you in paralysis by analysis; take action.
advice_items.quote: not be scared and over analyze... a lot of times people over analyze situations and then they don't move right it's paralysis by analysis
advice_items.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Insurance CEO Lavon Perrin

advice_items.summary_zh: 善用时间杠杆，组建团队协作走得更远
advice_items.summary_en: Multiply your time by putting capable people around you so you can accomplish more and go further.
advice_items.quote: he's smarter with his time he puts people around him that's able to help him do more in a shorter period of time they say if you want to go somewhere fast go alone
advice_items.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Insurance CEO Lavon Perrin

advice_items.summary_zh: 根据人生阶段配置定期与终身寿险实现财富规划
advice_items.summary_en: Understand both term and whole life insurance: term offers affordable coverage for young families, while whole life builds invested value over the long run.
advice_items.quote: the truth of the matter is you actually probably should lean toward both... for younger people depends on their situation term is really fits them at the time as you get older... whole life may be a little bit better... on the long run whole life is cheaper even though you pay more money per month
advice_items.video_title: These Millionaires Gave Us Life Changing Advice...

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.summary_zh: 选能按价值获酬的事业，独立创业但有团队支撑
advice_items.summary_en: Pursue work where you are paid for what you are worth and are in business for yourself with team support.
advice_items.quote: finding something that you're passionate about something where you can get paid for what you're worth in my case I was being in business for myself but not by myself
advice_items.video_title: These Millionaires Gave Us Life Changing Advice...

advice_items.summary_zh: 只要不轻言放弃，你就永远不会输
advice_items.summary_en: Stay persistent through setbacks because you only lose when you quit.
advice_items.quote: if you don't quit you don't lose
advice_items.video_title: These Millionaires Gave Us Life Changing Advice...

guests.industry_zh: 营销代理与高客单销售
guests.wealth_detail: $160M revenue last year; $250M goal this year
guests.first_money_or_break: 出身贫寒、在校成绩拿D，19岁进入零门槛的销售行业，第一年赚12.5万美元，第二年22.5万，20岁第三年赚到50万美元，后创办大型销售培训公司（年营收1.6亿美元）。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Growing up poor and earning D grades in school, he entered the zero-barrier sales industry at 19, making $125,000 in year one, $225,000 in year two, and $500,000 in year three at age 20. He later founded a major sales training company generating $160 million in annual revenue.
guests.zero_start_advice: 从零门槛的销售行业切入并掌握销售与领导力；把谷底的痛苦转化为反弹动力；全身心专注于客户并比客户更关心他们的利益；坚信自己、拒绝平庸。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Break into sales, where there is no barrier to entry, and master both selling and leadership while turning rock-bottom pain into fuel to bounce back. Focus completely on your clients, care about their interests even more than they do, believe deeply in yourself, and refuse mediocrity.

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.summary_zh: 选择零门槛且回报无上限的销售赛道
advice_items.summary_en: Choose a vehicle like sales with zero barrier to entry and immediate six-to-seven-figure earning upside.
advice_items.quote: lowest barrier of entry... what does it cost to get in sales zero... you can get in sales and you can make 500 grand a year

advice_items.summary_zh: 把谷底痛苦化作反弹动力与成长见证
advice_items.summary_en: Use rock-bottom pain and adversity as fuel to bounce back higher and build your testimony.
advice_items.quote: broken people are the most dangerous... when the pain overrides the fear of change people change... without a test there's no testimony

advice_items.summary_zh: 比客户更关心其利益，全神贯注服务
advice_items.summary_en: Give clients your undivided presence and care more about their outcomes than anyone else ever has.
advice_items.quote: I care more about my clients than they care about themselves... be where your feet are... take care of your clients better than they've ever been taken care of
advice_items.video_title: Asking Scottsdale Millionaires How They Got Rich

advice_items.summary_zh: 永远像第一天般饥渴热爱，永不倦怠
advice_items.summary_en: Keep day-one hunger and excitement for your craft so you never burn out and always out-hustle competitors.
advice_items.quote: if you treat something like it's the beginning there'll never be an end... I never get exhausted it never gets burned out... whoever's the hungriest wins

advice_items.summary_zh: 培养极度自信，收入永远不会超过你的自我价值
advice_items.summary_en: Cultivate unshakeable, even delusional self-belief because your income will never exceed your self-worth.
advice_items.quote: confidence is a big deal and you'll never out earn your own self-worth... I have a delusional belief in me
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Scottsdale)

advice_items.summary_zh: 勇敢追求本该活出的人生，拒绝平庸
advice_items.summary_en: Have the courage to chase your full potential and unlived life rather than settling for average.
advice_items.quote: have you ever thought about the unlived life... either get there or die trying but damn sure don't be average never conform
advice_items.video_title: Asking Scottsdale Millionaires How They Got Rich

advice_items.summary_zh: 利用团队杠杆带人销售，从众人业绩中获益
advice_items.summary_en: Transition from solo selling to leading a large team so you earn leverage from many people's output.
advice_items.quote: if I could lead a bunch of people I could get a little cut on a bunch of people
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Scottsdale)

advice_items.summary_zh: 减少成长路上的分心诱惑，专注于核心目标
advice_items.summary_en: Eliminate distractions early so you don't waste years before waking up to your full potential.
advice_items.quote: I had a lot of distractions along the way
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Scottsdale)

advice_items.summary_zh: 保持高强度自我成长，在他人松懈时持续超越
advice_items.summary_en: Never stop self-developing after reaching an initial goal; keep growing while others get comfortable.
advice_items.quote: I out self-develop them they've slowed down and that's why I keep growing
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Scottsdale)

advice_items.canonical_tag: Don't Surround Yourself With Toxic / Negative People
advice_items.summary_zh: 果断远离嫉妒并打压你梦想的负能量人群
advice_items.summary_en: Distance yourself from anyone—even blood relatives—who envies your growth or hates on your big goals.
advice_items.quote: sometimes your blood family isn't the one that supports you when you go bigger... they Envy you or they get jealous and then they hate on you and once you do that I'm out
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Scottsdale)

advice_items.canonical_tag: Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)
advice_items.summary_zh: 坚持全款消费不借贷，消除利息支出与负债
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid financing cars, buildings, or lifestyle items; pay cash so you owe nothing and avoid interest drain.
advice_items.quote: I pay cash for everything I have nothing financed in my life... I only buy what I can get when I can pay cash for it
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Scottsdale)

advice_items.summary_zh: 坚持健身与形象管理，保持最佳精神状态
advice_items.summary_en: Stay disciplined with physical fitness because looking and feeling your best fuels closing confidence.
advice_items.quote: I talk about Fitness because you can see what you look like... if you don't think you look the best and you're feel good about yourself you're not going to close that deal
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Scottsdale)

advice_items.summary_zh: 带着善意与真诚待人，市场才会给你丰厚回报
advice_items.summary_en: Pair strong sales and leadership skills with genuine good intentions and care for people.
advice_items.quote: if you got good intentions and you like people
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Scottsdale)

guests.role_or_title: Founder, Commercial Real Estate Company (~$1B AUM)
guests.wealth_detail: Eight-figure commercial real estate portfolio; closed a $25M shopping center deal; first $575K property refinanced at $800K generating $5,000/mo free cash flow
guests.first_money_or_break: 早年为富人洗车洗船接触财富圈层，90年代做股票经纪人靠佣金攒下六位数积蓄；25岁时掏空账户只剩50美元，以57.5万美元买下首套商业地产，翻新招租后7个月内按80万美元估值再融资套回全部本金，从此获得每月5000美元的永久自由现金流。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: He entered wealthy circles early by washing cars and boats for the rich, then saved a six-figure nest egg from commissions as a stockbroker in the 1990s. At 25, he emptied his account down to $50 to buy his first commercial property for $575,000, renovated and leased it, refinanced at an $800,000 valuation within seven months to pull out all his principal, and secured $5,000 a month in permanent free cash flow.
guests.zero_start_advice: 不要迷信“读书找好工作存钱还房贷退休”的传统脚本；首先相信自己与富人并无不同，主动找机会待在最富有的人身边（如去乡村俱乐部做代客泊车），找到同样白手起家的榜样并模仿他们，加倍努力思考如何为他人创造价值。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Do not buy into the traditional script of getting good grades, finding a safe job, saving, paying off a mortgage, and retiring. First believe you are no different from wealthy people, put yourself around the richest people (such as valeting at a country club), find self-made role models to emulate, and work twice as hard thinking about how to create value for others.
recommended_books_or_mentors: Keeping It Real on Commercial Real Estate by Todd Napola
