advice_items.summary_zh: 主动寻找同领域顶尖导师并虚心请教
advice_items.summary_en: Proactively seek out a mentor who already does what you want to do and ask successful people for help.
advice_items.quote: find a mentor and I would repeat that 10 times... the more successful people are the more they really want to see other people win... just ask them for help
advice_items.video_title: He Turned $100k Into $25M

advice_items.summary_zh: 别攀比他人财富或为虚荣超前消费
advice_items.summary_en: Stop counting other people's money or overspending to keep up with fake appearances on social media.
advice_items.quote: don't count other people's money... people get so caught up in what other people have and keeping up with the Joneses and they're buying things and spending money on things they really can't afford
advice_items.video_title: He Turned $100k Into $25M

advice_items.summary_zh: 敢于在年轻时承担可控的大风险
advice_items.summary_en: Assess your worst-case downside and be willing to take big calculated swings early in your career.
advice_items.quote: it was a huge risk but pays off you got to be willing to take those shots
advice_items.video_title: He Turned $100k Into $25M

advice_items.summary_zh: 大量阅读专业书籍，汲取前人数十年经验
advice_items.summary_en: Read voraciously—especially books written by experienced practitioners in your industry—to absorb decades of experience quickly.
advice_items.quote: last year I read 60 books... anyone who writes a book probably has 25 30 years of experience and they're going to give it to you in 200 pages... read books by real estate guys
advice_items.video_title: He Turned $100k Into $25M

advice_items.summary_zh: 成功后懂得感恩回馈，把收益与经验分享给他人
advice_items.summary_en: Once you achieve success, give back by sharing your knowledge and donating proceeds to help others.
advice_items.quote: I've done so much the greatest thing I could do now is helping give back so I wrote a book and I give all the proceeds to charity
advice_items.video_title: He Turned $100k Into $25M

advice_items.summary_zh: 尽早投资房地产以构建长期现金流
advice_items.summary_en: Invest in real estate and pay down property over time to secure long-term wealth and retirement stability.
advice_items.quote: the richest people on the planet... they all invest in real estate... you buy one piece of real estate and you do everything else wrong but pay that one property off over 25 years 20 years you own it you're set
advice_items.video_title: He Turned $100k Into $25M

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.summary_zh: 不要只靠时间或佣金赚钱，要拥有资产
advice_items.summary_en: Do not rely solely on active labor or commissions; build ownership in cash-flowing assets that pay you even when you stop working.
advice_items.quote: if you want to be the greatest architect or the greatest dentist you could be you're not going to have continued cash flow in your retirement years you're not going to have something you could give your kids
advice_items.video_title: He Turned $100k Into $25M

advice_items.canonical_tag: Don't Wait Too Long to Start / Invest
advice_items.summary_zh: 买房投资要趁早，人们只会后悔起步太晚
advice_items.summary_en: Start buying assets as early as possible; almost nobody regrets starting, only waiting too long.
advice_items.quote: I very rarely ever hear of a person saying I don't want to own a second they say I should have done it sooner so start early
advice_items.video_title: He Turned $100k Into $25M

advice_items.summary_zh: 坚信自己能成功，并找到有意义的致富动力
advice_items.summary_en: Believe you can achieve wealth and anchor yourself to a deep, meaningful 'why' such as family security rather than vanity.
advice_items.quote: I believe anyone could be a multi-millionaire you just got to believe you want to be a millionaire and you got to know why you want to be a millionaire
advice_items.video_title: He Turned $100k Into $25M

advice_items.summary_zh: 主动混入富人圈层，近距离观察并建立人脉
advice_items.summary_en: Put yourself in environments where the wealthiest people spend time—even via an entry-level job like country club valet—to learn how they operate.
advice_items.quote: find very wealthy people so find the wealthiest people you could be around... get a job as a valet Parker at a country Club where he's parking fancy cars
advice_items.video_title: Asking Luxury Shoppers How They Got RICH! (Miami)

advice_items.summary_zh: 建立过硬的个人声誉与信誉是最宝贵的资产
advice_items.summary_en: Protect your reputation and what you stand for, as trust is the foundation that lets you recover from any setback.
advice_items.quote: my reputation of what I am and what I stand for I know I could build it all back up in no time
advice_items.video_title: He Turned $100k Into $25M

advice_items.summary_zh: 聚焦热爱的核心主业，拒绝不熟悉的诱惑
advice_items.summary_en: Stay strictly focused on the core business you love and know well instead of chasing unrelated side ventures.
advice_items.quote: why don't you open a restaurant why don't you take a vacancy and open this one that's not what I do I don't have passion for that I invest in real estate
advice_items.video_title: He Turned $100k Into $25M

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.summary_zh: 努力思考自己能如何为他人创造并增加价值
advice_items.summary_en: Focus intensely on finding ways to add real value to other people as the foundation of financial freedom.
advice_items.quote: I would be working very hard to see how I could add value to other people
advice_items.video_title: Asking Luxury Shoppers How They Got RICH! (Miami)

advice_items.summary_zh: 经商就是终身销售，哪怕顶级富豪也每天都在推销自己
advice_items.summary_en: Even the richest founders never stop selling themselves; if you stop selling, you are out of business.
advice_items.quote: you're always selling and anybody who thinks you're going to be in Business Without selling is sadly mistaken you will sell forever
advice_items.video_title: Meet The Kid Who Interviews Billionaires For a Living

guests.wealth_detail: $120M peak single-year earnings; owns ~20 businesses
guests.first_money_or_break: 出身希腊雅典贫困移民家庭，16-17岁前曾在街头售卖CD、手表和DVD贴补家用；在球队月薪仅300美元时，14岁获5000欧元签约邀约（因坚持让哥哥同获签约而拒绝阿迪达斯、转投耐克），2013年被NBA密尔沃基雄鹿队选中。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Raised in a poor immigrant family in Athens, Greece, he sold CDs, watches, and DVDs on the street until ages 16-17 to help support his family. While earning just $300 a month with his club, he received a 5,000-euro contract offer at 14 (turning down Adidas for Nike after insisting his brother be signed too) and was drafted by the NBA's Milwaukee Bucks in 2013.
guests.zero_start_advice: 创业和起步并不需要很多启动资金，关键在于头脑精明灵活；尽早自主学习理财知识（如阅读《富爸爸穷爸爸》《金钱心理学》），保持积极的自我暗示与极强自律，虚心寻找导师向任何人学习，并把赚到的钱投入市场复利增值。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Starting out does not require much seed money if you stay sharp and resourceful. Teach yourself financial literacy early (by reading books like "Rich Dad Poor Dad" and "The Psychology of Money"), stay intensely disciplined with positive self-talk, stay humble enough to find mentors and learn from anyone, and invest your earnings in the market to compound.

advice_items.summary_zh: 坚守原则与承诺不为金钱妥协
advice_items.summary_en: Refuse to compromise your principles or accept broken promises, even when life-changing money is on the table.
advice_items.quote: That's not what you guys told me... No, brother, I can't sign.
advice_items.video_title: Inside Giannis Antetokounmpo’s $120M NBA Empire

advice_items.canonical_tag: Be Careful Who You Partner With
advice_items.summary_zh: 别让律师顾问和经纪人私下串通
advice_items.summary_en: Keep your lawyer, financial advisor, and agent separate so they hold each other accountable instead of colluding.
advice_items.quote: Don't ever let your lawyer, financial advisor, agent know one another. Ever... they can keep one another accountable if they don't know each other.
advice_items.video_title: Inside Giannis Antetokounmpo’s $120M NBA Empire

advice_items.summary_zh: 阅读理财书籍系统学习财务知识
advice_items.summary_en: Educate yourself by reading personal finance books so you understand how to save and invest rather than blindly trusting advisors.
advice_items.quote: Read Rich Dad Poor Dad, The Psychology of Money. Read books to learn about financial literacy. Learn how to save your money, how to invest your money.
advice_items.video_title: Inside Giannis Antetokounmpo’s $120M NBA Empire

advice_items.summary_zh: 区分价格与价值并计算机会成本
advice_items.summary_en: Evaluate purchases by value and opportunity cost—spending $1M on a depreciating asset also forfeits the investment return it could generate.
advice_items.quote: Price is what you pay, value is what you get... When I give 1 million to a Ferrari... I'm not giving 1 million, I'm giving 1.1 million because I'm losing the interest I'm making from that money.
advice_items.video_title: Inside Giannis Antetokounmpo’s $120M NBA Empire

advice_items.summary_zh: 保持自信并在顺逆境中坚守信仰
advice_items.summary_en: Maintain self-belief and stay grounded in faith throughout your journey from the bottom to the top.
advice_items.quote: Believing in myself, and believing in God... I trusted him from the beginning, and trusting him until the end.
advice_items.video_title: Inside Giannis Antetokounmpo’s $120M NBA Empire

advice_items.summary_zh: 聘用更聪明的高管团队专业打理
advice_items.summary_en: Build a team and family office staffed with people smarter than you to professionally manage your business ventures.
advice_items.quote: I've had this family office with a lot of people smarter than me that help me manage everything... I put CEO, CFO, manage everything.
advice_items.video_title: Inside Giannis Antetokounmpo’s $120M NBA Empire

advice_items.summary_zh: 将个人品牌与影响力当公司经营
advice_items.summary_en: Recognize the value of your platform and treat your personal brand like a company.
advice_items.quote: I know I have an incredible platform, and I know as myself, I have a brand, and I view myself as a company.
advice_items.video_title: Inside Giannis Antetokounmpo’s $120M NBA Empire

advice_items.summary_zh: 警惕豪车名表等虚假排场消费陷阱
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid chasing status symbols like chains and luxury cars to project a false lifestyle that leads to going broke after peak earning years.
advice_items.quote: Young athletes, they focus on the chains, they focus on the cars, they focus on so much on this false reality, false lifestyle, man.
advice_items.video_title: Inside Giannis Antetokounmpo’s $120M NBA Empire

advice_items.summary_zh: 积极寻找导师并虚心向所有人学习
advice_items.summary_en: Seek out mentors and remain humble enough to learn something from everyone you meet.
advice_items.quote: I find mentors, man, and people that help me... It doesn't matter if you're a billionaire. You can always learn from everybody. Anything you want to learn.
advice_items.video_title: Inside Giannis Antetokounmpo’s $120M NBA Empire

advice_items.summary_zh: 绝不违背对自己的承诺并保持自律
advice_items.summary_en: Never negotiate with yourself or break promises you make to yourself; build consistent daily habits.
advice_items.quote: They don't break promises. If they say, 'I'm going to wake up tomorrow and I'm going to go and run 5 miles,' they will do it. And they have incredible habits.
advice_items.video_title: Inside Giannis Antetokounmpo’s $120M NBA Empire

advice_items.summary_zh: 坚持市场投资享受长期复利翻倍
advice_items.summary_en: Invest consistently in the market so long-term compounding doubles your capital roughly every seven years.
advice_items.quote: If I just keep on investing my money, your money doubles every 7 years... if you invest it in the market.
advice_items.video_title: Inside Giannis Antetokounmpo’s $120M NBA Empire

advice_items.canonical_tag: Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)
advice_items.summary_zh: 善用良性负债追求更高投资回报
advice_items.summary_en: Treat productive debt as an ally when your return on investment far exceeds the borrowing cost, letting capital compound faster than labor.
advice_items.quote: That's my friend. I can make more money. The return of investment it will be way far greater than that... money makes more money for you than human people can.
advice_items.video_title: Inside Giannis Antetokounmpo’s $120M NBA Empire

advice_items.summary_zh: 无视外界廉价质疑坚定自我信念
advice_items.summary_en: Ignore critics and doubters because other people's opinions are cheap and never pay your bills.
advice_items.quote: Opinion is cheap, that's why everybody has one... Nobody's thoughts paid anybody's bills, man.
advice_items.video_title: Inside Giannis Antetokounmpo’s $120M NBA Empire

advice_items.summary_zh: 拼搏精神与坚持不懈是成功公式
advice_items.summary_en: Combine relentless work ethic with persistence as a reliable formula for achieving long-term success.
advice_items.quote: If you have work ethic and you're persistent, you are going to be successful. That's a formula for success.
advice_items.video_title: Inside Giannis Antetokounmpo’s $120M NBA Empire

guests.role_or_title: Investor, Board Member & Former CEO/COO of HMS Holdings
guests.first_money_or_break: 计算机科学专业毕业后从一线程序员做起，在首份工作中深入现场为B1轰炸机、迪士尼等项目编写设备通信程序，借此积累了协议理解与客户沟通经验；随后晋升为安达信合伙人并负责医疗科技板块，后掌舵IBM全球医疗咨询业务，最终出任医疗公司HMS Holdings首席运营官（该公司以35亿美元出售），如今转型为早期风投人及公司董事。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: After graduating in computer science, he started as a frontline programmer writing device-communication software on site for projects like the B1 bomber and Disney, gaining protocol expertise and client-facing skills. He rose to partner at Andersen running healthcare technology, later led IBM's global healthcare consulting practice, served as COO of healthcare company HMS Holdings (sold for $3.5 billion), and now works as an early-stage VC and board director.
guests.zero_start_advice: 不要总想着自己如何出人头地，而要多问“我能帮别人做些什么”；专心学好并享受当下岗位的工作，真心关心并主动托举身边的同事与合作伙伴，当你不断成就他人时，贵人与机会自然会回到你身上。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Stop obsessing over how to get ahead and ask instead, "What can I do to help others?" Focus on mastering and enjoying your current role while genuinely caring for and lifting up colleagues and partners, because when you consistently help others succeed, champions and opportunities naturally come back to you.

advice_items.summary_zh: 保持专注，聚焦高影响力的关键目标
advice_items.summary_en: Stay focused on the right targets and execute what truly drives impact rather than reacting to every distraction.
advice_items.quote: Make sure that they're focused and they're on the right target, they do things that are really impactful for the company.
advice_items.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Investor & Executive Doug Williams

advice_items.summary_zh: 长期积累商业信誉，用个人信任背书
advice_items.summary_en: Build long-term credibility and trust over years so clients trust the businesses and teams you vouch for.
advice_items.quote: If the company that we're selling to trusts me, then they will trust the company that I'm trying to bring to them.
advice_items.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Investor & Executive Doug Williams

advice_items.summary_zh: 用提问挖掘真实需求，而非硬性推销
advice_items.summary_en: Use solution selling by asking questions to uncover a buyer's true need instead of pitching everything you have.
advice_items.quote: No one likes to be sold to, but everybody likes to buy... I sell by asking questions, understanding first what the real true need is.
advice_items.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Investor & Executive Doug Williams

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.summary_zh: 提前做好客户背调，共同解决核心痛点
advice_items.summary_en: Do thorough homework on clients beforehand, focus on their specific pain points, and collaboratively solve their problem.
advice_items.quote: Slow down, do a lot of homework on your client before you ever show up... understand their pain points and mutually solve a problem.
advice_items.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Investor & Executive Doug Williams

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.summary_zh: 明确价值主张、目标受众与潜在市场规模
advice_items.summary_en: Get the fundamentals right before scaling: define your value proposition, total addressable market, target buyer, and key message.
advice_items.quote: You have to figure out the value proposition, you have to figure out the total addressable market, you have to figure out who you're selling to.
advice_items.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Investor & Executive Doug Williams

advice_items.summary_zh: 提前设计组织架构与扩展剧本再扩张
advice_items.summary_en: Design your organizational structure, metrics, alignment, and channels in advance for future scale so growth isn't chaotic.
advice_items.quote: In my organizational structure, my metrics, my alignment, my relationships, my channels, all those are designed so I kind of know the playbook in advance.
advice_items.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Investor & Executive Doug Williams

advice_items.summary_zh: 结交良师益友，并真心帮助同事成长
advice_items.summary_en: Surround yourself with great mentors and colleagues, and genuinely invest in helping the people you work with advance.
advice_items.quote: If you have great mentors and you have great people and you really care about the people that you work with, helping them get better.
advice_items.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Investor & Executive Doug Williams

advice_items.summary_zh: 专注打磨当下技能，享受工作中的积累
advice_items.summary_en: Master the skills in your current role and enjoy the journey, as everything you learn now compounds in the future.
advice_items.quote: Learn what you're doing where you are today, enjoy what you're doing today, and it will definitely come back and help you in the future.
advice_items.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Investor & Executive Doug Williams

advice_items.canonical_tag: Don't Neglect Health & Family for Money
advice_items.summary_zh: 别为赚钱忽视家庭，退休只剩钱并无乐趣
advice_items.summary_en: Be fully present with family when you are home; professionals who only chase work end up rich at 65 without real relationships.
advice_items.quote: They haven't built family relationships and all they have is money. Money by itself is not very fun.
advice_items.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Investor & Executive Doug Williams

advice_items.summary_zh: 坚持早起锻炼与兴趣爱好，为精神减压
advice_items.summary_en: Maintain daily physical discipline and outside hobbies to clear your mind, sharpen your axe, and avoid living in a pressure cooker.
advice_items.quote: I get up at 4:30 in the morning, I'm in the gym by five, I work out generally seven days a week... those other things that you do sharpen the axe.
advice_items.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Investor & Executive Doug Williams

advice_items.canonical_tag: Don't Wait Too Long to Start / Invest
advice_items.summary_zh: 遗憾早期对看好的资产下注不够重
advice_items.summary_en: His biggest financial regret was not investing enough into high-conviction bets like Bitcoin and Tesla when he bought them.
advice_items.quote: The worst decision I made was not buying enough Bitcoin or Tesla—invested in both, but not enough.
advice_items.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Investor & Executive Doug Williams

advice_items.canonical_tag: Be Careful Who You Partner With
advice_items.summary_zh: 投资或合作前要线下深入了解对方人品
advice_items.summary_en: Look beyond pitch decks and get to know founders personally—their character, family, and alignment—before investing.
advice_items.quote: Get to know people before you invest with them and not just through a demo or PowerPoint... you want to know the character of the people.
advice_items.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Investor & Executive Doug Williams

advice_items.summary_zh: 只承担多数核心变量可控的理性风险
advice_items.summary_en: Evaluate whether risky variables can be controlled or mitigated; take calculated shots when you control most variables and know your risk tolerance.
advice_items.quote: If there's three variables that are risky and you think you can control two of them, then generally you have a pretty good shot.
advice_items.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Investor & Executive Doug Williams

advice_items.summary_zh: 多问能帮人什么，主动托举他人终会回流
advice_items.summary_en: Ask how you can help others rather than just how to get ahead; lifting people up builds goodwill that lifts you up in return.
advice_items.quote: Ask what you can do to help versus ask what you can do to get ahead... the more people see you lifting others up, the more people are going to lift you up.
advice_items.video_title: 10 Questions with a Millionaire: Investor & Executive Doug Williams

guests.role_or_title: Construction Company Owner & Real Estate Investor
guests.wealth_detail: $5M/yr peak take-home; $35M/yr business revenue; 400+ real estate doors (became a millionaire at 31-32)
guests.first_money_or_break: 24岁身无分文时在路易斯安那州接钢结构搭建合同，凭合同向银行申请到首笔1.5万美元信用额度（周薪资约2500美元、雇两人做后院建筑），以此起步。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Broke at age 24 in Louisiana, he landed a steel-building erection contract and used it to secure his first $15,000 bank line of credit. With a weekly payroll of roughly $2,500 and two employees building backyard structures, he launched his business from there.
guests.zero_start_advice: 一旦认准方向就立刻开干并死磕单一核心业务不半途而废；极度相信自己的产品并用底气和履约能力去销售；趁20多岁保持清醒自律（不碰烟酒）并练出强健体魄赢得尊重；远离不理解你的杂音，主动加入同频奋斗者的圈子。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Once you pick a direction, start immediately and commit relentlessly to one core business without quitting halfway, selling with conviction backed by belief in your product and delivery. Spend your 20s staying sober and disciplined (no smoking or drinking), build physical strength to command respect, ignore naysayers, and join a circle of driven peers.

advice_items.summary_zh: 深耕单一行业直到实现财务自由，切忌分散精力
advice_items.summary_en: Stay focused on one industry long enough to build substantial wealth and freedom instead of spreading your energy thin.
advice_items.quote: I stayed in the same thing long enough to make substantial money to create freedom. If you pour it over too many plants, you'll never bear fruit on any of them.
advice_items.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews Millionaire Justin Waller

advice_items.summary_zh: 拒绝被原生环境定义，下定决心跳出既定圈层
advice_items.summary_en: Refuse to become a product of a limiting environment and decide to pursue something greater.
advice_items.quote: You either become the situation that you're in, the atmosphere, or you decide that you want to do anything but be in that atmosphere.
advice_items.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews Millionaire Justin Waller

advice_items.summary_zh: 没钱起步就先拿下客户合同，再去银行争取授信
advice_items.summary_en: When starting with no capital, go win customer contracts first and use them to secure a bank line of credit.
advice_items.quote: We didn't have any money, so what I had to do is go out and get contracts and then go to the bank and show them I had contracts and try to get lines of credit.
advice_items.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews Millionaire Justin Waller

advice_items.summary_zh: 学会房产交易承销，灵活组合他人资金与银行长贷
advice_items.summary_en: Learn to underwrite real estate deals and structure the capital stack using investor equity and long-term bank financing.
advice_items.quote: Understand the capital stack, whether you're raising somebody else's money to get the down payment and then you're going to take it to the long-term debt with the bank.
advice_items.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews Millionaire Justin Waller

advice_items.summary_zh: 算清净收益、资本化率与偿债等房产核心财务账
advice_items.summary_en: Master core real estate math—NOI, cap rate, and debt service—which only requires basic arithmetic.
advice_items.quote: You just have to be able to understand the math of real estate: what's a net operating income, what's the cap rate, what's my debt service going to be.
advice_items.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews Millionaire Justin Waller

advice_items.canonical_tag: Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)
advice_items.summary_zh: 紧盯利率与债务周期，提前规划以降低融资风险
advice_items.summary_en: Track interest rate movements and short- and long-term debt cycles so you can structure financing early and reduce rate risk.
advice_items.quote: Understand the debt service and understand where you are in the overall cycle, like the long-term, short-term debt cycle, and pay attention to where rates will go.
advice_items.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews Millionaire Justin Waller

advice_items.summary_zh: 依托系统与高意愿能人扩张，并让员工参与共建
advice_items.summary_en: Scale from seven to eight figures by pairing systems with capable, motivated people who co-create and own the process.
advice_items.quote: It's systems and then it's competent people with intent. If they can help you build systems and be a part of building something, then they can have ownership in it.
advice_items.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews Millionaire Justin Waller

advice_items.summary_zh: 拥抱挫折与失败，把每次磨难当作搭建城堡的砖石
advice_items.summary_en: Be grateful for failures and obstacles—they forge your story and serve as the bricks that build your success.
advice_items.quote: If you can learn to embrace the things that are getting in your way, embrace the failures that are coming, those are just small bricks that are going to build your castle in life.
advice_items.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews Millionaire Justin Waller

advice_items.summary_zh: 哪怕屡遭重击也要每天起身，保持一颗坚韧之心
advice_items.summary_en: Show up daily with a relentless heart no matter how many times you get knocked down.
advice_items.quote: Get up every day, every time you get hit in the face, have a relentless heart, and there's nothing this world can't stop you from doing.
advice_items.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews Millionaire Justin Waller

advice_items.summary_zh: 极度相信自己的产品，用绝对信念去成交
advice_items.summary_en: Sell with unshakable conviction in your product and delivery schedule so clients trust you even at a higher price.
advice_items.quote: you need to be able to sell with conviction... believe in your product so much that you truly believe that if you do not sell to that person you are [ __ ] them over
advice_items.video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 练好身材展现自律，走到哪里都能赢得尊重
advice_items.summary_en: Get in top physical shape because visible discipline earns instant respect and credibility in business rooms.
advice_items.quote: get your ass in shape when you walk in a room people treat you differently... displaying discipline
advice_items.video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 主动融入与你使命同频的圈子，哪怕在网上
advice_items.summary_en: Surround yourself with people on the same mission, even through online communities if none exist locally.
advice_items.quote: put yourself around other people that are on the same Mission as you even if you have to do that on the internet
advice_items.video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH!

advice_items.canonical_tag: Don't Surround Yourself With Toxic / Negative People
advice_items.summary_zh: 礼貌远离不同频且不理解你的人，走自己的路
advice_items.summary_en: Stay polite toward doubters close to you, but distance yourself from people who are not on your path.
advice_items.quote: be kind to those people... respectfully go your own Direction and don't put yourself around them if they're not on the same path as you
advice_items.video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH!

guests.role_or_title: Franchise Owner (Formerly 155 Five Guys Locations) & NBA Legend
guests.wealth_detail: Became a millionaire at age 18
guests.first_money_or_break: 出身贫寒，凭借NBA职业生涯赚取高额薪资与代言收入作为原始资本；拿到第一个100万美元时曾30分钟挥霍一空，随后自学金融理财并将体育收入杠杆化投资及特许经营（曾拥有155家Five Guys门店），建立庞大商业帝国。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Raised in poverty, he built his initial capital from high NBA salaries and endorsement deals. After blowing his first $1 million in 30 minutes, he taught himself finance and leveraged his sports income into investments and franchises (at one point owning 155 Five Guys locations), building a vast business empire.
guests.zero_start_advice: 有计划就先写下来；找到已经在做同类事情并取得成功的人，观察并借鉴（“偷师”）他们的做法，再加入自己的独特风格；商业必然有起有伏，只要始终保持信念，就能更快登上顶峰。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Write your plans down first, then find people already succeeding at something similar, study and borrow their playbook, and add your own unique style. Business will always have ups and downs, so if you never lose faith, you will reach the top faster.
guests.primary_video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews SHAQ

appearances.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews SHAQ
Asking Billionaires What To Invest In!
Meet The Kid Who Interviews Billionaires For a Living

advice_items.summary_zh: 听取父母忠告并紧跟优秀导师学习，是成功秘诀
advice_items.summary_en: Listen to your parents and closely follow great mentors as a core key to success.
advice_items.quote: Two things. Listen to your mom and dad and follow your favorite mentors. Jamie is one of my favorite mentors ever.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires What To Invest In!

advice_items.summary_zh: 赚钱容易守财难，务必学懂财务知识与年金
advice_items.summary_en: Making money is easy, keeping it is hard; build financial literacy and learn concepts like annuities.
advice_items.quote: It's easy to make a lot of money, it's hard to keep a lot of money. For those who are not financially literate, learn this word: annuity.
advice_items.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews SHAQ

advice_items.summary_zh: 别自以为全懂，雇佣更聪明的人并学会授权
advice_items.summary_en: Don't think you know everything; hire people smarter than you and delegate to scale.
advice_items.quote: The common mistake business owners make is they think they know it all. Make sure you hire people that are smarter than you.
advice_items.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews SHAQ

advice_items.canonical_tag: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep
advice_items.summary_zh: 将75%收入存下，只用25%消费享乐
advice_items.summary_en: Save 75% of your earnings and limit fun or lifestyle spending to 25%.
advice_items.quote: One piece of advice was to save 75% and have fun with 25%.
advice_items.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews SHAQ

advice_items.summary_zh: 谈判时别先开口，报价应从高往低谈
advice_items.summary_en: In negotiations, don't speak first and anchor high so you don't leave money on the table.
advice_items.quote: Start high... if you start at 50 and their budget is 200, you just lost 150 million.
advice_items.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews SHAQ

advice_items.summary_zh: 切忌暴富后立刻挥霍购买豪车与珠宝
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid blowing newfound wealth immediately on luxury cars, jewelry, and status symbols.
advice_items.quote: I made a very big mistake the first time I got a million dollars, I spent it in about 30 minutes. Bought three cars, I bought three jewelries, and I bought some suits.
advice_items.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews SHAQ

advice_items.summary_zh: 拥有让家人过得更好的深层动力才能持久巅峰
advice_items.summary_en: Sustain longevity at the top by anchoring yourself to a deep personal motivation like providing for family.
advice_items.quote: The secret was just having special motivation. My motivation was always being able to get my mother what she wants.
advice_items.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews SHAQ

advice_items.summary_zh: 保持信仰与感恩，一切成就离不开上帝
advice_items.summary_en: Stay grounded in faith and gratitude; recognize that success isn't achieved alone.
advice_items.quote: Very important. None of this is possible without God.
advice_items.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews SHAQ

advice_items.canonical_tag: Don't Wait Too Long to Start / Invest
advice_items.summary_zh: 后悔当年犹豫未投资星巴克，错失良机
advice_items.summary_en: Regrets hesitating and failing to pull the trigger on partnering with Starbucks early on.
advice_items.quote: Not pulling the trigger when I had the opportunity to... Howard Schultz wanted to open Starbucks in the hood... I didn't pull the trigger.
advice_items.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews SHAQ

advice_items.summary_zh: 顶级成功者都谦逊友善且身边围绕优秀人才
advice_items.summary_en: Highly successful people remain kind and humble, keep things simple, and surround themselves with great people.
advice_items.quote: I think they're nice, I think they're humble, and I think they have great people around them, and they keep it very simple.
advice_items.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews SHAQ

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.summary_zh: 投资真正能改变人们生活的事物与企业
advice_items.summary_en: Adopt Jeff Bezos's principle: invest in businesses and innovations that change people's lives.
advice_items.quote: Jeff Bezos said you invest in things that's going to change people's lives. I heard him say that and I changed my whole investment strategy and been very, very successful.
advice_items.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews SHAQ

advice_items.summary_zh: 用真正的热情与信念打动投资人
advice_items.summary_en: Build genuine passion and conviction in your venture, as that is what top investors back.
advice_items.quote: I like to believe in what they believe in... if you told me your passion, I would definitely invest in you.
advice_items.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews SHAQ

advice_items.summary_zh: 写下计划，在商业起伏中始终坚定信念
advice_items.summary_en: Write down your plan and maintain unwavering self-belief through the inevitable ups and downs.
advice_items.quote: Always believe, there will be ups and downs in this business, long you believe, quickly you'll make it to the top.
advice_items.video_title: Young Entrepreneur Interviews SHAQ

guests.role_or_title: Founder of Solidcore & Back on My Feet; Entrepreneur & Investor
guests.wealth_detail: ~$100M net worth; sold Solidcore at >$300M valuation (~$90M personal equity payout); $64M in public equities
guests.first_money_or_break: 26、27岁时曾处于负资产，先创办了帮助无家可归者的公益组织Back on My Feet，后抢先发现精品普拉提健身的早期空白并创立Solidcore，靠口碑前4年零营销费扩张，9年半后以超3亿美元估值出售公司，个人股权套现约9000万美元。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: With a negative net worth at ages 26-27, she first founded the homeless-aid nonprofit Back on My Feet before spotting an early gap in boutique Pilates and launching Solidcore. Expanding purely by word of mouth with zero marketing spend for the first four years, she sold the company nine and a half years later at a valuation over $300 million, cashing out roughly $90 million for her equity.
guests.zero_start_advice: 找到自己超越95%人群的独特专长并结合热爱的领域去创业；不要把钱存银行拿微薄利息，通过书籍和播客学习投资，哪怕从1000美元开始也要尽早投入股市（如指数基金）享受复利。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Build a business around a unique skill where you outperform 95% of people combined with an area you love. Instead of leaving cash in a bank for tiny interest, learn investing through books and podcasts and put even as little as $1,000 into the stock market (such as index funds) early to capture compounding.
recommended_books_or_mentors: How to Win Friends and Influence People (Dale Carnegie)
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich!

appearances.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich!

advice_tags: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.summary_zh: 抢先一步切入尚未出现大品牌的早期蓝海赛道
advice_items.summary_en: Win by entering emerging categories early before major brands exist and aligning them with your core strengths.
advice_items.quote: My ability as an entrepreneur to be successful was finding the things before people found them... nobody knows about this. Nobody's built a big brand around this.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 从一开始就锚定终局目标，拒绝半路分心诱惑
advice_items.summary_en: Define a clear long-term endgame from day one so you say no to premature buyouts or franchising distractions.
advice_items.quote: I created a northstar. So, from the very beginning, I knew what my endgame was... having that clear sight of path, I never got distracted.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 选择真正热爱的事业才能熬过长达两年的危机期
advice_items.summary_en: Choose a business you genuinely love so you have the stamina to push through crises like a two-year pandemic.
advice_items.quote: You have to find something that fills you up, that you feel authentically connected to, that you're going to want to work on it even through a two-year pandemic.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich!

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.summary_zh: 先专注为他人创造价值与影响，财富回报自然会来
advice_items.summary_en: Focus on enhancing people's lives and delivering real value; the financial payday follows naturally.
advice_items.quote: It wasn't about the money for me. It was always about the impact. Knowing if I did a really good job and created value for people, the payday would be there.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 理解亲友质疑多出于保护，仍要坚定相信自己能力
advice_items.summary_en: Recognize that loved ones doubt you out of protection, and trust your own skills anyway.
advice_items.quote: I think people doubt you because they love you and they want to protect you... they don't want to see you fail.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich!

advice_items.canonical_tag: Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)
advice_items.summary_zh: 用低息股票质押融资替代卖股，合法避开高额资本利得税
advice_items.summary_en: Borrow against appreciating equities at a low margin rate instead of selling stocks and triggering capital gains taxes.
advice_items.quote: I would rather pay 5% than sell my stocks and pay 20%. I don't have to pay any taxes on the money that I borrow.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 主动通过读书和播客学习理财，别拿没学过当借口
advice_items.summary_en: Take responsibility for your financial education through freely available books and podcasts.
advice_items.quote: The only person who loses when you decide not to learn about money is you. Like read a book, listen to a podcast. These things are available to absolutely everybody.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 别把钱闲置在银行，投入股市与指数基金吃复利红利
advice_items.summary_en: Keep minimal cash in low-yield bank accounts and invest consistently in equities and index funds to let compounding work.
advice_items.quote: Stop putting your money into a bank... You should be putting it into the stock market, whether it's index funds... you have to stack your assets and you need to just let them continue to compound.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 保持慷慨心态，赚钱后积极捐赠并教朋友理财
advice_items.summary_en: Practice generosity by donating, sharing experiences, and educating friends on how to build wealth.
advice_items.quote: One of my values is generosity. Like when I have a great month, like I'm giving away money. I'm making donations.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 哪怕只有一千美元也要迈出投资与创业的第一步
advice_items.summary_en: Start investing and building immediately regardless of how small your initial capital is.
advice_items.quote: It doesn't matter if you're starting with $10,000, $1,000. You got to start somewhere... everybody has to have a day one.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 谈判核心在于当面真诚沟通，让人喜欢并相信你的愿景
advice_items.summary_en: Win negotiations by meeting in person, building genuine rapport, and projecting conviction in your vision.
advice_items.quote: Read the book How to Win Friends and Influence People... It's really getting someone to like you and believe in you. And that comes with a lot of confidence.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich!

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.summary_zh: 围绕自身顶尖专长创业拥有股权，才能实现财富自由
advice_items.summary_en: Achieve true financial freedom by becoming an entrepreneur around a skill where you outperform 95% of people.
advice_items.quote: You got to be an entrepreneur... figure out what your special thing is that you know how to do better than like 95% of the population.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 坚守诚信与自豪感赚钱，享受创业全过程而非只看套现
advice_items.summary_en: Build your business with pride and integrity so the entire journey feels worthwhile beyond the exit payday.
advice_items.quote: What made it all worth it is I felt like I made my money with pride and with integrity and I loved like the whole journey.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich!

guests.role_or_title: Founder of The Corcoran Group & Shark Tank Investor
guests.wealth_detail: Sold The Corcoran Group for $66M cash in one day
guests.first_money_or_break: 曾打过22份工并做过女服务员，21岁凭1000美元借款创办纽约住宅地产公司The Corcoran Group，拒绝200万美元收购后在两年后以6600万美元现金出售公司；后通过主动写信争取重获《创智赢家》席位。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: After holding 22 jobs including waitressing, she borrowed $1,000 at age 21 to found New York residential brokerage The Corcoran Group, later turning down a $2 million buyout before selling the company two years later for $66 million in cash. She later wrote a persuasive letter to win back her seat on Shark Tank.
guests.zero_start_advice: 脚踏实地从零起步（如在街角卖苹果先赚5万美元再滚雪球），做自己真正热爱的事、保持真实自我并善用沟通；若有积蓄尽早买两户型住宅，自住一半并以租金还贷。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Start humbly from scratch (like selling apples on a street corner to make your first $50,000 and snowball from there), do what you genuinely love, stay authentic, and use communication well. Once you have savings, buy a two-family home early so you can live in one unit and use the rent to pay the mortgage.
guests.primary_video_title: She Turned $1,000 Into a $66M Empire at 76 Years Old!

appearances.video_title: She Turned $1,000 Into a $66M Empire at 76 Years Old!
I Spent A Day With Shark Tank Billionaires!

advice_tags: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
Don't Wait Too Long to Start / Invest
Be Careful Who You Partner With

advice_items.summary_zh: 学会克服失败，跌倒后必须立刻站起来重回赛场
advice_items.summary_en: Develop resilience to overcome failure, get back up immediately, and get back in the game.
advice_items.quote: It's all about overcoming failure. If you don't have that gene naturally in you, you have to develop it or you'll never succeed in business. Just have to overcome failure. Get back up and get back in the game.
advice_items.video_title: I Spent A Day With Shark Tank Billionaires!

advice_items.summary_zh: 招对人并充分激励与授权，不要事必躬亲
advice_items.summary_en: Hire the right people, motivate them deeply, and delegate rather than trying to do everything yourself.
advice_items.quote: The key to really getting ahead... delegation. I'm great at hiring the right people, motivating the right people.
advice_items.video_title: She Turned $1,000 Into a $66M Empire at 76 Years Old!

advice_items.summary_zh: 善用稀缺与紧迫感成交，洞察买家真实需求
advice_items.summary_en: Create urgency by taking the deal away and read between the lines to uncover what buyers truly want.
advice_items.quote: I took the deal away, which is good because everybody always wants what they can't get their hands on.
advice_items.video_title: She Turned $1,000 Into a $66M Empire at 76 Years Old!

advice_items.summary_zh: 绝不接受拒绝，用行动证明质疑你的人是错的
advice_items.summary_en: Never take no for an answer and directly advocate for yourself when others doubt you.
advice_items.quote: I didn't take no for an answer. I was the only one who wrote Mark Burnett, who owned the show, a letter and I told him he was making a mistake
advice_items.video_title: I Spent A Day With Shark Tank Billionaires!

advice_items.summary_zh: 看清最坏结果并敢于冒险，失败也能重头再来
advice_items.summary_en: Take risks knowing your downside is capped—you can always fall back on earning a living if a venture fails.
advice_items.quote: I had 22 jobs and I knew if it didn't work out I could always get my old job back.
advice_items.video_title: She Turned $1,000 Into a $66M Empire at 76 Years Old!

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.summary_zh: 选择刚需常青赛道，确保经济周期中有需求
advice_items.summary_en: Build in evergreen markets with permanent human demand, like residential housing, to weather market cycles.
advice_items.quote: Residential, people need a place to live. I felt there was always a need for it.
advice_items.video_title: She Turned $1,000 Into a $66M Empire at 76 Years Old!

advice_items.summary_zh: 善用房贷杠杆买房并长期持有，靠再融资套现
advice_items.summary_en: Use mortgage leverage to buy real estate, hold forever, and pull out cash via refinancing as rents rise.
advice_items.quote: It's leveraging. It's like getting a big mortgage, a small down payment, and the minute the tenants are paying more rent, you go back to the bank, and you ask them for a second mortgage, and you keep taking the cash out. I've never sold any real estate I've bought.
advice_items.video_title: I Spent A Day With Shark Tank Billionaires!

advice_items.canonical_tag: Don't Wait Too Long to Start / Invest
advice_items.summary_zh: 莫因恐惧错失首次买房良机，尽早上车积累筹码
advice_items.summary_en: Don't back out of buying your first property out of fear—getting in early gives you equity to trade up.
advice_items.quote: I got scared and I purposely failed the board. Do you know it took me eight years to catch up to the market?
advice_items.video_title: She Turned $1,000 Into a $66M Empire at 76 Years Old!

advice_items.summary_zh: 坚守自己擅长且能赚钱的领域，不要盲目跨界
advice_items.summary_en: Stick to the industries and investments you know well and consistently make money in.
advice_items.quote: I invest here in Shark Tank. I invest in real estate in my own life and that's what I stick with. Stick with my knitting because I make money at it.
advice_items.video_title: I Spent A Day With Shark Tank Billionaires!

advice_items.summary_zh: 投身真正热爱的事业或产品，热爱驱动成功
advice_items.summary_en: Pick a business or product you genuinely love because passion drives consistent excellence.
advice_items.quote: When you have a passion for your business or your product you always do well.
advice_items.video_title: She Turned $1,000 Into a $66M Empire at 76 Years Old!

advice_items.summary_zh: 靠拼劲破局，遇挫就找低成本方案并继续前进
advice_items.summary_en: Hustle relentlessly; when you hit a wall, find a cheap solution and keep moving forward.
advice_items.quote: It's just hustling yourself, you know? And you have to think of solutions. When you hit a wall, you think of a solution and you think of a cheap one and you keep moving on.
advice_items.video_title: I Spent A Day With Shark Tank Billionaires!

advice_items.canonical_tag: Be Careful Who You Partner With
advice_items.summary_zh: 选对人生与商业伙伴至关重要，远离不诚实者
advice_items.summary_en: Choosing the right life and business partner is the most important decision; avoid dishonest or unhealthy partners.
advice_items.quote: When you have a good life partner, when you have a good business partner, you double your chances of success.
advice_items.video_title: She Turned $1,000 Into a $66M Empire at 76 Years Old!

advice_items.summary_zh: 从零起步立刻行动，哪怕街角卖苹果先赚第一桶金
advice_items.summary_en: Start small with immediate, practical action from zero and compound your momentum from the first win.
advice_items.quote: I would sell apples on the corner and make $50,000 in the first month, build from there.
advice_items.video_title: She Turned $1,000 Into a $66M Empire at 76 Years Old!

guests.role_or_title: Tech Entrepreneur & Information Security Pioneer (New Startup Founder)
guests.wealth_detail: Sold tech company for over $1 billion; owned 95% with partner at 1999 IPO; grew to $120M in annual sales within 4 years
guests.first_money_or_break: 家境贫寒出身，年少自学编程，20岁出头辞职创业并靠最后1000美元积蓄和卖掉摩托车撑过起步期。先开发局域网安全审计软件拿下美联储及美国各大银行客户实现年入百万美元，后抓住互联网浪潮转型做网站流量营销分析，4年内做到1.2亿美元营收，1999年上市并最终以超10亿美元出售。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Born into a poor family and self-taught in programming as a teen, he quit his job in his early 20s and survived startup life on his last $1,000 and the sale of his motorcycle. After building LAN security-auditing software that won the Federal Reserve and major U.S. banks to reach $1 million a year, he pivoted into web traffic marketing analytics, scaled to $120 million in revenue within four years, went public in 1999, and ultimately sold for over $1 billion.
guests.zero_start_advice: 科技新人建议切入高增长的网络安全/信息安全领域；若有10万美元启动资金，可先做服务业快速产生现金流，或凭技术能力全职投入一年自己打造产品；选择能热爱并深耕3-5年以上的赛道，专注熟悉领域，并在经济衰退期低成本布局或保持现金储备。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Tech newcomers should target fast-growing cybersecurity, while anyone with $100,000 in seed capital can start a service business for fast cash flow or spend a full year building a product if they have technical skills. Choose a field you love enough to stick with for 3-5+ years, stay in areas you know, and keep cash reserves to buy cheap or position yourself during recessions.

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.summary_zh: 抓住时代大趋势与新兴市场风口
advice_items.summary_en: Spot transformative industry shifts early and pivot to catch the emerging market wave.
advice_items.quote: I see this train going past... if we start running now we might be able to catch the last car of that train because this is going to be the future.
advice_items.video_title: How I Turned $1,000 Into $1 Billion

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.summary_zh: 先做可演示产品并验证真实需求
advice_items.summary_en: Build a demonstrable product and prove early user adoption rather than pitching just an idea.
advice_items.quote: It always helps to have something demonstrable and not just an idea. Ideas are really difficult to get funded.
advice_items.video_title: How I Turned $1,000 Into $1 Billion

advice_items.summary_zh: 看清最坏兜底后果后勇敢冒险一试
advice_items.summary_en: Recognize that the worst-case downside is simply getting a job, and take the entrepreneurial leap without regret.
advice_items.quote: The worst thing that can happen to me is I'll have to go get a job... if I didn't try it I would be always wondering why didn't I try.
advice_items.video_title: How I Turned $1,000 Into $1 Billion

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.summary_zh: 不盲目融资以守住高比例公司股权
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid unnecessary venture capital dilution and stay frugal so founders retain overwhelming equity ownership.
advice_items.quote: We were way more frugal with the decisions we made going forward and when we took the company public he and I owned 95 percent of the company.
advice_items.video_title: How I Turned $1,000 Into $1 Billion

advice_items.summary_zh: 有限资金先做服务业或靠自己动手研发
advice_items.summary_en: With modest capital ($100k), start a cash-flowing service business or invest in yourself to build the product yourself.
advice_items.quote: start in a service industry and try to get some income coming in... or if you've got the skill set take the year off of work and write it yourself
advice_items.video_title: Life After Selling Your Company For $1 Billion

advice_items.summary_zh: 通过阅读精准解决企业管理与营销难题
advice_items.summary_en: Read books across domains to gain mental models for diagnosing management bottlenecks and launching products.
advice_items.quote: I started reading Into Thin Air and then it clicked for me what the problem was with my company... that book to me saved my company.
advice_items.video_title: How I Turned $1,000 Into $1 Billion

advice_items.summary_zh: 超前招聘高段位人才并及时调整职责
advice_items.summary_en: Hire leaders who have already operated at your future scale, and relieve early staff who hit their management ceiling.
advice_items.quote: We changed our hiring practices across the company to hire above a level for the position... I need somebody who's already been up the mountain.
advice_items.video_title: How I Turned $1,000 Into $1 Billion

advice_items.canonical_tag: Don't Neglect Health & Family for Money
advice_items.summary_zh: 切勿为事业拼命而忽略健康与家庭
advice_items.summary_en: Protect your physical health and meaningful relationships instead of letting 60-70 hour workweeks cause burnout or divorce.
advice_items.quote: I would tell myself to take care of my health better because I think that's the first and easiest thing to let go as an entrepreneur.
advice_items.video_title: How I Turned $1,000 Into $1 Billion

advice_items.canonical_tag: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep
advice_items.summary_zh: 赚到钱后切忌乱花并尽早寻求理财建议
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid overspending once wealth arrives and seek qualified financial advice early to manage newfound money.
advice_items.quote: Don't spend so much money once you finally make it; better yet would be get some really good financial advice once you finally do make good money.
advice_items.video_title: How I Turned $1,000 Into $1 Billion

advice_items.summary_zh: 戒掉拖延立刻行动并快速试错迭代
advice_items.summary_en: Stop waiting for the perfect idea—time is non-renewable, so start immediately, fail fast, and iterate.
advice_items.quote: Procrastination is your worst enemy... if you're going to fail, fail fast. Get in there, try it, it didn't work, move on.
advice_items.video_title: How I Turned $1,000 Into $1 Billion

advice_items.summary_zh: 列待办清单，先做易事打破拖延
advice_items.summary_en: Use daily to-do lists and start with easy, enjoyable tasks to break procrastination and build momentum.
advice_items.quote: if I do something real easy that I enjoy doing it kind of breaks the ice and then I kind of get on a roll
advice_items.video_title: Life After Selling Your Company For $1 Billion

advice_items.summary_zh: 选能坚持三到五年以上的热爱事业
advice_items.summary_en: Execution is hard and takes 3 to 5+ years, so choose a venture you truly enjoy working on every day.
advice_items.quote: pick something you want to be spending a lot of time with... even the most successful companies usually take three to five years minimum
advice_items.video_title: Life After Selling Your Company For $1 Billion

advice_items.summary_zh: 深耕熟悉领域，切忌盲目追风口分散精力
advice_items.summary_en: Stick to what you know and go deep into one industry instead of chasing trends and scattering your focus.
advice_items.quote: stick to what you know or learn something and learn really deep on it and I think so often people shotgun
advice_items.video_title: Life After Selling Your Company For $1 Billion

guests.role_or_title: Co-founder of LinkedIn, VC & AI Startup Co-founder (Former PayPal Executive)
guests.wealth_detail: Sold LinkedIn to Microsoft for $26B (LinkedIn $16B annual revenue); PayPal acquired by eBay for $1.5B; became a billionaire around age 38
guests.first_money_or_break: 出身公务员家庭，斯坦福AI专业毕业后先在苹果、富士通工作积累产品与人脉；随后创办首家公司Social（虽未成功但进入创业轨道），核心参与PayPal（15亿美元被eBay收购），并在2003年创立LinkedIn，最终以260亿美元售予微软（约38岁成为亿万富翁）。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Raised in a civil-servant family, he graduated from Stanford in AI and worked at Apple and Fujitsu to build product skills and connections before launching his first startup, Social (which did not succeed but got him on the entrepreneurial track). He then played a core role at PayPal (acquired by eBay for $1.5 billion) and founded LinkedIn in 2003, eventually selling it to Microsoft for $26 billion and becoming a billionaire around age 38.
guests.zero_start_advice: 做与大多数人截然不同的事情；不玩一年期短线游戏，而是以10年为单位进行长远复利思考（例如创办AI抗癌新药研发公司），通过长期积累实现改变行业的颠覆性成果。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Do something radically different from what most people are doing. Avoid playing one-year short-term games and instead compound your thinking over 10-year horizons (such as founding an AI cancer drug discovery company) to achieve industry-disrupting breakthroughs through long-term accumulation.

advice_items.summary_zh: 敢冒他人不敢冒的风险，确保失败后仍能重新再来
advice_items.summary_en: Burn the boats early and take bold risks others avoid, while ensuring you can survive failure and play again.
advice_items.quote: Take a risk that other people won't take that might fail, but if you win, you win huge... make sure that you can play again.
advice_items.video_title: Meet the Billionaire Who Created LinkedIn (Then Sold It for $26B)

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.summary_zh: 选对核心赛道与产业集群，顺应时代技术浪潮
advice_items.summary_en: Pick the right strategic arena and geographic ecosystem, such as software in Silicon Valley or AI accelerating physical industries.
advice_items.quote: I knew what strategic game I was playing... doing software things within Silicon Valley was a very good place to be doing it.
advice_items.video_title: Meet the Billionaire Who Created LinkedIn (Then Sold It for $26B)

advice_items.summary_zh: 无视多数人唱衰，问自己掌握了什么别人不懂的真相
advice_items.summary_en: Don't be deterred when smart peers predict failure; invite critique to test what contrarian insight you hold that others miss.
advice_items.quote: More than two-thirds of my smart friends thought I was going to be a complete failure... What do I know that they don't know?
advice_items.video_title: Meet the Billionaire Who Created LinkedIn (Then Sold It for $26B)

advice_items.summary_zh: 人脉核心是先思考能为对方提供什么价值，而非索取
advice_items.summary_en: Build genuine relationships by leading with what useful insight or help you can offer someone, rather than asking for favors.
advice_items.quote: The key thing is think what you can give someone. So what's something that you could do that would help them?
advice_items.video_title: Meet the Billionaire Who Created LinkedIn (Then Sold It for $26B)

advice_items.summary_zh: 顶级成功者都具备强烈的好奇心与持续学习的渴望
advice_items.summary_en: Cultivate intense curiosity and a relentless desire to learn, a core trait shared by the top 0.001% of successful people.
advice_items.quote: One is curiosity. So, like intensely wanting to learn.
advice_items.video_title: Meet the Billionaire Who Created LinkedIn (Then Sold It for $26B)

advice_items.summary_zh: 拥有“无论如何都要把事情做成”的原始韧劲与毅力
advice_items.summary_en: Develop raw grit and unyielding determination to push through obstacles and make your venture work.
advice_items.quote: Another one is just raw grit and you know like I am going to make this work.
advice_items.video_title: Meet the Billionaire Who Created LinkedIn (Then Sold It for $26B)

advice_items.summary_zh: 公司是被买家主动收购的，而非靠卖家低姿态推销
advice_items.summary_en: In M&A and deal-making, shift the power dynamic so buyers or investors pursue you rather than you desperately pitching them.
advice_items.quote: Companies are bought not sold. So, if you're selling, you have a problem. You want them to come in and buy you.
advice_items.video_title: Meet the Billionaire Who Created LinkedIn (Then Sold It for $26B)

advice_items.summary_zh: 果断选择一扇门并放弃备选，才能换取长期大机会
advice_items.summary_en: Commit decisively to one path (door A over door B); narrowing short-term options is the only way to unlock long-term opportunity.
advice_items.quote: When you make the decision, you've chosen door A, not door B, but it's the only way you get opportunity in the long term.
advice_items.video_title: Meet the Billionaire Who Created LinkedIn (Then Sold It for $26B)

advice_items.summary_zh: 把创业当多次博弈，坦然面对挫折并从学习中获胜
advice_items.summary_en: Treat entrepreneurship as a multi-round game where setbacks are expected—celebrate learning in order to win rather than glorifying failure.
advice_items.quote: I'm playing a multi-time game. And I'm expecting that I'm going to fail along the way some... celebrate learning in order to win.
advice_items.video_title: Meet the Billionaire Who Created LinkedIn (Then Sold It for $26B)

advice_items.canonical_tag: Work Under a Winner First Before Starting
advice_items.summary_zh: 融资前先去优秀企业推出产品，证明战绩并积累人脉
advice_items.summary_en: Before trying to raise capital without a track record, work at a strong company to prove you can launch products and build a network.
advice_items.quote: You need to go prove your credentials at launching products first... I actually went and ended up working at Apple Computer.
advice_items.video_title: Meet the Billionaire Who Created LinkedIn (Then Sold It for $26B)

advice_items.summary_zh: 人生是团队运动，招募能力能互补你短板的合伙人
advice_items.summary_en: Life is a team sport—hire and partner with people whose operational strengths directly complement your weaknesses.
advice_items.quote: The things that's most important to hire or partner with are the people who add their strengths against your weaknesses.
advice_items.video_title: Meet the Billionaire Who Created LinkedIn (Then Sold It for $26B)

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.summary_zh: 顺应客户主动求购需求及时转型，先拿订单再做产品
advice_items.summary_en: Listen to market pull and pivot when customers show up—validate demand with a pitch deck and purchase orders before building.
advice_items.quote: The companies are coming to us... make a slide deck... the sales guy came back with purchase orders and we're like okay we're building that product.
advice_items.video_title: Meet the Billionaire Who Created LinkedIn (Then Sold It for $26B)

guests.role_or_title: Real Estate Entrepreneur & Investor (Hotels, Retail & Multifamily)
guests.wealth_detail: $500M net worth (stated by host/title; owns $30M mansion, sold $90M+ property package and $34M hotel)
guests.first_money_or_break: 出身贫寒，20岁出头起步，先为富人打工并建立合作打开认知，随后用退伍军人贷款(VA loan)零首付买下第一套1-4单元多户房产，从保障房逐步扩展到零售物业与酒店。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Starting out poor in his early 20s, he first worked for wealthy people and partnered with them to expand his perspective. He then used a VA loan with zero down payment to buy his first 1-4 unit multifamily property, gradually scaling from affordable housing into retail properties and hotels.
guests.zero_start_advice: 先找一份工作保证稳定收入以获得银行贷款预批，利用VA零首付或FHA 3.5%低首付买下2-4单元多户住宅，用租金覆盖账单甚至实现正现金流；戒掉派对与虚荣消费，踏实研究好交易、借助专业人士并按计划逐块积累资产。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: First get a job with steady income to qualify for bank loan pre-approval, then use a zero-down VA loan or a 3.5%-down FHA loan to buy a 2-4 unit multifamily property where rent covers your bills or generates positive cash flow. Cut out partying and vanity spending, carefully analyze good deals, lean on professionals, and stack assets piece by piece according to plan.

advice_items.summary_zh: 先替成功者打工以打开眼界和认知上限

guests.first_money_or_break: 出身贫困，父母入狱后曾住寄养家庭，15岁起养家；21岁辞去7万美元年薪工作创办家庭安防公司，提前买下小货车组建上门推销团队，为兑现90天内给母亲买房的承诺全力销售实现突破。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Born into poverty and placed in foster care after his parents went to prison, he began supporting his family at age 15. At 21, he quit a $70,000-a-year job to launch a home security company, buying a van ahead of time to build a door-to-door sales team and pushing hard to fulfill a promise to buy his mother a house within 90 days.
guests.zero_start_advice: 先想清楚支撑自己的核心动力（Why），寻找能赚取目标收入的行业机会并找到利益绑定的成功导师；将大目标拆解到极致并设死线，在资源未齐时先行动，同时把收入三等分以保障现金储备。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: First clarify the core "why" driving you, find an industry capable of paying your target income, and partner with a successful mentor whose incentives align with yours. Break big goals down to the finest detail with strict deadlines, act before you have all the resources, and split income into thirds to protect cash reserves.

advice_items.summary_en: Pick an opportunity or industry with enough upside to support the income level you want.

guests.role_or_title: Head of Sales & Partner at Virtus Insurance (Former Insurance PE Roll-Up Executive)
guests.first_money_or_break: 大学毕业后在芝加哥做猎头但一个月后因受不了严寒早起辞职，随后进入大公司派驻圣路易斯积累经验；后为照顾守寡母亲回家乡进入商业保险行业做销售（producer），前3-4年不断摸索，坚持25年以上将原公司发展为2000人规模的私募股权整合（PE roll-up）企业并成功出售，后加入Virtus Insurance担任合伙人及销售负责人。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: After quitting a Chicago recruiting job after one month due to brutal winters and early mornings, he gained experience at a large firm in St. Louis before returning home to care for his widowed mother and entering commercial insurance sales as a producer. After 3-4 years of trial and error, he stuck with it for over 25 years, scaling the firm into a 2,000-person PE roll-up and selling it before joining Virtus Insurance as a partner and head of sales.
guests.zero_start_advice: 如果账户明天归零，会立刻重返全职销售岗位，靠比别人更拼、更努力（out-hustle/outwork）快速赚取佣金支票；随后将资金分散投资于股市、房地产、私募股权/初创公司及个人热爱并熟悉的收藏爱好领域。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: If his bank account hit zero tomorrow, he would immediately take a full-time sales role and out-hustle and outwork everyone to earn commission checks quickly. From there, he would diversify across stocks, real estate, private equity/startups, and collectible hobbies he genuinely knows and loves.

guests.first_money_or_break_en: Getting sober at 21, he worked as an $8.50-an-hour fast-food worker and dishwasher before moving into oil and gas. guests.zero_start_advice_en: Make zero excuses, because if you want it badly enough you will find a way and accept the sacrifices. advice_items.summary_en: Adopt social media and creator seeding early to scale distribution rapidly.
advice_items.quote: we're the first beauty brand having a presence on Instagram and this is how we scale. It exploded the company.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaire Women How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 保持警觉随时转型，积极学习并全面应用AI
advice_items.summary_en: Constantly adapt to change and adopt new tools like AI across operations.
advice_items.quote: You have to adapt. You have to pivot. Business changes every day. Right now with AI, I want to learn more. I want to implement AI as much as I can
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaire Women How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 保持危机感的同时热爱事业，把工作当乐趣
advice_items.summary_en: Work with hunger while loving the craft and daily problem-solving.
advice_items.quote: I work like I can't pay my rent next month. ... I love what I do. I don't even feel like I work.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaire Women How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 不要害怕，勇敢迈出第一步去做内心想做的事
advice_items.summary_en: Do not be afraid to start pursuing what your heart pulls you toward.
advice_items.quote: Don't be afraid to start to do whatever your heart is telling you.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaire Women How They Got RICH!

guests.role_or_title: Serial Entrepreneur & Private Jet / Beverage Company Founder
guests.wealth_detail: Sold 4 companies including a private jet company with $5B+ in sales; made hundreds of millions of dollars; became a millionaire at 26
guests.first_money_or_break: 23岁睡朋友沙发年薪仅1.6万美元且入不敷出，经历上门卖海鲜、唱片、T恤、营销等多家公司失败后，因受邀坐上私人飞机发现商机，与合伙人创办私人飞机公司（年销超50亿美元并出售给巴菲特），26岁成为百万富翁。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: At 23, sleeping on a friend's couch while barely getting by on $16,000 a year, he failed at ventures selling seafood door-to-door, records, T-shirts, and marketing before spotting an opportunity after being invited onto a private jet. He co-founded a private aviation company that reached over $5 billion in annual sales and sold to Buffett, becoming a millionaire at 26.
guests.zero_start_advice: 在没背景时每天去比弗利山酒店等顶级场所制造近距离接触大佬的机会，保持饥饿感，做好十年磨一剑慢慢变富的准备。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: When you have no connections, go every day to top venues like the Beverly Hills Hotel to create proximity to major players. Stay hungry, and be prepared to grind patiently over a decade to build wealth slowly.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Atlanta Billionaires How They Got Rich!

appearances.video_title: Asking Atlanta Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_tags: Don't Neglect Health & Family for Money

advice_items.summary_zh: 兼顾财富与精神丰盈，只赚取金钱而无灵魂等于零
advice_items.summary_en: Build both financial wealth and spiritual/philanthropic richness, because money without spirit equals zero.
advice_items.quote: If you have a billion dollars and your spirit's zero, a billion times zero is zero. But if you have one dollar and your spirit's a billion, a dollar times a billion is a billion. You got to have both.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Atlanta Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 创业者必须坚信自己的故事会有好结局
advice_items.summary_en: Maintain deep conviction that your venture will ultimately succeed even before the proof arrives.
advice_items.quote: It's really important that you believe in the end of your story... If you're an entrepreneur, you have to believe that what you're doing is going to work.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Atlanta Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 年轻时寻找强力导师引路，学会赚钱并享受过程
advice_items.summary_en: Seek out an experienced mentor early who can guide you on both business execution and enjoying the ride.
advice_items.quote: I met that guy at 26. His name was Bob Sillerman. And he held my hand as a young kid. He said three things: make money, have fun, and have fun making money.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Atlanta Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 学会消化失望与连续失败，不轻言放弃才能等到成功
advice_items.summary_en: Learn to absorb repeated failure and disappointment without quitting before your breakthrough hits.
advice_items.quote: What he was teaching me was how to deal with disappointment and that nothing would be handed to you... I had so many ventures that failed before one worked.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Atlanta Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.canonical_tag: Don't Neglect Health & Family for Money
advice_items.summary_zh: 别只顾赚钱而忽略挚爱之人、友情与生活体验
advice_items.summary_en: Don't over-index on money at the expense of adventure, friendships, and the people you love.
advice_items.quote: Put more on your plate of what it is you love to do with the people you love to do it with... we tend to over index in the energy we put into the financial side, but we tend to sometimes neglect the spiritual side.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Atlanta Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 保持身体健康是头等大事，没有健康一切归零
advice_items.summary_en: Protect your physical health above everything else; without health you cannot enjoy wealth.
advice_items.quote: At the end of the day, we only have one job and that's stay healthy... You can't enjoy anything if you don't have your health.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Atlanta Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 听巴菲特劝告慢慢变富，打造品牌需要8到10年沉淀
advice_items.summary_en: Accept that real brand building and wealth creation take 8-10+ years; avoid overnight-rich illusions.
advice_items.quote: The biggest thing I learned from Warren is that you get rich slowly... It takes 8, 10 years to build a brand in this country for most people. And it takes a long time to acquire wealth.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Atlanta Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 保持强烈饥饿感与行动力，你本人就是最好的商业计划书
advice_items.summary_en: Show relentless hunger and hustle; top investors bet on hungry founders even more than business plans.
advice_items.quote: Hunger. Yeah, I'm looking at like you're hungry. I see you out there hustling. The way you approached me, you are the business plan.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Atlanta Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 主动走进大佬聚集的场所，通过近距离社交改变命运
advice_items.summary_en: Deliberately place yourself in rooms where top performers hang out, observe them, and initiate conversations.
advice_items.quote: Proximity. You got to put yourself in situations in right in the right rooms... I went every single day at 21 into the Beverly Hills Hotel and I would watch their mannerisms... Just starting small talk.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Atlanta Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 以永生之心持续学习，以末日之心尽情生活
advice_items.summary_en: Stay a lifelong learner while living boldly every single day.
advice_items.quote: I think the best quote I ever heard is from Gandhi. Learn like you'll live forever, live like you'll die tomorrow.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Atlanta Billionaires How They Got Rich!

guests.zero_start_advice: 零资金起步可先开车扫街寻找破旧或空置房产（Driving for Dollars），无需房产执照即可开始，先通过批发合约积累资金并规避翻修负债，同时可借助有经验的团队合作成交。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: With zero capital, start by driving for dollars to spot rundown or vacant properties, which requires no real estate license. Build initial capital through wholesaling contracts to avoid renovation debt, and partner with experienced teams to help close deals.
guests.primary_video_title: How to Wholesale Real Estate for Beginners

appearances.video_title: How to Wholesale Real Estate for Beginners

advice_tags: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value

advice_items.summary_zh: 零资金起步先开车扫街找房，后续再买数据
advice_items.summary_en: Start with zero capital by driving for dollars to spot distressed properties before paying for lead data lists as you scale.
advice_items.quote: for a typical person starting off with no money, no resources, the driving for dollars is going to be the answer, as you scale up then you get into person data
advice_items.video_title: How to Wholesale Real Estate for Beginners

advice_items.summary_zh: 学会分析房产并对比同类成交价（ARV）
advice_items.summary_en: Master property underwriting and run comparable sales (comps) to calculate ARV so you never overpay on a contract.
advice_items.quote: if you get the property too high you don't make no money so you have to know how to analyze a property, you have to run comparables
advice_items.video_title: How to Wholesale Real Estate for Beginners

advice_items.summary_zh: 找支持批发的本地产权公司并当面建立关系
advice_items.summary_en: Partner with investor-friendly local title companies where you can build face-to-face relationships to resolve closing issues.
advice_items.quote: me personally I like to work with a title company where I can go there I can talk to them, I can be face-to-face with them just in case anything goes down
advice_items.video_title: How to Wholesale Real Estate for Beginners

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.summary_zh: 以足够低价拿房，让买家和自己实现双赢
advice_items.summary_en: Secure properties at deep enough discounts so cash buyers still earn strong rehab profits while you collect a wholesale fee.
advice_items.quote: they're paying me because I found a property at such a discount I was able to make money and I'm able to save them money
advice_items.video_title: How to Wholesale Real Estate for Beginners

advice_items.summary_zh: 批发房产无需中介执照，零门槛可立即起步
advice_items.summary_en: Take action immediately because real estate wholesaling requires no license or minimum age to begin.
advice_items.quote: it doesn't require a license, you get started right away
advice_items.video_title: How to Wholesale Real Estate for Beginners

advice_items.summary_zh: 与卖家建立信任关系并促成合约谈判签约
advice_items.summary_en: Develop seller communication and rapport-building skills to negotiate and close off-market contracts.
advice_items.quote: dealing with these sellers, building rapport, getting these contracts, learning different tools about the real estate
advice_items.video_title: How to Wholesale Real Estate for Beginners

advice_items.summary_zh: 房产批发流程简单但需硬磨，关键在于坚持
advice_items.summary_en: Accept that wholesaling is simple in concept but a daily grind, and stay persistent through the learning curve.
advice_items.quote: just sticking to it, learning the business and just sticking to it as you go
advice_items.video_title: How to Wholesale Real Estate for Beginners

advice_items.summary_zh: 别盲从网上各路导师，找到适合自己的方法
advice_items.summary_en: Tune out conflicting advice from online gurus and double down on the specific process that works for you.
advice_items.quote: there's a ton of different gurus online telling you how to do stuff, but once you figure out what works for you I think that's the key
advice_items.video_title: How to Wholesale Real Estate for Beginners

advice_items.summary_zh: 缺资金信用时先做批发赚现金流并规避风险
advice_items.summary_en: Use wholesaling to limit rehab liability and build capital when you lack funding or credit to flip properties yourself.
advice_items.quote: when you're wholesaling you're just basically getting the contract set up to someone else and you're not taking on all responsibility
advice_items.video_title: How to Wholesale Real Estate for Beginners

advice_items.summary_zh: 房地产是创造财富与跃迁的优质赛道
advice_items.summary_en: Enter real estate as a primary vehicle for generating capital and transitioning into long-term property investing.
advice_items.quote: if you guys are out there you're looking to get into this space looking to make some money, looking to make some moves, trust me real estate is where it's at
advice_items.video_title: How to Wholesale Real Estate for Beginners

guests.wealth_detail: Billionaire; built company worth $2.2B-$3.3B enterprise value (sold to Hilton)
guests.first_money_or_break: 父亲破产后背负2000万美元债务起步，在酒店业从端盘子一路做到董事会，最终创立Diamond Resorts International并卖给希尔顿。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Starting out saddled with $20 million in debt after his father's bankruptcy, he worked his way up in hospitality from bussing tables to the boardroom. He eventually founded Diamond Resorts International and sold it to Hilton.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got Rich! (Beverly Hills)

appearances.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got Rich! (Beverly Hills)
Meet The Kid Who Interviews Billionaires For a Living

advice_tags: Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)
Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
