advice_items.summary_zh: 打造标准化可复制的商业系统才能稳赢
advice_items.summary_en: Build a repeatable, watertight business system so simple anyone can execute it.
advice_items.quote: You have to have a system if you want to win... the system's so good that a 15-year-old can run the business.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Miami Moguls How They Got Rich!

advice_items.canonical_tag: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep
advice_items.summary_zh: 别把主动收入花掉，要将其投入资产
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid spending earned income on luxuries until passive asset cash flow covers your goals.
advice_items.quote: Don't spend your earned income, invest it in assets.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Miami Moguls How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 每月定投标普500 ETF，让资金持续复利
advice_items.summary_en: Dollar-cost average into an S&P 500 ETF every month to compound your initial cash.
advice_items.quote: Whatever you can afford every single month, you put it into an S&P ETF and let it grow.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Miami Moguls How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 在赚钱的主业中拼尽全力深耕打拼
advice_items.summary_en: Work relentlessly in your primary income vehicle to fuel your asset investments.
advice_items.quote: Work your ass off in your vehicle and your business.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Miami Moguls How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 资金积累到一定阶段后投资多户住宅房产
advice_items.summary_en: Transition accumulated capital into multifamily real estate for cash flow and appreciation.
advice_items.quote: Once you get to a certain point you have money compounding, start investing in multifamily.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Miami Moguls How They Got Rich!

advice_items.canonical_tag: Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)
advice_items.summary_zh: 善用银行贷款买下租金能覆盖月供的房产
advice_items.summary_en: Use bank debt on cash-flowing multifamily properties where tenants pay off the loan.
advice_items.quote: The bank will lend you because it's not a personal residence, they want to see cash flow... those seven people paid the debt load.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Miami Moguls How They Got Rich!

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.summary_zh: 打造不靠出卖时间也能自动生钱的被动资产
advice_items.summary_en: Build passive residual income streams so you earn money even when not working.
advice_items.quote: Whether I work or not, sitting here with this guy, I'm making money right now standing here. That's what you got to be doing.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Miami Moguls How They Got Rich!

guests.guest_name: Nationwide Vacuum Truck & Liquid Storage Tank Founder
guests.role_or_title: Founder (Nationwide Vacuum Truck & Liquid Storage Tank Businesses; Sold to 4 Public Companies)
guests.wealth_detail: North of $100M/yr revenue (sold to 4 public companies); bought first vacuum truck for $180,000
guests.first_money_or_break: 大学毕业后亲自开卡车在纽约商业楼顶吸砾石，随后切入电厂、炼油厂等工业清洗领域，用攒下的钱买下第一辆18万美元真空卡车，靠利润再投入打造全国性真空卡车及储液罐业务并卖给四家上市公司。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Right out of college, he drove a truck himself vacuuming gravel off New York commercial rooftops before expanding into industrial cleaning for power plants and refineries. Using his savings to buy his first $180,000 vacuum truck, he reinvested profits to build a nationwide vacuum-truck and liquid-storage-tank business that he eventually sold to four public companies.
guests.zero_start_advice: 不要指望一步从0冲到100，应稳扎稳打跑长期马拉松；亲自敲门获客、把客户当朋友维系忠诚度，并坚持做自己真正热爱的事业。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Don't try to jump from zero to 100 overnight; treat building a business as a steady, long-term marathon. Knock on doors yourself to win customers, build loyalty by treating clients like friends, and stick to work you genuinely love.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Palm Beach Billionaires How They Got So RICH!

appearances.video_title: Asking Palm Beach Billionaires How They Got So RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 靠逐户登门拜访硬啃下早期客户
advice_items.summary_en: Win early B2B customers by relentlessly knocking on doors in person.
advice_items.quote: Ultimately, knocked on doors, Cole. Just knocked on doors. No cell phones, beepers, and pay phone.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Palm Beach Billionaires How They Got So RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 不融资借债，把利润滚雪球再投入业务
advice_items.summary_en: Grow organically without outside debt by reinvesting profits back into the business.
advice_items.quote: All organically growing. It was just kind of like you got the profits, put it back into the business, and just kept growing it.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Palm Beach Billionaires How They Got So RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 职业生涯最好的财务决策是押注自己
advice_items.summary_en: Make your biggest financial bet on yourself and your own execution.
advice_items.quote: What was the best financial decision you made throughout your career? Great question. Betting on myself, right?
advice_items.video_title: Asking Palm Beach Billionaires How They Got So RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 别贪快钱，像跑马拉松一样稳步做大价值
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid chasing quick money; scale steadily as a long-term marathon to build real enterprise value.
advice_items.quote: Don't try to go to zero to 100, grow 0 to 5, then 10, 15. Take your time. It's a marathon, not a sprint... Don't go for the quick money. Go for building a business that's worth something to many.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Palm Beach Billionaires How They Got So RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 做热爱的事业，靠内驱力坚持三十年早起
advice_items.summary_en: Build a business you genuinely love so internal passion sustains decades of 4 AM mornings.
advice_items.quote: You got to do something that you love. It has to be internal passion. You can't get up every day at 4 in the morning if you don't love it for 30 straight years.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Palm Beach Billionaires How They Got So RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 保持忠诚与饥饿感，把客户变成挚友留存
advice_items.summary_en: Retain clients long-term by staying loyal, humble, and turning customers into genuine friends.
advice_items.quote: Stay loyal, hungry, and become friends. You never have customers. They become your best friend. Buy him ice cream, buy them hot dogs, and that's how you get somewhere.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Palm Beach Billionaires How They Got So RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 把质疑你的人当作最想迎面证明的动力
advice_items.summary_en: Use doubters as fuel and target proving them wrong.
advice_items.quote: Did you ever have anybody that doubted you in business? Oh, that's the best people I want to go after.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Palm Beach Billionaires How They Got So RICH!

guests.role_or_title: Founder & Former CEO of Cable TV Company
guests.wealth_detail: Sold cable TV company for over $3B in 1999
guests.first_money_or_break: 中产家庭出身，上学时成绩平庸，12岁时因听到长辈说自己难成大器而立志证明自己；后从波士顿银行贷款700万美元收购有线电视系统，连续8年每年将公司规模翻倍，1999年以逾30亿美元出售公司。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Raised in a middle-class family as an average student, he vowed to prove himself at age 12 after overhearing an adult say he wouldn't amount to much. He later secured a $7 million loan from a Boston bank to acquire cable TV systems, doubled the company's size every year for eight straight years, and sold it in 1999 for over $3 billion.
guests.zero_start_advice: 走别人不走的路、瞄准未来高增长行业；学会洞察他人需求实现双赢谈判；控制好债务风险确保现金流能覆盖利息；平等待人、任人唯贤且绝不任用亲友；永不放弃自己的想法。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Take the road less traveled into high-growth future industries, learn to read what the other side wants for win-win deals, and keep debt disciplined so cash flow always covers interest. Treat everyone as equals, hire strictly on merit without nepotism, and never give up on your ideas.

advice_items.summary_zh: 用行动证明质疑者看错自己，不被成绩定义
advice_items.summary_en: Do not let mediocre grades or others doubting your potential define you; use skepticism as fuel to prove them wrong.
advice_items.quote: I was a very mediocre student. ... Not at all. ... I said, 'I'm going to prove them wrong.'
advice_items.video_title: Inside America's Billionaire Neighborhood (Beverly Hills)

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.summary_zh: 避开拥挤赛道，选择未来高增长行业
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid crowded conventional career paths and target emerging, high-growth industries early.
advice_items.quote: Don't go on the path that everybody wants to go. ... I want to go to the future for the growth. ... Go on the path less traveled.
advice_items.video_title: Inside America's Billionaire Neighborhood (Beverly Hills)

advice_items.summary_zh: 销售谈判要了解对方需求并实现双赢
advice_items.summary_en: Understand the other party's needs and desires in every deal and structure negotiations as win-win outcomes.
advice_items.quote: You got to know the people, you got to talk to the people, find out what their needs and desires are. ... It's got to be a win-win situation.
advice_items.video_title: Inside America's Billionaire Neighborhood (Beverly Hills)

advice_items.canonical_tag: Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)
advice_items.summary_zh: 控制债务规模，确保现金流能随时偿债
advice_items.summary_en: Keep debt manageable and ensure your business generates enough cash flow to service it under any market conditions.
advice_items.quote: Watch the debt. If you have too much debt and the markets go against you, you can lose control of the company.
advice_items.video_title: Inside America's Billionaire Neighborhood (Beverly Hills)

advice_items.summary_zh: 跳出固有框架思考，保持创造力与专注
advice_items.summary_en: Think outside the box, stay creative, and maintain laser focus to succeed as an entrepreneur.
advice_items.quote: Just think outside of the box. Be creative, focus, and you will be a great entrepreneur.
advice_items.video_title: Inside America's Billionaire Neighborhood (Beverly Hills)

advice_items.summary_zh: 任人唯贤不雇亲友，果断辞退不称职者
advice_items.summary_en: Maintain a strict meritocracy: avoid hiring friends or family and fire people who cannot deliver on the job.
advice_items.quote: Of course you fire people who are incompetent. ... Stay away from [hiring friends and family]. ... Those who deliver should move forward.
advice_items.video_title: Inside America's Billionaire Neighborhood (Beverly Hills)

advice_items.summary_zh: 忠于自我与想法，面对质疑永不放弃
advice_items.summary_en: Stay true to yourself, stick with your ideas, and never give up even when people think you are crazy.
advice_items.quote: Never give up. Be true to yourself and stick with your ideas. Never, ever give up and pursue those ideas.
advice_items.video_title: Inside America's Billionaire Neighborhood (Beverly Hills)

guests.wealth_detail: Sold healthcare business for $460M (owned ~50%, ~$230M)
guests.first_money_or_break: 在南非长大，曾被父亲赶出家门并一度住在车里。后来拿着约12万美元的年薪养育三个孩子，同时白手起家创办医疗健康企业，并于五年前以4.6亿美元出售（个人占股约一半）。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Growing up in South Africa, he was kicked out by his father and spent time living in his car. He later supported three kids on a roughly $120,000 salary while bootstrapping a healthcare company from scratch, which he sold five years ago for $460 million while owning about half of the business.
guests.zero_start_advice: 明确神赋予的使命并全力以赴；主动融入比自己更优秀的圈层并保持谦卑学习；每周听一本书；把被拒绝当成常态，不要在意他人评价。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Identify your God-given purpose and pursue it relentlessly, intentionally get in rooms with people sharper than you to learn with humility, and listen to one book a week. Treat rejection as normal and stop worrying about what others think.
recommended_books_or_mentors: The Purpose Driven Life by Rick Warren

advice_items.summary_zh: 置身更优秀的圈子，做房间里最不起眼的人
advice_items.summary_en: Surround yourself with accomplished peers so you are the least important person in the room and constantly learning.
advice_items.quote: If your friends think you're amazing, you're in the wrong circle. I like to be in the room where I'm the least most important person.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires If They Believe In God!

advice_items.summary_zh: 心怀笃定信念，敢于迈出创业和冒险的一步
advice_items.summary_en: Draw confidence from a higher purpose to start a business and take risks despite humble beginnings.
advice_items.quote: There was always the sense that God had a bigger purpose... just gave me confidence to start a business, to take a risk.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires If They Believe In God!

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.summary_zh: 善用AI降本增效，为更多人创造更大价值
advice_items.summary_en: Adopt new technologies like AI to serve more people at lower cost and make a bigger impact.
advice_items.quote: In healthcare, we're jumping on [AI] and say, 'Hey, if we can help more people in a less expensive way, make a bigger difference in their life, we are going to be in the very center of it.'
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires If They Believe In God!

advice_items.summary_zh: 绝不安逸躺平，每周坚持听书持续精进
advice_items.summary_en: Refuse to get comfortable; listen to a book every week and learn continuously via podcasts and conversations.
advice_items.quote: I can't get comfortable. I listen to a book a week. I listen to podcasts.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires If They Believe In God!

advice_items.summary_zh: 世界并非以你为中心，去思考能为他人做什么
advice_items.summary_en: Stay humble and grounded in faith and service—changing the world starts with realizing it's not about you.
advice_items.quote: If you really want to change the world, you got to understand it's not about you. I'm the least important. It's about what I can do for others.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires If They Believe In God!

advice_items.summary_zh: 把每天被拒绝当作常态，否则说明还不够拼
advice_items.summary_en: Treat daily rejection and embarrassment as normal proof that you are pushing hard and taking risks.
advice_items.quote: You have to expect to hear no every day. If you aren't hearing no and feeling embarrassed, you ain't trying.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires If They Believe In God!

advice_items.summary_zh: 别在意他人眼光，早日活出无所畏惧的心态
advice_items.summary_en: Stop caring about others' opinions early in life so nothing holds back your growth.
advice_items.quote: You can't worry about what people think about you... At 60, you realize they weren't even thinking about you in the first place.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires If They Believe In God!

guests.wealth_detail: Sold company to PepsiCo for $2 billion
guests.first_money_or_break: 夫妻合伙创业初期极为拮据，搬到达拉斯6个月时刚生下第一个孩子且差点付不起房贷；在房贷到期前一天意外收到政府因未申报受抚养子女而退回的税务支票（金额几乎与房贷相等），两人一路坚持最终将公司以20亿美元出售给百事公司。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Starting their husband-and-wife company on a shoestring budget, they moved to Dallas, had their first baby six months later, and nearly missed their mortgage before an unexpected government tax refund check for an unclaimed dependent arrived the day before it was due, matching the exact payment. They pushed forward through those early struggles and ultimately sold the business to PepsiCo for $2 billion.
guests.zero_start_advice: 愿意付出别人不愿付出的牺牲（初期没有所谓平衡），习惯并迎难而上应对不适感，不怕在外面反复出丑试错以换取清晰度与自信，相信自己和普通人一样有能力实现梦想。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Be willing to make the sacrifices others won't since there's no early work-life balance, lean into discomfort, and don't fear embarrassing yourself through repeated trial and error to earn clarity and confidence. Believe that you are just as capable of achieving your dreams as anyone else.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Billionaires If They Believe In God!

appearances.video_title: Asking Billionaires If They Believe In God!

advice_items.summary_zh: 合伙与婚姻的关键是相互信任，且说到做到
advice_items.summary_en: Mutual trust and consistently following through on your word are non-negotiable for business and life partners.
advice_items.quote: It's trust. If you don't trust one another to do what they say they're going to do, and if you don't show up and do the things that you say you're going to do, like it doesn't happen.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires If They Believe In God!

advice_items.summary_zh: 财富自由不等于使命，因热爱而继续创造
advice_items.summary_en: Financial freedom doesn't replace purpose—keep building meaningful work with people you enjoy.
advice_items.quote: Purpose is really big in business and in life... freedom doesn't equal purpose. So, I think even though we sold our company, we're not done. We're not going to retire.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires If They Believe In God!

advice_items.summary_zh: 在最拮据时坚定信念，感受神为自己开路
advice_items.summary_en: In moments of near-bankruptcy, recognize provision and faith as a sign to persevere.
advice_items.quote: It was almost to the penny of what our mortgage was. And it was like this amazing unlock to say like God is paving the way for us, and this was a sign for us to keep going.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires If They Believe In God!

advice_items.summary_zh: 想要超越常人的成就，就得做别人不愿做的事
advice_items.summary_en: Achieving extraordinary entrepreneurial results requires doing what others won't and accepting no early work-life balance.
advice_items.quote: Everybody wants what people don't have. But the question is, are you willing to do what others won't do to get it? ... to be an entrepreneur and have the things that others can't get, like there's no balance.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires If They Believe In God!

advice_items.summary_zh: 习惯并主动拥抱不适感，成长正发生在其中
advice_items.summary_en: Lean into uncomfortable moments when scaling a business because discomfort is where growth happens.
advice_items.quote: Get comfortable with being uncomfortable. That's what it takes to build and scale a business... Really lean into them cuz that's where growth happens.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires If They Believe In God!

advice_items.summary_zh: 世界由普通人创造，相信自己并全力以赴
advice_items.summary_en: Remember the world was built by people no smarter than you—believe you are capable and put in the work.
advice_items.quote: This world was created by people no smarter than you and I. And so if you have a dream, like you're smart enough, you're capable enough. Like just put in the work and go get it.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires If They Believe In God!

advice_items.summary_zh: 别怕当众出丑，反复试错才能换来精进与自信
advice_items.summary_en: Willingly embarrass yourself repeatedly—that cycle creates refinement, clarity, and lasting confidence.
advice_items.quote: Embarrassment is the most underexplored emotion when it comes to success. You have to go out there and make a fool of yourself because once you make a fool of yourself, then comes refinement, then comes clarity, then comes confidence.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires If They Believe In God!

guests.role_or_title: Co-founder of Web Traffic Technology Company

guests.first_money_or_break_en: He honed his sales chops in college selling T-shirts dorm-to-dorm, and when he landed unemployed in Los Angeles with $3,000, he spent five hours per letter writing 300 tailored pitches to top CEOs, landing 80 interviews and his dream job. He later walked away from $3 million in Fortune 500 stock options to co-found an internet traffic technology company.
guests.zero_start_advice: 永远别放弃并押注自己，用极致准备迎接每次机会，主动开口提出诉求，系统学习AI并坚持长期为身边人脉提供价值。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Never quit and always bet on yourself, prepare obsessively for every opportunity, and never be afraid to ask for what you want. Study AI systematically and commit to consistently adding value to your network over the long run.

advice_items.summary_zh: 敢于放弃高薪金手铐，勇敢押注在自己身上
advice_items.summary_en: Escape golden handcuffs and bet on yourself even when leaving lucrative stock options behind seems crazy to others.
advice_items.quote: I left an amazing job... Left $3 million of stock options on the table to take a risk, bet on myself... there's no better person in the world to bet on than you.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaire Mansion Owners How They Got RICH

advice_items.summary_zh: 创业需要每周百小时投入与极其顽强的韧性
advice_items.summary_en: Understand that building a real company requires 100-hour workweeks, sacrifice, and relentless tenacity.
advice_items.quote: It really takes long hours, 100 hours a week if you're going to do it right... My superpower in business is tenacity.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaire Mansion Owners How They Got RICH

advice_items.summary_zh: 主动学习并深研AI工具以大幅提升商业效率
advice_items.summary_en: Educate yourself and take classes on AI tools now so your business gains massive efficiency instead of falling behind.
advice_items.quote: The key to AI is knowing how to use it... people should educate themselves, even take classes today on how to most effectively use it to improve their businesses.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaire Mansion Owners How They Got RICH

advice_items.summary_zh: 在反复被当面拒绝中锤炼销售抗挫与成交能力
advice_items.summary_en: Build resilience through cold calling and face-to-face rejection until the eventual yes makes the 99 nos irrelevant.
advice_items.quote: There's nothing better at the end of the day than getting rejected to your face over and over and over again cuz the first 100 tries you get a no. On the 100th yes, you say, okay, I forgot about the first 99 no.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaire Mansion Owners How They Got RICH

advice_items.summary_zh: 用笨功夫大量写信争机会并敢于直接开口要单
advice_items.summary_en: Do the outreach others call a waste of time, trust your gut, and directly ask for the job or order.
advice_items.quote: I wrote 300 letters. Each one took 5 hours to write... I got 80 meetings out of 300... You got to ask for the order.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaire Mansion Owners How They Got RICH

advice_items.summary_zh: 长期维护人脉并在每次交流结尾主动寻求帮人赋能
advice_items.summary_en: Maintain relationships every 6 months and end every call by asking how you can help the other person.
advice_items.quote: You have to build relationships long term... always end a meeting saying, 'What are you doing that I can help you with?' You always should look to add value to somebody.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaire Mansion Owners How They Got RICH

advice_items.summary_zh: 用极致准备和每日自律训练彻底拉开竞争差距
advice_items.summary_en: Out-prepare everyone else through daily discipline and extreme preparation for every major opportunity.
advice_items.quote: Prepare more than anybody else. I call it extreme preparation. You spend 25,000 hours from kindergarten through college, and yet most people spend only 15 to 30 minutes preparing for a job interview.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaire Mansion Owners How They Got RICH

guests.first_money_or_break: 母子均为被收养出身，赴加拿大留学仅带够一年学费，写信向牙买加总理申请奖学金才读完大学；靠销售共同基金积累现金流后，借贷超过自身净资产以50万美元收购一家共同基金公司，四年后升值至350万美元。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Born to a mother who was adopted just like he was, he arrived in Canada for college with only enough money for one year's tuition and wrote to the Prime Minister of Jamaica for a scholarship to finish his degree. After building cash flow selling mutual funds, he borrowed beyond his own net worth to buy a mutual fund company for $500,000, which grew to $3.5 million four years later.
guests.zero_start_advice: 保持“贫穷、饥渴与内驱力”，向世界顶级榜样学习并严格复制其方法，用稳定现金流结合审慎杠杆买下看得懂的高成长企业并长期持有。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Stay "poor, hungry, and driven," study world-class role models and faithfully replicate their playbooks. Pair steady cash flow with prudent leverage to buy high-growth businesses you truly understand and hold them for the long term.

advice_items.summary_zh: 集中持有少数看得懂的高成长企业并长期持有
advice_items.summary_en: Concentrate ownership in a few understandable, high-quality businesses in growth industries and hold long-term.
advice_items.quote: They own a few high quality businesses. Number two, they make sure they understand them. Number three, they make sure they're in strong long-term growth industries. Number four, they make sure that they hold for the long run.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Monaco Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.canonical_tag: Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)
advice_items.summary_zh: 先创造稳定现金流，再善用杠杆收购优质资产
advice_items.summary_en: Generate steady cash flow first, then use borrowing capacity to acquire high-quality businesses.
advice_items.quote: I had to borrow to invest. I had cash flow because I was selling mutual funds... if you have cash flow, use your cash flow to borrow and then invest in high quality businesses.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Monaco Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.summary_zh: 紧跟主导能源向核能转移的历史大趋势布局
advice_items.summary_en: Position yourself in industries benefiting from major energy transitions, such as nuclear power.
advice_items.quote: Whenever there's a shift in the dominant source of energy, there's a shift in economic power. Right now, there's a shift occurring towards nuclear.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Monaco Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 75岁仍坚持工作、锻炼并让大脑保持活跃
advice_items.summary_en: Stay sharp at any age through hard work, mental activity, and consistent physical exercise.
advice_items.quote: I work hard. I keep my mind active and I've always exercised.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Monaco Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 践行行善致富，通过托举他人获得真正幸福
advice_items.summary_en: Derive true fulfillment by doing well financially while doing good and uplifting others.
advice_items.quote: My happiness comes from my mantra. Doing well by doing good. Doing well by uplifting others.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Monaco Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 找世界顶级榜样，拿到成功配方并严格照做
advice_items.summary_en: Pick the best role model in the world, get their exact recipe, and execute it faithfully.
advice_items.quote: Identify a role model... make sure that role model is the best in the world. Number two, get the recipe... And thirdly, don't change a recipe. Do exactly what that person did.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Monaco Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 成功需具备“PhD”：贫穷、饥渴与内驱力
advice_items.summary_en: Cultivate a real 'PhD'—staying poor, hungry, and driven—to build generational wealth.
advice_items.quote: To be successful, you have to have a PhD. That's not a school PhD: Poor, hungry, and driven.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Monaco Billionaires How They Got Rich!

guests.wealth_detail: $350M (video title)

guests.first_money_or_break_en: Not born into wealth, he started in music before branching into television (The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air), film, and production. His true financial turning point came when he realized he was a stronger actor than a musician, went all in on mastering acting, and watched the wealth follow.
guests.zero_start_advice: 初期先像箭头一样专精一件事再横向拓展；每天比别人投入更多时间形成复利优势；不怕出丑和被拒绝；不要听取没做过你想做之事的人的建议，相信自己的直觉；重视人际关系，并做好承受磨难的准备。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Start narrow like the tip of an arrow by mastering one craft before expanding, put in more hours every day so your effort compounds, and don't fear failure or rejection. Ignore advice from people who haven't done what you're trying to do, trust your gut, prioritize relationships, and brace yourself for hardship.

advice_items.video_title: I Asked Will Smith How He Made $350 Million

advice_items.summary_en: Victory goes to whoever puts in the most cumulative daily hours; consistent time applied beats raw talent.
advice_items.quote: The win goes to the most hours committed... if I do something for 10 hours a day and you only do it for 9 hours a day, in a year it's going to be really hard for you to beat me.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Will Smith How He Made $350 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 破除狭隘的身份标签束缚，人的潜能远超想象
advice_items.summary_en: Stop confining yourself to a narrow personality or social label; your true potential is far greater.
advice_items.quote: We are way bigger than we think we are... that idea of a person can even become the prison that keeps us from excelling.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Will Smith How He Made $350 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 苦难是淬炼意志的礼物，要学会习惯不适感
advice_items.summary_en: Adversity and hardship shape willpower; learn to get comfortable being uncomfortable to achieve big goals.
advice_items.quote: Suffering is a gift. The universe teaches through difficulty... get comfortable being uncomfortable if you want to achieve.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Will Smith How He Made $350 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 培养信仰并连接创造性智慧，突破小我的局限
advice_items.summary_en: Cultivate faith and connect with the creative intelligence beyond your ego to multiply your capacity.
advice_items.quote: I believe in an energy that is constantly creating in all things that if I cultivate a relationship with I can be more powerful than I am.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Will Smith How He Made $350 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 习惯被拒绝与当众出丑，坦然面对失败即自信
advice_items.summary_en: Real confidence comes from getting used to rejection, mistakes, and not being afraid to look foolish in public.
advice_items.quote: It becomes confidence after you get used to rejection. You get used to doing it wrong... The comfort to fail in front of people is what is perceived as confidence.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Will Smith How He Made $350 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 一切皆为人脉关系，善待他人能带你走得更远
advice_items.summary_en: Treat everyone with care because relationships compound over decades and open doors that money never can.
advice_items.quote: Everything is relationships... every person is going to be a part of the tapestry of your future... People will take you places that money can't.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Will Smith How He Made $350 Million

guests.wealth_detail: Over $1B/year in sales; sold Kind company; confirmed billionaire
guests.first_money_or_break: 40岁左右成为百万富翁。斯坦福法学院毕业后放弃高薪律所工作，先创办PeaceWorks在天然食品行业试错10年，每天早7晚7拎公文包在曼哈顿挨家推销并亲自送货；后创立Kind健康零食棒实现年销超10亿美元并出售公司。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Becoming a millionaire around age 40, he walked away from a lucrative law career after Stanford Law School and spent 10 years learning the natural foods industry at PeaceWorks, carrying a briefcase through Manhattan from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. to pitch stores and deliver orders himself. He went on to found KIND healthy snack bars, scaling the brand past $1 billion in annual sales before selling the company.
guests.zero_start_advice: 亲力亲为逐店开拓渠道并坚持多年；节俭务实、重视每一分钱；早期选对公司架构以利利润再投资与复利增长；保持品牌与价值观始终一致，并善待每一个人。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Do the unglamorous work of building distribution store by store for years, stay frugal and respect every dollar, and choose the right corporate structure early so profits can compound through reinvestment. Keep your brand aligned with your values and treat everyone with kindness.

advice_items.summary_zh: 经历十年试错与失败后找到爆款
advice_items.summary_en: Learn from years of mistakes in your industry before finding a breakout product.
advice_items.quote: 10 years of mistakes in the natural food industry... Made so many mistakes, but eventually had an idea for a healthy snack that you could travel with and that exploded and did really well.

advice_items.summary_zh: 一家店一家店地推攻克零售货架
advice_items.summary_en: Win retail distribution one store at a time by personally pitching and knocking on doors.
advice_items.quote: I need to go into this convenience store. And I would like sell or try to get the product on the right shelves one at a time... It took years and years and years of knocking down all those doors
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Tom Cruise How He Made $600 Million

advice_items.canonical_tag: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持节俭谦逊重视并省下每一分钱

advice_items.quote: A man that's too proud to pick up a penny is not worth a penny... Mind the pennies, and the dollars will mind themselves.

advice_items.summary_en: Maintain unshakeable self-belief despite starting with nothing and continuously invest in yourself.

guests.guest_name: Wall Street Private Equity Firm Founder
guests.wealth_detail: $500k peak single-year earnings
guests.first_money_or_break: 非富裕家庭出身，凭借本科和MBA学历、强烈拼搏精神及疯狂拓展人脉进入华尔街私募股权行业，最高年收入50万美元（自述尚未达到百万富翁），目前正在创立自己的私募股权公司。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Not from a wealthy background, he broke into Wall Street private equity through his bachelor's degree, MBA, relentless hustle, and aggressive networking, reaching a peak annual income of $500,000 (noting he isn't a millionaire yet). He is now in the process of launching his own private equity firm.
guests.zero_start_advice: 凭借高学历和拼劲在人群中脱颖而出，脚踏实地大量线下拓展人脉；聚焦能产生真实现金流的传统实体或可规模化金融服务行业，积累经验与人脉后组建团队创业。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Stand out with strong credentials and sheer grit while putting in the legwork to network heavily in person. Target traditional brick-and-mortar businesses with real cash flow or scalable financial services, then build your team and launch once you have the experience and relationships.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Wall Street Millionaires How To Make $1 Million

appearances.video_title: Asking Wall Street Millionaires How To Make $1 Million

advice_tags: Work Under a Winner First Before Starting

advice_items.summary_zh: 投资能产生真实稳定现金流的传统实体与金融业务
advice_items.summary_en: Focus on scalable financial services and boring real-asset businesses like data centers and waste management that produce real cash flow.
advice_items.quote: I'm a fan of businesses that make real cash flow... boring businesses as well as financial services businesses that can achieve scale.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wall Street Millionaires How To Make $1 Million

advice_items.canonical_tag: Work Under a Winner First Before Starting
advice_items.summary_zh: 先在行业内摸透规则并攒够人脉再出来单干创业
advice_items.summary_en: Learn the playbook and build relationships in the industry before launching your own firm.
advice_items.quote: I feel like I knew enough, knew enough people, might as well start building.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wall Street Millionaires How To Make $1 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 依靠优秀团队协作在激烈竞争中脱颖而出走得更远
advice_items.summary_en: Stand out in competitive deal-making through the quality of your team.
advice_items.quote: The team stands out. People I work with. I could do it alone, but it's much easier to go further with more people.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wall Street Millionaires How To Make $1 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 看懂银行息差逻辑、真实自由现金流与税务成本
advice_items.summary_en: Understand bank lending spreads, real cash flow versus EBITDA, and how cash compensation is taxed.
advice_items.quote: They don't want you to know that they need to lend money to people to make money... They make money on the spread, right?
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wall Street Millionaires How To Make $1 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 培养把钱看得像空气一样自然充沛的富足心态
advice_items.summary_en: Cultivate an abundance mindset where money feels as natural and unstressed as breathing air.
advice_items.quote: You want to be able to think about money like it's air... you want to get to a point where money is like air.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wall Street Millionaires How To Make $1 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 靠强烈饥饿感、拼搏精神与硬核学历在金融圈突围
advice_items.summary_en: Bring relentless hustle, hunger, and credentials to stand out when breaking into competitive finance.
advice_items.quote: You just got to have a lot of hustle, hunger... I got an MBA as well... I had to stand out somehow, so I did that.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wall Street Millionaires How To Make $1 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 不辞辛劳跑断腿般疯狂拓展高质量人脉进入核心圈层
advice_items.summary_en: Put in heavy legwork to network relentlessly and get into the right rooms.
advice_items.quote: You have to network your ass off... You got to run. You got to spend a lot of shoe leather.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wall Street Millionaires How To Make $1 Million

guests.guest_name: Palm Beach Private Equity Founder (84 Companies)
guests.role_or_title: Private Equity Investor & Multi-Business Owner (82-84+ Companies)
guests.wealth_detail: Became millionaire at 26; earned six figures/month in mid-20s; owns 82-84+ companies including one personally owned business generating over $3B
guests.first_money_or_break: 在網路普及前的 20 多歲中期，拿著電話簿從第一個名字開始逐一打陌生開發電話並留語音訊息推銷，藉此建立自信並達到月入六位數，26 歲成為百萬富翁，之後將儲蓄投入複利與私募股權併購。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: In his mid-20s before the internet era, he opened the phone book at the very first name and cold-called his way down the list leaving voicemails, building the confidence to hit six-figure monthly income and become a millionaire at 26. He then put his savings to work through compounding and private equity acquisitions.
guests.zero_start_advice: 克制消費並積極儲蓄本金、學習複利原理；年輕時別怕失敗丟臉要多方嘗試；善用既有人脈並持續跟進客戶；每天讚美他人並保持謙卑。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Control your spending, save aggressively to build capital, and learn the power of compounding while trying plenty of things in your youth without fearing embarrassment or failure. Leverage your existing network, follow up relentlessly with clients, compliment people every day, and stay humble.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich! (Palm Beach)

appearances.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich! (Palm Beach)

advice_tags: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep

advice_items.canonical_tag: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep
advice_items.summary_zh: 自律減少花費，明白花一元得賺兩元來補齊
advice_items.summary_en: Discipline yourself not to overspend and focus on stacking capital.
advice_items.quote: If you spend a dollar, you have to go make two... Don't spend, discipline yourself to stack it up.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich! (Palm Beach)

advice_items.summary_zh: 趁早儲蓄累積本金，深入研究複利與利息運作
advice_items.summary_en: Save capital early and study how compounding and interest build wealth in investing.
advice_items.quote: If you're not studying compounding and where interest is, the private equity game is so good... you need some capital, but that's why you want to save.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich! (Palm Beach)

advice_items.summary_zh: 成就感才是核心，必須真心熱愛所做的事業
advice_items.summary_en: Prioritize fulfillment and genuinely love the business you are building.
advice_items.quote: At the end of the day, fulfillment is the number one deal... You got to love what you do.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich! (Palm Beach)

advice_items.summary_zh: 二十幾歲別怕丟臉失敗，多嘗試不同機會才對
advice_items.summary_en: Try many ventures in your 20s without fearing failure or what others think of your reputation.
advice_items.quote: Turn over a million more rocks than most people... fear of what their name may look like for trying three or four ventures and falling on their face... It's the biggest mistake you can make in your early 20s.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich! (Palm Beach)

advice_items.summary_zh: 透過大量陌生開發練出自信，只賣真正有用的產品
advice_items.summary_en: Build sales confidence through relentless cold outreach and only sell what truly benefits buyers.
advice_items.quote: I started calling every first name [in the phone book]... I understood the power of leaving voice messages... If you don't feel like what you're putting your name to is beneficial to others, you're wasting your time.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich! (Palm Beach)

advice_items.summary_zh: 人脈就是你的勞力士，要向人脈圈提供真正價值
advice_items.summary_en: Treat your contact list as your greatest asset and bring real value to your network.
advice_items.quote: Your rolodex is your Rolex... everyone has all these contacts, you've got all these friends, but what are you putting in front of them that you feel has value?
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich! (Palm Beach)

advice_items.summary_zh: 保持謙卑並視眾人平等，每天至少稱讚五到十人
advice_items.summary_en: Stay humble, treat everyone as equal, and compliment 5 to 10 people daily.
advice_items.quote: Give at least 5 to 10 compliments a day to anyone that's in front of you... remember that we're all equal... when you stay humble, blessings come.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich! (Palm Beach)

guests.role_or_title: Entrepreneur, Author, Philanthropist & Business Strategist (114 Companies)
guests.wealth_detail: Millionaire at 24; self-confirmed billionaire; owns 114 companies doing over $12B/year
guests.first_money_or_break: 出身貧寒，11 歲感恩節收到陌生人匿名送來的火雞與食物後立志回饋社會；17 歲時為跟隨導師 Jim Rohn 學習而去擔任清潔工（janitor），並透過研究人類心理學與為市場創造價值，在 24 歲賺進第一個一百萬，最終建立橫跨多元產業的 114 家企業。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Born into poverty, he vowed to give back after receiving an anonymous Thanksgiving turkey and food at age 11, and at 17 took a job as a janitor to learn from his mentor Jim Rohn. By studying human psychology and creating market value, he made his first million at 24 and eventually built 114 companies across multiple industries.
guests.zero_start_advice: 先思考你能為他人提供什麼「對方真正需要」的價值，而非只想索取；為接近成功人士不惜從基層做起；在精通一項事業前別急著分散精力，並學會招募優秀領導者讓自己從操作者轉為擁有者。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Focus first on providing value that others genuinely need rather than seeking to take, and don't hesitate to start at the bottom to get close to successful people. Avoid spreading yourself thin before mastering one business, and learn to recruit great leaders so you can transition from operator to owner.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich! (Palm Beach)

appearances.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich! (Palm Beach)

advice_tags: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value

advice_items.summary_zh: 把焦點從「獲取」轉向「給予」，助人帶來生命意義
advice_items.summary_en: Shift your focus from getting to giving; serving others creates wealth and real fulfillment.
advice_items.quote: My whole life has grown from this focus on how do you give more, not how do you get more... it makes you feel fully alive.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich! (Palm Beach)

advice_items.summary_zh: 為接近頂尖導師不計身段，就算當清潔工也要跟隨學習
advice_items.summary_en: Do whatever it takes—even entry-level work—to get close to and learn from great mentors.
advice_items.quote: I was 17 years old and I went to work for him [Jim Rohn] because I loved what he was teaching... I worked as a janitor so I'd be around them.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich! (Palm Beach)

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.summary_zh: 提升自身市場價值，提供市場與他人真正需要的東西
advice_items.summary_en: Increase your marketplace value by delivering what others actually need more than anyone else.
advice_items.quote: You have to become more valuable. You have to do more for others than anybody else in the marketplace... figure out what you can give... it has to be what people need, not what you want to give.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich! (Palm Beach)

advice_items.summary_zh: 別用過去創傷當藉口，勇敢直面恐懼並照樣採取行動
advice_items.summary_en: Stop hiding behind excuses or past trauma; act despite fear rather than waiting for fear to vanish.
advice_items.quote: Most people rather than face their fear, they come up with a story... fearless doesn't mean you don't have fear. It means you fear less. It means you take action anyway.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich! (Palm Beach)

advice_items.summary_zh: 先徹底精通一項事業與商業邏輯，再考慮多角化擴張
advice_items.summary_en: Achieve mastery in one business and its economics before diversifying into new ventures.
advice_items.quote: You got to master this thing before you go do these other 12 things... you have to have a certain level of mastery of business, economics, and so forth. Otherwise, you spread yourself too thin.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich! (Palm Beach)

advice_items.summary_zh: 從親力親為的營運者轉型為擁有者，招募頂尖領導人放大槓桿
advice_items.summary_en: Transition from operator to owner by recruiting elite leaders and building strategic leverage.
advice_items.quote: Move from being an operator to an owner... really know how to leverage yourself. So I know how to recruit great leaders, I know how to scale things, I know how to be extremely strategic.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich! (Palm Beach)

advice_items.summary_zh: 永不放棄並主導人生，為超越自我的使命而戰才有持久能量
advice_items.summary_en: Be relentless and anchor your effort in a mission bigger than yourself for lasting energy.
advice_items.quote: Be relentless. Become the creator of your own life... If there's something you care about more than you, you're going to have enormous energy for the rest of your life.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich! (Palm Beach)

guests.wealth_detail: $24M peak single-year earnings; $2.9M peak single-month earnings
guests.first_money_or_break: 曾在监狱服刑10年靠吃廉价泡面度日；在狱中便开始发Instagram分享健身与正能量，出狱时已积累1万粉丝并坚持每日在各平台发布内容，最终实现单月290万美元、年入2400万美元。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: After spending 10 years in prison surviving on cheap ramen, he began posting fitness and positivity content on Instagram while incarcerated and left prison with 10,000 followers. By posting daily across platforms, he scaled to $2.9 million in a single month and $24 million a year.
guests.zero_start_advice: 效仿你想成为的成功人士并坚持不懈，将Instagram和YouTube等社媒作为最强营销工具坚持日更，只卖自己真正热爱且需要的内容；养成凌晨2:45起床和每日健身的自律习惯，靠近高消费高标准的圈子并打造持续性收入（Recurring Revenue）。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Emulate the successful people you want to become with relentless consistency, using Instagram and YouTube as daily marketing tools to sell only what you genuinely love and need. Build strict discipline by waking up at 2:45 AM and working out daily, surround yourself with high-spending, high-standard circles, and focus on recurring revenue.

advice_tags: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value

advice_items.summary_zh: 靠近高消费高标准、绝不将就的圈子
advice_items.summary_en: Surround yourself with high-spending, ambitious operators who never settle.
advice_items.quote: get around people who think it's okay to have $500,000 a month in expenses... get around people who do not settle
advice_items.video_title: Asking Miami Millionaires How to Get RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 做当年自己需要的人，说到做到绝不失约
advice_items.summary_en: Be reliable and never miss on your commitments where others only talk a big game.
advice_items.quote: be the man you always needed... my company's based on the fact that I'll never miss
advice_items.video_title: Asking Miami Millionaires How to Get RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 天下没有白吃的午餐，必须死磕到底
advice_items.summary_en: Nothing works unless you work for it; follow proven paths and refuse to take no for an answer.
advice_items.quote: nothing in this world is going to work for you you got to work for it... don't take no for an answer
advice_items.video_title: Asking Miami Millionaires How to Get RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 把社媒作为最强营销工具坚持每日更新
advice_items.summary_en: Use social media daily without missing a post as the ultimate free marketing engine.
advice_items.quote: I posted every day on Instagram... I've never missed a post on Instagram or YouTube... greatest marketing tool known to man
advice_items.video_title: Asking Miami Millionaires How to Get RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 只卖自己真正热爱且自身需要的产品
advice_items.summary_en: Build and sell what you genuinely love and need yourself rather than chasing random products.
advice_items.quote: I chased something that I really loved and something that I needed I sell what I need I don't just sell anything people will buy
advice_items.video_title: Asking Miami Millionaires How to Get RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 用早起、高频健身等日常习惯决定未来
advice_items.summary_en: Win the day through strict daily habits like waking early, training daily, and clean nutrition.
advice_items.quote: show me your habits I'll tell you your future... I get up at 2:45... train every day... keep the nutrition on point
advice_items.video_title: Asking Miami Millionaires How to Get RICH!

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.summary_zh: 全力服务他人，以利他创造真实价值
advice_items.summary_en: Dedicate yourself to serving others and providing the positive value they need.
advice_items.quote: being the source of what you see I literally can't live without serving others and that's the gift
advice_items.video_title: Asking Miami Millionaires How to Get RICH!

guests.guest_name: NYC Trucking & Commercial Real Estate Founder
guests.role_or_title: Former Trucking & Logistics Owner / Commercial Real Estate Investor
guests.wealth_detail: Sold trucking/logistics company for over $500M (debt-free); owns real estate with over 1,000 tenants
guests.first_money_or_break: 从小送报纸、割草、做砍树生意起家，之后用 68 美元应收账款、两辆卡车和空仓库接手父亲的小生意，服务财富100强客户并零负债做大，最终以超 5 亿美元出售物流公司并转型拥有逾千名租客的商业地产。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Starting with paper routes, lawn mowing, and tree cutting as a kid, the founder took over his father's small business with $68 in receivables, two trucks, and an empty warehouse. Growing debt-free while serving Fortune 100 clients, he eventually sold the logistics company for over $500 million and pivoted into commercial real estate with over 1,000 tenants.
guests.zero_start_advice: 别找借口，每天全力以赴去干；保持零负债或极低杠杆，避免踩坑翻车；坚持每天健身自律，凡事提前10分钟到场并用5年长远视角规划人生。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Make no excuses and give your all every day while staying debt-free or using minimal leverage to avoid wiping out. Maintain daily workout discipline, show up 10 minutes early to everything, and plan your life with a 5-year horizon.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking NY Billionaires How They Got Rich!

appearances.video_title: Asking NY Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_tags: Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)

advice_items.summary_zh: 真正热爱所做的传统行业，每天充满干劲
advice_items.summary_en: Love your craft even in an unglamorous industry and wake up excited to compete every day.
advice_items.quote: I ended up in the space because I loved what I did, right? I love the smell of diesel in the morning. Every morning for me was like Christmas morning.
advice_items.video_title: Asking NY Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 成功取决于投入程度，每天早出晚归死磕
advice_items.summary_en: Stand out by outworking everyone—show up early, stay late, and go to work every single day.
advice_items.quote: What makes him better than the next guy? It's how much you put into it... every morning getting up, every night coming home late.
advice_items.video_title: Asking NY Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 围绕主业持续囤地买房，打造千名租客资产
advice_items.summary_en: Buy land and income-producing real estate consistently alongside your operating business to build generational wealth.
advice_items.quote: we needed land and we bought a lot of land. Now today, we have over a thousand tenants in all of our real estate.
advice_items.video_title: Asking NY Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.canonical_tag: Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)
advice_items.summary_zh: 坚持零负债稳健经营，不被高杠杆拖垮
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid heavy leverage and operate debt-free (only financing core equipment like trucks you keep for 10 years) so you can survive mistakes and keep exit proceeds.
advice_items.quote: Don't have debt. I'm a debt-free operator, right? So, that's key because if there's a mistake, you can rebound. And a lot of guys leverage all the debt up... they're so broke because they're leveraged up.
advice_items.video_title: Asking NY Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 保持每天健身自律，身体纪律决定事业高度
advice_items.summary_en: Physical fitness and daily gym discipline directly reinforce the mental discipline required for financial success.
advice_items.quote: If you got the discipline to go to the gym every single day and take care of yourself, it starts right here.
advice_items.video_title: Asking NY Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 经历鬼门关后更加笃信信仰，懂得感恩敬畏
advice_items.summary_en: Stay grounded in faith and remember that surviving major health crises puts life and success in perspective.
advice_items.quote: When I sold my business two months later, I had a massive heart attack... my survival rate in the hospital was 11%... You want to wake up? That's a wakeup call.
advice_items.video_title: Asking NY Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 学历低也绝不听信质疑，坚定追求心中目标
advice_items.summary_en: Do not let limited formal education or doubters stop you from pursuing what you know you can achieve.
advice_items.quote: I got a third grade education. I'm not a schooled guy... Because I know I was better than that and I know what I wanted and I was going to go for it.
advice_items.video_title: Asking NY Billionaires How They Got Rich!

guests.wealth_detail: Became a millionaire at 23; business on track for $20M/yr (with partners)
guests.first_money_or_break: 18岁离开沙特阿拉伯上大学时因父亲生意失败断了经济来源，顶着英语不佳同时打两三份工养活自己和家人，在无路可退中被迫创业，23岁成为百万富翁。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: After leaving Saudi Arabia for college at 18 and losing financial support when his father's business failed, he worked two or three jobs despite limited English to support himself and his family. Forced into entrepreneurship with no safety net, he became a millionaire at 23.
guests.zero_start_advice: 别等万事俱备再行动，要在行动中摸索成长；尽早掌握销售与个人品牌能力，利用短视频前3秒强钩子和鲜明观点建立个人影响力。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Don't wait for everything to be ready before taking action, because you learn and grow by doing. Master sales and personal branding early, using strong 3-second hooks and bold viewpoints in short-form videos to build influence.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich!

appearances.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 把过往困境与背景化为赚钱的动力
advice_items.summary_en: Turn past hardships and humble beginnings into fuel to build wealth rather than excuses.
advice_items.quote: Whatever your past is, take that, take all the lessons and use it to just make a lot of money.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich!

guests.zero_start_advice: 通过卖方融资收购婴儿潮一代退休出售的害虫防治、暖通空调等“无聊但稳赚”的实体生意，从小店起就搭建可复制流程，并尽可能设计成经常性收入模式。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Use owner financing to acquire "boring" yet steady brick-and-mortar businesses like pest control or HVAC from retiring Baby Boomers. Build replicable processes from the very first store and structure the business for recurring revenue whenever possible.

advice_items.summary_en: Study what customers love and hate about an existing industry and build a better product.

advice_items.video_title: I Asked Dana White How He Made $500 Million!

advice_items.summary_en: Pair relentless drive with daily consistency across business, fitness, and relationships.

advice_items.summary_zh: 持续把赚来的钱再投资到自身成长和事业扩张中

advice_items.video_title: I Asked Dana White How He Made $500 Million!

guests.wealth_detail: $200M/yr business revenue

advice_items.summary_zh: 保持强大信念与大格局，敢于把梦想做大

advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Scottsdale)

guests.zero_start_advice_en: Find a great mentor to learn from, and recognize that you don't have to start your own company right away when you can first create value inside someone else's. Work in person at the office, and fiercely protect your honesty and reputation.

advice_items.summary_en: Stay driven by the love of building businesses, taking care of employees, and solving complex problems rather than chasing money.

advice_items.summary_en: Protect your single reputation by being honest with lenders and partners, doing the right thing, and delivering bad news fast.

guests.role_or_title: Public/Charter School Real Estate Developer & General Contractor
guests.wealth_detail: $100M-$150M annual revenue; $600M-$700M real estate portfolio (3M sq ft, with partners)
guests.first_money_or_break: 1999年向并不富裕的父亲借了3万美元，仅凭一辆皮卡和一包工具做起总承包生意；2008年金融危机时赌上全部身家买下原本替人代建的房产项目大获成功，随后做过十几家酒店并偶然接手皇后区一所旧天主教学校，发现特许学校场地缺口后重仓深耕至21所学校。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: In 1999, he borrowed $30,000 from his father of modest means to launch a general contracting business with just a pickup truck and a bag of tools. Betting everything in 2008 to buy a project he had been building for a client, he went on to do over a dozen hotels and acquired an old Catholic school in Queens, spotting the charter school facility shortage and scaling to 21 schools.
guests.zero_start_advice: 保持强烈的紧迫感，今日事今日毕；极度爱护个人声誉并信守承诺，同时对合作方“信任但要核实”；有耐心、按计划稳步推进，拿到优质资产后长期持有、切忌轻易卖出。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Operate with intense urgency to finish today's work today, fiercely guard your reputation, and keep your word while adopting a "trust, but verify" approach with partners. Stay patient, execute your plan steadily, and hold onto quality assets for the long term instead of selling lightly.

advice_items.summary_en: Operate with a relentless sense of urgency and never delay until tomorrow what can be executed today.

guests.role_or_title: Business Consultant & Former US Army Battle Captain
guests.wealth_detail: $15M/yr peak annual income; $2.1M earned in 1 hour from a stage talk
guests.first_money_or_break: 父母分别是保洁员和仅受过二三年级教育的佃农；她在美军服役21年并三度赴战场担任作战连长，退役后凭人生经验转型商业顾问，用自身演讲与咨询能力创办无需融资的企业，单年收入最高达1500万美元，曾一小时演讲成交210万美元。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Born to a custodian and a sharecropper with only a second- or third-grade education, she served 21 years in the U.S. Army, including three combat tours as a company commander. After retiring, she leveraged her speaking and consulting skills into a bootstrapped business consultancy that peaked at $15 million in a single year and once closed $2.1 million from a one-hour talk.
guests.zero_start_advice: 不要等拿到融资才行动，先靠自身知识和表达能力轻资产创业；不要躲在公司品牌背后，全力打造个人品牌；与高净值人士交流时先问能如何支持对方，敢于利用杠杆且拒绝被他人的恐惧束缚，立刻起步。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Don't wait for funding to start; launch an asset-light business with your knowledge and communication skills, and build a bold personal brand rather than hiding behind a company name. When speaking with high-net-worth individuals, ask how you can support them, embrace leverage, refuse to be held back by others' fears, and start immediately.

advice_items.summary_en: Cultivate self-earned confidence by surviving rock bottom and knowing nothing can stop you.

guests.wealth_detail: Sold 7-Eleven for "many billions of dollars" (company sale as CEO)
guests.first_money_or_break: 出身极其贫寒（童年住所没有自来水），以“企业内部创业者”的身份在大公司一路晋升，最终担任7-Eleven与百视达两家财富500强企业CEO，并主导了7-Eleven数十亿美元的出售交易。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Growing up in extreme poverty without running water, he climbed the corporate ladder as an "intrapreneur" to become CEO of two Fortune 500 companies, 7-Eleven and Blockbuster. He also led the multi-billion-dollar sale of 7-Eleven.
guests.zero_start_advice: 并非所有人都适合白手起家单干，进入大企业做“内部创业者”同样能借助平台结构获得成功；在商界要无所畏惧地沟通交易、看重团队关系，并牢记现金流、沟通力和品格三大要素。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Not everyone needs to start from scratch on their own; becoming an "intrapreneur" inside a large company lets you leverage an existing platform to succeed. Communicate fearlessly in deals, value team relationships, and always prioritize cash flow, communication, and character.

advice_items.summary_zh: 保持强健体魄和自律状态以应对日常挑战
advice_items.summary_en: Stay physically fit and disciplined every day.
advice_items.quote: Every day is a new adventure. You got to stay fit to get out of these things.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaire Texans How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 培养无畏心态，敢于主动与人沟通促成交易
advice_items.summary_en: Be fearless—walk up to people and transact without hesitation.
advice_items.quote: Fearlessness... It's the ability to walk up to somebody and be able to transact without any fear.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaire Texans How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 人际关系与人才团队是公司最宝贵的资源
advice_items.summary_en: Relationships and your team are the most valuable asset of any company.
advice_items.quote: Relationships are everything. It took me almost my entire career to realize that the most valuable resource of any company is the human resource... Your team is critically important to your success.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaire Texans How They Got Rich!

advice_items.canonical_tag: Work Under a Winner First Before Starting
advice_items.summary_zh: 若不适合单干，可在大企业内部做创业者
advice_items.summary_en: Leverage corporate structure by acting as a corporate entrepreneur.
advice_items.quote: Not everybody is an entrepreneur. And the corporate world provides an entrepreneurial opportunity. You still have to be an entrepreneur to be successful in the corporate world. I call it being a corporate entrepreneur.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaire Texans How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 现金流是企业氧气，紧盯债务与应收应付账款
advice_items.summary_en: Treat cash flow as oxygen and closely monitor debt, payables, and receivables.
advice_items.quote: Cash flow is critical to any business. It's your oxygen. You got to watch your debt and you got to watch your payables and receivables.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaire Texans How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 困境最能考验品格与韧性，决定最终成败
advice_items.summary_en: Character, values, and resilience in hard times separate winners from losers.
advice_items.quote: In times of trouble, you are going to be tested. Your values, your resilience, your self-confidence will all be on the line. Character is what will ultimately separate a winner from a loser.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaire Texans How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 从经典读物中汲取领导力与做人原则
advice_items.summary_en: Draw timeless business and leadership principles from foundational books like The Boy Scout Handbook.
advice_items.quote: You know what the strongest book I read in business was? ... The Boy Scout Handbook... A scout is trustworthy, loyal, helpful, friendly, courteous, kind, obedient, cheerful, thrifty, brave, clean, reverent.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaire Texans How They Got Rich!

guests.role_or_title: Bank Owner & Executive (44 years in banking)
guests.wealth_detail: ~$500M/year (most made in a single year)
guests.first_money_or_break: 早年曾经历经济拮据，随后在银行业深耕44年，主要通过收购银行并削减冗余成本实现规模化扩张，将旗下业务做到年营收约5亿美元。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: After facing financial hardship early on, he spent 44 years in banking, scaling primarily by acquiring banks and cutting redundant costs. Through this strategy, he grew his business to roughly $500 million in annual revenue.
guests.zero_start_advice: 尽早独立创业，全力聚焦A计划而不留退路，牢牢掌握现金流避免盲目扩张耗尽资本，融资时避免让单一投资人话语权过大，并在谈判中敢于离场。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Start your own venture early and commit fully to Plan A with no fallback, keeping tight control over cash flow so reckless expansion never drains your capital. Avoid giving any single investor outsized leverage when raising money, and never be afraid to walk away from a negotiation.

advice_items.summary_zh: 专注A计划，别留B计划分散精力

advice_items.summary_zh: 懂现金流，别因扩张过快耗尽资本

advice_items.quote: they don't understand cash flow... a lot of businesses will grow fast and thinking they're successful and they outstrip their capital
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Dallas)

advice_items.canonical_tag: Be Careful Who You Partner With
advice_items.summary_zh: 别让单一投资人占股过大而失去控制权
advice_items.summary_en: Do not let any single investor hold too much leverage or you end up working for them.
advice_items.quote: don't let any investor be too big or otherwise you're working for them
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Dallas)

advice_items.summary_zh: 每天坚持去健身房锻炼并健康饮食
advice_items.summary_en: Go to the gym every day and eat well to maintain health and energy as you age.
advice_items.quote: get to the gym every day and eat well
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Dallas)

advice_items.canonical_tag: Don't Wait Too Long to Start / Invest
advice_items.summary_zh: 后悔没有比当年更早出来独立创业
advice_items.summary_en: He wishes he had gone out on his own and started his own business sooner.
advice_items.quote: go out on my own sooner than I did
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Dallas)

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.summary_zh: 想赚大钱通常必须靠自己创业持有股权
advice_items.summary_en: While entrepreneurship is not for everyone, making real wealth usually requires working for yourself.
advice_items.quote: not everybody's built for it, but if you want to make real money you usually have to make it working for yourself
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Dallas)

advice_items.summary_zh: 谈判最好的策略是敢于主动起身离开
advice_items.summary_en: Be willing to walk away during negotiations; the best deals often come back to you.
advice_items.quote: walk away. The best deals I've done in my life I've walked away and they've come back
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Dallas)

guests.wealth_detail: Sold HomeServe in 2023 for £4.1 billion (~$5B); paid nearly £100M in taxes
guests.first_money_or_break: 父亲是公务员，曾祖父母在1929年大萧条破产。童年受实业家启发决心创业，最终深耕家居管道维修领域创办HomeServe，并于2023年以41亿英镑（约50亿美元）出售。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: With a civil servant father and great-grandparents bankrupted by the 1929 Great Depression, he was inspired by industrialists in childhood to become an entrepreneur. Focusing on home plumbing repairs, he founded HomeServe and sold it in 2023 for £4.1 billion (about $5 billion).
guests.zero_start_advice: 先找准自己喜欢且擅长的职能（销售、财务或运营），去行业大公司和小型创业公司各历练两三年，积累五六年经验后，用卖方融资的方式收购退休老板的企业，风险远低于白手起家。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Identify a core function you enjoy and excel at, such as sales, finance, or operations, and spend two to three years each at a large industry player and a small startup. After five or six years of experience, buy out a retiring owner using seller financing, which carries far less risk than starting from scratch.
recommended_books_or_mentors: Good to Great by Jim Collins
How to Make a Billion in Nine Steps by Richard Harpin

advice_items.summary_zh: 深耕刚需传统行业，复制并微调成熟商业模式
advice_items.summary_en: Don't reinvent the wheel; look at proven models in unsexy industries like home services, copy one yourself, and improve it slightly.
advice_items.quote: My advice to any aspiring entrepreneur would be, first of all, copy a business model... copy and then improve slightly. Don't reinvent the wheel.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How Much They Pay In Taxes!

advice_items.summary_zh: 做刺猬型创业者，列“不做清单”并屏蔽诱惑
advice_items.summary_en: Be a disciplined hedgehog with a clear model and a 'not-to-do list' so shiny-object distractions don't derail you.
advice_items.quote: We need to be hedgehogs moving in a methodical direction... we keep going with a very simple, clear model without distractions. A not to-do list is more important than a to-do list.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How Much They Pay In Taxes!

advice_items.summary_zh: 寻找教练与导师，向过来人借力学习
advice_items.summary_en: Get a coach and a mentor; learning directly from others accelerates business growth.
advice_items.quote: Thirdly, get a coach and a mentor. Really important to learn from others.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How Much They Pay In Taxes!

advice_items.summary_zh: 雇比你更强的人接手日常运营并授权本土人才
advice_items.summary_en: Hire your replacement—people better than you—and local leaders to run operations so you can focus on vision and growth.
advice_items.quote: Hire somebody that's better than you to run the day-to-day business... hire other people to do those other things that we don't like doing so you can focus on the vision and the growth.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How Much They Pay In Taxes!

advice_items.summary_zh: 怀抱回馈社会之心，合规纳税支持创业环境
advice_items.summary_en: Believe in giving back and paying fair taxes to support the country that enabled you to build and scale globally.
advice_items.quote: I paid nearly 100 million pounds in tax when I sold HomeServe, but it was worth it because I made a lot of money and I do believe in giving back and paying taxes.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How Much They Pay In Taxes!

advice_items.canonical_tag: Work Under a Winner First Before Starting
advice_items.summary_zh: 先在大厂和创业公司打工攒经验，再独立掌舵
advice_items.summary_en: Master a core skill by working 2-3 years at a large company and 2-3 years at a smaller entrepreneurial firm before going out on your own.
advice_items.quote: Go and work for a big company in an industry that you like and get experience for two or three years. Then go and work for a smaller entrepreneurial company in that same role.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How Much They Pay In Taxes!

advice_items.canonical_tag: Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)
advice_items.summary_zh: 善用卖方融资，用目标公司未来利润收购成熟生意
advice_items.summary_en: Use vendor finance to buy an existing business from a retiring owner out of its future profits rather than risking capital from scratch.
advice_items.quote: Say I'll buy your business, but I'll pay you over three or four years out of the future profits. So, you can buy a business, it's lower risk than setting up from scratch, and you can use their money to acquire it, which is called vendor finance.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How Much They Pay In Taxes!

guests.guest_name: Youngest Nigerian Unicorn Founder (Andela & Flutterwave Co-Founder)
guests.role_or_title: Co-Founder of Andela & Flutterwave (35-Year-Old Tech Entrepreneur)
guests.wealth_detail: Built two $1B+ valuation companies (Andela & Flutterwave), each doing well over $100M/yr; millionaire at 23
guests.first_money_or_break: 受电影《社交网络》启发在大学决定创业，先从担任导师Joe Lonsdale（字幕作Jolon/Joe Lonto）的实习生起步，23岁成为百万富翁，并联合创办Andela与Flutterwave两家独角兽企业。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Inspired by the movie "The Social Network" in college, he began as an intern for mentor Joe Lonsdale (captioned as Jolon/Joe Lonto) and became a millionaire at 23. He went on to co-found two unicorn startups, Andela and Flutterwave.
guests.zero_start_advice: 先通过实习等方式服务成功人士（常问“我能帮什么忙”），结交有抱负的朋友；搭建自动化招聘与复盘系统并对齐顶尖团队利益，通过解决年轻人口需求、帮他人赚钱来创造持续财富。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Serve successful people early through internships by constantly asking how you can help, and surround yourself with ambitious peers. Build automated hiring and review systems that align top talent's incentives, creating lasting wealth by serving young demographics and helping others make money.
recommended_books_or_mentors: Joe Lonsdale (mentor; transcript: Jolon / Joe Lonto)
Mark Zuckerberg (inspiration via The Social Network & investor)

advice_tags: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value

advice_items.summary_zh: 打破地域限制，别人能做到你也能
advice_items.summary_en: Believe that if founders elsewhere can build billion-dollar companies, you can build them locally too.
advice_items.quote: I just thought if people elsewhere in the world could do it, there was no reason why somebody here in Africa couldn't do it as well.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Nigerian Billionaires How They Got RICH!

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.summary_zh: 帮他人赚钱，解决真实需求就能致富
advice_items.summary_en: Sustainable wealth comes from helping others earn money and solving real needs at scale.
advice_items.quote: Sustainable wealth comes from helping other people... we took people who are earning $100 a month... into careers where they're earning $300, $400,000 a year.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Nigerian Billionaires How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 搭建自动化系统，凝聚顶尖人才团队
advice_items.summary_en: Build automatic recruiting and review systems, and align A-players into one shared mission instead of building separately.
advice_items.quote: It's all about systems... you need to make things automatic... A billion-dollar company is just a bunch of people who could have individually built $10 million businesses who decided to come together.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Nigerian Billionaires How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 结交有上进心和实力的朋友
advice_items.summary_en: Build genuine friendships with ambitious, capable people who are actively going somewhere.
advice_items.quote: Two poor men cannot help each other... I got where I am because of friendships with people who are going somewhere.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Nigerian Billionaires How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 从实习生做起，先服务才能链接贵人
advice_items.summary_en: Start by serving successful mentors as an intern and leading with 'How can I help?' rather than taking.
advice_items.quote: I started as his intern... the biggest advice for networking is serve people. How can I help? Don't be a taker. Give, give, give.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Nigerian Billionaires How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 保持信仰，视自己为资源的管家
advice_items.summary_en: Stay grounded in faith and treat yourself as a steward of resources meant to work and serve.
advice_items.quote: I always make sure that I am consistently doing God's will and I consider myself just a steward of his resources.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Nigerian Billionaires How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 专注去创造，世界仍有巨大建设空间
advice_items.summary_en: Focus on building things that serve humanity—wealth will follow naturally along the way.
advice_items.quote: Build. Build. So much of the world still needs to be built. There's an opportunity for you to build there and be of service to humanity.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Nigerian Billionaires How They Got RICH!

guests.role_or_title: Real Estate Developer & Miami Dolphins Owner
guests.wealth_detail: $17B net worth (over $15B)
guests.first_money_or_break: 白手起家（以1万美元创业且从未拿过外部投资者一分钱），通过房地产开发在35岁左右成为亿万富翁，后收购NFL迈阿密海豚队。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Starting from scratch with $10,000 and never taking a dime from outside investors, he built a real estate empire that made him a billionaire around age 35. He later went on to acquire the NFL's Miami Dolphins.
guests.zero_start_advice: 先了解自己，随后立大志并付诸行动；看准机会果断执行，敢于承担风险；瞄准行业一流并组建强大团队，同时兼顾社会影响力与回馈。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Start by knowing yourself, then dream big and take decisive action on opportunities without shying away from risk. Aim to be best-in-class with a strong team, while staying committed to social impact and giving back.

advice_items.summary_zh: 敢于立下远大志向，格局要足够宏大
advice_items.summary_en: Think big and aspire to ambitious goals because you never know how far they can take you.
advice_items.quote: You aspire to things. You never know where you end up. But, you got to think big.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Celebrities How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 人人都有想法，成败关键在于看到机会就执行
advice_items.summary_en: Everyone has ideas, but success comes down to executing and acting decisively when you spot an opportunity.
advice_items.quote: It's really execution. You know, today everybody has ideas. It's the ability to execute... When you see opportunity, you have to act upon [it].
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Celebrities How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 热爱所做之事与成功本身，而非只为金钱
advice_items.summary_en: Billionaires love what they do and thrive on the impact and fulfillment of achieving what others won't, not just money.
advice_items.quote: They love what they're doing. And I mean, it's not about the money. It's about the love of success, how that makes you feel, and doing things that other people aren't doing.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Celebrities How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 在创造财富同时回馈社会，才能获得成就感
advice_items.summary_en: Combine making money with giving back and creating real impact so your work remains fulfilling.
advice_items.quote: It's not all about making money. You're giving back the same time. And if you don't have that feeling of giving back, you lose that fulfillment of having done something.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Celebrities How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 创业必须敢于承担风险，失败了也要相信自己
advice_items.summary_en: Entrepreneurship requires taking risks without fear and maintaining self-belief even when things don't go as planned.
advice_items.quote: You got to take risks... I believe in myself and if I fail, not everything works out the way you expect, but you just got to believe overall what you're doing.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Celebrities How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 追求成为行业顶尖，并依靠优秀团队成事
advice_items.summary_en: Aim to be best-in-class and build a united organization of great people, because you cannot scale alone.
advice_items.quote: You got to shoot to be the best and you want your organization and people to believe in that... It's about people. You don't do it yourself.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Celebrities How They Got Rich!

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.summary_zh: 选对高增长且营商环境优越的地区发展
advice_items.summary_en: Operate in high-opportunity, business-friendly markets like South Florida and West Palm Beach.
advice_items.quote: South Florida, I see Palm Beach County, West Palm Beach is probably offering the most amount of opportunity of any place... state of Florida is probably the best business state.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Celebrities How They Got Rich!

guests.role_or_title: Oscar-Winning Actor, Author & Pantalones Tequila Co-Founder
guests.first_money_or_break: 大学时在酒吧结识制片人Don Phillips并毛遂自荐，次日早9点半试镜获得《年少轻狂》角色，毕业后带2000美元驾U-Haul闯荡好莱坞。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: In college, he met producer Don Phillips at a bar, pitched himself, and landed a role in "Dazed and Confused" at a 9:30 AM audition the very next morning. After graduating, he drove a U-Haul to Hollywood with $2,000 to chase his career.
guests.zero_start_advice: 年轻时多承担风险，在行业里坚持深耕以结识人脉、接住非工作时间出现的微小机遇；敢于拒绝不适合的高薪，转型时不退缩。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Take more risks while you're young and stay persistent in your industry to build relationships and catch small opportunities that appear off the clock. Have the courage to turn down lucrative offers that don't fit, and never shrink from pivoting.

advice_items.summary_zh: 跨过学习笨拙期，把技能磨成专业本能
advice_items.summary_en: Persist through the clumsy learning phase until deliberate study turns instinct into mastery.
advice_items.quote: There's always a clumsy bridge when we start to learn what we instinctually know how to do. And if you can persist over that bridge... becoming an expert at your craft
