advice_items.summary_zh: 在事业转型关键期敢于牺牲且毫不退缩
advice_items.summary_en: Be willing to make sacrifices, walk away from easy money, and never flinch during a career pivot.
advice_items.quote: If you're going to pivot, don't flinch.
advice_items.video_title: Asking One of Hollywood's Biggest Stars How He Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 高分不如拼搏，兼顾苦干与街头嗅觉
advice_items.summary_en: Academic grades don't replace hustle; combine relentless work ethic with street smarts.
advice_items.quote: I don't care if you got a 4.9 GPA. You have to hustle. And I mean hustle in the work ethic sense, but also in the street sense, man.
advice_items.video_title: Asking One of Hollywood's Biggest Stars How He Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 果断抓住微小机会，切忌犹豫错失窗口
advice_items.summary_en: Jump on off-hours opportunities immediately before hesitation closes the window.
advice_items.quote: You will have little opportunities and you've got to hit it cuz as soon as you think, oh, should I hit that opportunity? Window closes.
advice_items.video_title: Asking One of Hollywood's Biggest Stars How He Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 只投身并代言自己真正喜爱与认可的事业
advice_items.summary_en: Only build or back businesses that you genuinely like and authentically believe in.
advice_items.quote: So, one, I got to believe in it, I got to like it... anything that I back even in my portfolio that I don't have to put on a proverbial another hat to talk about. No, I believe it.
advice_items.video_title: Asking One of Hollywood's Biggest Stars How He Got Rich!

advice_items.canonical_tag: Don't Wait Too Long to Start / Invest
advice_items.summary_zh: 遗憾年轻时冒的风险不够多，鼓励趁早搏
advice_items.summary_en: Take more risks when you are young; even after taking many, you may wish you had taken more.
advice_items.quote: And I say I wish I had taken more risk as a kid. I look back, I took quite a few risks as a kid. I still wish I would have taken more.
advice_items.video_title: Asking One of Hollywood's Biggest Stars How He Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 留在行业内持续深耕，人脉与机遇自会到来
advice_items.summary_en: Stay in the game so you meet people, receive offers, and catch unexpected opportunities.
advice_items.quote: But you stay in it, you will meet people, you will get offers, you will get an opportunity.
advice_items.video_title: Asking One of Hollywood's Biggest Stars How He Got Rich!

guests.role_or_title: Content Creator, WWE Wrestler & Co-Founder of Prime
guests.wealth_detail: First $1M at age 21; $25M-$30M/yr ($50M+ in a single year at age 22); Prime did $1.2B in year 2
guests.first_money_or_break: 9岁起就在YouTube上传视频，在没有“网红”概念的年代坚持创作9至10年、积累了一万小时经验后，借力Vine短视频爆发；21岁成为百万富翁，22岁单年个人收入超5000万美元，随后打造服装品牌并与合伙人创立饮料品牌Prime（第二年营收达12亿美元）。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Uploading videos to YouTube since age 9, he spent 9 to 10 years logging 10,000 hours of creation before "influencers" existed, then broke out on Vine to become a millionaire at 21 and earn over $50 million personally at 22. He later built an apparel brand and co-founded the beverage brand Prime, which hit $1.2 billion in revenue in its second year.
guests.zero_start_advice: 先因为真正热爱而投入创作，用多年时间打磨吸引注意力的能力并大量尝试不同领域；不要被陌生人的评价左右，在建立起个人影响力后寻找优秀的商业合伙人共同放大品牌价值。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Create out of genuine passion first, spending years honing your ability to capture attention and experimenting widely. Ignore opinions from strangers, and once you build personal influence, team up with strong business partners to scale your brand's value.
guests.primary_video_title: I Asked Logan Paul How He Built a Billion-Dollar Business

appearances.video_title: I Asked Logan Paul How He Built a Billion-Dollar Business

advice_items.summary_zh: 商业变现之前必须发自内心地热爱创作本身
advice_items.summary_en: You have to genuinely love the craft of making content before layering business monetization on top of it.
advice_items.quote: If you're doing this, you got to do it cuz you love it. The business is a great step you can add to what you're building, but you have to love making content.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Logan Paul How He Built a Billion-Dollar Business

advice_items.summary_zh: 在核心优势基础上围绕多元兴趣拓展收入版图
advice_items.summary_en: Diversify across ventures aligned with your interests once your core audience or platform is established.
advice_items.quote: It's so important. I have a unique, diverse set of interests, and I get to do all of them because I started with this.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Logan Paul How He Built a Billion-Dollar Business

advice_items.summary_zh: 把注意力当作货币，用内容引发强烈情绪共鸣
advice_items.summary_en: Master capturing and directing audience attention through content, ensuring people feel something rather than indifference.
advice_items.quote: Attention is a currency. How you wield that attention, that's the art. The opposite of hate is not love, it's indifference. You got to make people feel.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Logan Paul How He Built a Billion-Dollar Business

advice_items.summary_zh: 不被陌生人的评价定义自己，屏蔽外界噪音
advice_items.summary_en: Never let strangers' criticism define your identity or derail what you are building.
advice_items.quote: No stranger is going to tell me who I am... Everyone's entitled to their opinion and I'm entitled to think your opinion doesn't matter to me.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Logan Paul How He Built a Billion-Dollar Business

advice_items.summary_zh: 爆红前需先经历十年磨一剑与一万小时积累
advice_items.summary_en: Put in years and 10,000 hours of unglamorous work before expecting an overnight breakthrough.
advice_items.quote: We were making content for 9, 10 years before we took off on Vine. We had logged our 10,000 hours... we had put in the work.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Logan Paul How He Built a Billion-Dollar Business

advice_items.summary_zh: 心怀信仰与日常感恩能让人生实现彻底扭转
advice_items.summary_en: Leading with faith and daily gratitude can completely turn around your mindset and life trajectory.
advice_items.quote: When I respected God and accepted him and opened my heart and started having real conversations with him daily, I led with gratitude... my life's been 180'd.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Logan Paul How He Built a Billion-Dollar Business

advice_items.summary_zh: 多去行动和尝试各种兴趣，直到找到命中天赋
advice_items.summary_en: Experiment broadly and take more shots across different interests until you discover your true pocket.
advice_items.quote: Do more. Life's not short, you just got to do more. Try to experiment and find everything you can in life that interests you and eventually something's going to click.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Logan Paul How He Built a Billion-Dollar Business

guests.guest_name: San Antonio Audi R8 Real Estate & Exotic Car Rental Owner
guests.role_or_title: Real Estate / Airbnb Investor (~38-40 Units) & Exotic Car Rental Owner
guests.wealth_detail: $1.3M/yr gross; ~38-40 properties/units; 6-car fleet
guests.first_money_or_break: 通过在YouTube上联系一位做Airbnb的朋友，用健身私教培训交换学习机会起步，随后在房产基础上叠加Turo豪车租赁业务。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: He got started by reaching out to an Airbnb host on YouTube and trading personal fitness training for mentorship. He later layered a Turo exotic car rental business on top of his real estate holdings.
guests.zero_start_advice: 先找到真正热爱并愿意全力以赴的领域，投入并吃透规则后不断复制；若零房产起步，先在Airbnb等网站深入调研目标城市与地段再果断出手；若做豪车租赁，可通过成立LLC建立商业信用拿车。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Find a field you truly love and commit wholeheartedly, mastering its rules so you can replicate your success. If starting with zero properties, research target cities and neighborhoods thoroughly on platforms like Airbnb before pulling the trigger, and form an LLC to build business credit for acquiring rental cars.
recommended_books_or_mentors: Friend from YouTube (traded fitness training for Airbnb pointers)
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Entrepreneurs How They Got RICH! (San Antonio)

appearances.video_title: Asking Entrepreneurs How They Got RICH! (San Antonio)

advice_tags: Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)

advice_items.summary_zh: 保持自律与全天候持续行动，终能成功
advice_items.summary_en: Stay disciplined and consistent 24/7 even as life responsibilities grow.
advice_items.quote: stay consistent 24 7 because as you get older things that get in your life so discipline and just being consistent man you can make it anywhere
advice_items.video_title: Asking Entrepreneurs How They Got RICH! (San Antonio)

advice_items.summary_zh: 投身热爱并深耕复制，滚雪球式扩张
advice_items.summary_en: Pick something you are truly passionate about, master everything around it, and repeat the winning playbook.
advice_items.quote: finding something that you're really really passionate about first because when you're passionate about it you typically go pretty hard and then invest in it learn everything around it and then from there duplicate that same deal every single time
advice_items.video_title: Asking Entrepreneurs How They Got RICH! (San Antonio)

advice_items.summary_zh: 保持谦逊心态，永不停止学习成长
advice_items.summary_en: Stay humble and open-minded so you never stop learning and growing.
advice_items.quote: staying humble is a very very key to grow with the humbleness you never stop learning
advice_items.video_title: Asking Entrepreneurs How They Got RICH! (San Antonio)

advice_items.summary_zh: 主动链接成功者与导师，用技能换取指导
advice_items.summary_en: Reach out to practitioners you see online, trade skills for mentorship, and learn from programs and peers.
advice_items.quote: it was a friend of mine that I saw on the internet on YouTube I've reached out to him... I actually did Training Fitness training as an exchange instead of actually paying for the service... I learned a lot from everybody
advice_items.video_title: Asking Entrepreneurs How They Got RICH! (San Antonio)

advice_items.summary_zh: 充分调研城市与地段后，果断入手首套房产
advice_items.summary_en: Research target cities and neighborhoods thoroughly on Airbnb before diving into your first property deal.
advice_items.quote: definitely research I would research a whole lot... go to Airbnb itself look at the city that you're looking at and look at the area try to find something around that area... and just dive into it
advice_items.video_title: Asking Entrepreneurs How They Got RICH! (San Antonio)

advice_items.canonical_tag: Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)
advice_items.summary_zh: 善用LLC与商业信用，配置生息租车资产
advice_items.summary_en: Form an LLC and build business credit to finance cash-flowing rental vehicles into your fleet.
advice_items.quote: go and learn how to get the vehicles in your LLC you might have to build up some business credit... you can grow really fast actually in the Exotic if that's like your go-to
advice_items.video_title: Asking Entrepreneurs How They Got RICH! (San Antonio)

advice_items.summary_zh: 在现有资产之上叠加新业务，打造多元收入
advice_items.summary_en: Layer complementary cash-flowing businesses—like exotic car rentals for Airbnb guests—on top of existing assets.
advice_items.quote: for me it was just something to be another layer on top of something else already had
advice_items.video_title: Asking Entrepreneurs How They Got RICH! (San Antonio)

guests.role_or_title: Tech Startup Founder & Co-founder of Haymaker (Previously Exited Tech Startup)
guests.first_money_or_break: 大学期间当酒保时，常有戴尔、应用材料和英特尔的从业者光顾，他主动恳求其中一人给自己科技销售机会从而入行；2014年推出应用并在2018年成功退出。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: While tending bar in college for regulars from Dell, Applied Materials, and Intel, he persistently asked one of them for a shot in tech sales to break into the industry. He later launched an app in 2014 and achieved a successful exit in 2018.
guests.zero_start_advice: 在写代码做产品前先大量访谈目标客户决策者以验证痛点与市场规模，拿到早期试点承诺后再开发MVP，并用低成本测试和早期营收滚雪球后再融资。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Before writing a single line of code, interview plenty of target decision-makers to validate the pain point and market size, and secure early pilot commitments before building an MVP. Snowball through low-cost testing and early revenue before raising capital.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking A Tech Millionaire How To Start & Scale a Tech Company

appearances.video_title: Asking A Tech Millionaire How To Start & Scale a Tech Company

advice_tags: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.summary_zh: 做产品前先访谈客户验证痛点与市场
advice_items.summary_en: Interview potential clients and decision-makers to validate pain points, TAM, and secure a pilot commitment before building an MVP.
advice_items.quote: Before you create anything you need to understand the viability of the product and the total addressable market... start with interviewing as many potential clients as you can.
advice_items.video_title: Asking A Tech Millionaire How To Start & Scale a Tech Company

advice_items.summary_zh: 克服完美主义尽早拿半成品给客户反馈
advice_items.summary_en: Overcome perfectionism by showing an imperfect product early to gather constructive feedback and get clients bought in.
advice_items.quote: Perfectionism is really a form of insecurity... show them something, admit it's not perfect, and ask what can we do to make this perfect for you.
advice_items.video_title: Asking A Tech Millionaire How To Start & Scale a Tech Company

advice_items.summary_zh: 把逆境和挫折视为成长与蜕变的必经之路
advice_items.summary_en: Embrace setbacks and adversity as part of the entrepreneurial journey that builds resilience and prepares you to help others.
advice_items.quote: Adversity and setbacks are part of the journey... those are the things that will shape you into a really successful person who can overcome obstacles.
advice_items.video_title: Asking A Tech Millionaire How To Start & Scale a Tech Company

advice_items.summary_zh: 低成本测试并把营收复投增长后再融资
advice_items.summary_en: Build and test cheaply, reinvest early revenue to grow MRR and repeatable customer acquisition, then raise outside capital.
advice_items.quote: It is a lot cheaper now to build a product and test your product... generating some revenues where you can keep investing back into the business, build traction, then take it out for investment.
advice_items.video_title: Asking A Tech Millionaire How To Start & Scale a Tech Company

advice_items.summary_zh: 低于自身时薪的工作就外包并规划全职招聘
advice_items.summary_en: Outsource tasks costing less than your hourly rate and build budgets and forecasts to hire permanent team members as you scale.
advice_items.quote: If I could outsource this for less than my hourly rate then I'm gonna outsource; if it means bringing on someone permanent, budget for it and build your forecasts.
advice_items.video_title: Asking A Tech Millionaire How To Start & Scale a Tech Company

advice_items.summary_zh: 企服靠直邮电销，消费品重社交媒体
advice_items.summary_en: Tailor marketing to your model: use direct email outreach, cold calling, and social media for enterprise, and lean heavily on social media for consumer plays.
advice_items.quote: If you're an enterprise play... it's going to be a mix of social media, direct outreach through emails, I'd even be cold calling. If you're doing more of a consumer play, social media plays a pretty critical role.
advice_items.video_title: Asking A Tech Millionaire How To Start & Scale a Tech Company

advice_items.summary_zh: 按细分领域组建专家导师团而非只靠一人
advice_items.summary_en: Build a board of advisors who are experts in specific business areas rather than relying on a single mentor for everything.
advice_items.quote: There's a lot of nuance to running a business and you're not going to be an expert at everything, so go out and try to find people who are experts in those categories. I still have sales mentors.
advice_items.video_title: Asking A Tech Millionaire How To Start & Scale a Tech Company

guests.first_money_or_break: 22岁时与父母共同创办公立学校咨询公司，后独自前往外州开拓更大市场并成功退出。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: At 22, he co-founded a public school consulting firm with his parents. He later moved out of state on his own to capture a larger market and achieved a successful exit.
guests.zero_start_advice: 先通过上千次对话与实际销售验证想法；跨行创业时寻找热爱该领域的专家合伙，并通过高频拓展人脉、地推获客和清晰的品牌故事打开市场。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Validate your idea through thousands of conversations and real sales before scaling. When entering an unfamiliar industry, partner with passionate domain experts and break into the market through relentless networking, door-to-door outreach, and a clear brand story.
guests.primary_video_title: Entrepreneurs Guide To Start and Scale ANY Business

appearances.video_title: Entrepreneurs Guide To Start and Scale ANY Business

advice_tags: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value

advice_items.summary_zh: 敢于跳出舒适区，押注更大的市场
advice_items.summary_en: Leave comfortable lifestyle businesses behind and take calculated leaps into larger markets.
advice_items.quote: I could have played it safe... I decided to make the leap, move to an area of the country I knew nobody, had no resources.
advice_items.video_title: Entrepreneurs Guide To Start and Scale ANY Business

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.summary_zh: 发现行业痛点并提供全方位解决方案
advice_items.summary_en: Spot gaps where customers feel neglected and build a holistic solution for their real needs.
advice_items.quote: You are just a number and so I wanted to solve that problem... treat the whole athlete and not just what's broken.
advice_items.video_title: Entrepreneurs Guide To Start and Scale ANY Business

advice_items.summary_zh: 把失败当成商业游戏的必然组成部分
advice_items.summary_en: Accept upfront that failure and losing money on bad ideas are normal parts of building businesses.
advice_items.quote: Failure first of all is a part of the game, you just know going in you're going to throw money at bad ideas.
advice_items.video_title: Entrepreneurs Guide To Start and Scale ANY Business

advice_items.summary_zh: 用真实销售与千次对话验证商业想法
advice_items.summary_en: Validate business ideas strictly through real sales and at least 1,000 customer conversations before scaling.
advice_items.quote: Sales are your only indicator on whether you've got a great idea... I'd like to get to at least a thousand conversations.
advice_items.video_title: Entrepreneurs Guide To Start and Scale ANY Business

advice_items.summary_zh: 放下傲慢，尽可能多地结交优秀导师
advice_items.summary_en: Put aside pride early on and surround yourself with as many experienced mentors as possible.
advice_items.quote: It really proved incredibly valuable and now I try to surround myself with as many mentors as I possibly can.
advice_items.video_title: Entrepreneurs Guide To Start and Scale ANY Business

advice_items.summary_zh: 每周投入半数时间拓展人脉提升知名度
advice_items.summary_en: Dedicate 3 to 4 days a week to networking because getting a business off the ground depends on who you know.
advice_items.quote: I am fine doing three to four days a week in just networking... most of getting business going is all in who you know.
advice_items.video_title: Entrepreneurs Guide To Start and Scale ANY Business

advice_items.summary_zh: 戒掉个人英雄主义，授权团队解决问题
advice_items.summary_en: Stop being the bottleneck by centralizing decisions; listen and empower your team to own solutions.
advice_items.quote: In order to scale I have to shut up and I have to listen and I have to give permission for other people to own the solutions.
advice_items.video_title: Entrepreneurs Guide To Start and Scale ANY Business

guests.guest_name: Los Angeles Former Model & Real Estate Developer
guests.role_or_title: Real Estate Developer & Home Builder (Former Model)
guests.wealth_detail: $3.5M profit on last property
guests.first_money_or_break: 早年从事模特行业，退役后转型翻修房屋，再逐步发展为独立住宅开发与建造商，通过持续将利润再投资滚大项目规模。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Starting out as a model, the founder transitioned into house flipping after retiring from modeling and eventually grew into an independent residential developer and builder. By continually reinvesting profits, they steadily scaled up their projects.
guests.zero_start_advice: 起步时要敢于冒险并相信自己，把赚到的利润不断再投资并善用1031置换延税以做大规模。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Be willing to take risks and believe in yourself when starting out. Continuously reinvest your profits and leverage 1031 exchanges to defer taxes and scale faster.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich

appearances.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich

advice_items.summary_zh: 创业起步要敢于承担风险
advice_items.summary_en: Take calculated risks when starting out instead of letting fear hold you back.
advice_items.quote: one of the things that I love to teach my son is take a risk
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich

advice_items.summary_zh: 坚定相信自己和所做之事
advice_items.summary_en: Believe deeply in yourself and your work to create a high likelihood of success.
advice_items.quote: if you believe in yourself and you believe in what you do then the chances are you will be a success
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich

advice_items.summary_zh: 把利润反复再投资以做大规模
advice_items.summary_en: Continuously reinvest profits back into your business to scale from six to seven figures and beyond.
advice_items.quote: I was able to reinvest my profit over and over and over and what that did was that allowed me to get larger and larger
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich

advice_items.summary_zh: 善用1031置换递延税款滚大项目
advice_items.summary_en: Use tax-deferral tools like 1031 exchanges to roll profits into larger real estate builds.
advice_items.quote: do a 1031 exchange and what that does it allows you to push out your taxes because you rolling your profit into your next build
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich

advice_items.summary_zh: 坚信努力付出终有回报
advice_items.summary_en: Maintain a strong work ethic because consistent hard work pays off over time.
advice_items.quote: I'm a great believer in hard work pays off
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich

advice_items.summary_zh: 明确目标并保持专注直到达成
advice_items.summary_en: Define your goal clearly, stay locked in on it, and refuse to quit until you achieve it.
advice_items.quote: know your goal focus on the goal and don't stop until you get there
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich

guests.wealth_detail: $200M annual revenue
guests.first_money_or_break: 6岁随家人从哥伦比亚移民美国，两周后父母因执法突袭双双入狱，15岁挑起家庭重担打工谋生，21岁创办家庭安防公司并带队挨家挨户地推起步。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Immigrating to the U.S. from Colombia at age 6, he saw both parents imprisoned in a raid two weeks later and began working at 15 to support his family. At 21, he founded a home security company and launched it by leading door-to-door sales teams.
guests.zero_start_advice: 条件尚未齐备时就先行动并投入资源逼自己一把，坚持将收入三等分（1/3生活、1/3缴税储蓄、1/3设为绝对不动的备用金），靠自己彻底改写家族命运。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Take action and commit resources before everything feels ready to force yourself forward, and divide your income strictly into thirds: one-third for living, one-third for taxes and savings, and one-third as an untouchable reserve. Take full responsibility to rewrite your family's destiny.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich

appearances.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich

advice_tags: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep

advice_items.summary_zh: 用足够宏大的愿景吸引优秀人才
advice_items.summary_en: Scale by casting a vision large enough that talented people can fulfill their own dreams inside yours.
advice_items.quote: to bring in good people they have to believe in you you know your dreams got to be so big that everybody's dream can fit inside of it
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich

advice_items.summary_zh: 条件未齐先行动，用真金白银倒逼投入
advice_items.summary_en: Take action and commit resources before everything is in place to force real commitment.
advice_items.quote: faith is really taking action before you have what you need... when you put money behind something that's when you know you're committed
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich

advice_items.summary_zh: 主动置身高压不适环境以激发潜能
advice_items.summary_en: Intentionally place yourself in high-pressure, uncomfortable situations to unlock peak performance.
advice_items.quote: low stress is low performance but when you put yourself in these uncomfortable situations that's when that greatness that lies within comes out
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich

advice_items.summary_zh: 销售本质是信念传递，先让自己坚信产品
advice_items.summary_en: Validate your offering until you have total conviction, because selling is a transfer of belief.
advice_items.quote: people don't have to believe what you're saying they have to believe that you believe what you're saying cuz everything's a transfer of belief
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich

advice_items.canonical_tag: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep
advice_items.summary_zh: 收入三等分，只用三分之一生活并留备用金
advice_items.summary_en: Divide every paycheck into thirds: live on one-third, set aside one-third for taxes/savings, and lock one-third in an untouched reserve.
advice_items.quote: I would split my check three ways and I would live on a third of it one would go towards IRS and savings and then the other one would go towards a reserve account
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich

advice_items.summary_zh: 即便出身贫寒，也要立志改写家族命运
advice_items.summary_en: Decide that even if you were not born into wealth, you will be the one to transform your family's trajectory.
advice_items.quote: if you don't come from a rich family a rich family can come from you and I made the decision in my family that I was going to be the one person that changed my family tree forever
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich

guests.industry_zh: 营销代理与高客单销售
guests.wealth_detail: Nine-figure annual revenue; takes $4M-$5M/yr in distributions; millionaire at age 17

guests.first_money_or_break_en: Starting at 15 and a half driving traffic to websites, he landed a first client paying $5,000 a month and generated $25 million for them, earning three referrals that raised his income to $20,000 a month. By age 17, he became a millionaire.
guests.zero_start_advice: 若从零起步要在一年内赚100万美元，会利用卖家融资加SBA贷款收购60岁退休老板的屋顶、管道或暖通（HVAC）等传统枯燥实业，再通过表格自动化开票与Google本地排名优化实现增长。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: To make $1 million in a year starting from zero, he recommends combining seller financing with an SBA loan to buy a "boring" traditional business like roofing, plumbing, or HVAC from a 60-year-old retiring owner. Then drive rapid growth by automating invoicing with spreadsheets and optimizing local Google rankings.

advice_items.summary_en: Take only enough distributions to cover expenses and reinvest the bulk of profits into growth, talent, and acquisitions.

advice_items.summary_zh: 借力高互动中小网红按销售佣金推广产品
advice_items.summary_en: Use commission-based partnerships with engaged micro-influencers (1k-100k followers) as a high-ROI growth channel.
advice_items.quote: The number one highest ROI channel right now in marketing... is micro influencers between 1,000 and 100,000 followers... you can pay them commission base.

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.summary_zh: 瞄准庞大总目标市场，吃下极小份额即可做大
advice_items.summary_en: Target a massive Total Addressable Market (TAM) so capturing even a tiny percentage builds a huge business.
advice_items.quote: Most businesses fail because they're going after too small of a TAM... you want to go after something really big and just try to capture a small percentage of it.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got Rich! (Beverly Hills)

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.summary_zh: 为客户创造极致业绩回报，靠口碑转介绍裂变增长
advice_items.summary_en: Generate outsized measurable results for your clients so referrals naturally compound your growth.
advice_items.quote: My first client paid me 5 grand a month, I made him 25 million in revenue, got three more referrals... it just kept scaling from doing really good work.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got Rich! (Beverly Hills)

advice_items.summary_zh: 收购退休者手中的传统实业并做数字化升级增长
advice_items.summary_en: Acquire profitable, boring service businesses from retiring owners and modernize them with basic software and local SEO.
advice_items.quote: I would go buy a business from someone who's retiring in a boring, ugly field like roofing, plumbing, HVAC... put in technology... and grow the business.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got Rich! (Beverly Hills)

advice_items.quote: You would seller-based finance it... put down 2x profit which I can get bank financing for and you hold a note... the government helps, it's called SBA financing.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got Rich! (Beverly Hills)

guests.wealth_detail: Made first $1B at age 39; sold AI company for over $1B
guests.first_money_or_break: 由单亲妈妈抚养长大，家境普通，从基层销售助理起步；2020年早期入局AI并服务沙特政府及大型企业客户，39岁时以超10亿美元出售公司。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Raised in a modest household by a single mother, the founder started at the bottom as a junior sales associate. Entering AI early in 2020 to serve the Saudi government and major enterprise clients, they sold the company for over $1 billion at age 39.
guests.zero_start_advice: 走出家乡和居家舒适区，去全球有机会的地方建立连接，并先从小事入手从无到有创造作品。

advice_items.summary_en: Be willing to walk away from multi-million dollar deals if payment terms compromise product quality.
advice_items.quote: I'm happy to walk away from the deal rather than hurt my brand and hurt your outcome... we didn't even make it to the gate. They called us back immediately.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Middle Eastern Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 走出舒适圈与家乡，去全球一线现场面对面抓机会
advice_items.summary_en: Leave your hometown bubble and travel to where global deals and opportunities happen in person.

guests.wealth_detail: $300M/month in payment processing volume
guests.first_money_or_break: 在英国出生并接受教育，曾从事对冲基金行业，后定居迪拜创办支付处理公司，目前月交易处理量达3亿美元。

guests.zero_start_advice: 每天保持学习新知，在销售中深入研究客户并把拒绝当作沟通起点，投资上坚持恐慌期低吸并长期持有。

appearances.video_title: Asking Middle Eastern Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 勇于承担风险是每个人走向创业的必经课题
advice_items.summary_en: Recognize that building wealth through entrepreneurship requires learning to take risks.
advice_items.quote: Even if they don't know it yet, life will teach them to start taking risks.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Middle Eastern Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 每天坚持学习新知，停止学习就意味着失去竞争力
advice_items.summary_en: Commit to learning something new every day to stay competitive in business.

advice_items.video_title: Asking Middle Eastern Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 保持绝对自信，绝不允许怀疑者影响自己的判断
advice_items.summary_en: Project unshakable conviction and refuse to let others' doubts enter your environment.
advice_items.quote: I don't allow people in the room to doubt me... because it's the way I'm built. I won't allow it.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Middle Eastern Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 研究客户语言，把拒绝当作对方尚未理解的成交信号
advice_items.summary_en: Study your client's language, sell benefits with urgency, and treat 'no' as a prompt to explain better.
advice_items.quote: You learn the client... use the words they use... 'No' is just another version of someone saying, 'I don't understand. Sell me.'
advice_items.video_title: Asking Middle Eastern Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 在实战中保持灵活敏捷，将每次被拒化为武器库经验
advice_items.summary_en: Stay agile and turn every rejection into practical feedback for future deals.
advice_items.quote: In the real world, you need to adapt. You need to be mobile, you need to be agile. When someone says no... take that away and use that in your repertoire going forward.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Middle Eastern Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 理解周期规律，在市场恐慌低谷买入资产并长期持有
advice_items.summary_en: Understand market cycles, buy assets like crypto during fear, and hold through dips instead of panic-selling.
advice_items.quote: You're supposed to buy when people are fearful and sell when they're greedy... Buy when it's cheap, hold. It's only a negative if you realize and crystallize it.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Middle Eastern Billionaires How They Got Rich!

guests.role_or_title: Investor & Former Army Green Beret (PE, VC & Investment Banking)
guests.wealth_detail: $11M/yr peak revenue

guests.first_money_or_break_en: After serving 22 years in the Army Special Forces (Green Berets) while strapped for cash, he pivoted to buying and selling businesses, operating aviation in Africa and construction projects in South America. Moving into venture capital, private equity, and investment banking, he reached a peak annual revenue of $11 million.

appearances.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich! (Scottsdale)

advice_items.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich! (Scottsdale)

advice_items.summary_en: Conduct business transparently and never do anything illegal, immoral, or unethical.

advice_items.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich! (Scottsdale)

advice_items.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich! (Scottsdale)

advice_items.summary_en: Use daily gratitude, morning mantras, meditation, and positivity to overcome adversity.

advice_items.summary_zh: 无论遭遇何种逆境都要坚持战斗绝不退缩
advice_items.summary_en: Stay in the fight and never quit when facing adversity.

advice_items.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich! (Scottsdale)

guests.role_or_title: Founder & 100% Owner of It's a 10 Haircare; Serial Entrepreneur (15 Companies)
guests.wealth_detail: Self-confirmed billionaire; over 9 figures ($100M+) peak single-year revenue; 100% owner of It's a 10 and 15 companies
guests.first_money_or_break: 深耕美业42年，最初租用4平方英尺工位做独立美发师（1099）；首家公司彻底失败并亏光一切后，仅凭一瓶产品创办“It's a 10”护发品牌，10年后买断合伙人股权实现100%独资，现拥有15家公司。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: With 42 years in the beauty industry, the founder began as an independent 1099 stylist renting a 4-square-foot station before losing everything in a failed first company. Rebuilding with a single product to launch the "It's a 10" haircare brand, the founder bought out a partner 10 years later for 100% ownership and now owns 15 companies.
guests.zero_start_advice: 重要的不是你拥有什么，而是你用现有的东西做什么；竞争激烈时不能只靠努力，要更具战略思维，敢于创新并在别人往左时往右（Zig when they zag），同时在奋斗中享受乐趣。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: It's not what you have, but what you do with what you have; in fierce competition, hard work alone isn't enough without strategic thinking. Dare to innovate, zig when everyone else zags, and have fun along the grind.

guests.role_or_title: Real Estate Investor & Billboard Media Founder
guests.wealth_detail: ~$2B real estate portfolio (10,000 units)
guests.first_money_or_break: 白手起家，通过阅读和主动结识免费导师起步，从买第一套房逐步累积至约20亿美元、10,000套房产规模，并善用银行和金融机构资金杠杆。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Starting from scratch through reading and seeking out free mentors, he grew from buying his first property to a roughly $2 billion portfolio of 10,000 units. Much of that scale came from effectively leveraging bank and institutional financing.
guests.zero_start_advice: 多读书并主动找真正做过实事的导师喝咖啡请教，提升社交圈层，理解银行借贷系统并用他人资金买现金流资产，不要把钱存银行被通胀贬值。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Read widely, invite proven practitioners out for coffee to learn from them, and upgrade your social circle. Understand how bank lending works to buy cash-flowing assets with other people's money instead of letting cash sit in a bank losing value to inflation.

advice_items.quote: One by one, man. Like, it wasn't strategic. After a while, you kind of figure it out, but I started with just one.

advice_items.summary_zh: 朋友圈层比你的薪水更重要

advice_items.summary_en: Start your journey to financial freedom by reading books and learning continuously.

advice_items.summary_en: Seek out unpaid mentors who have achieved real results by boldly asking them for coffee and listening closely.

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.summary_zh: 别按小时出卖时间，要按成果与价值收费
advice_items.summary_en: Never sell your limited hours; structure your work and businesses to sell outcomes, results, and take a percentage of success.
advice_items.quote: Why would you sell time as an outcome? Most of my businesses have been successful. I've sold outcomes. I've sold results.
advice_items.video_title: Asking London Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 尽早设立有限责任公司，规范账务并隔离风险
advice_items.summary_en: Form a limited company or LLC to keep clean accounts and shield your personal assets from lawsuits.
advice_items.quote: If you have a limited business, same as LLC in America, it's harder for you to be sued personally... You do need a structure.
advice_items.video_title: Asking London Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 有想法就立刻执行去试错，莫到晚年徒留遗憾
advice_items.summary_en: Always execute on your ideas and take action now so you don't end up in your 80s or 90s full of regret.
advice_items.quote: I will always execute on an idea because I don't want to live with regret... Too many people... don't take action and try it.
advice_items.video_title: Asking London Billionaires How They Got Rich!

guests.wealth_detail: Company did $35M+ revenue in the past year; valued at ~$140M
guests.first_money_or_break: 18岁放弃上大学，过去十年连续创业并扩展多家公司，如今与团队共同管理约800家亚马逊电商店铺，公司年营收超3500万美元、估值约1.4亿美元。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Skipping college at 18, Ryan spent the past decade launching and scaling multiple ventures. Today, he and his team manage roughly 800 Amazon storefronts, generating over $35 million in annual revenue at a valuation of around $140 million.
guests.zero_start_advice: 打破“上大学拿十万年薪”的传统思维限制，坚定相信自己能实现百万千万级收入；经营企业要看重长期估值与退出空间；尽早利用复利与金融工具配置资产，在连续失败中保持乐观并练好高价值销售能力。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Break free from the conventional "go to college for a $100,000 salary" mindset and believe you can earn millions, while building businesses with long-term valuation and exit potential. Leverage compounding and financial tools early, stay optimistic through repeated failures, and master high-value sales skills.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH!

appearances.video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH!

advice_tags: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.summary_zh: 别只盯月现金流，要做高估值以实现大额退出
advice_items.summary_en: Prioritize building long-term enterprise valuation for a large exit rather than optimizing only for monthly cash flow.
advice_items.quote: it's not just about what's your cash flow it's what's the valuation... in three years I want to exit for 100 million
advice_items.video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 打破传统学历与年薪观念，重塑财富认知
advice_items.summary_en: Reject society's conventional limits around college and six-figure salaries so making millions feels normal rather than unattainable.
advice_items.quote: most of society puts this traditional box system of I got to go to college make a hundred grand a year and that's their belief system
advice_items.video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 趁年轻利用复利效应并合理运用资产抵押杠杆
advice_items.summary_en: Harness compounding early—such as using overfunded life insurance (IUL) policies to compound capital while borrowing against it tax-free.
advice_items.quote: specifically for young people it's the power of the compounding effect... put it in an iul first and then you actually get to pull out 80 to 90 LTV
advice_items.video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 在频繁失败中保持乐观，绝不轻言放弃
advice_items.summary_en: Stay optimistic through frequent failures so setbacks do not make you quit before succeeding.
advice_items.quote: you need to learn how to stay optimistic through the failures because you will fail way more than you win
advice_items.video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 必须学会销售，学会兜售高价值的解决方案
advice_items.summary_en: Master sales by learning how to deliver and communicate value that customers willingly pay big money for.
advice_items.quote: you need to learn how to sell without sales there is no money... learn how to sell value that people will pay big money for
advice_items.video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 永不放弃，每天坚持打拼并坚信自己
advice_items.summary_en: Grind every single day, believe in yourself, and never give up on your dreams.
advice_items.quote: never ever ever give up... believe in yourself you got that my man keep it going
advice_items.video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH!

guests.wealth_detail: Company generated $400M revenue in a single year
guests.first_money_or_break: 身为脊椎按摩师，2007年遭遇摩托车事故后为缓解自身伤痛在2008年发明了筋膜枪（Theragun/Therabody），靠达人运动员、理疗师背书与公关传播做到单年4亿美元营收。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Working as a chiropractor, the founder invented the massage gun (Theragun/Therabody) in 2008 to relieve pain from a 2007 motorcycle accident. Fueled by endorsements from top athletes, physical therapists, and PR, the company scaled to $400 million in annual revenue.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Millionaire Mansion Owners How They Got RICH

appearances.video_title: Asking Millionaire Mansion Owners How They Got RICH

advice_tags: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.summary_zh: 从解决自身和用户的真实痛点出发创造好产品
advice_items.summary_en: Create products out of real necessity to solve genuine pain and improve how customers feel.
advice_items.quote: It was made from fixing pain. Necessity is the mother of invention... helping people was the key thing.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaire Mansion Owners How They Got RICH

advice_items.summary_zh: 亲友质疑往往恰恰说明你走在了正确的创新路上
advice_items.summary_en: Treat skepticism from friends and family as confirmation that you are building something original.
advice_items.quote: If you're doing something and you have your friends and family challenging you like, 'What are you doing?' That kind of means you're on the right track.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaire Mansion Owners How They Got RICH

advice_items.summary_zh: 借力达人专业背书与公关媒体引爆产品传播
advice_items.summary_en: Combine influencers/athletes, industry professionals, and aggressive PR/social media so the market learns about your product.
advice_items.quote: The third thing which is most important is press, PR. You need people talking about it... Bill Gates said that if he was down to his last dollar, he'd spend it on PR.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaire Mansion Owners How They Got RICH

advice_items.summary_zh: 早期创业必须反应迅速并果断抓住关键曝光机会
advice_items.summary_en: Move fast, pivot quickly, and seize high-visibility opportunities like major events in the early days.
advice_items.quote: You've got to be able to move fast, especially in the early days. There's an opportunity that comes, you need to jump on it.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaire Mansion Owners How They Got RICH

advice_items.summary_zh: 找准热爱擅长与助人的交汇点而非只为赚钱而做
advice_items.summary_en: Build at the intersection of Ikigai—skills, profit, and helping the world—rather than chasing money alone.
advice_items.quote: If you're trying to create a product just to make money, you're just going to move on to the next thing... I'm truly committed to this. I'm trying to change people's lives.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaire Mansion Owners How They Got RICH

advice_items.summary_zh: 心怀信仰与感恩，珍惜关键时刻出现的贵人助力
advice_items.summary_en: Stay grounded in faith and gratitude for the right people who show up at critical moments.
advice_items.quote: I've seen in my life where clearly the things that happened to me were out of my control. They were in God's hands... we had these people that showed up at the right time.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaire Mansion Owners How They Got RICH

guests.role_or_title: Founder of Military & Industrial Encryption Hardware Company
guests.first_money_or_break: 8岁从牙买加仅带一个行李箱赴美重新开始，参军月薪600美元并获资助读完本硕；后创办军工与工业加密硬件公司，2000年在法兰克福证券交易所上市（公司估值20亿欧元）。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Arriving in the U.S. from Jamaica at age 8 with just a suitcase, the founder joined the military for $600 a month and earned funded bachelor's and master's degrees. After launching a military and industrial encryption hardware company, they took it public on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange in 2000 at a €2 billion valuation.
guests.zero_start_advice: 年轻人可参军磨炼自律并免费深造，从第一天起瞄准全球市场，先解决真实痛点、坚持储蓄并与能力互补的伙伴建立长期关系。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Young people can join the military to build discipline and earn a free education while targeting the global market from day one. Focus on solving real pain points, save consistently, and build long-term partnerships with people whose skills complement yours.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Monaco Billionaires How They Got Rich!

appearances.video_title: Asking Monaco Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_tags: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value

advice_items.summary_zh: 通过参军等严格环境培养自律、忠诚与团队精神
advice_items.summary_en: Develop discipline, loyalty, and camaraderie early—even through military service.
advice_items.quote: If I was young, I would 100% go in the army again... The discipline, the camaraderie, the loyalty, the sense of service to the country, it's one of the most fulfilling feelings.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Monaco Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.summary_zh: 瞄准AI背后的可持续能源供给赛道
advice_items.summary_en: Target sustainable power generation to supply the massive energy demands of AI.
advice_items.quote: AI needs power... Anyone that could generate energy in a sustainable manner to feed this AI monster, that's where you want to be.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Monaco Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.summary_zh: 不要只盯着钱，解决真实痛点才能真正致富
advice_items.summary_en: Focus on solving real problems rather than chasing money; wealth follows problem-solving.
advice_items.quote: It was never really about money. It was really about solving real problems... If you solve people's problems, you become wealthy.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Monaco Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 规模化扩张核心是持续销售与建立客户信任
advice_items.summary_en: Scale through relentless selling rooted in genuine relationships and solving client problems.
advice_items.quote: The secret to scaling is non-stop relationship building, non-stop selling... I don't sell to get money from people. I really like to build a relationship up and solve their problems.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Monaco Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 别借钱消费去取悦别人，先存钱再消费
advice_items.summary_en: Stop spending money you do not have to impress people you dislike; make saving your top priority.
advice_items.quote: People spend the money they don't have to impress the people they don't like. Save first and then spend later. So, saving should be your number one goal.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Monaco Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 真诚经营人脉，与能力互补的强者同行共创
advice_items.summary_en: Cherish relationships and partner with people whose strengths complement your weaknesses.
advice_items.quote: Work on relationships... If you're weak at something, you should befriend people that have a strength that you don't have and then you learn from them and then build together.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Monaco Billionaires How They Got Rich!

guests.role_or_title: Tax Strategist & Founder of Tax Alchemy
guests.zero_start_advice: 年赚超5万至6万美元时应尽早将个体户或单人LLC转为S-Corp以省去15.3%自雇税，并梳理手机、电脑和差旅等商业抵扣；年入10万美元后可结合杠杆购置短租房并做成本分摊折旧来抵消所得税。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Once you earn over $50,000 to $60,000 a year, convert your sole proprietorship or single-member LLC to an S-Corp early to save the 15.3% self-employment tax and track business deductions like phones, computers, and travel. At $100,000 in annual income, use leverage to buy short-term rentals and apply cost segregation depreciation to offset income taxes.
guests.primary_video_title: He Made $7M/Year And Paid Zero Taxes!

appearances.video_title: He Made $7M/Year And Paid Zero Taxes!

advice_tags: Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)

advice_items.summary_zh: 合法利用税法三招实现联邦零税
advice_items.summary_en: Legally reduce taxes to near zero using income shifting, real estate depreciation, and a private family foundation.
advice_items.quote: I focus on income shifting strategies... I focus on depreciation how do I create a paper loss by investing in real estate and most importantly... I have a private family Foundation that gives money back to other Charities
advice_items.video_title: He Made $7M/Year And Paid Zero Taxes!

advice_items.summary_zh: 买短租房做成本分摊折旧抵消主动收入
advice_items.summary_en: Use short-term rentals or a real estate professional spouse with cost segregation studies to create paper losses that offset W-2 or 1099 income.
advice_items.quote: highly recommend that you look at short-term rentals because the IRS will allow for you to manage the short-term rental for 100 hours and it becomes an active business... perform a strategy called the cost segregation study which forces a paper loss
advice_items.video_title: He Made $7M/Year And Paid Zero Taxes!

advice_items.summary_zh: 像富人一样快速决策执行别陷入分析瘫痪
advice_items.summary_en: Act with speed instead of falling into analysis paralysis; wealthy people move quickly to invest and offset taxes rather than hesitating.
advice_items.quote: speed speed speed speed speed when you're wealthy... it happens in hours not days not weeks when I'm dealing with middle class they're nervous their analysis paralysis
advice_items.video_title: He Made $7M/Year And Paid Zero Taxes!

advice_items.summary_zh: 将折旧省下的税款再投资生息现金流资产
advice_items.summary_en: Take bonus depreciation and Section 179 write-offs on qualifying >6,000 lb business vehicles, then reinvest the tax savings into cash-flowing assets.
advice_items.quote: you can buy a vehicle like this offset your taxes reinvest the tax savings into a cash flow producing asset
advice_items.video_title: He Made $7M/Year And Paid Zero Taxes!

advice_items.canonical_tag: Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)
advice_items.summary_zh: 远离高息消费坏账善用良性杠杆买资产
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid high-interest consumer debt and leverage good debt on appreciating real estate without overextending yourself to expand buying power.
advice_items.quote: there's good debt and there's bad debt there's bad debt which is Consumer Debt... High interest rate debt that's the type of debt you want to avoid and then there's good debt which is debt in the form of loans like buying a house
advice_items.video_title: He Made $7M/Year And Paid Zero Taxes!

advice_items.summary_zh: 与银行家建立私人银行关系撬动授信资源
advice_items.summary_en: Use credit responsibly and build relationships with bankers to earn private banking perks, waived transfer fees, and access to private equity deals.
advice_items.quote: the best way to get access to credit is to use credit and to start establishing the right type of relationships with Bankers
advice_items.video_title: He Made $7M/Year And Paid Zero Taxes!

guests.role_or_title: Co-Founder of The Home Depot & Owner of the Atlanta Falcons
guests.wealth_detail: Co-founded The Home Depot (~$350B company); owns the Atlanta Falcons (bought for $500M+, now worth $5B+)
guests.first_money_or_break: 出身清贫，一家四口挤在一室公寓，父母睡门厅折叠沙发；36岁时被解雇，随后创办家得宝（Home Depot），初期不被看好并被预言破产，最终于1981年成功上市并发展成约3500亿美元的商业帝国。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Raised in a poor family of four in a one-bedroom apartment where his parents slept on a pull-out sofa in the hallway, he was fired at age 36 before founding Home Depot. Dismissed by skeptics who predicted bankruptcy, the company went public in 1981 and grew into an approximately $350 billion empire.
guests.zero_start_advice: 以正确价值观为根基，放下傲慢谦卑倾听客户需求，无论对待团队还是客户都要把建立信任放在首位，财富会随之而来。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Build on strong core values, set aside ego to listen humbly to customers, and put trust first with both your team and your clients. When you get those right, the wealth will follow.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Atlanta Billionaires How They Got Rich!

appearances.video_title: Asking Atlanta Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_tags: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value

advice_items.summary_zh: 秉持正确动机做正确的事，坚守价值观并承担后果
advice_items.summary_en: Operate from strong core values: do the right things for the right reasons and stand by the outcome.
advice_items.quote: My mother had an expression, you do the right things for the right reasons, and live with the consequences.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Atlanta Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 面对外界看衰与唱衰，保持定力与韧性坚持走下去
advice_items.summary_en: Stay resilient and stay the course when critics predict your business model will go broke.
advice_items.quote: They said, 'Just ignore these guys. They're going to go broke.'... Commitment to values, commitment to behavior, staying the course, having the resilience.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Atlanta Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 谦卑倾听客户需求而非争辩，赢得客户的极致忠诚
advice_items.summary_en: Listen to customers with genuine humility instead of arguing, and earn fierce customer loyalty.
advice_items.quote: Listening to what customers wanted, not debating, not forcing our arguments on them, learning from them, and having the real humility... our ultimate sign of success is when our customers... would feel like they would be disloyal by shopping someplace else.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Atlanta Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.summary_zh: 专注创造真实价值而非追逐金钱，十亿身家只是副产品
advice_items.summary_en: Focus on creating genuine value rather than chasing money; billionaire wealth is merely a byproduct.
advice_items.quote: It was never about money to me per se. It was always about building value, doing the right things for the right reasons. So, becoming a billionaire was only a byproduct of that.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Atlanta Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 将成功的定义超越金钱，扩展到家庭、爱人与全人类福祉
advice_items.summary_en: Define true success broadly around caring for your family, community, and humanity, not just net worth.
advice_items.quote: Because I've gotten older, success means not just financially, means not just your immediate family, but everybody living in your circle of love, but your really humanity.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Atlanta Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 与员工和客户建立深度信任，信任是一切商业合作的基础
advice_items.summary_en: Build deep trust with both employees and customers; trust unlocks hearts, minds, and long-term business.
advice_items.quote: In all these businesses, I think it's so critical that you develop the trust, whether it be with your associates or whether it be the people that you're serving. Because once you have that trust level established, people will open up their hearts and their minds and eventually their wallets to you.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Atlanta Billionaires How They Got Rich!

guests.guest_name: River Oaks Labor Force Management Founder
guests.role_or_title: Founder & Owner of a Labor Force Management Company
guests.wealth_detail: $300M/yr company revenue; $3M/yr income at age 28
guests.first_money_or_break: 白手起家，成长过程中曾身无分文，创业初期毫无资金，靠21%高息应收账款保理贷款维持现金流，并坚持将每周利润留存公司以滚大资产负债表，最终获得6%-8%的银行传统授信额度，28岁时年收入达300万美元，现公司年营收达3亿美元。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Starting out broke with zero capital, he kept cash flowing through 21% accounts-receivable factoring loans and retained weekly profits to build his balance sheet until qualifying for 6%-8% bank credit lines. By age 28 he was earning $3 million a year, and his company now generates $300 million in annual revenue.
guests.zero_start_advice: 从零开始要先找到自己真正热爱的事物并绝不放弃；同时趁早学习基础商业财务知识，把赚到的利润留存在公司里再投资，不要盲目追求豪车名表等外在炫耀。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: When starting from zero, find something you genuinely love and never quit. Learn basic business finance early, reinvest your profits back into the company, and skip flashy status symbols like luxury cars and watches.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH!

appearances.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 组建团队弥补自身短板，脱离执行才能做大
advice_items.summary_en: Build a team to cover your weaknesses and work on the business rather than in it.
advice_items.quote: You've got to build a team around you that are going to cover all those weaknesses... you need to be working on the business.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 别被法拉利名表等外在炫耀的假象所迷惑
advice_items.summary_en: Don't get fooled by luxury status symbols like Ferraris and Patek watches.
advice_items.quote: Don't be fooled by all the Ferraris and the Pateks and all that BS.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 公司每一分钱支出都必须能直接核算投资回报
advice_items.summary_en: Never spend a dollar in your business without a directly calculable ROI.
advice_items.quote: Every dollar that a company spends must have an ROI attached to it.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 将公司盈利全部留存再投入以实现持续扩张
advice_items.summary_en: Leave every dollar of profit inside the business to build retained earnings and fund growth.
advice_items.quote: Every dollar that you're making, if you're doing the right thing, it's got to stay in that company to be able to grow.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 找到你真正热爱的事物，其余一切皆为次要
advice_items.summary_en: Find something you are truly passionate about; everything else comes second.
advice_items.quote: Find something you're truly passionate about. Everything else after that is secondary.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 不必是屋里最聪明的人，但要做最不肯放弃的人
advice_items.summary_en: You don't have to be the smartest person in the room if you simply refuse to quit.
advice_items.quote: I wasn't always the smartest person in the room, I was just the SOB that refused to quit.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH!

guests.wealth_detail: $250M peak single-year earnings
guests.first_money_or_break: 出身贫寒（祖父母仅二年级学历且靠收垃圾谋生），28岁在电脑与消费电子行业赚到第一个一百万，后依托技术背景创办机场和酒店电视网络Reach TV（并于2021年1月收购CNN Airport），单年最高收入达2.5亿美元。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Raised in poverty by grandparents with second-grade educations who collected trash for a living, he made his first $1 million in computers and consumer electronics by age 28. Leveraging his tech background, he founded the airport and hotel TV network Reach TV, acquired CNN Airport in January 2021, and reached $250 million in peak annual revenue.
guests.zero_start_advice: 以服务心态做销售与谈判，把拒绝当成“暂时还没有”；长期保持同一联系方式并坚持线下露面兑现承诺；做好打多年持久战的准备，每天早起并全力投入。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Approach sales and negotiations with a service mindset and treat every no as a "not yet." Keep the same contact details over the long haul, show up in person to deliver on your promises, and get up early every day ready for a multi-year grind.

advice_tags: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.summary_zh: 谈判与交易的核心是真诚为对方创造服务价值
advice_items.summary_en: Approach every deal and negotiation with a mindset of serving the other person.
advice_items.quote: Serve the person you're talking to... Never do something to somebody. Do something for someone.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wall Street Millionaires How To Make $1 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 面对客户拒绝时把“不”视为“暂时还没有”
advice_items.summary_en: Treat a prospect's 'no' as 'not yet' and keep following up.
advice_items.quote: No is never no. It's always not yet.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wall Street Millionaires How To Make $1 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 32年不换号并坚持线下露面建立长期铁杆人脉
advice_items.summary_en: Show up in person, demonstrate commitment first, and keep long-term contact accessibility.
advice_items.quote: I have run the same phone number for the last 32 years... your net worth is really your network... You got to get out and you got to be in person.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wall Street Millionaires How To Make $1 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 别被社媒一夜成名假象迷惑事业需要多年深耕
advice_items.summary_en: Don't be fooled by social media overnight-success myths; real businesses take years to build.
advice_items.quote: Instagram and other things like people think it's overnight. Like some people call me now and say, 'Wow, this is amazing.' This is my ninth year.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wall Street Millionaires How To Make $1 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 学会接纳并珍视失败才能真正享受胜利的果实
advice_items.summary_en: Appreciate and learn from every failure as part of the entrepreneurial journey.
advice_items.quote: You can't tell me you appreciate being the winner if you don't appreciate the failures. Got to learn all of it to enjoy every single bit of it.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wall Street Millionaires How To Make $1 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 每天清晨五点起床并保持始终如一的高能量状态
advice_items.summary_en: Wake up early at 5 a.m. and bring consistent high energy every single day.
advice_items.quote: Every single day I love waking up. I'm up at 5. I'm up every day. Same energy you see me now. I have all day every day.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wall Street Millionaires How To Make $1 Million

guests.role_or_title: Real Estate Investor, Lender & Creative Finance Entrepreneur
guests.wealth_detail: $500M portfolio; $115M company revenue; $15M/yr personal net
guests.first_money_or_break: 最早从事建筑承包行业10年，后来转型进入房地产与借贷领域，通过学习卖家融资（Creative Finance）在不动用银行贷款、个人信用和自有资金的情况下收购多户住宅积累资产。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: After spending 10 years in construction contracting, he pivoted into real estate and lending. By mastering Creative Finance (seller financing), he built a multifamily portfolio without using bank loans, personal credit, or his own cash.
guests.zero_start_advice: 打破必须靠银行贷款和自有资金才能买房的传统观念，学习卖家融资等创意金融手段；加入高能量创业社群，远离不相信你愿景的人。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Let go of the conventional belief that you need bank loans and your own cash to buy property, and learn creative financing strategies like seller financing. Surround yourself with high-energy entrepreneurial communities and cut ties with people who doubt your vision.

advice_items.summary_zh: 选择房地产作为经得起历史验证的稳健造富资产
advice_items.summary_en: Invest in real estate as a historically proven, reliable vehicle for building wealth.
advice_items.quote: scientifically proven numbers have shown for hundreds of years real estate is the most guaranteed investment you could make
advice_items.video_title: Asking Bugatti Owners How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 善用税法与地产投资抵税规则合法降低税务支出
advice_items.summary_en: Understand the tax code and legal real estate tax incentives to minimize tax burden.
advice_items.quote: the IRS code allows me as a real estate investor to pay $0 in federal income taxes... I have not paid a dollar in federal income tax in seven years
advice_items.video_title: Asking Bugatti Owners How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 高薪聘请顶尖人才并授权委托，实现企业规模化扩张
advice_items.summary_en: Scale by delegating to top talent and paying well to attract high-quality people.
advice_items.quote: delegate to high level people pay people a lot of money you'll attract really high quality people if you pay peanuts you'll get monkeys
advice_items.video_title: Asking Bugatti Owners How They Got RICH!

advice_items.canonical_tag: Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)
advice_items.summary_zh: 利用卖家融资等创意金融手段收购生息资产
advice_items.summary_en: Use creative seller financing so cash-flowing properties pay the seller without needing bank loans or your own cash.
advice_items.quote: I have half a billion dollars in my portfolio and I've never used a bank I don't use credit... I do everything creative finance
advice_items.video_title: Asking Bugatti Owners How They Got RICH!

advice_items.canonical_tag: Don't Surround Yourself With Toxic / Negative People
advice_items.summary_zh: 停止浪费时间说服怀疑者，远离不认可你的人
advice_items.summary_en: Stop wasting years trying to convince skeptics and move on to people who believe in you.
advice_items.quote: stop trying to convince the world around you to believe in your vision... if they don't believe in you today they're never going to believe in you move on
advice_items.video_title: Asking Bugatti Owners How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 融入比自己更优秀的人脉圈，激发更大的成长格局
advice_items.summary_en: Join communities of high achievers who inspire and give you permission to grow bigger.
advice_items.quote: get around people that are doing more than you are... people better than you will give you permission to become better yourself
advice_items.video_title: Asking Bugatti Owners How They Got RICH!

guests.wealth_detail: Personally made first $1M at age 42; current company generates over $850M in annual revenue
guests.first_money_or_break: 40年前从IBM起步进入科技行业，深耕15年后赴奥斯汀加入创业公司，2000年与三位好友创办首家企业，42岁赚到个人第一个100万美元，现任软件公司年营收超8.5亿美元。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: He began his tech career at IBM 40 years ago, spent 15 years there before joining an Austin startup, and co-founded his first company with three friends in 2000. He made his first $1 million at age 42, and his current software company brings in over $850 million in annual revenue.
guests.zero_start_advice: 将90%的精力投入本职工作、10%用于拓展人脉与规划下一步；找准大市场痛点，组建专业团队并用试点和客户背书建立信任，同时不要把自我价值完全绑定在生意成败上。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Put 90% of your energy into your day job and 10% into networking and planning your next move. Target major market pain points, build a strong team, earn trust through pilots and customer endorsements, and never tie your self-worth solely to business outcomes.

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.summary_zh: 为大客户解决高价值核心痛点
advice_items.summary_en: To sell to large enterprises, focus on solving high-stakes problems and prove you are their best partner.
advice_items.quote: You got to solve those $100,000 million problems... Ultimately... it's going to come down to do they believe we're the best partner, the best company that's going to solve their problem.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Texan Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 用试点项目和客户背书赢取信任
advice_items.summary_en: Win enterprise deals through hands-on proofs of concept, pilots, and strong existing customer references.
advice_items.quote: You got to show them... proofs of concept or pilot... You got to have typically very strong references... using our existing references to help our new potential prospects trust that we can solve their problem.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Texan Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 组建优秀团队，切勿单打独斗
advice_items.summary_en: Build a great team with domain-specific engineers, salespeople, and marketers rather than trying to build alone.
advice_items.quote: Surround yourself with a great team. It all comes down to people. Never do this by yourself.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Texan Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.summary_zh: 选择足够庞大的市场与问题规模
advice_items.summary_en: Identify an emerging, sufficiently large market problem that can sustain a billion-dollar scale business.
advice_items.quote: You got to have a big enough market problem to get to a billion dollar business for sure.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Texan Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 待人以己所欲，让他人感到被重视
advice_items.summary_en: Treat everyone with care and respect regardless of differences so people feel genuinely valued.
advice_items.quote: Treat others the way you like to be treated... They're going to feel good. They're going to feel valued.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Texan Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 不把自我价值绑定在生意成败上
advice_items.summary_en: Anchor your personal identity and self-worth in faith and family rather than tying it to business outcomes.
advice_items.quote: My identity is not in being a business guy or an entrepreneur, right? My identity is being a child of God... I'm not going to base my worth on whether my business works or not.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Texan Billionaires How They Got Rich!

guests.role_or_title: Law Firm, Healthcare & Tech Billionaire Entrepreneur
guests.wealth_detail: Billionaire; owns a $175M Miami compound (bought for $46M plus ~$20M in improvements)
guests.first_money_or_break: 父亲曾无家可归，带着5个孩子从古巴来到美国。他是家里唯一受过高等教育并从法学院毕业的人，靠父亲给的800美元Discover信用卡起步，法学院一毕业就开设个人律所，以工作时间抵扣办公室租金。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: The son of a formerly homeless father who brought five children from Cuba to the United States, he became the only person in his family to earn a higher degree and graduate from law school. Starting out with an $800 Discover credit card from his father, he opened his own law firm straight out of law school and traded his work hours to cover office rent.
guests.zero_start_advice: 不必重新发明轮子，做大平台业务与小生意的规则相同却回报巨大；保持全天候响应、自律作息与强健体魄，无视外界噪音并每天坚定执行。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Don't reinvent the wheel, because big-platform businesses follow the same rules as small ones while delivering far greater returns. Stay responsive around the clock, keep a disciplined routine and a strong body, ignore outside noise, and execute relentlessly every day.

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.summary_zh: 做大平台生意，赚1亿与赚1美元费力相同
advice_items.summary_en: Play on bigger platforms because making $100M takes the same effort and rules as making $1.
advice_items.quote: It takes the same effort to make $1 than it does to make 100 million... the rules are the same, the laws are the same. It's just a bigger platform.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Miami Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 创业需要极度投入、艰苦努力与巨大牺牲
advice_items.summary_en: Accept that entrepreneurship requires relentless dedication, hard work, and ongoing personal sacrifice.
advice_items.quote: It takes a lot of dedication, hard work, and a lot of sacrifice... I sleep 3 and 1/2, 4 hours a night at most.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Miami Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 坚定自信，不要听信外界质疑的噪音
advice_items.summary_en: Believe in yourself and ignore doubters and critics who do not pay your bills.
advice_items.quote: You got to believe in yourself. And don't listen to the noise. Every single time I've had a business that's been successful, everybody told me it wasn't going to work.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Miami Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.canonical_tag: Be Careful Who You Partner With
advice_items.summary_zh: 只与正派人做生意，远离品行不端之辈
advice_items.summary_en: Only do business with good, trustworthy people; bad partners ruin any deal.
advice_items.quote: There's no bad business with a good man. There's no good business with a bad men. You'll never fail.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Miami Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 让对方明白他们需要你，才能谈成好交易
advice_items.summary_en: Frame negotiations around why your offer is valuable to the other party so they feel they need you.
advice_items.quote: You got to make the other person understand why what you have is valuable to them, not valuable to you. So when you make them understand that they need you and you don't need them, that's when you're going to make the best deal.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Miami Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 每天保持同样目标，日复一日坚定执行
advice_items.summary_en: Consistency beats one-day greatness; wake up every single day committed to execution.
advice_items.quote: It's not about how great you are one day. My dad taught me this. You got to do it every day... I wake up every day with the same goal in mind, which is to execute.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Miami Billionaires How They Got Rich!

guests.role_or_title: Scrap Metal & Junk Car Shredding CEO / Founder
guests.wealth_detail: Company worth ~$1B; peak annual earnings of $60M-$70M
guests.first_money_or_break: 早期靠向银行贷款起步，从事废旧汽车粉碎与金属回收生意近 40 年，期间曾因违规操作被捕并服刑一年，出狱后从谷底专注重建，将公司做到年入 6000 万至 7000 万美元、估值约 10 亿美元。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Backed early by bank loans, he spent nearly 40 years in auto shredding and metal recycling, including a year in prison after being arrested for regulatory violations. Rebuilding from rock bottom after his release, he scaled the company to $60 million to $70 million a year and an estimated $1 billion valuation.
guests.zero_start_advice: 创业早期可以用杠杆但不要过度负债，签任何贷款和担保合同前都要仔细看清小字并找专业人士审核；陷入谷底时别自怨自艾，专注并做出牺牲，也不要让自己处于可能犯错的境地；成功之后别相信外界对你的吹捧，学会在物质之外寻找幸福。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Use leverage early on without overextending yourself, and have a professional review the fine print before signing any loan or guarantee. When you hit rock bottom, skip self-pity, stay focused, make sacrifices, and avoid situations that invite mistakes; once you succeed, ignore the flattery and seek happiness beyond material things.

appearances.video_title: Asking NY Billionaires How They Got Rich!
