advice_items.summary_zh: 创业并不光鲜而是睡眠不足，唯靠拼命工作
advice_items.summary_en: Recognize that entrepreneurship is exhausting and unglamorous, and outwork others even if you are not the smartest or best negotiator.
advice_items.quote: it's tough. It's not as glamorous as like my eyes are bloodshot. You don't sleep much. It's not that sexy... I'm not the best. I just work really hard.
advice_items.video_title: Asking NY Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.canonical_tag: Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)
advice_items.summary_zh: 早期靠杠杆起步，但成熟后要果断远离负债
advice_items.summary_en: Bank loans and leverage can fuel early growth, but over-leverage is brutal—pay it down and shed debt as you mature.
advice_items.quote: I was really overleveraged in the beginning. It was a total shit show... leverage is part of the growth. But at this point in my life that I'm older, the leverage days are over.
advice_items.video_title: Asking NY Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 遭遇低谷别自怨自艾，唯有自己能拯救自己
advice_items.summary_en: Never feel sorry for yourself when hitting rock bottom; take full responsibility, save yourself, and keep pushing forward.
advice_items.quote: we all have bad stuff happen but you can't just feel sorry for yourself. You got to keep pushing through... you have to save yourself. No one's going to fix it.
advice_items.video_title: Asking NY Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 保持专注并学会牺牲，远离诱发错误的情境
advice_items.summary_en: Stay laser-focused, make sacrifices, and deliberately avoid putting yourself in situations where you might make bad choices.
advice_items.quote: You just got to stay focused and you got to sacrifice... I try not to even put myself in situations that I have to make that [bad] choice.
advice_items.video_title: Asking NY Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 别轻信自身光环，物质豪车无法带来持久幸福
advice_items.summary_en: Never believe your own hype or tie your happiness to jets, fancy cars, and watches—learn to be happy with nothing.
advice_items.quote: never believe your own hype... money is a mirage. My biggest strength is I can be happy with nothing... I don't need fancy cars. I don't need jets... if that drives your happiness, it's not sustainable.
advice_items.video_title: Asking NY Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 常怀感恩珍惜当下，莫让欲望超越内心满足
advice_items.summary_en: Keep perspective on how small your problems are compared to others and practice daily gratitude for family and life.
advice_items.quote: our problems are so little compared to other people's problems. So, I just appreciate what I have every day.
advice_items.video_title: Asking NY Billionaires How They Got Rich!

guests.role_or_title: NYSE Floor Trader / Stock Broker (40 years on Wall Street)
guests.first_money_or_break: 在纽交所大厅担任场内交易员40年，每天经手5亿至10亿美元股票交易量；2006至2008年曾破产长达两三年，靠坚持每天穿戴整齐出门上班，在地铁上偶遇昔日华尔街搭档并重启交易策略，才东山再起并合作长达20年。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: He spent 40 years as a floor trader at the New York Stock Exchange handling $500 million to $1 billion in daily stock volume, yet went broke for two to three years between 2006 and 2008. By still suiting up and commuting to work every day, he ran into a former Wall Street partner on the subway, revived their trading strategy, and went on to partner together for 20 years.
guests.zero_start_advice: 把钱投进股票而非买贬值消费品；每天穿戴整齐出门工作寻找机会，不要在家躺平；找到热爱的事业并做到精通，多向拥有你理想结果的人看齐。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Put your money into stocks instead of depreciating consumer goods, and suit up every day to go out and hunt for opportunities rather than sitting at home. Find work you love, master your craft, and model yourself after people who already have the results you want.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Wall Street Moguls How They Got Rich!

appearances.video_title: Asking Wall Street Moguls How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 买会增值的股票，而非一买就贬值的消费品
advice_items.summary_en: Buy appreciating assets like stocks instead of depreciating consumer goods.
advice_items.quote: One of the most important things is to invest in stocks and not stuff... Everything we buy goes down in value... invest in things that perhaps are going to go up in value.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wall Street Moguls How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 建立多元化收入来源，让钱主动为你工作
advice_items.summary_en: Build multiple streams of revenue and put your capital to work.
advice_items.quote: Have multiple streams of revenue and let your money work for you.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wall Street Moguls How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 每天坚持打扮整齐出门工作，机会不会找上门
advice_items.summary_en: Show up in person dressed and ready every day because opportunities do not find you hiding at home.
advice_items.quote: Waking up, showing up, suiting up. Know that in any given day, if you look for opportunity, you'll find it.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wall Street Moguls How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 找到热爱的事并做到极致，同时积极提携后辈
advice_items.summary_en: Find work you genuinely love, master it, and share your knowledge with the next generation.
advice_items.quote: I love what I do... Find something you love to do, get really good at it, and embrace the younger generation.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wall Street Moguls How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 赢得巨额资金托付的信任需要数十年长期积累
advice_items.summary_en: Earning the trust required to handle massive institutional order flow takes years of consistent integrity.
advice_items.quote: In order for somebody to trust you enough to give you that much stock, it's a big deal. It's taken years and years like that.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wall Street Moguls How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 务必与那些已经拥有你渴望之物的人为伍
advice_items.summary_en: Deliberately surround yourself with people who already have what you aspire to achieve.
advice_items.quote: Surround yourself by people who have what you want. It's really important.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wall Street Moguls How They Got Rich!

guests.wealth_detail: Probably a billionaire; ~$850M in real estate (all cash); $300M made at Ramsey this year
guests.first_money_or_break: 20多岁曾一度破产，此后始终坚持无负债创业，靠公司现金流逐步全款买下1000万美元的48英亩土地并自建总部园区，2008年金融危机时用现金以15%-20%的低价抄底大量优质房产。

guests.wealth_detail: Couple billion dollars/year revenue (under $3B); billionaire before launching Arnold Palmer (host cites $6B+ net worth)
guests.first_money_or_break: 父亲在杂货店工作年薪不超过1.5万美元，1970年未上大学且因身高免服兵役后，先当了10年卡车司机，从小生意一步步做大并创立AriZona饮料。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Raised by a grocery worker earning no more than $15,000 a year, he skipped college in 1970 after a height exemption kept him out of the draft and drove trucks for 10 years. From humble beginnings, he grew small ventures step by step and founded AriZona Beverages.
guests.zero_start_advice: 算清每一笔货物和运营成本并确保加价盈利；坚持零负债、现金支付与垂直整合，用高性价比与亮眼包装吸引消费者而非烧钱打广告，并始终善待顾客。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Know every penny of your product and operating costs so every sale turns a profit, and stick to zero debt, cash payments, and vertical integration. Win shoppers with standout packaging and great value instead of burning cash on ads, and always treat customers well.

advice_items.summary_zh: 算清成本并保证利润绝不入不敷出借债
advice_items.summary_en: Know your exact unit costs and cost of doing business, sell above cost, and avoid borrowing to cover overspending.

advice_items.summary_zh: 从事真正热爱的事业五十五年如一日
advice_items.summary_en: Build a business you genuinely enjoy so even decades of hard work never feel boring.

advice_items.summary_zh: 成本上升时勒紧腰带不盲目追求奢华
advice_items.summary_en: Prioritize happiness over chasing wealth metrics and tighten your belt when margins compress.

advice_items.summary_zh: 对所处环境心怀感恩并珍惜创业机会

advice_items.video_title: Asking the RICHEST People in the World How They Got RICH!

guests.wealth_detail: $20M in a single year
guests.first_money_or_break: 不喜欢为别人打工，进入金融行业创业深耕25年，曾经历过多次破产又重新翻身，单年最高收入达2000万美元。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Unwilling to work for someone else, this owner spent 25 years building businesses in the finance industry, bouncing back from multiple bankruptcies to hit a peak annual income of $20 million.
guests.zero_start_advice: 远离有毒的人，保持大格局并终身学习；在商业中注重人和与团队文化，始终做到给予而非索取，全力提升人脉关系价值。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Distance yourself from toxic people, think big, and stay a lifelong learner. Prioritize people and team culture in business, always give more than you take, and pour energy into strengthening your relationships.

advice_tags: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time

advice_items.summary_zh: 投资商业或多户地产，自管翻修后再融资滚雪球
advice_items.summary_en: Skip buying a primary home as an investment; buy commercial or multifamily real estate, manage it yourself, and refinance to scale.
advice_items.quote: The home is a terrible investment... I'd go right into a commercial property. Multifamily is the easiest one to get into... Manage it yourself, lease it yourself, running all the books yourself, fix it up, then eventually refinance it and go buy another.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH! (Florida)

advice_items.summary_zh: 长持地产十至三十年，不要试图预测市场时机
advice_items.summary_en: Don't try to time the market; buy real estate consistently in both good and bad markets and hold for 10 to 30 years.
advice_items.quote: Always the best time to buy real estate... I'm going to buy this property and I'm going to keep it for 10, 20, 30 years. And by the way, nobody could time a market.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH! (Florida)

advice_items.summary_zh: 提升财商，分清好坏债务，买企业而非消费品
advice_items.summary_en: Build financial education—learn mortgages, bookkeeping, good vs. bad debt, and buy income-producing businesses instead of toys.
advice_items.quote: Lack of financial education... they don't teach you how to get a mortgage, how to balance a checkbook, what to do with credit card debt, what's good debt, what's bad debt, why you should be buying a business, not buying a damn jet ski.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH! (Florida)

advice_items.summary_zh: 别盲从大众或理会质疑者，坚定走自己的路
advice_items.summary_en: Ignore conventional herd advice and doubters who project their own inaction; stay in your own lane and keep pushing forward.
advice_items.quote: Don't listen to the masses. The masses are entirely wrong... Doubters are just afraid you might do something that they're not doing. So don't worry about what people tell you no. Do your own thing and keep chugging forward.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH! (Florida)

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.summary_zh: 创业虽有压力，但远胜于一辈子替别人打工
advice_items.summary_en: Despite the challenges of being the boss, entrepreneurship is far better than working for someone else.
advice_items.quote: It's way better to be an entrepreneur. Most people think it's scary, but it's way better to be an entrepreneur than to work for someone else.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH! (Florida)

advice_items.summary_zh: 社交媒体炫富多为假象，任何成功都无法速成
advice_items.summary_en: Don't fall for the illusion of overnight wealth on social media; mastering any field and building real wealth takes years.
advice_items.quote: It's just an illusion. Nobody gets there quick... whether you're going to be the best lawyer, the best architect, the best real estate guy, whatever it is, it's going to take a lot of time.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH! (Florida)

guests.wealth_detail: Sold Vitaminwater to Coca-Cola for $4B–$4.1B (2007) and BodyArmor to Coca-Cola for $8B (2021)
guests.first_money_or_break: 出身法裔移民贫困家庭（父母资产仅约5000美元），20岁时辞去水厂高薪工作降薪创业，靠亲友和合伙人拼凑约1万美元启动，将维他命水（Vitaminwater）从10万美元做到7.5亿美元营收并以41亿美元卖给可口可乐，后又创办BodyArmor并以80亿美元再次卖给可口可乐。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Born to poor French immigrant parents with roughly $5,000 in net worth, he quit a well-paying water-plant job at age 20 for a pay cut and scraped together about $10,000 from family, friends, and partners to start out. He grew Vitaminwater from $100,000 to $750 million in revenue before selling it to Coca-Cola for $4.1 billion, then founded BodyArmor and sold it to Coca-Cola for $8 billion.
guests.zero_start_advice: 想做十亿美元公司必须先从100美元、1000美元、10万美元的小公司一步步做起，不能急于求成；要做好前五年创业“生存期”随时可能破产的准备，专注打造消费者真正需要的产品而非只盯分销，并敢于赌在自己身上。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: To build a billion-dollar company, you have to start small at $100, $1,000, and $100,000 without rushing the process. Brace for the risk of going broke during the first five survival years, focus on building a product consumers truly want rather than obsessing only over distribution, and bet on yourself.

advice_tags: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value

advice_items.summary_zh: 把梦想定得更大，能实现说明野心还不够
advice_items.summary_en: Set ambitious goals and continually expand your vision—if you are easily hitting your dreams, you aren't dreaming big enough.
advice_items.quote: Think big, dream bigger. If you're hitting your dreams, you're not dreaming big enough. My dreams are bigger now than they were when I was 15.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH! (Florida)

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.summary_zh: 产品与用户需求永远第一，好产品自带分销
advice_items.summary_en: Prioritize creating a product consumers genuinely demand above all else; strong consumer demand pulls distribution to you.
advice_items.quote: Always the product. The product, the consumer. The distribution to me is the least important... If you build a product that consumers demand, you don't have to worry about distribution. Those accounts are going to call you.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH! (Florida)

advice_items.summary_zh: 稳扎稳打从百元生意起步，切忌急于做大
advice_items.summary_en: Start small with lean capital and scale step-by-step from $100 to $100,000 to $1 million rather than trying to grow overnight.
advice_items.quote: I took money from friends, family, my partner had money... we didn't try to grow quick... If you want to build a billion dollar company, you have to build a $100 company first, then a $1,000 company, then a $100,000 company.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH! (Florida)

advice_items.summary_zh: 熬过前五年创业生存期，每天都要做好破产准备
advice_items.summary_en: Be prepared to grind through the first five survival years of entrepreneurship when bankruptcy and missed payroll feel one day away.
advice_items.quote: First five years for an entrepreneur, I call the survival years. Every single day you could go bankrupt. There are days that I didn't think we could make payroll.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH! (Florida)

advice_items.summary_zh: 拥抱甚至热爱失败，没失败说明还没拼尽全力
advice_items.summary_en: Welcome failure as proof you are pushing your limits and use it as feedback to find a new path to the next level.
advice_items.quote: Failing is good. If you don't fail in life, you're not trying hard enough... I love failing. Failing means I've taken it as far as I can and now I got to figure out another [ __ ] way to get to the next level.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH! (Florida)

advice_items.summary_zh: 人生要敢于冒险甚至带点疯狂，别害怕失败
advice_items.summary_en: Be willing to be a little adventurous, take bold chances, and stop letting the fear of failure hold you back.
advice_items.quote: I do want people to take chances and get a little crazier in life and be a little bit more adventurous and take chances and don't be afraid to fail.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH! (Florida)

guests.wealth_detail: Company valued at $3.6B; millionaire in his 20s
guests.first_money_or_break: 2012年创立Whoop并致力打造可穿戴健康设备，前六七年一度濒临破产；2015年在电视广告中看到勒布朗·詹姆斯佩戴当时全球仅百条之一的Whoop手环，成为重燃信心的关键转折点。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: After founding Whoop in 2012 to build wearable health technology, this founder hovered on the brink of bankruptcy for the first six or seven years. A pivotal turning point came in 2015 when they spotted LeBron James wearing one of only about 100 Whoop straps in the world during a TV commercial, reigniting their belief.
guests.zero_start_advice: 找到真正热爱并痴迷的事业，放下理所当然的心态，去做别人不愿做的苦差事，换个角度看待问题并保持极致坚持，同时组建优秀团队并融资。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Find a mission you are truly obsessed with, drop any sense of entitlement, and do the grunt work others avoid. Look at problems from fresh angles, stay relentlessly persistent, assemble a great team, and raise the capital you need.

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.summary_zh: 以解决真实痛点为创业驱动力
advice_items.summary_en: Start a business driven by a genuine problem you want to solve for millions of people.
advice_items.quote: I was driven by the problem I was trying to solve... build wearable devices that millions of people understand and use to improve their health.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH! (Boston)

advice_items.summary_zh: 培养直面危机与做艰难决定的勇气
advice_items.summary_en: Develop the courage as a leader to confront problems head-on and make hard decisions when things go wrong.
advice_items.quote: The single trait that I found is the hardest trait in all of building business is courage... Can you say the hard thing? Can you do the hard thing?
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH! (Boston)

advice_items.summary_zh: 不被行业巨头吓倒，坚信凭借产品力必胜
advice_items.summary_en: Do not be intimidated by giant competitors; believe in your superior product and commit to winning.
advice_items.quote: Well, we certainly took it seriously when they came out with a product, but we also said we're going to win. In fact, we wrote on every circuit board, don't bother copying us. We will win.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH! (Boston)

advice_items.summary_zh: 找到真正热爱的事物并极致痴迷地追逐
advice_items.summary_en: Find something you genuinely love and pursue it with relentless obsession.
advice_items.quote: I think you got to find something you love and be obsessed with it and chase it and chase it and chase it.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH! (Boston)

advice_items.summary_zh: 摒弃理所当然心态，做苦工并坚持到底
advice_items.summary_en: Drop any sense of entitlement, do the hard work others avoid, and persist relentlessly.
advice_items.quote: No one is entitled to be a great entrepreneur... you go do the hard work that other people aren't doing... and then it's persistence, persistence, persistence.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH! (Boston)

advice_items.summary_zh: 组建顶尖团队并善用资本推动事业成长
advice_items.summary_en: Assemble a great team and raise capital to turn persistence and vision into something special.
advice_items.quote: You find a great team, you raise capital and then boom, you'll do something special.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH! (Boston)

guests.role_or_title: Founder of Samuel Adams (Boston Beer Company)
guests.wealth_detail: $2B (stated as peak single-year earnings)
guests.first_money_or_break: 40年前在自家厨房酿出第一批Samuel Adams啤酒，通过委托现有酒厂代工、用酒吧谈生意和投币电话亭办公等极简方式创业；公司仅两人时便在上市6周后被评为全美最佳啤酒，并靠每天拿下一个客户打下市场。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: He brewed the first batch of Samuel Adams in his kitchen 40 years ago and launched lean using contract breweries, bars for meetings, and pay phones as his office. Just six weeks after launch with a two-person team, it was named the best beer in America, and he built the market by winning one customer a day.
guests.zero_start_advice: 将开支缩减到绝对最低，把资源集中到优质原料与顶尖人才上并持续将利润再投入；不要过度迷信营销，先做出好产品并亲自真诚去卖，同时追求有意义的事业目标而非单纯追逐暴富。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Cut overhead to the bone, pour your resources into top-quality ingredients and great people, and keep reinvesting profits. Don't over-rely on marketing; craft a genuinely great product, sell it yourself with sincerity, and chase a meaningful purpose rather than quick riches.
recommended_books_or_mentors: His uncle (Goldman Sachs salesperson & original investor)

advice_items.summary_zh: 打磨极致好产品远比华丽营销和品牌更重要
advice_items.summary_en: Prioritize creating a genuinely superior product over flashy branding or marketing.
advice_items.quote: At the end of the day, marketing is very overrated. Really, what really works is a better product... And we had a better glass of beer.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH! (Boston)

advice_items.summary_zh: 别用筹备琐事拖延，每天必须拿下一个客户
advice_items.summary_en: Stop procrastinating with equipment or setup tasks; overcome fear and go win at least one customer every day.
advice_items.quote: I've seen a lot of businesses that went broke, and they all had computers, but they went broke cuz they didn't have any sales. Go out and get one customer every day and don't come home till you got that customer.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH! (Boston)

advice_items.summary_zh: 真诚相信产品并全力销售，销量能解一切难题
advice_items.summary_en: Focus on authentic, sincere selling driven by genuine belief in your product, because strong sales cure almost every business issue.
advice_items.quote: You're the best salesperson there is if you genuinely believe in your product. Being genuine, sincere, authentic... no business went broke because they had too many sales.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH! (Boston)

advice_items.summary_zh: 极简轻资产起步，前15年利润全部再投入
advice_items.summary_en: Strip startup costs to the absolute minimum—using contract production and no office—and reinvest profits back into the business for years.
advice_items.quote: What is the absolute minimum I need to start this business?... I didn't have an office for a year. I did everything from pay phone booths... invested all your money back into the business for the first like 15 years.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH! (Boston)

advice_items.summary_zh: 用股权激励招募现金暂时请不起的顶尖人才
advice_items.summary_en: Offer equity creatively to bring in world-class talent you cannot yet afford in cash.
advice_items.quote: I needed the best brew master in the world to help me. So I went out and hired him... I couldn't really afford what he cost, but I gave him 2% of the company.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH! (Boston)

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.summary_zh: 即使上市也要保留投票权，牢牢守住控制权
advice_items.summary_en: Retain voting control even when taking on investors or going public so you never end up working for someone else.
advice_items.quote: If you get to the point where you can go public, keep the voting shares... I basically sacrifice some of the economics for control cuz I don't want to work my ass off every day for somebody else.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH! (Boston)

guests.wealth_detail: Company on track for $100M+ annual revenue; became a millionaire by age 24
guests.first_money_or_break: 高中时期白手起家，在当地率先创办无人机摄影与营销公司；24岁成为百万富翁，四年前切入人形机器人赛道，首年即做到100万美元，随后乘着AI浪潮实现近百倍增长。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Starting from scratch in high school, he launched his area's first drone photography and marketing business and became a millionaire by age 24. Four years ago he moved into humanoid robotics, hit $1 million in year one, and rode the AI wave to nearly 100x growth.
guests.zero_start_advice: 投资自己，尽早创办小生意并勇于快速试错（实战比学校学得更多）；保持耐心追求长期复利而非快钱；顺应AI大趋势并通过听书克制自我膨胀。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Invest in yourself, start a small business early, and test and fail fast because real-world reps teach far more than school. Stay patient for long-term compounding instead of chasing fast cash, ride the AI wave, and listen to audiobooks to keep your ego in check.
recommended_books_or_mentors: Ego is the Enemy by Ryan Holiday
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Mega Mansion Owners How They Got Rich!

appearances.video_title: Asking Mega Mansion Owners How They Got Rich!

advice_tags: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market

advice_items.summary_zh: 快钱难以长久，创业重在耐心与持久耐力
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid chasing fast money because it never lasts; true entrepreneurship is about patience, longevity, and endurance.
advice_items.quote: Fast money never lasts. And if you keep building and be patient, that's what a real entrepreneur is, is it's longevity and endurance.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Mega Mansion Owners How They Got Rich!

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.summary_zh: 借力AI等时代浪潮将其融入自身业务
advice_items.summary_en: Build your business around major macro waves like AI and robotics rather than chasing superficial trends.
advice_items.quote: Leveraging the trends that are out there such as AI to build them into your business... being able to basically ride that wave at the same time.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Mega Mansion Owners How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 警惕年少得志后盲目消费与虚荣攀比
advice_items.summary_en: Do not rush into building a flashy lifestyle or equate buying luxury cars with true business maturity.
advice_items.quote: I tried to build like a life very fast. Patience is like key... Just cuz you can afford a Lamborghini or whatever does not mean you're at the level that everyone that has a Lamborghini is.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Mega Mansion Owners How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 投资自己并勇于试错，实战比学校更学东西
advice_items.summary_en: Invest in yourself by starting a small business and failing fast; real-world experience teaches far more than school.
advice_items.quote: Invest in yourself. And that means even just like trying and failing. Like start a business, fail cuz you're going to learn so much about it that it's not a waste of money... fail fast. Just do something.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Mega Mansion Owners How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 坚持听书学习，克制自负保持平和心态
advice_items.summary_en: Continuously listen to audiobooks like Ryan Holiday's 'Ego is the Enemy' to keep your ego in check and maintain a neutral headspace.
advice_items.quote: I listen to books. I don't read them. I'm always on Audible. There's a book called Ego is the Enemy... a great way to start pushing my headspace to a much more like neutral space.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Mega Mansion Owners How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 绝不轻言放弃，留在牌桌上等待转机
advice_items.summary_en: Never give up through bad days in business because one life-changing breakthrough can happen the very next day as long as you stay in the game.
advice_items.quote: Just don't give up... you may have a really down day in business and the next day might be amazing... as long as you're in the game, you're going to get somewhere.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Mega Mansion Owners How They Got Rich!

guests.role_or_title: Billionaire Healthcare Entrepreneur (22+ Companies) & Gubernatorial Candidate
guests.wealth_detail: Billionaire; $3B/yr revenue across 22+ healthcare companies; became a millionaire at age 26
guests.first_money_or_break: 从小生活在贫困公租房，13岁进入寄养家庭并辗转多个家庭与学校，19岁因付不起学费大学辍学；20岁因无学历求职被拒后，主动提出不要底薪、只拿33%纯佣金入行，一年后买下该公司，26岁成为百万富翁，最终在医疗领域创立并拥有超22家公司（年营收30亿美元）。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Growing up in public housing before entering foster care at 13 and dropping out of college at 19 when he couldn't afford tuition, he was rejected for jobs at 20 for lacking a degree until he offered to work for zero base pay and a pure 33% commission. He bought the company a year later, became a millionaire at 26, and went on to found and own over 22 healthcare companies generating $3 billion in annual revenue.
guests.zero_start_advice: 摒弃受害者心态并对自己的人生与失败负全责；入行时敢于用纯佣金证明自己，与人合作先帮对方赢，同时保持强烈求知欲亲自学透税务、会计与营销。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Drop the victim mentality and take full ownership of your life and failures. Be willing to prove yourself on pure commission, help partners win first, and stay hungry enough to master taxes, accounting, and marketing yourself.
recommended_books_or_mentors: Georgia State University PhD tutor (hired at age 26 for $2000/month)
What They Dont Teach You at Harvard Business School by Mark McCormack
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich! (Atlanta)

appearances.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich! (Atlanta)

advice_items.summary_zh: 敢于零底薪纯佣金换取入行与翻身机会
advice_items.summary_en: Eliminate employer risk by offering to work on straight commission to break into an industry without credentials.
advice_items.quote: What if I work for no money a month and just 33% straight commission? Would you give me a chance? A year later, I bought the firm.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich! (Atlanta)

advice_items.summary_zh: 先了解客户真正需求再全力帮其达成目标
advice_items.summary_en: Master sales by uncovering what the other person truly needs and focusing on fulfilling that win for them.
advice_items.quote: You can have everything in the world you want if you help other people get what they want. I asked them what did they need and then I fulfilled that need.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich! (Atlanta)

advice_items.summary_zh: 怀抱信仰并将财富视为神的托付
advice_items.summary_en: Maintain humility and faith by viewing wealth as stewardship entrusted to you by God.
advice_items.quote: It's not my money. It's God's money.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich! (Atlanta)

advice_items.summary_zh: 广泛阅读商业实战书籍并学习为人处世之道
advice_items.summary_en: Study executive summaries and practical books on street smarts and dealing with people.
advice_items.quote: It's a book called What They Don't Teach You at Harvard ... what they don't teach you at Harvard is how to deal with people.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich! (Atlanta)

advice_items.summary_zh: 亲自学透税务财务与营销，绝不盲目外包
advice_items.summary_en: Never blindly outsource tax, accounting, legal, or marketing knowledge—study and master them yourself.
advice_items.quote: There's nobody that knows more about tax, marketing, and accounting ... I never would abdicate to any professional lawyer or anybody.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich! (Atlanta)

advice_items.summary_zh: 摒弃受害者心态，为失败负全责并屡败屡战
advice_items.summary_en: Reject a victim mindset, take full personal ownership of failures, learn from them, and get back up every time.
advice_items.quote: I never saw myself as a victim. ... Take ownership of your failures and you learn from them and then get up one more time than you fall down.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich! (Atlanta)

guests.guest_name: Fiber Optic & Data Center Infrastructure Founder
guests.wealth_detail: Selling company for $2.5B; completed multi-billion dollar IPO on July 1st
guests.first_money_or_break: 早年靠在路边捡汽水罐换钱买午饭；高中毕业即从一线技术员做起，加入早期创业公司Charter Communications（Spectrum），随后紧跟创始人并肩创办多家企业，深耕数据中心光纤基础设施，完成数十亿美元IPO并即将以25亿美元出售公司。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: After collecting roadside soda cans to afford lunch as a kid, this founder started right out of high school as a frontline technician at an early-stage Charter Communications (Spectrum) and went on to co-found multiple ventures alongside its founder. Focusing on data-center fiber infrastructure, they took a company public in a multibillion-dollar IPO and are now nearing a $2.5 billion sale.
guests.zero_start_advice: 不要怕主动开口向成功人士请教；从行业最基层做起学透业务，跟随优秀创始人成长；组建比自己更聪明的合伙团队并充分授权，在数据中心基建等高需求领域持续复投。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Never hesitate to ask successful people for advice, learn the business from the ground floor up, and grow alongside great founders. Build a partnership team smarter than yourself, delegate fully, and keep reinvesting in high-demand sectors like data-center infrastructure.

advice_items.summary_zh: 从一线基层做起，跟随优秀创始人学透业务
advice_items.summary_en: Start on the front lines, learn every detail from the ground up, and partner with proven founders.
advice_items.quote: I started as a front line as a technician right out of high school... worked my way to start partnering with the founder... really learning the business from the ground up.
advice_items.video_title: Inside Texas’s Billionaire Town (Highland Park)

advice_items.summary_zh: 赋能并授权优秀人才，打造高效自治团队
advice_items.summary_en: Surround yourself with capable people, equip them with resources, and empower them so the business runs without you.
advice_items.quote: Create an environment where you're not needed. Empower your people, set them up for success, and give them the tools and resources to be successful.
advice_items.video_title: Inside Texas’s Billionaire Town (Highland Park)

advice_items.summary_zh: 抓住数据中心基建刚需，在细分赛道深耕
advice_items.summary_en: Position yourself in essential infrastructure niches riding massive real-world demand like fiber optics for data centers.
advice_items.quote: We install fiber optic cables for all the major companies and all the data centers... Tons of data centers, tons of needs. It's absolutely a great position to be in right now.
advice_items.video_title: Inside Texas’s Billionaire Town (Highland Park)

advice_items.summary_zh: 身边围绕比你更聪明的人，携手共事
advice_items.summary_en: Partner with and surround yourself with people who are smarter than you.
advice_items.quote: It's been greatly helpful to surround yourself with people that are smarter than you.
advice_items.video_title: Inside Texas’s Billionaire Town (Highland Park)

advice_items.summary_zh: 主动向成功者请教，寻找并跟随良师益友
advice_items.summary_en: Don't be afraid to walk up to successful people, ask how they did it, and learn from mentors.
advice_items.quote: Some of the best mentors I had, they always say just walk up to somebody and ask them how you did it.
advice_items.video_title: Inside Texas’s Billionaire Town (Highland Park)

advice_items.summary_zh: 坚守高尚品格，己所不欲勿施于团队成员
advice_items.summary_en: Lead with high integrity and never ask someone on your team to do work you wouldn't do yourself.
advice_items.quote: Follow Jesus Christ, follow your heart, have high integrity, and don't ask somebody to do something you're not willing to do yourself.
advice_items.video_title: Inside Texas’s Billionaire Town (Highland Park)

guests.role_or_title: Labor Force Management Founder ("The Houston Mogul")
guests.wealth_detail: ~$375M annual business revenue (up ~25% from ~$300M previously)
guests.first_money_or_break: 出身一无所有且没有大学学历，20岁打工时因提出颠覆1974年传统做法的新点子遭老板和众人嘲笑，却拒绝妥协并毅然创业，切入劳动力管理细分赛道，将公司年营收做到约3.75亿美元。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Starting with nothing and no college degree, he was laughed at by his boss and peers at age 20 for proposing an idea that upended industry practices dating back to 1974. Refusing to back down, he launched his own company in a workforce-management niche and scaled it to roughly $375 million in annual revenue.
guests.zero_start_advice: 先进入大行业打工领薪水并观察大公司忽略的细分缺口；砍掉不必要的日常消费，把钱当作工具投向能放大未来的大机会；选定擅长领域深耕，不听外界噪音、绝不放弃。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Take a salaried job in a big industry to spot the niche gaps giants overlook, and slash unnecessary spending so your money works as a tool for outsized opportunities. Pick an area where you excel, dig deep, tune out the noise, and never quit.

advice_items.summary_zh: 以尊重赢得团队忠诚，围绕共同愿景扩张
advice_items.summary_en: Earn your team's loyalty through respect and scale by uniting people around a shared vision.
advice_items.quote: Treat others with respect, to earn their loyalty... the only way you're ever going to grow a business is by scaling with people around you that are built around your vision.
advice_items.video_title: Inside Texas’s Billionaire Town (Highland Park)

advice_items.summary_zh: 无视他人质疑与传统束缚，坚定信念前行
advice_items.summary_en: Reject entrenched conventional wisdom and ignore doubters who think your new approach is crazy.
advice_items.quote: My boss told me... 'We've been doing this way since 1974.' I didn't buy into that. People thought I was crazy.
advice_items.video_title: Inside Texas’s Billionaire Town (Highland Park)

advice_items.canonical_tag: Work Under a Winner First Before Starting
advice_items.summary_zh: 先到大行业带薪学本领，抓住巨头忽视的漏洞
advice_items.summary_en: Get paid to learn inside an established industry, spot what incumbents are missing, and out-execute them in that gap.
advice_items.quote: Go work for someone else in a large industry, and see what they're missing... Let them pay you while you get educated to outdo them.
advice_items.video_title: Inside Texas’s Billionaire Town (Highland Park)

advice_items.canonical_tag: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep
advice_items.summary_zh: 戒掉日常无效消费，把钱用于投资未来增长
advice_items.summary_en: Eliminate frivolous daily spending and treat money as a tool to invest aggressively in big opportunities.
advice_items.quote: Get rid of all your Amazon deliveries, get rid of your $8 a day coffees. You need to be using money to expand your future.
advice_items.video_title: Inside Texas’s Billionaire Town (Highland Park)

advice_items.summary_zh: 远离社交媒体虚妄炒作，别轻信一夜暴富
advice_items.summary_en: Ignore online hype and fabricated social media success narratives.
advice_items.quote: Don't get caught up in all the hype and 99% of what you see on social media is absolute BS.
advice_items.video_title: Inside Texas’s Billionaire Town (Highland Park)

advice_items.summary_zh: 找到擅长领域深耕不辍，遇到困难绝不放弃
advice_items.summary_en: Find what you excel at, dig in relentlessly, and never quit despite hardship.
advice_items.quote: Be true to yourself, find something that you're great at, dig in, and I can't emphasize this enough, just never quit.
advice_items.video_title: Inside Texas’s Billionaire Town (Highland Park)

guests.wealth_detail: Over $11M in a single year
guests.first_money_or_break: 出身极度贫寒，高中未毕业且无大学学历，2015年白手起家创立沐浴及身体护理品牌（主营沐浴球），凭营销卖出数百万件产品，年收入曾超1100万美元。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Raised in extreme poverty without finishing high school or attending college, this founder bootstrapped a bath and body brand centered on bath bombs in 2015. Driven by sharp marketing, the company sold millions of products and surpassed $11 million a year.
guests.zero_start_advice: 重视营销让客户先认识、喜欢并信任你，敢于提出邀约；持续学习并对标Apple等顶尖企业，寻找十亿级痛点去解决；善用债务杠杆和房地产循环积累免税现金流，并尽早学习应用AI。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Prioritize marketing so customers get to know, like, and trust you, and never be afraid to ask for the sale. Keep learning, benchmark against top companies like Apple, target billion-dollar problems, use debt leverage and real estate cycling to build tax-free cash flow, and adopt AI early.

advice_items.summary_zh: 让客户先认识喜欢并信任你，并勇于发出邀约
advice_items.summary_en: Build know-like-trust through marketing and consistently make offers so customers can do business with you.
advice_items.quote: An offer you don't make is an offer that they can't take. So, you want to make sure that they know you. That way, they can like you. And if they know you and they like you, they'll trust you and do business with you.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Chicago)

advice_items.summary_zh: 专注理想目标而非现状，心中所想终会化为现实
advice_items.summary_en: Focus mentally on where you want to be rather than your current circumstances so you can manifest and seize it.
advice_items.quote: What you think about you bring about. So, too many people focus on where they are versus where they want to be... You have to see it before you see it so that you can seize it.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Chicago)

advice_items.summary_zh: 永远保持学习，停止学习的那一刻就停止赚钱
advice_items.summary_en: Never stop learning and taking notes, because the moment you stop learning is the moment you stop earning.
advice_items.quote: They never stop learning. The minute you stop learning is the minute you stop earning. For example, you want to write this down. Notetakers are money makers.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Chicago)

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.summary_zh: 对标顶尖企业，专注解决越多人面临的痛点问题
advice_items.summary_en: Study elite companies like Apple for inspiration, find gaps, and solve big problems since pay scales with problem size.
advice_items.quote: Look at the best mirror. Get inspiration. Then ask yourself, what are they not doing? What can I do? What problem can I solve?... You get paid in correlation to the problems that you solve, not the actual work that you do.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Chicago)

advice_items.canonical_tag: Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)
advice_items.summary_zh: 善用债务杠杆免税增值，别因全款忽视信用积累
advice_items.summary_en: Use debt and credit strategically as tax-free leverage rather than paying all cash and neglecting credit history.
advice_items.quote: The rich, the wealthy, the wise make money off of debt... now I maximize debt as leverage to increase my net worth. Why? Because I don't pay taxes on debt.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Chicago)

advice_items.summary_zh: 将主业利润转投房地产再融资，实现被动现金流
advice_items.summary_en: Roll operating business profits into real estate to earn 24/7 passive income, build equity, and refinance tax-free capital.
advice_items.quote: If company A makes X amount of money, I then roll that money into company B, which is a real estate company, and then I refinance out of those properties... The money is generating income 24/7, 365 passively. Plus, it's increasing in equity and in value.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Chicago)

guests.wealth_detail: Over $100M/yr (best year); founded 17 companies, sold 9 (3 to Berkshire Hathaway)

guests.zero_start_advice_en: Start in a recession-resistant cash-flow business like car washes and focus obsessively on becoming number one. Hire people smarter than you and help them get wealthy too.

advice_tags: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.summary_zh: 打造极具吸引力和最佳价值主张的公司
advice_items.summary_en: Build an irresistible company with the best value proposition in your space.
advice_items.quote: Build a company that is absolutely irresistible, has the best value proposition of anybody in your space
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaire Texans How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 雇佣比自己更聪明的人并深度投资帮助他们致富
advice_items.summary_en: Hire smarter people than yourself and invest deeply in helping them build wealth.
advice_items.quote: My whole life is about hiring smarter people than me... Spend all your time and all your energy getting the best talent you possibly can and investing in them deeply and helping them get to where you are.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaire Texans How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 选择洗车行等抗衰退的传统现金流生意
advice_items.summary_en: Choose recession-proof traditional cash-flow businesses like car washes.
advice_items.quote: Car wash, man... it's like an ATM machine, a legal ATM machine. It's recession proof. It's depression proof.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaire Texans How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 极度专注做好一件事并持续复利精进
advice_items.summary_en: Stay laser-focused on mastering one thing and compound your growth relentlessly.
advice_items.quote: The people that I know that have made the most money and created the most wealth have been laser focused on what they're doing and they compound that growth every hour, every minute, every day, forever.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaire Texans How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 保持低调，暴富高调炫耀，真正财富安静内敛
advice_items.summary_en: Stay low-key; rich is loud while true wealth is quiet.
advice_items.quote: Don't ever get rich and good-looking... Rich is loud and wealth is quiet.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaire Texans How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 将信仰置于首位，健康财富会失但信仰永恒
advice_items.summary_en: Prioritize faith; health and money can be lost, but faith endures.
advice_items.quote: You can lose your health, you can lose your money, you can lose your friends, but if you have a relationship with Jesus Christ, you got it forever.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaire Texans How They Got Rich!

guests.role_or_title: Venture Capitalist & Founder of RxList / Medable
guests.wealth_detail: Millionaire at 28; sold RxList (33x); Medable at $2.1B valuation (close to billionaire)
guests.first_money_or_break: 28岁通过储蓄、换取优质工作与拼搏成为百万富翁；后自筹资金创办RxList并在三年半后以33倍回报卖给WebMD，又推动Medable估值升至21亿美元。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Saving diligently, trading up into better jobs, and hustling hard made this founder a millionaire by age 28. They later bootstrapped RxList, sold it to WebMD three and a half years later for a 33x return, and helped drive Medable to a $2.1 billion valuation.
guests.zero_start_advice: 早年多储蓄并抓住好工作机会，多出门社交握手积累人脉；创业后聘请比自己更强的A级人才并学会放权，像海绵一样学习且不怕犯错。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Save aggressively early on, seize strong job opportunities, and get out there shaking hands to build your network. Once you launch, hire A-players stronger than yourself, learn to delegate, absorb knowledge like a sponge, and don't fear mistakes.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking San Francisco Millionaires How They Got Rich!

appearances.video_title: Asking San Francisco Millionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_tags: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep

advice_items.summary_zh: 理解风投幂律，敢于承担归零风险
advice_items.summary_en: Be comfortable with most bets going to zero in venture capital, knowing a few winners will pay off 100x.
advice_items.quote: you have to be comfortable with the risk of things going to zero and five of them are going to pay off 100 fold
advice_items.video_title: Asking San Francisco Millionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.canonical_tag: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep
advice_items.summary_zh: 早期坚持储蓄并全力拼搏积累
advice_items.summary_en: Save money early, land good jobs, stay mobile for opportunity, and hustle relentlessly.
advice_items.quote: started saving my money I got good jobs I moved around yeah so I just hustled
advice_items.video_title: Asking San Francisco Millionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 走出家门多社交，人脉决定财路
advice_items.summary_en: Don't stay isolated working from home; get out and network because more connections create more wealth.
advice_items.quote: the more hands you shake the more money you make
advice_items.video_title: Asking San Francisco Millionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 招募A级人才并充分放权才能扩张
advice_items.summary_en: Scale by hiring A-players who can do the job better than you and delegating real responsibility.
advice_items.quote: they can't scale because they won't hire a players and they won't hire good people around them and they won't delegate
advice_items.video_title: Asking San Francisco Millionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 像海绵一样不断吸收新信息学习
advice_items.summary_en: Act like a sponge and constantly absorb information and learn.
advice_items.quote: you got to be a sponge absorb information
advice_items.video_title: Asking San Francisco Millionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 别害怕犯错，放下顾虑勇敢试错
advice_items.summary_en: Stop letting the fear of making mistakes hold you back.
advice_items.quote: don't worry about making mistakes everybody worries about making mistakes
advice_items.video_title: Asking San Francisco Millionaires How They Got Rich!

guests.guest_name: Financial District Commercial Real Estate Investor
guests.wealth_detail: Millionaire at 38; $500k/yr personal income, $1M/yr business revenue; owns ~100,000 sq ft
guests.first_money_or_break: 专注于商业地产（公寓、办公楼与零售物业），38岁成为百万富翁，名下拥有约10万平方英尺地产，个人峰值年收入50万美元、公司年营收约100万美元。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Focusing on commercial real estate across apartments, offices, and retail, this investor became a millionaire at age 38 and built a portfolio of roughly 100,000 square feet. At peak, personal annual income hit $500,000 alongside roughly $1 million in annual company revenue.
guests.zero_start_advice: 地产赚钱在买入环节，趁他人急售低价时买进并直接与对方本人谈判；善用杠杆但勿过度负债，低谷期保持健康自律、低头苦干与信仰。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Real estate profits are made on the buy, so purchase when sellers need to move fast at a discount and negotiate directly with them. Use leverage wisely without overborrowing, and lean on health, discipline, quiet hard work, and faith during downturns.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking San Francisco Millionaires How They Got Rich!

appearances.video_title: Asking San Francisco Millionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_tags: Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)

advice_items.summary_zh: 地产投资赚在买入，低买才好退出
advice_items.summary_en: Make your money when you buy real estate rather than relying on the sell, so the exit is easy.
advice_items.quote: it's on the buy not the sell actually yeah you always want to make the best deal on the buy otherwise the exit's easy
advice_items.video_title: Asking San Francisco Millionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 直接与核心决策者谈判，剔除中介
advice_items.summary_en: Negotiate directly with the principal buyer or seller without letting middlemen get in the way.
advice_items.quote: make sure you're negotiating with the other principal don't let anybody get in the middle of your deal
advice_items.video_title: Asking San Francisco Millionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 遭遇低谷时沉住气低头苦干熬过去
advice_items.summary_en: During market downturns, keep your head down, work hard, and plow through adversity.
advice_items.quote: just keep your head down and you just got to keep plowing through it
advice_items.video_title: Asking San Francisco Millionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.canonical_tag: Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)
advice_items.summary_zh: 买地产须用杠杆但切忌过度负债
advice_items.summary_en: Use debt leverage to acquire real estate, but never over-leverage yourself.
advice_items.quote: that's the only way to buy real estate is leveraging... you cannot over leverage
advice_items.video_title: Asking San Francisco Millionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 保持身体健康自律，戒掉无效派对
advice_items.summary_en: Prioritize staying healthy, skip endless partying, and stay disciplined and focused on business.
advice_items.quote: keep myself healthy that's really key is to be healthy and stay healthy don't spend your time partying
advice_items.video_title: Asking San Francisco Millionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 保持信仰与敬畏，沉下心努力工作
advice_items.summary_en: Stay humble, work hard, and maintain strong faith in God.
advice_items.quote: keep your head down work hard and have faith in God
advice_items.video_title: Asking San Francisco Millionaires How They Got Rich!

guests.guest_name: Miami E-Commerce, M&A & Real Estate Founder
guests.wealth_detail: $5M gross ($3.9M net) last year; $6M YTD on track for $10M gross ($7.9M net) this year
guests.first_money_or_break: 最初从电商起家，后拓展至企业并购（M&A）及房地产领域，通过组建团队和建立业务系统实现业绩倍增。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Starting in e-commerce before expanding into mergers and acquisitions (M&A) and real estate, this founder multiplied results by building strong teams and repeatable business systems.
guests.zero_start_advice: 量入为出、切勿攀比炫富，尽早开设罗斯退休账户（Roth IRA）并持续复利投资，坚持以十年为单位的长期思维。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Live below your means and resist trying to keep up with flashy spenders. Open a Roth IRA early, keep compounding your investments, and think on a decade-by-decade horizon.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Miami)

appearances.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Miami)

advice_tags: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep

advice_items.summary_zh: 学会授权放权，组建团队与系统
advice_items.summary_en: Stop trying to be a solopreneur; put the right people in place, build systems, and delegate to scale.
advice_items.quote: if you can put the right people in place and delegate your work then you're able to grow a business... once you start to delegate... that's when you're going to start to see major growth
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Miami)

advice_items.summary_zh: 销售本质是心理学，用稀缺和品牌成交
advice_items.summary_en: Understand sales psychology—exclusivity, scarcity, and strong personal or business branding let you sell at high volume.
advice_items.quote: sales is psychology... if you can make someone believe that something is first of all limited edition and that is exclusive you can get them to buy anything... if you can brand your business if you can brand yourself you can sell anything
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Miami)

advice_items.summary_zh: 别为虚荣超前消费，攀比豪车名牌
advice_items.summary_en: Don't fall for social media flexes or go broke buying Lamborghinis and luxury items to keep up with the Joneses.
advice_items.quote: everyone that you see driving a Lamborghini and wearing flashy clothes they aren't actually rich... don't keep up with the Joneses even if you are making money
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Miami)

advice_items.canonical_tag: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持量入为出，避免生活方式膨胀
advice_items.summary_en: Live below your means and steadily build your reserves over time instead of inflating your lifestyle.
advice_items.quote: I know more millionaires who have sat back live below their means and built their funds over time... the best financial advice I could do is live below your means
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Miami)

advice_items.summary_zh: 每年定投罗斯退休账户，让时间复利
advice_items.summary_en: Open a Roth IRA, invest consistently every single year, and let compound interest grow your wealth.
advice_items.quote: invest invest invest accumulate your money compound interest open a Roth IRA invest in your Roth IRA every single year compound all of your money
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Miami)

advice_items.summary_zh: 坚持十年以上的长期思维，远离暴富盘
advice_items.summary_en: Think in years and decades rather than weeks and months; chasing get-rich-quick schemes will make you broke fast.
advice_items.quote: poor people think in weeks and months rich people think in years and decades... that get rich quick stuff is going to get you broke real quick
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Miami)

guests.wealth_detail: $100M+ NBA career earnings; compounded 2x-3x through business & investments
guests.first_money_or_break: 出身多伦多政府廉租房，16岁独自赴美读预科顶住质疑成为全美第一高中生，19岁进入NBA赚取超1亿美元并让父母退休。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Raised in Toronto public housing, he moved to the United States alone at 16 for prep school and defied skeptics to become the nation's top high school player. He entered the NBA at 19, went on to earn over $100 million, and retired his parents.
guests.zero_start_advice: 先在心理上把目标终局具象化并像成功人士一样自律行事；比所有人多投入一份努力，绝不走捷径。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Visualize your end goal clearly in your mind and carry yourself with the discipline of someone who has already made it. Outwork everyone around you and never take shortcuts.
guests.primary_video_title: I Asked Mark Wahlberg for His Best Life Advice!

appearances.video_title: I Asked Mark Wahlberg for His Best Life Advice!

advice_tags: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market

advice_items.summary_zh: 具象化终局目标，消除借口像富人一样行事
advice_items.summary_en: Picture yourself in the end state, drop mental excuses, and conduct yourself like a millionaire early.
advice_items.quote: I always pictured myself in the end state... you start walking like a millionaire, talking like a millionaire, conducting your life like a millionaire.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Mark Wahlberg for His Best Life Advice!

advice_items.summary_zh: 不要合群而要出众，比别人多付出一小时努力
advice_items.summary_en: Don't fit in, fit out—put in extra hours and effort beyond what everyone else is doing.
advice_items.quote: Don't fit in, fit out... If everyone's just working out 2 hours a day, do 3 hours. Go outside the box. Put that extra effort in cuz it's going to pay off.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Mark Wahlberg for His Best Life Advice!

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.summary_zh: 投资机器人能源数据等底层基建而非终端产品
advice_items.summary_en: Invest in foundational infrastructure layers like robotics, drones, energy, and data rather than only end products.
advice_items.quote: I'm investing a lot in robotics, drones, energy, data infrastructure, the infrastructure layer, not the end product.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Mark Wahlberg for His Best Life Advice!

advice_items.summary_zh: 利用个人影响力进入核心圈层并学习商业知识
advice_items.summary_en: Leverage your personal brand and status to enter deal rooms while educating yourself on business fundamentals.
advice_items.quote: Leveraging your NIL to put yourself in these rooms. And when you educate yourself and understand the business, then you come with a double edge
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Mark Wahlberg for His Best Life Advice!

advice_items.summary_zh: 永远不要走捷径，投机取巧只会带来失败
advice_items.summary_en: Never take shortcuts; what you put in is what you get out, and shortcuts invite failure.
advice_items.quote: No shortcuts. What you put in, what you get out, right?... Never have shortcuts. They have a shortcuts. That's where there's room for failure
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Mark Wahlberg for His Best Life Advice!

advice_items.summary_zh: 坚定对神的信仰，心怀信念走出低谷
advice_items.summary_en: Stay grounded in faith in God to overcome self-doubt and difficult origins.
advice_items.quote: my mom always told me who God has blessed, no man can curse... God's in it's in all of us.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Mark Wahlberg for His Best Life Advice!

guests.wealth_detail: $13B+ net worth; ~$10B/yr revenue (1,100 stores)
guests.first_money_or_break: 曾在TG&Y零售店担任主管，后借款600美元起家（450美元购买木框切割机，其余买胶水与木条），在车库制作迷你相框并雇销售员卖给工艺品店；攒够资金后于1970年在俄克拉荷马城开出第一家600平方英尺的Hobby Lobby门店并逐步扩展品类。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: A former supervisor at TG&Y retail stores, he started with a $600 loan ($450 for a frame-cutting machine and the rest for glue and wood strips) to make miniature picture frames in his garage and sell them to craft shops through hired reps. Once he saved enough, he opened the first 600-square-foot Hobby Lobby store in Oklahoma City in 1970 and steadily expanded its product lines.
guests.zero_start_advice: 资金有限时切忌急于开大店，应从微小的产品或生意做起并依靠自身盈利滚动扩张；避免银行借贷以防资金链断裂风险；保持运营简单标准化，深入研究每一款产品的成本与利润，并坚守信仰与道德原则。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: When capital is tight, start with a tiny product or venture and grow strictly out of profits rather than rushing into a big store or taking bank loans that can break your cash flow. Keep operations simple and standardized, know the exact cost and margin of every item, and stand firm on your faith and ethics.
guests.primary_video_title: I Started With $600... Now I Make $10B/Year

appearances.video_title: I Started With $600... Now I Make $10B/Year

advice_items.summary_zh: 热爱所做之事并怀抱超越金钱的使命
advice_items.summary_en: Love what you do and work for a deeper purpose beyond simply accumulating more money.
advice_items.quote: You have to love what you're doing and I love what I'm doing because I'm doing it for a reason... More does not make people happy.
advice_items.video_title: I Started With $600... Now I Make $10B/Year

advice_items.summary_zh: 资金有限时从小生意起步，攒够利润再开店
advice_items.summary_en: Start lean with the capital you have (making frames in a garage) and accumulate profits before opening a retail store.
advice_items.quote: When you have $600, you don't open up a retail store. You just make little frames and sell them to arts and crafts stores
advice_items.video_title: I Started With $600... Now I Make $10B/Year

advice_items.summary_zh: 持续深入研究选品与业务数据，切忌盲目扩张
advice_items.summary_en: Study your product assortment, inventory balance, and business thoroughly instead of guessing or diluting focus.
advice_items.quote: That's where the buyers have to study, study, study... you learn that by studying it cuz when you go like this you're just diluting everything.
advice_items.video_title: I Started With $600... Now I Make $10B/Year

advice_items.summary_zh: 精确掌握每一款产品的销量、成本与利润
advice_items.summary_en: Track exact unit sales, costs, and profit margins on every single item you carry.
advice_items.quote: it tells you how much money we make on each item... if you look at the cost and the sale that equates to $255,000 a month... we have that on every item that we carry.
advice_items.video_title: I Started With $600... Now I Make $10B/Year

advice_items.summary_zh: 保持信仰与感恩，视己为财富管家并慷慨回馈
advice_items.summary_en: Treat yourself as a steward rather than the owner of wealth, stay grounded in faith, and give generously (donating 60% of profits).
advice_items.quote: I think the best thing you can do for God to bless you is to let him know you're only the steward and not the owner.
advice_items.video_title: I Started With $600... Now I Make $10B/Year

advice_items.summary_zh: 坚守原则与道德底线，不为短期利益妥协
advice_items.summary_en: Never compromise your faith, ethics, or core principles for short-term profit (such as staying closed on Sundays).
advice_items.quote: if we see something that makes us more money, it has nothing to do with what's going to guide us. What's going to guide us is doing things that we think is right
advice_items.video_title: I Started With $600... Now I Make $10B/Year

guests.guest_name: Miami Yacht Owner & Former Hedge Fund / Fintech Founder
guests.role_or_title: Former Hedge Fund Owner & Fintech Founder
guests.wealth_detail: $300M most made in a single year; lost over $8M in one day trading
guests.first_money_or_break: 第一份工作在华尔街Nesbit Burns（后被蒙特利尔银行收购），随后创立对冲基金经营近28年（旗下约4000名交易员、600名员工，占美国市场成交量3%-4%），2010年转型创立金融科技公司并出售给加拿大大型银行。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Starting on Wall Street at Nesbit Burns (later acquired by the Bank of Montreal), this founder went on to run a hedge fund for nearly 28 years with roughly 4,000 traders and 600 employees accounting for 3%-4% of U.S. market volume. In 2010, they pivoted to launch a fintech company and sold it to a major Canadian bank.
guests.primary_video_title: I Asked Miami’s Millionaire Elite How They Got Rich

appearances.video_title: I Asked Miami’s Millionaire Elite How They Got Rich

advice_items.summary_zh: 遭遇重大亏损时保持冷静，总结教训再赢回来
advice_items.summary_en: Stay composed after major financial losses, treat setbacks as just one bad day, and learn the lesson to bounce back.
advice_items.quote: I had a bad day. Thought about it and I said, 'It's just a bad day.' ... over time, we learned from our lessons, made it back
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Miami’s Millionaire Elite How They Got Rich

advice_items.summary_zh: 时刻认清潜在风险，只投入能承受归零的资金
advice_items.summary_en: Always understand your downside risk, never underestimate uncertainty, and only invest what you can afford to lose completely.
advice_items.quote: always know what your risk is and always don't underestimate anything at all... make sure that I could afford what I'm investing if it goes to zero or it fails.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Miami’s Millionaire Elite How They Got Rich

advice_items.summary_zh: 重视人脉经营，主动结交行业核心关键人物
advice_items.summary_en: Prioritize intentional networking to connect with the exact people who can elevate your business.
advice_items.quote: the most important thing is networking where you want to meet people that you want to connect with.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Miami’s Millionaire Elite How They Got Rich

advice_items.summary_zh: 想要成功就必须吸引行业最顶尖的人才加入
advice_items.summary_en: Attract top-tier industry leaders and A-players to build credibility and take your company to the next level.
advice_items.quote: you got to be able to attract the best people in the industry if you want to make [it].
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Miami’s Millionaire Elite How They Got Rich

advice_items.summary_zh: 执行速度决定成败，看准机会必须果断出击
advice_items.summary_en: Move with urgency and speed—when an opportunity appears, act immediately rather than waiting.
advice_items.quote: so speed is extremely important when you want something you got to go for it
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Miami’s Millionaire Elite How They Got Rich

advice_items.summary_zh: 坚持正向心理暗示与目标具象化，规划路径并全力以赴
advice_items.summary_en: Use daily positive self-talk and mental visualization to map out the steps toward your goal and execute relentlessly.
advice_items.quote: manifesting is the most important thing you can do in business... I think in my head what are the steps for me to achieving that and I create this whole story and then I go for it.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Miami’s Millionaire Elite How They Got Rich
