advice_items.summary_zh: 先学会管好小钱才有能力驾驭大钱
advice_items.summary_en: Build disciplined money management with small sums first, or more income will just vanish into higher spending.
advice_items.quote: if you can't manage a $100 you can't manage a 100,000 you can't manage a million... you'd blow that and you'd be living paycheck to paycheck even if you had $10 million
advice_items.video_title: Asking Salt Lake City Millionaires How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 别为了面子买豪车名表等非必要消费
advice_items.summary_en: Stop buying status symbols like expensive cars, rings, and watches that you have not earned yet.
advice_items.quote: they spend too much money on that they don't need... you just think because you live here that you're owed the house and the apartment and the car and the ring and the watch
advice_items.video_title: Asking Salt Lake City Millionaires How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 发扬不怕吃苦的拼搏精神只管埋头实干
advice_items.summary_en: Commit to total self-reliance and outworking everyone without expecting handouts.
advice_items.quote: I just vowed to my dad that I would never in my life be in a place where I needed somebody to help me that's why I decided I was going to build everything on my back
advice_items.video_title: Asking Salt Lake City Millionaires How They Got RICH!

guests.guest_name: Houston ER Doctor & Lake Home Developer
guests.role_or_title: Emergency Room Doctor & Real Estate Developer
guests.wealth_detail: $4M-$5M in a single good year
guests.first_money_or_break: 最初按父母意愿学计算机，后转学医学成为急诊科医生，随后涉足商业并开始开发湖景房地产。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: After initially studying computer science to satisfy their parents, this founder switched to medicine to become an ER doctor before expanding into business and lake-home real estate development.
guests.zero_start_advice: 追随热爱的事业并敢于中途转型；打工学会本领后就自己单干，创业要放下自我、勇于担责，年轻时别急着买豪车而要留钱投资。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Follow what you love and don't be afraid to pivot midstream, then strike out on your own once you've learned the ropes on someone else's dime. Check your ego, take full responsibility as a founder, and hold off on luxury cars while you're young so you can invest your cash.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Houston)

appearances.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Houston)

advice_tags: Work Under a Winner First Before Starting
Be Careful Who You Partner With

advice_items.summary_zh: 追随热爱并允许方向随成长而调整
advice_items.summary_en: Follow your passion, and accept that your passions can shift as you grow older.
advice_items.quote: you got to follow your passion but it's okay for passions to be redirected as you get a little older
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Houston)

advice_items.canonical_tag: Work Under a Winner First Before Starting
advice_items.summary_zh: 打工只为学习，学成后应果断离开创业
advice_items.summary_en: Keep a job only long enough to learn everything you can, then move on to build your own thing.
advice_items.quote: you should only have a job long enough to learn what you can from it at that point it's time to move on
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Houston)

advice_items.summary_zh: 将盈利再投资于业务增长与扩张
advice_items.summary_en: Use profitable years to offset earlier losses and reinvest profits back into growth.
advice_items.quote: years where I made good money let's say around four to five million then you can offset some losses and then reinvest that into growth
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Houston)

advice_items.summary_zh: 创业初期要做好连轴转苦干的准备
advice_items.summary_en: Expect extreme grind early on—your first business takes relentless hours before turning profitable.
advice_items.quote: the first one's always the hardest it took me years to make it profitable you know there was times where I worked like 96 hours straight
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Houston)

advice_items.canonical_tag: Be Careful Who You Partner With
advice_items.summary_zh: 新手期防人之心不可无，勿轻信托付资金
advice_items.summary_en: Be cautious when you are new and trusting—don't hand your money over blindly, as many will try to take advantage of you.
advice_items.quote: rule number one in business is almost everybody will try to take advantage of you especially when you're new and trusting so before I say that I say don't give it to anybody
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Houston)

advice_items.summary_zh: 年轻时别急着买豪车，留钱用于投资
advice_items.summary_en: Don't blow money on a nice car in your twenties; preserve capital so you can invest when opportunities arise.
advice_items.quote: when you become 20 is when you want to spend money on that new car right away I didn't have my first nice car till I was 30 years old if you spent all your money too fast you won't be able to have the money to invest
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Houston)

guests.first_money_or_break: 28岁成为百万富翁，早年打好教育与专业基础后创立事业，现年51岁并掌管一家数十亿美元规模的保险经纪公司。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: After building a strong educational and professional foundation early on, this executive became a millionaire by age 28 and went on to launch a business. Now 51, they lead a multibillion-dollar insurance brokerage.
guests.zero_start_advice: 年轻人不要急功近利，先接受教育并花4到5年时间吃透本行业专业知识再大胆创业；早期坚持储蓄收入的10%-20%，靠复利在三四十岁实现百万资产。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Avoid chasing quick wins early on; get educated and spend 4 to 5 years mastering your industry before taking the entrepreneurial leap. Save 10%-20% of your income from the start so compounding can build a million-dollar net worth in your thirties or forties.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Houston)

appearances.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Houston)

advice_tags: Work Under a Winner First Before Starting

advice_items.summary_zh: 卓越领导力与优秀团队是做大企业核心
advice_items.summary_en: Scale a multi-billion dollar business through great leadership and hiring great people.
advice_items.quote: the insurance brokerage fund that I run now is a multi-billion dollar company... and it's all about great leadership and great people
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Houston)

advice_items.summary_zh: 创业起步要敢于果断，资金与资源自会汇聚
advice_items.summary_en: Be bold when starting out, and financial resources will follow.
advice_items.quote: be bold and money forces will come to your Aid
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Houston)

advice_items.canonical_tag: Work Under a Winner First Before Starting
advice_items.summary_zh: 花四五年深耕专业打好基础再自主创业
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid rushing for quick riches; spend four to five years mastering your discipline before launching on your own.
advice_items.quote: young people they all want to like try to make it as fast as they can spend four or five years understanding your discipline and then go out and do it yourself
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Houston)

advice_items.summary_zh: 精读《富裕理发师》与《邻家的百万富翁》
advice_items.summary_en: Read foundational personal finance books like The Wealthy Barber and The Millionaire Next Door.
advice_items.quote: read The Wealthy Barber and read The Millionaire Next Door
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Houston)

advice_items.summary_zh: 职业早期坚持储蓄10%-20%并靠复利致富
advice_items.summary_en: Save 10% to 20% early in your career and leverage compounding so even a modest salary builds a million-dollar net worth by your 30s or 40s.
advice_items.quote: save money early in your career you know the rule of seven say 10 to 20 percent and if you do that by 30 or 40 you're a millionaire even if you make 70 80 000 a year
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Houston)

advice_items.summary_zh: 用财富积极行善回馈社会、改变他人生活
advice_items.summary_en: Use your success to help others and give back generously through charity.
advice_items.quote: always change people's lives help people I have a 501c I give away a lot of a lot a lot of money... God put me on the start to change people's lives
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Houston)

guests.role_or_title: Retired NFL Quarterback & Entrepreneur (7-Time Super Bowl Champion)
guests.first_money_or_break: 靠在橄榄球场上拼命训练与比赛赚取数亿美元；高中和大学花了九年才站稳主力，NFL选秀前六轮被32支球队跳过后凭借韧性在职业赛场打出成绩。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: He earned hundreds of millions of dollars through relentless training and play on the football field. After taking nine years across high school and college to lock down a starting job and getting passed over by all 32 teams through six rounds of the NFL draft, his resilience carried him to pro stardom.
guests.zero_start_advice: 别抱怨自己没得到的机会，全力抓住眼前的每一次机会；主动走出舒适区、通过日常高压训练建立抗压能力，保持自律与诚信并永不言弃。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Stop complaining about the opportunities you didn't get and pour everything into the ones right in front of you. Step outside your comfort zone, build toughness through daily high-pressure training, stay disciplined and honest, and never quit.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking One of the Richest Men in the NFL How He Got Rich!

appearances.video_title: Asking One of the Richest Men in the NFL How He Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 逆境绝不放弃，拼尽全力战斗到底
advice_items.summary_en: Never quit when facing adversity; fight relentlessly until the very end.
advice_items.quote: Don't quit. Go fight your ass off and fight to the end. Look, whatever happens, be proud of what you did by the way you fought.
advice_items.video_title: Asking One of the Richest Men in the NFL How He Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 无视外界质疑，倾听内心的自我信念
advice_items.summary_en: Ignore external doubters and trust your own internal self-belief.
advice_items.quote: I think you have to listen to what's inside of you and the own self-belief that you have. And the person that you're looking at in the mirror every day really matters most.
advice_items.video_title: Asking One of the Richest Men in the NFL How He Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 接纳试错与失败，失败是成功的阶梯
advice_items.summary_en: Embrace trial, error, and failure as the stepping stones that enable success.
advice_items.quote: It's just a lot of trial and error and a lot of failure. And I think the failures that I had allowed me to be successful.
advice_items.video_title: Asking One of the Richest Men in the NFL How He Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 向优秀导师学习正确方法与自律
advice_items.summary_en: Seek out great mentors who teach you the right methods and discipline for longevity.
advice_items.quote: I had so many great mentors and that taught me the right way... it was a lot of discipline that I learned through our work together about how to take care of my body that allowed me to do what I love to do for a long time.
advice_items.video_title: Asking One of the Richest Men in the NFL How He Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 用每日正确习惯与自律赢得成功
advice_items.summary_en: Commit to daily discipline, habits, and actions that put you in position to succeed.
advice_items.quote: You have to have the right discipline and habits and actions every day to make the right choices to put yourself in a position to succeed.
advice_items.video_title: Asking One of the Richest Men in the NFL How He Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 坚守诚信与原则，以身作则活出榜样
advice_items.summary_en: Live with integrity and be proud of the person in the mirror, as your actions set the example.
advice_items.quote: Be proud of the person you look back in the mirror every single day because that's the person you got to satisfy. And the life you lead is the lesson you teach.
advice_items.video_title: Asking One of the Richest Men in the NFL How He Got Rich!

guests.wealth_detail: $15M/yr peak income; first $1M at age 28 (~$4M-$5M inflation-adjusted)
guests.first_money_or_break: 出身普通，在华尔街担任债券交易员，28岁赚到人生第一个100万美元（按通胀折合如今约400万至500万美元），巅峰期单年收入达1500万美元。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Coming from an ordinary background, this Wall Street bond trader made their first $1 million at age 28, equivalent to roughly $4 million to $5 million today after inflation. At peak, annual earnings reached $15 million.
guests.zero_start_advice: 尽早开始并自信地投资标普500指数基金，切勿短线投机或频繁交易，让复利发挥作用；同时选择热爱的工作，保持自信并持续投入时间深耕。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Start investing early and confidently in an S&P 500 index fund, avoiding short-term speculation or frequent trading so compounding can work. Pair that with work you genuinely love, stay confident, and put in the hours to master it.
guests.primary_video_title: I Asked Logan Paul How He Built a Billion-Dollar Business

appearances.video_title: I Asked Logan Paul How He Built a Billion-Dollar Business

advice_tags: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time

advice_items.summary_zh: 长期持有投资资产以发挥复利威力
advice_items.summary_en: Stay invested long-term in the market (such as the S&P 500) to let compounding multiply your wealth.
advice_items.quote: You have to stay in investments because of compounds. Compounding money is like, you know, the eighth wonder of the world.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Logan Paul How He Built a Billion-Dollar Business

advice_items.summary_zh: 低谷期也要保持绝对自信与信念
advice_items.summary_en: Maintain unwavering confidence in yourself and your strategy even during bad days or losing weeks.
advice_items.quote: Most important thing is in my opinion was always to be confident. Even when I had bad days, a bad week, I was always confident.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Logan Paul How He Built a Billion-Dollar Business

advice_items.summary_zh: 热爱自己的工作才能走得长远
advice_items.summary_en: Love your work so much that you look forward to showing up every day.
advice_items.quote: I couldn't wait to get to work. I loved going to work. That's the most important thing in the world. Love your job.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Logan Paul How He Built a Billion-Dollar Business

advice_items.summary_zh: 认准方向后坚持投入工时并贯彻到底
advice_items.summary_en: Once you find your lane, commit to it, put in the hours, and see it through.
advice_items.quote: Once you find something, you got to stick with it and see it through. You have to work hard. You got to put in hours.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Logan Paul How He Built a Billion-Dollar Business

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.summary_zh: 通过持有公司股权或股票积累大额财富
advice_items.summary_en: True wealth comes from owning equity in companies rather than merely earning a paycheck.
advice_items.quote: People own equity or stock in their own companies. You know, like Jeff Bezos, Jensen Huang.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Logan Paul How He Built a Billion-Dollar Business

advice_items.summary_zh: 切忌短线投机或频繁交易，应耐心定投指数
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid speculation and frequent trading; be patient and invest steadily in broad index funds like the S&P 500.
advice_items.quote: Invest early, invest confidently, don't speculate. Buy the S&P 500.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Logan Paul How He Built a Billion-Dollar Business

guests.role_or_title: Coach for Top Entrepreneurs & Content Creators / Content Creator
guests.zero_start_advice: 先确定当下最想做的小事及愿付出的代价，自信迈出最小一步；留出独处静思空间激发灵感，戒除过度刺激，并通过饮食与呼吸管理身体状态。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Decide on the smallest thing you want to do right now and what you're willing to pay for it, then take that first step with confidence. Carve out quiet solitude for inspiration, cut out overstimulation, and manage your physical state through diet and breathwork.
guests.primary_video_title: HOW TO GET EVERYTHING YOU WANT IN LIFE Ft. Josh Terry

appearances.video_title: HOW TO GET EVERYTHING YOU WANT IN LIFE Ft. Josh Terry

advice_items.summary_zh: 明确所求与代价，自信迈出最小下一步
advice_items.summary_en: Define what you want, decide what you will sacrifice, and confidently take the smallest reasonable next step.
advice_items.quote: figure out what you want... figure out what you will do or give up to get it and then... come up with the smallest reasonable Next Step that you can do in a cocky manner
advice_items.video_title: HOW TO GET EVERYTHING YOU WANT IN LIFE Ft. Josh Terry

advice_items.summary_zh: 区分欲望与瘾欲，追逐让人变强的兴奋目标
advice_items.summary_en: Distinguish real desires from cheap cravings and pursue exciting goals that make you stronger.
advice_items.quote: learn the difference between a desire and a craving because now you can actually chase after stuff that you want just chase after the things that make you better
advice_items.video_title: HOW TO GET EVERYTHING YOU WANT IN LIFE Ft. Josh Terry

advice_items.summary_zh: 戒除手机与酒精等过度刺激，避免借口拖延
advice_items.summary_en: Eliminate overstimulation like endless phone scrolling, streaming, and drinking instead of blaming lack of passion.
advice_items.quote: one of the biggest issues is overstimulation... they're staring at the phone for 16 hours it's that they're addicted to Netflix they're drinking too much
advice_items.video_title: HOW TO GET EVERYTHING YOU WANT IN LIFE Ft. Josh Terry

advice_items.summary_zh: 相信良师益友存在，主动融入积极向上的圈子
advice_items.summary_en: Believe supportive peers exist, expose yourself to positive content, and join communities of driven people.
advice_items.quote: first believe that it's possible and then try to get any exposure to the good stuff that you can... and then start finding communities where people are doing good stuff
advice_items.video_title: HOW TO GET EVERYTHING YOU WANT IN LIFE Ft. Josh Terry

advice_items.summary_zh: 用客观事实打破冒充者综合征，聚焦下一步
advice_items.summary_en: Overcome imposter syndrome by accepting objective results and focusing on your next actions rather than worthiness.
advice_items.quote: look at it from an evidence-based framework... stop questioning about whether or not you deserve it and start questioning what you're gonna do moving forward
advice_items.video_title: HOW TO GET EVERYTHING YOU WANT IN LIFE Ft. Josh Terry

advice_items.summary_zh: 严控饮食管理健康，找到适合自己的自律方案
advice_items.summary_en: Take control of your health and find a sustainable diet that works for your body as a foundation for performance.
advice_items.quote: my life never took off until I got diet under control... you gotta find the thing that works for you
advice_items.video_title: HOW TO GET EVERYTHING YOU WANT IN LIFE Ft. Josh Terry

guests.first_money_or_break: 在耐克从卖球鞋和T恤的基层做起，历任销售、零售到产品等多个岗位，最终晋升为耐克总裁。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Starting at Nike on the ground floor selling shoes and T-shirts, this executive rotated through sales, retail, and product roles before eventually rising to president of Nike.
guests.zero_start_advice: 半开玩笑称若性命攸关一年内赚100万美元，会开酒吧或发起GoFundMe众筹页面向大家求助。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Half-jokingly, they said that if their life depended on making $1 million in a year, they would open a bar or launch a GoFundMe page and ask everyone for help.
guests.primary_video_title: Exclusive Interview with Former Nike President: Life Lessons and Advice for Success

appearances.video_title: Exclusive Interview with Former Nike President: Life Lessons and Advice for Success

advice_tags: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep

advice_items.summary_zh: 自信做真实的自己，处事更果敢大胆
advice_items.summary_en: Be bolder, have more confidence in yourself, and always stay authentic to who you are.
advice_items.quote: I'd probably be a little bolder than I was and I'd probably be a little bit more confident in who I was to make certain that I always remain authentic to who I was
advice_items.video_title: Exclusive Interview with Former Nike President: Life Lessons and Advice for Success

advice_items.summary_zh: 趁年轻无牵绊时，勇敢尝试各种新事物
advice_items.summary_en: Take bold risks and try as many different things as possible while you are young and have fewer responsibilities.
advice_items.quote: you should be trying as many different things as you can try and by the way do it in a very bold audacious way and to have the confidence to go do it
advice_items.video_title: Exclusive Interview with Former Nike President: Life Lessons and Advice for Success

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.summary_zh: 高度聚焦目标消费者，明确为其解决痛点
advice_items.summary_en: Maintain a strong focus on the consumer you want to serve and the specific problems you are solving for them.
advice_items.quote: super strong focus on the consumer who are you trying to serve and what type of problems are you trying to solve for those people
advice_items.video_title: Exclusive Interview with Former Nike President: Life Lessons and Advice for Success

advice_items.summary_zh: 追逐梦想投身热爱，保持好奇并解决问题
advice_items.summary_en: Chase your dreams, work on something you are passionate about, stay curious, and focus on solving a problem.
advice_items.quote: chase your dreams get involved with something that you're passionate about and then try to solve a problem and remain curious
advice_items.video_title: Exclusive Interview with Former Nike President: Life Lessons and Advice for Success

advice_items.canonical_tag: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep
advice_items.summary_zh: 制定理财计划并坚持执行，存下10%收入
advice_items.summary_en: Create a financial plan with clear goals, stick to it, and consistently save 10% of your income.
advice_items.quote: I had a plan in place I set goals out for myself and I stuck with that plan... have a plan and I save 10 of my income
advice_items.video_title: Exclusive Interview with Former Nike President: Life Lessons and Advice for Success

advice_items.summary_zh: 警惕所谓“稳赚不赔”的投资，别偏离计划
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid 'can't-miss, for-sure' investment pitches—they rarely work out and will pull you off track from your financial plan.
advice_items.quote: when you listen to someone tell you hey there's this can't miss investment I've had a few of those and I've missed almost every time
advice_items.video_title: Exclusive Interview with Former Nike President: Life Lessons and Advice for Success

guests.role_or_title: Owner & Co-Founder, Taifi Real Estate (Real Estate Brokerage & Investor)
guests.first_money_or_break: 17岁考取房产经纪执照，一边在Papa John's送披萨、拖地打工，一边在小型经纪公司早出晚归；拖地时接到首个客户电话并成功成交，赚取约6000-7000美元，从此踏入房产行业。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: He earned his real estate license at 17, working long days at a small brokerage while delivering pizzas and mopping floors at Papa John's. He landed his first client call while mopping, closed the deal for around $6,000-$7,000, and launched his real estate career.
guests.primary_video_title: 10 Questions with a Real Estate Millionaire: Tips for Building Wealth and Success

appearances.video_title: 10 Questions with a Real Estate Millionaire: Tips for Building Wealth and Success

advice_tags: Be Careful Who You Partner With
Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time

advice_items.summary_zh: 早出晚归拼命工作，初入行就拿新人王
advice_items.summary_en: Be the first one in, last one out, and out-hustle everyone early in your career.
advice_items.quote: I started at a mom and pop brokerage first one in last one out just hustling man I got rookie of the year
advice_items.video_title: 10 Questions with a Real Estate Millionaire: Tips for Building Wealth and Success

advice_items.summary_zh: 全面学习行业知识，掌握金融与评估技能
advice_items.summary_en: Learn every aspect of your industry—including finance and appraisal—to prepare for ownership.
advice_items.quote: I always wanted to learn as much as possible about real estate and then figure out how do I own real estate
advice_items.video_title: 10 Questions with a Real Estate Millionaire: Tips for Building Wealth and Success

advice_items.summary_zh: 深度链接身边志同道合的伙伴并互相成就

advice_items.video_title: 10 Questions with a Real Estate Millionaire: Tips for Building Wealth and Success

advice_items.summary_en: Most business partnerships fail; rigorously test a potential partner's work ethic, sobriety, and discipline before committing.

advice_items.summary_en: Run the business on clear operating systems and divide roles by strengths—delegating operations and hiring so you focus on vision and relationships.
advice_items.quote: we've divided the roles where he's the operations guy... and I'm out there living what I believe is my best role which is networking

advice_items.quote: take off the broker hat we're investors... we have control of this piece of paper which is actual ownership

guests.first_money_or_break_en: Working in finance and owning businesses, he began investing in residential real estate along the Los Angeles coast and in tax-friendly states in the 1990s. Today, he holds properties through more than 50 LLCs.
guests.zero_start_advice: 极度努力工作，只投资自己理解的资产（如住宅房产），通过LLC保护资产并深入理解税务，同时别忘了享受生活。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Work relentlessly, invest only in assets you truly understand such as residential real estate, and master taxes while protecting your assets through LLCs. Above all, remember to enjoy life along the way.

advice_items.summary_zh: 坚持公平共赢，给他人证明自己的机会
advice_items.summary_en: Conduct business fairly, aim for win-win outcomes, and give people a chance.
advice_items.quote: I believe in doing things fairly and that business can be a win-win for anybody ... Everybody deserves a break and a chance to prove themselves in business.

advice_items.summary_zh: 创业必须雇佣值得信赖的人才
advice_items.summary_en: Hire trustworthy, capable employees when running companies.
advice_items.quote: employees, you have to hire people that you trust.

advice_items.summary_en: Use LLCs to protect assets and learn tax fundamentals early.

guests.guest_name: Atlanta Tech Founder & Former Wall Street Banker
guests.role_or_title: Tech Company Founder & Former Wall Street Professional
guests.wealth_detail: Just shy of $10M in a single year; owns an eight-figure tech company; millionaire at 33
guests.first_money_or_break: 出身中产家庭，成为家族首位大学生与百万富翁；曾在华尔街为富人管理资产，2013年离职创办科技公司，2017年实现盈利并在33岁成为百万富翁，单年最高收入接近1000万美元。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Born into a middle-class family, he became the first college graduate and millionaire in his family after managing wealth for rich clients on Wall Street. He left in 2013 to launch a tech company, turned profitable in 2017, became a millionaire at 33, and has earned nearly $10 million in a single year.
guests.zero_start_advice: 财富始于内心信念，先相信自己配得上进入顶级圈层；不要只靠省钱和打工，要通过拥有公司股权或自己创业并积极投资让钱生钱。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Wealth starts with believing you deserve a seat in top circles. Instead of relying solely on saving or a paycheck, build equity or start your own business and invest aggressively to make your money work for you.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Billionaire Women How They Got RICH!

appearances.video_title: Asking Billionaire Women How They Got RICH!

advice_tags: Work Under a Winner First Before Starting

advice_items.canonical_tag: Work Under a Winner First Before Starting
advice_items.summary_zh: 先在华尔街近距离服务顶级富豪，再辞职创业
advice_items.summary_en: Learn wealth mechanics working with billionaires on Wall Street before launching.
advice_items.quote: My job was to keep rich people rich for a living. I came up with the idea in 2013, but we didn't make our money until 2017 as a business.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaire Women How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 效仿富豪80%配置证券10%另类投资，不囤现金
advice_items.summary_en: Keep most wealth invested in marketable securities and alternatives rather than cash.
advice_items.quote: 80% of their money typically is in marketable securities. ... 10% in cash and 10% in alternative investments ... Wealthy people do not put their money in cash. It's always in something that has a potential to grow their wealth.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaire Women How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 不能靠死存钱或打工致富，必须让钱为你工作
advice_items.summary_en: Give your money a job description because you cannot save or work to wealth.
advice_items.quote: Wealthy people put their money to work. ... they give their money a job description. You cannot save or work your way to wealth. You can only invest your way there.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaire Women How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 打破身份设限，坚信自己配得上坐在顶级牌桌上
advice_items.summary_en: Adopt the mindset that you belong in the room and deserve wealth.
advice_items.quote: one of the biggest things I learned about a 1% on Wall Street, they believe they have power. They believe they deserve to be in a room. ... I knew that I could be a billionaire because I was in that room.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaire Women How They Got RICH!

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.summary_zh: 致富核心在于股权所有权，买优质公司或自创企业
advice_items.summary_en: Build wealth through equity ownership in companies or your own business.
advice_items.quote: the key is ownership. You have to create your wealth by owning companies that you know you use and believe in or create your own business.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaire Women How They Got RICH!

guests.wealth_detail: Sold Spanx for $1.2B; made hundreds of millions in a single year
guests.first_money_or_break: 挨家挨户推销传真机7年攒下5000美元作为全部启动资金，21年零外部融资创办并100%持有Spanx，在Neiman Marcus将产品主动摆上收银台后迅速爆红，最终以12亿美元出售公司。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: She saved $5,000 selling fax machines door-to-door for 7 years to bootstrap Spanx, retaining 100% ownership with zero outside funding for 21 years. After placing her product directly by the register at Neiman Marcus, the brand took off and she eventually sold the company for $1.2 billion.
guests.zero_start_advice: 解决一个真实痛点，赌上自己并保持乐趣；在想法刚萌芽最脆弱的头一年先悄悄打磨，不要急于听亲友意见，同时把无数次拒绝当成通往成功的必经之路。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Solve a real pain point, bet on yourself, and keep things fun. Protect your fragile idea in its first year by refining it quietly without seeking friends' or family's opinions, and treat constant rejection as a normal step toward success.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Billionaire Women How They Got RICH!

appearances.video_title: Asking Billionaire Women How They Got RICH!

advice_tags: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value

advice_items.summary_zh: 用攒下的5000美元赌自己一把，敢于承担风险
advice_items.summary_en: Bet your hard-earned savings on yourself instead of playing it safe.
advice_items.quote: I had $5,000 that I had saved myself from selling fax machines door-to-door for seven years. ... Do you want to spend your five grand on a vacation or do you want to try to bet on yourself?
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaire Women How They Got RICH!

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.summary_zh: 坚持21年零外部融资，牢牢守住股权与控制权
advice_items.summary_en: Retain ownership and control by self-funding instead of giving away equity.
advice_items.quote: I never had a single investor in Spanx other than me. ... Self-funded the entire 21 years. ... whatever you give away in your business, you have to be very willing to give up.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaire Women How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 把拒绝视为成功公式的一部分，越被拒离肯定越近
advice_items.summary_en: Reframe every rejection as proof that you are getting closer to a yes.
advice_items.quote: Rejection is my middle name. ... by the time I started Spanx, rejection I knew was just part of the formula to success. ... Oh, I'm closer to my yes.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaire Women How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 不择手段推进业务，先斩后奏把产品摆到收银台
advice_items.summary_en: Take bold guerrilla action to get products in front of buyers; ask forgiveness, not permission.
advice_items.quote: I took bins that I bought at Office Depot and stuck them at every cash register in the store ... You do whatever it takes. And I always say ask for forgiveness, not permission.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaire Women How They Got RICH!

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.summary_zh: 敏锐发现并填补长期未被满足的消费者刚需空白
advice_items.summary_en: Create products that fill an unmet functional void for customers.
advice_items.quote: the way that I saw that it solved my problem with my clothes. ... I filled a void that women had been waiting for me to fill.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaire Women How They Got RICH!

guests.wealth_detail: $300M net worth; $100M personal annual income
guests.first_money_or_break: 出生在苏联时期的立陶宛（成长于澳大利亚），白手起家；2000年互联网泡沫破灭时曾倾家荡产，随后凭借对谷歌排名的理解创办全球第一扑克网站PokerNews.com翻身，现经营区块链公司年入1亿美元、净资产3亿美元。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Born in Soviet-era Lithuania and raised in Australia, he started from nothing, went broke in the 2000 dot-com crash, and bounced back by leveraging Google SEO to launch PokerNews.com, the world's top poker site. He now runs a blockchain company generating $100 million a year and holds a $300 million net worth.
guests.zero_start_advice: 没钱时要孤注一掷拼命干并组建顶尖团队，失败了也不要放弃而是把经验用到下一个项目；有钱后要做好多元化配置，不要只存钱，要持续投资自己的健康、大脑、事业以及股票和区块链资产。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: When you have nothing, go all-in, build an A-list team, and carry every lesson from failure into your next venture. Once you build wealth, diversify beyond cash by investing continuously in your health, mind, business, stocks, and blockchain assets.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Dubai Moguls How They Got Rich!

appearances.video_title: Asking Dubai Moguls How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 团队下班后依然通宵死磕，绝不轻言放弃
advice_items.summary_en: Outwork everyone, stay late overnight when needed, and refuse to give up.
advice_items.quote: if everyone wants to leave I go there and work overnight right you just don't give up you just keep going
advice_items.video_title: Asking Dubai Moguls How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 失败亏钱不可怕，把踩坑经验转化为新项目
advice_items.summary_en: When a venture fails, take the hard-earned knowledge from that loss and apply it to build your next project.
advice_items.quote: if you lose money on certain things you don't give up you take the knowledge that you got from that experience and you go and create other stuff
advice_items.video_title: Asking Dubai Moguls How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 拒绝自满，聚拢顶尖人才与技术团队做大事业
advice_items.summary_en: Never get complacent; recruit top talent and build a great team because you cannot succeed alone.
advice_items.quote: you cannot be complacent and you have to keep developing and you have to get the best people to work with you Henry Ford said only with a team you can make it... it's all about talent
advice_items.video_title: Asking Dubai Moguls How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 相信自己并投身热爱之事，把热爱做成事业
advice_items.summary_en: Trust yourself and pursue things you genuinely love so that building a business brings fulfillment.
advice_items.quote: trust yourself just go for it yourself do things you love and then if it becomes a business you're going to be very happy
advice_items.video_title: Asking Dubai Moguls How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 别只顾存钱，要终身投资健康、大脑与资产
advice_items.summary_en: Don't just hoard cash—invest continuously throughout your life in your health, mind, businesses, equities, and crypto.
advice_items.quote: key is to invest invest invest don't save but invest invest in yourself in your health in your head and in the businesses... just invest all your life
advice_items.video_title: Asking Dubai Moguls How They Got Rich!

guests.role_or_title: Founder, Specialty Finance Company & Former Wall Street Broker
guests.wealth_detail: Sold specialty finance company for almost $100M in 2018; 95% in equities and 25% in a crypto fund
guests.first_money_or_break: 出身布鲁克林蓝领家庭，曾在华尔街和三家全球顶级大公司担任高管；在一位导师的启发下，利用业余时间创办副业，最终于2018年以近1亿美元出售其专业金融公司。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Raised in a blue-collar Brooklyn family, he worked on Wall Street and held executive roles at three major global corporations. Inspired by a mentor, he started a side hustle in his spare time and eventually sold his specialty finance company in 2018 for nearly $100 million.
guests.zero_start_advice: 不要只为大公司打工，在全职工作期间先做副业起步，敢于押注自己并独立创业，同时着眼长远愿景。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Don't spend your career just working for big corporations; start a side hustle while keeping your day job. Bet on yourself, build your own business, and stay focused on a long-term vision.
recommended_books_or_mentors: Corporate mentor who advised him to build outside big companies

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.summary_zh: 为自己创业持股，远比替大公司打工更有前景
advice_items.summary_en: Start your own business to build equity for yourself rather than enriching huge corporations.
advice_items.quote: It's a lot better to make money for yourself and the people that work for you as opposed to really big companies. So the best advice I can give is to start something on your own.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich

advice_items.summary_zh: 听从职场导师点拨，趁早寻找打工之外的出路
advice_items.summary_en: Seek mentors who push you to look beyond corporate salaries for real wealth.
advice_items.quote: I worked at a big company and had a really good mentor... he was the one who said, 'If you really want to be successful and make a lot of money, it's not going to happen if you're working for a big company.'
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich

advice_items.summary_zh: 全职工作期间先做副业试水，找到热爱即行动
advice_items.summary_en: Launch a side business while still employed full-time to test and discover your passion.
advice_items.quote: So, I started a little side business while I was working full-time and realized that that was my passion.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich

advice_items.summary_zh: 六十岁依然敢于押注自己，持续承担创业风险
advice_items.summary_en: Bet on yourself and keep taking calculated entrepreneurial risks at every age.
advice_items.quote: I'm still taking risk and I'm not stopping... Again, the message is betting on yourself.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich

advice_items.summary_zh: 重仓股票长期复利，适度配置加密资产分散风险
advice_items.summary_en: Stay heavily invested in equities for growth while sizing crypto conservatively based on risk profile.
advice_items.quote: I'm 95% in equities... if someone has a modest risk profile, it [crypto] should probably be 10 to 15% of their profile.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich

guests.guest_name: Boca Raton Multifamily Real Estate Investor
guests.wealth_detail: Bought a $72M deal with zero money down via creative financing; lost $250M in equity and cash in one down-market year
guests.first_money_or_break: 受亲戚一句话启发进入多户住宅领域，卖光所有汽车并借了5万美元买下第一栋四户住宅（fourplex），自住一户出租三户起步，随后用创意融资滚雪球至7200万美元大单。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Inspired by a relative's remark, he sold his cars and borrowed $50,000 to buy his first fourplex, living in one unit and renting out the other three. From there, he used creative financing to snowball his portfolio into $72 million deals.
guests.zero_start_advice: 不必等攒够巨额资金再买房，可以从小型多户住宅自住兼出租起步，靠积累信用和口碑运用创意融资；同时重视自我成长、身心健康与诚实面对困境。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: You don't need a fortune to get into real estate; house-hack a small multifamily property and use strong credit and reputation to unlock creative financing. Prioritize personal growth, physical and mental health, and face setbacks honestly.
recommended_books_or_mentors: Family member who introduced him to multifamily fourplexes

appearances.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich

advice_items.summary_zh: 买下四户住宅自住一户出租三户，低成本起步
advice_items.summary_en: Start in multifamily real estate by buying a fourplex, living in one unit, and renting the rest.
advice_items.quote: I bought my first forplex... I lived in one and I rent the other three and that's how it started.

advice_items.canonical_tag: Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)
advice_items.summary_zh: 善用创意融资，靠信用和口碑实现零首付拿地
advice_items.summary_en: Use creative financing instead of banks to acquire large real estate deals with little or no cash down.
advice_items.quote: The last deal I think I bought $72 million I bought with zero money... It's a creative financing rather.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich

advice_items.summary_zh: 做人必须建立良好信用与口碑，资金自会找你
advice_items.summary_en: Build strong credit and a trustworthy reputation so capital partners willingly fund your deals.
advice_items.quote: You got to build your reputation and you got to build the credit and there's people that want to give you the money all the time.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich

advice_items.summary_zh: 成功学不到真东西，人生的失败才是最好的老师
advice_items.summary_en: Extract your deepest growth from major failures rather than coasting on past successes.
advice_items.quote: I don't learn [ __ ] from my successes... It's about the lessons and the failure I made in my life.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich

advice_items.canonical_tag: Don't Neglect Health & Family for Money
advice_items.summary_zh: 别把工作当成麻痹逃避，更别将身份绑定生意
advice_items.summary_en: Do not let workaholism sedate you or allow your business to become your entire identity.
advice_items.quote: My businesses becomes my identity versus I have my own identity... workaholism... it's a sedation because we don't want to be in the present moment.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich

guests.guest_name: Lagos Solo Female GP & Private Equity Fund Founder
guests.role_or_title: Private Equity & Venture Capital Fund Founder (Solo Female GP)
guests.wealth_detail: Manages ~$80M fund (AUM)
guests.first_money_or_break: 18岁进入雷曼兄弟投行部，20岁在摩根大通做并购，21岁进入私募股权，29岁怀孕5个月时创立自己的基金，如今运营非洲最大的女性独立GP风投基金。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: She entered investment banking at Lehman Brothers at 18, worked in M&A at J.P. Morgan at 20, and moved into private equity at 21. At 29, while five months pregnant, she launched her own fund and now leads Africa's largest solo female GP venture fund.
guests.zero_start_advice: 去无人关注的领域寻找被低估的机会（如女性创业、中小企业及非洲万亿级非正规经济基础设施），拒绝接受“不”，凭借坚持、信念和信仰创造属于自己的席位。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Look for overlooked opportunities where others aren't paying attention, such as female founders, SMEs, and infrastructure for Africa's trillion-dollar informal economy. Refuse to take no for an answer, and carve out your own seat through persistence, conviction, and faith.

advice_tags: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market

advice_items.summary_zh: 认准市场空白，克服质疑果断入局

guests.guest_name: Joy (Atlanta Attorney & Hair Salon Franchise Founder)
guests.wealth_detail: $5M highest single-year income
guests.first_money_or_break: 非富裕家庭出身，法学院毕业在律所工作时意识到高薪仍有上限，果断辞职转行做美发产品与美发沙龙特许经营，创业20余年。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Not from a wealthy family, she went to law school and worked at a firm before realizing even a high salary had a ceiling. She quit to launch a hair products and salon franchise business, which she has now been building for over 20 years.
guests.zero_start_advice: 不必等大笔资金再创业，先自筹资金向陌生人卖货验证需求，同时建立正规公司架构与专业门面，跑通后再融资10倍放大。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Don't wait for big capital to start; bootstrap by selling to strangers to validate demand while setting up a proper corporate structure and professional presence. Once the model works, raise funding to scale it 10x.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Atlanta Billionaires How They Got Rich!

appearances.video_title: Asking Atlanta Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_tags: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.summary_zh: 跳出有薪资上限的打工模式，自主创业追求无上限收益
advice_items.summary_en: Leave jobs with fixed salary caps and build your own business with uncapped upside.
advice_items.quote: I worked a law firm, and I realized that my income there's a salary cap, and no matter how good I was, I'm only going to make X amount of money. I was like, 'This isn't for me. I'm going to go on my own.'
advice_items.video_title: Asking Atlanta Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 先低成本自筹资金跑通产品验证并保留股权，再融资放大
advice_items.summary_en: Bootstrap early to prove strangers will pay and retain equity before raising capital to scale what works.
advice_items.quote: You can bootstrap it. Start small. You want to first get what's called proof of concept. Can you go sell your product or service to a stranger?... You bootstrap it, you own more equity in your business.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Atlanta Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 注重健康与形象管理，你本人的状态就代表公司品牌
advice_items.summary_en: Prioritize health, self-care, and sharp personal presentation because you are the face of your brand.
advice_items.quote: Health and self-care. I believe as a woman you need to always look your best. And in business you represent the brand, so you got to show up for yourself. You cannot sell a dream looking like a nightmare.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Atlanta Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 别听不愿与之交换银行账户的人的劝阻，坚定押注自己
advice_items.summary_en: Ignore dream killers who can't see your vision; never take advice from people whose financial life you wouldn't trade for.
advice_items.quote: Your biggest dream killers don't see the vision, but my motto is never take advice from someone that you wouldn't exchange a bank account with... I'm going to bet on myself.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Atlanta Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 创业不看起点看终点，被打倒后只要爬起来就能赢
advice_items.summary_en: Get back up every time business knocks you down; resilience determines how you finish.
advice_items.quote: It's not how you start, it's how you finish. In business, in life, you're going to get knocked down... If you get back up, you can keep on fighting and go get your win.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Atlanta Billionaires How They Got Rich!

guests.wealth_detail: $8M peak single-year income; company sold for $740M-$790M (with contingencies)
guests.first_money_or_break: 早期从事地球物理与地质技术工作，在石油天然气行业深耕35年、60岁左右成为百万富翁；后来抓住墨西哥市场开放的早期时机冒险钻出第一口大油井，最终将公司以7.4亿至7.9亿美元出售，个人单年最高收入达800万美元。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Starting in technical geophysics and geology roles, he spent 35 years in oil and gas and became a millionaire around age 60. He then took an early risk drilling the first major well as Mexico's market opened, eventually selling his company for $740 million to $790 million and earning up to $8 million in a single year.
guests.zero_start_advice: 如果重来会从银行业/金融起步，理解资金来源与资本运作而非仅做技术打工人；扩大企业规模需要极具进取心、抓住早期机遇敢于承担风险，并与值得信赖的好伙伴长期共事。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: If starting over, he would begin in banking or finance to understand capital flows instead of staying solely on the technical side. Scaling a business requires relentless drive, bold risk-taking on early opportunities, and building long-term alongside trustworthy partners.

appearances.video_title: Asking Holiday Shoppers How They Got RICH!

advice_items.quote: I'd start in banking... if you understand where the money's coming from or who's got the money and how that all works, then you can do a lot more things and then you benefit personally a bit more from it.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Holiday Shoppers How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 抓住早期窗口果断冒险，敢于下重注

advice_items.quote: Super aggressive, took a lot of risk, worked our asses off, and got in at the right time in the early stages when Mexico opened up and we were there and we took that risk and drilled that first well.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Holiday Shoppers How They Got RICH!

advice_items.video_title: Asking Holiday Shoppers How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 商业本质是人，与值得信赖的人长期共事

advice_items.summary_zh: 专注做好一件事，就能产生巨大涟漪效应
advice_items.summary_en: Focus on executing one core thing extraordinarily well rather than trying to solve everything.

advice_items.video_title: Asking Holiday Shoppers How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 保持敏锐观察，大量阅读与深入思考
advice_items.summary_en: Read voraciously, think deeply, and stay observant to spot winning products.
advice_items.quote: Just keep your eyes open. Read a lot, talk to people, network, but just read a lot, think a lot.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Robert Herjavec How He Made $500 Million

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.summary_zh: 敢于进入高竞争市场寻找大机会
advice_items.summary_en: Enter competitive markets because high competition proves strong demand and opportunity.
advice_items.quote: The more competitive something is, that means there's an opportunity. The best place to put a gas station is next to another gas station.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Robert Herjavec How He Made $500 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 敢于格局放大，无论如何绝不放弃
advice_items.summary_en: Think big, stay alert to opportunities, and never quit.
advice_items.quote: Keep your eyes open. Keep thinking big. Think big and never ever, no matter what, quit.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Robert Herjavec How He Made $500 Million

advice_items.summary_zh: 承受反复打击依然坚持前行
advice_items.summary_en: Endure repeated setbacks and keep pushing forward without quitting.
advice_items.quote: Don't ever quit. We've been punched in the head so many times it's not even funny.
advice_items.video_title: I Asked Robert Herjavec How He Made $500 Million

guests.wealth_detail: Close to $2M in a single year (became millionaire at 34)
guests.first_money_or_break: 进入住宅房地产经纪领域，团队单年累计成交额达14亿美元；个人34岁成为百万富翁，单年最高收入接近200万美元。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Entering residential real estate brokerage, he built a team doing $1.4 billion in annual sales volume. He personally became a millionaire at 34 and has earned nearly $2 million in a single year.
guests.zero_start_advice: 比任何人都更勤奋地发起房产沟通；建立包含老手资金方与产权贷款机构的优质人脉圈并全力寻找好交易，找到好项目后资金自然会找上门。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Outwork everyone in starting real estate conversations and build a strong network of seasoned capital partners and title or lending pros. Focus relentlessly on sourcing great deals, because money always finds good deals.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Scottsdale)

appearances.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Scottsdale)

advice_items.summary_zh: 买下优质房产长期持有，善用1031条款延税
advice_items.summary_en: Buy real estate, hold it long-term, and use 1031 exchanges to defer taxes and scale into bigger properties.
advice_items.quote: buy real estate don't sell it unless you need the money or there's a better opportunity... use the tax code 1031 exchange to be able to defer your tax
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Scottsdale)

advice_items.summary_zh: 别让资金闲置堆积，让钱流动起来才能增值
advice_items.summary_en: Keep deploying money into productive assets rather than letting cash sit idle so your wealth compounds.
advice_items.quote: money is like [ __ ] if you leave it in a pile it stinks and if you spread it around things grow
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Scottsdale)

advice_items.summary_zh: 比任何人都更高频地与人沟通房产交易
advice_items.summary_en: Out-communicate the competition by having more real estate deal conversations than anyone else.
advice_items.quote: have more real estate conversations than anybody else
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Scottsdale)

advice_items.summary_zh: 搭建涵盖新手、资产规划师与资金方的人脉网
advice_items.summary_en: Build a focused network of peers, asset-rich capital partners (enders), and reliable title/lending vendors to close deals.
advice_items.quote: find starters estate planners and Enders... build a small Network... and then the education to get the deal closed or vendor Partners like title companies and lending
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Scottsdale)

advice_items.summary_zh: 主动出击拼命找好项目，好项目自带资金
advice_items.summary_en: Hustle relentlessly to source great deals, because capital naturally flows to strong deals.
advice_items.quote: you got to go hustle and find the deal once you find the deal... the money will find the deal
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Scottsdale)

guests.first_money_or_break: 行医四十余年前为大学同窗，通过牙科执业赚取收入并数十年坚持将结余投入先锋指数基金实现财务自由。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Former college classmates who practiced dentistry for over 40 years, they earned steady clinical incomes and achieved financial freedom by consistently investing their savings in Vanguard index funds for decades.
guests.zero_start_advice: 阅读《The Simple Path to Wealth》，尽早储蓄并长期定投先锋指数基金让几何复利发挥威力，拒绝即时满足与超前消费。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Read "The Simple Path to Wealth," start saving early, and dollar-cost average into Vanguard index funds over decades so compounding can do its work. Resist instant gratification and overspending.
recommended_books_or_mentors: The Simple Path to Wealth (JL Collins)
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Philadelphia)

appearances.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Philadelphia)

advice_tags: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep

advice_items.summary_zh: 阅读《简单致富之路》学习指数投资理财
advice_items.summary_en: Read 'The Simple Path to Wealth' to learn a straightforward approach to investing and financial independence.
advice_items.quote: Read the book The Simple Path to Wealth.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Philadelphia)

advice_items.summary_zh: 尽早并数十年坚持定投指数基金享受复利
advice_items.summary_en: Invest your earnings into Vanguard index funds starting as young as possible so geometric compounding pays off over decades.
advice_items.quote: Put it into Vanguard Index Funds and you do it for decades... Money doesn't grow linearly. It grows geometrically.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Philadelphia)

advice_items.canonical_tag: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep
advice_items.summary_zh: 决定财富的是储蓄投资率，保守消费早退休
advice_items.summary_en: Wealth comes from how much you save and invest, not just income; living conservatively lets you retire early.
advice_items.quote: It's not how much you earn, it's how much you save and invest... I lived relatively conservative considering how much I earned.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Philadelphia)

advice_items.summary_zh: 戒掉即时满足与超前消费，避免终身打工
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid instant gratification and spending beyond your means; even high earners end up working forever if they overspend.
advice_items.quote: They have instant gratification... They spend more than they have... friends who earned more than I did are still going to work because they spent.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Philadelphia)

advice_items.summary_zh: 人生并非直线，接受起伏和亏损并从中成长
advice_items.summary_en: Accept that progress isn't linear—you will face losses and setbacks along the way, and experience teaches what advice alone cannot.
advice_items.quote: Life is not a straight line. You have your ups, your downs... You're going to have your losses.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Philadelphia)

guests.role_or_title: Commercial Real Estate Entrepreneur & Downtown Property Owner
guests.first_money_or_break: 与银行建立良好信任，每笔按时并超额偿还本金，以30%首付或抵押现有房产杠杆逐步买下费城市中心整条街区物业。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: By earning deep trust with banks through on-time and accelerated principal payments, he put 30% down or leveraged existing equity to acquire properties one by one. Over time, he ended up owning an entire block in Center City Philadelphia.
guests.zero_start_advice: 保守借贷并超额还本金赢得银行支持，不要沉溺于每天的失败；珍惜当下，多花时间陪伴并照顾家人。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Borrow conservatively and pay down principal ahead of schedule to win bank backing, without dwelling on daily setbacks. Stay present and devote real time to caring for your family.
recommended_books_or_mentors: Father (We grow old too soon and wise too late)
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Philadelphia)

appearances.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Philadelphia)

advice_items.canonical_tag: Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)
advice_items.summary_zh: 保守用债并提前多还本金赢得银行信任融资
advice_items.summary_en: Be conservative with loans and pay down extra principal ahead of schedule so friendly banks trust and finance your growth.
advice_items.quote: I was conservative and I tried to pay back more principal per year than I was due. So they saw me as a good client.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Philadelphia)

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.summary_zh: 买楼旨在引进优质租户、打造有活力的社区
advice_items.summary_en: Focus on building vibrant communities by bringing in great tenants and creating places people genuinely enjoy visiting.
advice_items.quote: My real goal is to build a tremendous community... put in great tenants that people would love to go to.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Philadelphia)

advice_items.summary_zh: 失败每天都在发生，别沉溺其中而要向前看
advice_items.summary_en: Everyone experiences failures daily; recall your past successes and move past setbacks quickly rather than dwelling on them.
advice_items.quote: Everyone has failures. I have them every day... If you dwell in failure, you'll never be successful.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Philadelphia)

advice_items.canonical_tag: Don't Neglect Health & Family for Money
advice_items.summary_zh: 人生苦短，尽可能多花时间陪伴家人
advice_items.summary_en: Prioritize spending as much time as possible with your family, recognizing how fragile life can be.
advice_items.quote: Spend as much time as you can with your family.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Philadelphia)

advice_items.summary_zh: 陷入低谷时依靠信仰祈祷并照顾好家人
advice_items.summary_en: When you hit rock bottom, lean on prayer and faith while taking care of your family.
advice_items.quote: Whatever religion you are praying to God, but also taking care of family.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Philadelphia)

guests.wealth_detail: Company worth hundreds of millions of dollars; ~$60M annual revenue; $1.5B+/month processed volume
guests.first_money_or_break: 早年在旧金山德勤咨询工作并赴斯坦福商学院深造，20多岁时立志投身重建非洲，随后创立金融基础设施公司 Paga。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: After working at Deloitte Consulting in San Francisco and earning his MBA at Stanford Graduate School of Business, he committed in his 20s to helping rebuild Africa. He went on to found the financial infrastructure company Paga.
guests.zero_start_advice: 放下傲气坚持跟进，把“不”当成“暂未成功”，并专注投身于你热爱的使命与事业。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Check your ego, follow up relentlessly, and treat every "no" as "not yet." Stay committed to a mission and work you genuinely love.
recommended_books_or_mentors: First boss at Deloitte Consulting (San Francisco)

appearances.video_title: Inside Africa’s Billionaire City (Lagos)

advice_tags: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market

advice_items.summary_zh: 招募顶尖人才并放权让他们创新
advice_items.summary_en: Hire exceptional people, align them with the mission, and empower them to build without micromanagement.
advice_items.quote: Find exceptional people, share the mission with them, and then get out of their way and let them build. Let them innovate.
advice_items.video_title: Inside Africa’s Billionaire City (Lagos)

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.summary_zh: 选择处于起步期的高增长大市场
advice_items.summary_en: Target massive, young, underserved greenfield markets with long-term demographic tailwinds.
advice_items.quote: Africa is the only market that is yielding financial services from ground up at this scale. It is the single largest greenfield opportunity for financial services
advice_items.video_title: Inside Africa’s Billionaire City (Lagos)

advice_items.summary_zh: 在商业中主动持续跟进客户与机会
advice_items.summary_en: Master follow-up in business because everyone is busy and it is your responsibility to chase opportunities.
advice_items.quote: Everybody has their own thing going on. It's on you to chase it up.
advice_items.video_title: Inside Africa’s Billionaire City (Lagos)

advice_items.summary_zh: 放下自尊，把拒绝视为暂未成功
advice_items.summary_en: Drop your ego and treat a 'no' as 'not yet' rather than permanent rejection.
advice_items.quote: Let your ego go. Somebody says no to you, it's not no forever. It's no today. No doesn't mean no, it means not yet.
advice_items.video_title: Inside Africa’s Billionaire City (Lagos)

advice_items.summary_zh: 专注热爱之事，明确使命并全力追求
advice_items.summary_en: Focus on something you genuinely love, define your mission and passion, and pursue it relentlessly.
advice_items.quote: Really focus on something that you love, decide your mission and your passion, and go after it.
advice_items.video_title: Inside Africa’s Billionaire City (Lagos)

guests.role_or_title: Amusement Park & Real Estate Developer (Built 13 Amusement Parks)
guests.first_money_or_break: 15岁起步、19岁起便未再替任何人打工，靠成功人士对其品格与能力的信任筹集借款，先后建造了13座游乐园以及高尔夫球场、购物中心与住宅项目。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Starting at 15 and never working for anyone else after 19, he raised loans on the strength of his character and competence from successful backers. He went on to build 13 amusement parks along with golf courses, shopping centers, and residential developments.
guests.zero_start_advice: 尽早为自己干、用行动力设定目标并持续耕耘，靠赢得成功者的信任筹资起步，同时选对伴侣经营长久幸福的家庭。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Work for yourself as early as possible, back your goals with relentless execution, and raise startup capital by earning the trust of successful people. Just as importantly, choose the right partner and build a lasting, happy family.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking 90 Year Old Billionaires If Getting Rich Was Worth It

appearances.video_title: Asking 90 Year Old Billionaires If Getting Rich Was Worth It

advice_tags: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.summary_zh: 为自己干就不算苦差事，尽早独立创业而非替人打工
advice_items.summary_en: Work for yourself rather than someone else so building your business feels fulfilling, not like work.
advice_items.quote: If you're doing it for yourself, it's not work. If you're doing it for someone else, it is.
advice_items.video_title: Asking 90 Year Old Billionaires If Getting Rich Was Worth It

advice_items.summary_zh: 赢得成功人士的信任，靠人脉与信誉撬动起步资金
advice_items.summary_en: Earn the trust of successful people who believe in you to help finance big ventures.
advice_items.quote: You come out with people like you that are successful that believe in you. They know you're worth it.
advice_items.video_title: Asking 90 Year Old Billionaires If Getting Rich Was Worth It

advice_items.summary_zh: 重大抉择前借由祈祷与禁食寻求内心笃定与指引
advice_items.summary_en: Seek spiritual clarity through prayer and fasting before making major life or investment decisions.
advice_items.quote: If you fast for a purpose with the Lord involved and you're praying... at the end of 24 hours, when you go forward thereafter, he's your partner.
advice_items.video_title: Asking 90 Year Old Billionaires If Getting Rich Was Worth It

advice_items.summary_zh: 一分耕耘一分收获，明确设定目标并全力以赴去实现
advice_items.summary_en: Set clear goals, work hard for them, and continually set new goals to develop your talents.
advice_items.quote: You get out of life what you put in it. If you want to succeed in life, you have to set a goal and you have to work for it.
advice_items.video_title: Asking 90 Year Old Billionaires If Getting Rich Was Worth It

advice_items.summary_zh: 保持早睡早起的自律作息，兼顾健康、财富与智慧
advice_items.summary_en: Maintain disciplined daily habits like going to bed early and rising early.
advice_items.quote: Early to bed, early to rise, makes a man healthy, wealthy, and wise.
advice_items.video_title: Asking 90 Year Old Billionaires If Getting Rich Was Worth It

guests.role_or_title: Former Hedge Fund Managing Partner & CEO
guests.wealth_detail: Millionaire at 30; managed ~$40B hedge fund
guests.first_money_or_break: 出身贫困（曾住加州贫民区及北卡乡村拖车房），靠拼命努力赢得他人投资与信任，抓住机会在管理近400亿美元资产的对冲基金担任资深管理合伙人长达21年，30岁成为百万富翁。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Growing up in poverty in California projects and rural North Carolina trailer parks, he earned others' trust and investment through sheer grit. He seized the chance to serve for 21 years as a senior managing partner at a nearly $40 billion hedge fund and became a millionaire at 30.
guests.zero_start_advice: 不要只依赖天赋与舒适区，要刻意学习补足短板；投资无需复杂化，把钱放进标普500等低成本指数基金并长期复利；重视伴侣品格并多行善助人。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Don't coast on talent or stay in your comfort zone; deliberately study to close your weak spots. Keep investing simple with low-cost index funds like the S&P 500 for long-term compounding, value character in a partner, and help others generously.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH! (Boston)

appearances.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH! (Boston)

advice_items.summary_zh: 拼命努力工作，才能抓住降临的机会
advice_items.summary_en: Work relentlessly so you are prepared to seize opportunities and breaks when people invest in you.
advice_items.quote: I worked my ass off and then got just a series of breaks that I took advantage of.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH! (Boston)

advice_items.summary_zh: 不要只靠天赋，主动学习补齐自身短板
advice_items.summary_en: Do not rely only on what comes naturally; continuously learn new skills to supplement your strengths.
advice_items.quote: Learn how to dribble with your left. Don't rely on what comes natural, what comes easy. Constantly look for those other things to supplement the things that you already have.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH! (Boston)

advice_items.summary_zh: 定投低成本标普500指数基金长期复利
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid overly complicated bets and consistently invest in a low-cost S&P 500 index fund to let wealth compound over time.
advice_items.quote: Put it in an index fund. Vanguard... S&P 500. Like don't be overly complicated... Compound wealth over time.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH! (Boston)

advice_items.summary_zh: 切勿沉迷豪车名表等外物炫耀，临终无用
advice_items.summary_en: Do not obsess over buying cars, rings, or status items; none of them matter at the end of life.
advice_items.quote: A lot of people think about, you know, cars and rings. When you're lying on your deathbed, the last thing that you're thinking about is the next thing that you bought.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH! (Boston)

advice_items.summary_zh: 以信仰、行善与助人多少来衡量人生价值
advice_items.summary_en: Ground your life in faith and measure yourself by how much you give and help others rather than how much money you stack.
advice_items.quote: More importantly than how much I made in a single year is how much I gave away to help others... Faith has been key for me... do something to help somebody today.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got RICH! (Boston)

guests.role_or_title: Founder of Internet Advertising Company (Sold to Blackstone)
guests.industry_zh: 营销代理与高客单销售
guests.wealth_detail: Sold company to Blackstone for ~$200M in 2016 (later bought it back)
guests.first_money_or_break: 早年挨家挨户推销黄页（Yellow Pages），参与公司互联网项目时看到公司收款1亿美元却只分给他1万美元奖金，遂决定在地下室白手起家单干，创办互联网广告公司。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Starting out selling Yellow Pages door-to-door, he helped build an internet initiative that brought in $100 million for his employer while paying him just a $10,000 bonus. That pushed him to go out on his own from a basement and launch an internet advertising company.
guests.zero_start_advice: 相信自己，设立看似遥不可及的目标并拆解每一步去实现；利用AI自动化一切重复性工作以释放批判性思维精力；尽早搭建LLC等合规实体结构保护自身。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Believe in yourself, set audacious goals, and break them down step by step while using AI to automate repetitive work and free up your critical thinking. Set up proper legal entities like an LLC early to protect yourself.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Mega Mansion Owners How They Got Rich!

appearances.video_title: Asking Mega Mansion Owners How They Got Rich!

advice_tags: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.summary_zh: 在AI等新兴平坦赛道找准细分切入点
advice_items.summary_en: Enter emerging fields like internet marketing or AI where everyone starts on a level playing field and out-execute through specificity.
advice_items.quote: It was new to everyone. So we were all on a level playing field... if you can really be specific with it and roll it out to people and just be smarter about it, you have a foothold in the industry.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Mega Mansion Owners How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 节假日秒回客户，以极致服务赢下大单
advice_items.summary_en: Beat giant competitors through extreme responsiveness and availability, even during holidays.
advice_items.quote: I sent an email over Christmas time and I said, 'Hey, listen, my team is going to be gone for the next two hours. If you need anything, just let me know.' He goes, 'You won the business.'
advice_items.video_title: Asking Mega Mansion Owners How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 永不满足停步，保持创业初期的干劲
advice_items.summary_en: Protect your drive and founder spirit; stay hungry, keep generating ideas, and never stop pushing.
advice_items.quote: You don't want to lose that drive. The biggest thing is not losing that founder spirit... Getting up, being excited, going in, coming up with new ideas, and just never stopping. Can't take a break.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Mega Mansion Owners How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 坚定自信并把远大目标拆解为可执行步骤
advice_items.summary_en: Believe in yourself, envision goals that seem out of reach, and map out the small incremental steps required to achieve them.
advice_items.quote: Believe in yourself. Always having that picture of something that's out of reach and saying, 'How do I get there?' But what are all the little steps along the way to actually get there?
advice_items.video_title: Asking Mega Mansion Owners How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 尽早设立LLC等合规架构保护个人资产
advice_items.summary_en: Set up a proper business entity structure like an LLC early to legally protect yourself and operate properly.
advice_items.quote: Incredibly important. That's how you protect yourself. That's how you make sure that you have everything legally done the right way.

guests.zero_start_advice_en: Don't just play defense or follow a rigid script; go all-out on offense to win, and concentrate heavily on one or two core ventures rather than over-diversifying to build maximum wealth. guests.zero_start_advice_en: Commit to building your brand for the long haul with a solid foundation and team, and calculate manufacturing costs, margins, and inventory cash flow before taking on big orders. advice_items.summary_zh: 买入低估房产并长期持有，房地产不会归零
advice_items.summary_en: Buy undervalued real estate and hold long-term; unlike stocks or businesses, real estate doesn't go to zero.
advice_items.quote: Find properties that are below value... think very long term with it... real estate does not go to zero.
advice_items.video_title: Here’s How Real Estate Millionaires Spend Their Day

advice_items.canonical_tag: Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)
advice_items.summary_zh: 善用房地产高杠杆以小博大，放大净值回报
advice_items.summary_en: Leverage in real estate allows a small down payment to control a large asset and multiply returns as it appreciates.
advice_items.quote: The leverage that you get with real estate is unreal. You might put ten thousand dollars down on a property, but if it's worth 300,000 and it goes up ten percent that year, you just tripled your money.
advice_items.video_title: Here’s How Real Estate Millionaires Spend Their Day

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.summary_zh: 不止赚佣金，与团队合伙买房持有股权资产
advice_items.summary_en: Look beyond commissions by partnering on real estate deals to own equity and build generational wealth.
advice_items.quote: That type of agent can come here and find that opportunity and we'll buy it with them and we'll show them how to do it and we'll give them equity.
advice_items.video_title: Here’s How Real Estate Millionaires Spend Their Day

advice_items.summary_zh: 善用社交媒体规模化传播，将触达从十人放大到千万
advice_items.summary_en: Digital content and social media provide massive leverage, scaling your reach from 10 people to 10 million.
advice_items.quote: The only way to scale and to get a message out is through social media... instead of talking to 10 people, we'd like to talk to 10 million.
advice_items.video_title: Here’s How Real Estate Millionaires Spend Their Day

advice_items.summary_zh: 主动创造价值、大胆破局链接高价值人脉
advice_items.summary_en: Be persistent, get creative, and shoot your shot with high-value people by leading with what they want to promote.
advice_items.quote: We knew that he had certain things that he wanted to talk about... so we just did it for him in the first five minutes... if you're persistent and you just shoot your shot, doesn't matter who it is, get creative.
advice_items.video_title: Here’s How Real Estate Millionaires Spend Their Day

guests.first_money_or_break: 取得法学学位并执业律师15年后，意识到按小时收费存在时间上限，随即转型进入房地产行业并创办产权过户公司（Title Office），依靠团队运营实现收入增长。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: After earning a law degree and practicing as an attorney for 15 years, she realized billing by the hour capped her income, so she pivoted into real estate and founded a title office that scales through a team.
guests.primary_video_title: Here’s How Real Estate Millionaires Spend Their Day

appearances.video_title: Here’s How Real Estate Millionaires Spend Their Day

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.summary_zh: 跳出按小时卖时间的陷阱，创办团队运作的产权公司
advice_items.summary_en: Leave hourly-capped work behind and build a team-run business so your income isn't limited to 24 hours a day.
advice_items.quote: I practiced law for about 15 years and realized hour for hour work is only going to get you paid hour for hour and there's 24 hours in a day, so I decided to move over into the real estate industry, started a title office.
advice_items.video_title: Here’s How Real Estate Millionaires Spend Their Day

advice_items.summary_zh: 敢于纵身一跃先上场，在行动过程中边做边完善
advice_items.summary_en: Take the leap and figure out the details as you go—the most important thing is getting into the game.
advice_items.quote: Sometimes you got to jump out of a plane and build the parachute on the way down. It doesn't matter what horse you're on, just make sure you're on a horse.
advice_items.video_title: Here’s How Real Estate Millionaires Spend Their Day

advice_items.summary_zh: 多与比自己更聪明、更有经验的人为伍
advice_items.summary_en: Surround yourself with people who are smarter than you to accelerate your growth.
advice_items.quote: Surround yourself with people who are smarter than you.
advice_items.video_title: Here’s How Real Estate Millionaires Spend Their Day

advice_items.summary_zh: 前辈愿意花时间指点你时，一定要抓住机会虚心请教
advice_items.summary_en: Whenever an experienced veteran offers to spend time mentoring you, always accept it.
advice_items.quote: If some old dog is offering their time to you, take it.
advice_items.video_title: Here’s How Real Estate Millionaires Spend Their Day

advice_items.summary_zh: 年轻时别过度犹豫，尽早迈出买房和行动的第一步
advice_items.summary_en: Stop overthinking early decisions like buying your first property—you simply have to get started.
advice_items.quote: My 22-year-old was trying to figure out if he wanted to buy a house or not... I just did everything I could to make him buy the house. Gotta get started.
advice_items.video_title: Here’s How Real Estate Millionaires Spend Their Day

guests.role_or_title: Martial Arts Coach & Men's Mentor / Content Creator
guests.zero_start_advice: 年轻男性应掌握五项核心能力：学习格斗防身并保持体魄、克服恐惧迈出行动第一步、在现实中寻找良师（如武术教练）、成家前及早培养养家能力、修习情绪与言行自控（节制），以及保持对自我和更高力量的信念。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Young men should build five core pillars: learn martial arts for self-defense and stay fit, overcome fear to take the first step, find real-world mentors like a martial arts coach, develop the ability to provide before starting a family, and master emotional and verbal self-control while keeping faith in themselves and a higher power.
guests.primary_video_title: 5 SKILLS Every Young Man Should Know in 2023

appearances.video_title: 5 SKILLS Every Young Man Should Know in 2023

advice_items.summary_zh: 学习格斗防身并保持体魄，像机器一样保养身体
advice_items.summary_en: Learn martial arts for self-defense and stay physically fit by treating your body like a machine.
advice_items.quote: you also need to be physically fit you have to treat your body as it is a machine
advice_items.video_title: 5 SKILLS Every Young Man Should Know in 2023

advice_items.summary_zh: 别只停留在准备阶段，要克服恐惧迈出第一步
advice_items.summary_en: Preparation means nothing without action; stop staying stuck in prep mode and take the first step.
advice_items.quote: so many people out there are stuck into the preparation mode because they are scared shitless to actually take that first step
advice_items.video_title: 5 SKILLS Every Young Man Should Know in 2023

advice_items.summary_zh: 主动迎接挑战直面恐惧，在实战中建立自信
advice_items.summary_en: Build courage by stepping into hard situations despite fear to prove to yourself you can handle them.
advice_items.quote: I was scared shitless every single time but I did it to prove to myself that I had what it takes to face my opponents to face my fears
advice_items.video_title: 5 SKILLS Every Young Man Should Know in 2023

advice_items.summary_zh: 别只看线上内容，要在现实中寻找真正的好导师
advice_items.summary_en: Online advice isn't enough; seek real-world mentors such as experienced martial arts coaches.
advice_items.quote: put him in martial arts because all the good coaches out there are mentors
advice_items.video_title: 5 SKILLS Every Young Man Should Know in 2023

advice_items.summary_zh: 培养对自我和更高力量的信念，坚信终将有所成
advice_items.summary_en: Cultivate faith in yourself and a higher force to stay grounded and achieve your goals.
advice_items.quote: faith in yourself faith in something bigger than yourself
advice_items.video_title: 5 SKILLS Every Young Man Should Know in 2023

guests.guest_name: Chris (K-12 Education Consulting & Real Estate Entrepreneur)
guests.first_money_or_break: 进入K-12教育咨询行业，将专业知识打包提供给客户，随后将该咨询与专业化模式复制到其他多个行业。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: He entered K-12 education consulting by packaging specialized expertise for clients, then replicated that consulting and professionalization model across several other industries.
guests.zero_start_advice: 利用他人资金（OPM）投资大都市外围40英里等尚未开发的潜力区房产（商业、住宅或翻新），再融资后循环复投。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Use other people's money (OPM) to invest in undeveloped growth areas about 40 miles outside major metros across commercial, residential, or fix-and-flip properties, then refinance and reinvest the capital in a continuous cycle.
