appearances.video_title: School of Hard Knocks First Speaking Event!

advice_tags: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep

advice_items.summary_zh: 与其读大学不如紧跟极具影响力的人学习实战技能
advice_items.summary_en: Instead of attending college, attach yourself to a highly influential person and spend as much time as possible learning real-life skills from them.
advice_items.quote: I instead would try to come up with somebody who is super influential and spend as much time with them as they possibly could learn as much as they can so that at the time they actually enter the workforce they've learned real life skills
advice_items.video_title: School of Hard Knocks First Speaking Event!

advice_items.summary_zh: 金钱可再赚但时间有限，创业要敢于承担财务风险
advice_items.summary_en: Have a high risk tolerance with money because you can make more, but a low risk tolerance with time—stop hesitating and swing away.
advice_items.quote: as an entrepreneur I take a lot of risks financially... I can make more but I have a low risk tolerance with time so I'm going to go for it... get that bat off your shoulder and swing away
advice_items.video_title: School of Hard Knocks First Speaking Event!

advice_items.summary_zh: 用他人资金买潜力区房产并再融资循环投资
advice_items.summary_en: Use other people's money to invest in real estate outside major metropolitan areas where untapped growth remains, refinance, and repeat.
advice_items.quote: borrow other people's money invest into real estate refinance do it all over again... get outside the major metropolitan areas get into areas where there's still a lot of growth potential
advice_items.video_title: School of Hard Knocks First Speaking Event!

advice_items.summary_zh: 选定方向就全力以赴至少坚持五年
advice_items.summary_en: Go completely all-in on what you choose rather than just trying things out, and commit for at least five years.
advice_items.quote: make sure that whatever you're going to do you're all in don't try things out you have to go for it and you have to give it time a year two years three years is not enough time you got to be shooting for at least five years where you are all in
advice_items.video_title: School of Hard Knocks First Speaking Event!

advice_items.canonical_tag: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep
advice_items.summary_zh: 初期极致节俭不外食，攒下所有钱投入创业
advice_items.summary_en: Live frugally early on—sleep on couches, skip eating out, and save every dollar so you can go all-in on your venture.
advice_items.quote: sleep on someone's couch don't go out to eat put all the money you have away so that you can go for it in a way that most people will never have the discipline to do
advice_items.video_title: School of Hard Knocks First Speaking Event!

guests.guest_name: Los Angeles Software Engineer & Marketing Agency Founder

guests.industry_zh: 营销代理与高客单销售

guests.first_money_or_break_en: Starting out in software engineering, he founded a tech startup that was eventually acquired, then pivoted to launch a marketing agency he has run steadily for nine years.

guests.zero_start_advice_en: Stop overthinking, make decisive moves, and outwork everyone on the ground without taking shortcuts, all while investing wisely and saving consistently.

appearances.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich

advice_items.summary_zh: 面对挫折别自我怀疑，每天坚持向前
advice_items.summary_en: Do not dwell on setbacks or slow sales; treat every day as a fresh chance to keep pushing forward.
advice_items.quote: don't get down on yourself don't start second guessing yourself and just keep working at it every single day is a new day
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich

advice_items.summary_zh: 果断决策不内耗，直接下场行动
advice_items.summary_en: Make decisions quickly without overthinking and jump straight into execution.
advice_items.quote: I can make a decision in a split second and I don't overthink things and don't worry about too many things I just jump right in
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich

advice_items.summary_zh: 早期拼命实干解决难题，绝不走捷径
advice_items.summary_en: Hustle hard early on, figure out how to get things done, and never take shortcuts.
advice_items.quote: early on I always just was like I hustled I figured out how to like get stuff done and I never uh I never took any shortcuts
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich

advice_items.summary_zh: 努力工作、积极储蓄并做好投资
advice_items.summary_en: Work hard, save diligently, and invest wisely to reach your major financial goals.
advice_items.quote: just work hard invest well save and go for it
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaire Homeowners How They Got Rich

guests.guest_name: Beverly Hills Hair Salon Chain Founder

guests.first_money_or_break_en: Starting out completely broke, she partnered with her brother (an early Yahoo employee) who put up the capital and gave her 50% sweat equity to handle day-to-day operations of their hair salon chain.

advice_tags: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
Be Careful Who You Partner With

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.summary_zh: 没本钱时可用精力换取股权，积极争取干股机会
advice_items.summary_en: Even when starting with zero capital, negotiate sweat equity so you own meaningful upside for running the business.
advice_items.quote: I had no money, but he offered me basically sweat equity... I don't put in any money, but I have 50% equity.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got Rich! (Beverly Hills)

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.summary_zh: 勇于倾听员工和客户的负面反馈并及时修正问题
advice_items.summary_en: Seek out uncomfortable feedback from employees and customers so you can see and fix what is broken.
advice_items.quote: Ask your employees, ask your customers what's working for you, what's not... most people don't want to hear bad feedback cuz it hurts.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got Rich! (Beverly Hills)

advice_items.summary_zh: 极致关注门店细节与氛围，让顾客获得舒适体验
advice_items.summary_en: Obsess over small operational details—cleanliness, staff attitude, and ambiance—to make customers want to return.
advice_items.quote: The littlest things can make some of the biggest differences... there's an ambiance that a business owner can create to make you as a customer feel comfortable.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got Rich! (Beverly Hills)

advice_items.canonical_tag: Be Careful Who You Partner With
advice_items.summary_zh: 谨慎选择合伙人与投资人，确保双方愿景一致
advice_items.summary_en: Treat partnerships and fundraising like a marriage—never take money from investors who lack alignment with your vision.
advice_items.quote: Be really careful who you get into business with... you don't want to raise money from the wrong people who aren't in lockstep with what you want to build.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got Rich! (Beverly Hills)

guests.first_money_or_break: 看到高速公路上川流不息的卡车且听人介绍后进入交通运输行业，认定该行业抗衰退且无法被替代。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Noticing endless streams of trucks on the highway and hearing about the business from others, he entered the trucking and transportation industry because he saw it as recession-proof and irreplaceable.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got Rich! (Beverly Hills)

appearances.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got Rich! (Beverly Hills)

advice_items.summary_zh: 选择抗衰退且难被科技取代的传统刚需行业
advice_items.summary_en: Focus on essential, recession-proof businesses like transport and trucking that technology cannot easily replace.
advice_items.quote: Transport is always going to be there, no electronic, no robot or anything like that is going to change it... it's recession proof and people can't replace it.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got Rich! (Beverly Hills)

advice_items.summary_zh: 销售秘诀在于持之以恒且绝不轻言放弃
advice_items.summary_en: Be relentless in sales by staying consistent and never taking 'no' for an answer.
advice_items.quote: Consistency, never take no for an answer.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got Rich! (Beverly Hills)

advice_items.summary_zh: 保持长期一致性并找准高价值定位与时机
advice_items.summary_en: Stay consistent and position yourself in the right place at the right time to maximize the value of what you offer.
advice_items.quote: Consistency and being at the right place, right time. You can take a bottle of water and move it from place to place and it changes its price.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got Rich! (Beverly Hills)

advice_items.summary_zh: 务必找位导师指引方向并借鉴其失败教训
advice_items.summary_en: Find a mentor to give you direction and study their past mistakes so you can grow faster.
advice_items.quote: Definitely get a mentor, because you don't have a mentor you don't have no direction, and find out his bad moves that he had made so you can grow from it.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How They Got Rich! (Beverly Hills)

guests.wealth_detail: $50M+ best single year

guests.first_money_or_break_en: Trained in computer science, he started as a programmer and went broke multiple times before spending 17 years building tech and venture capital businesses, reaching a peak single-year income over $50 million.
guests.zero_start_advice: 不要害羞，走出屏幕主动社交并制造“碰撞时刻”，以非功利交友的方式结交高端人脉；同时选择可无限复制的数字/科技产品，盯着5年后的未来趋势提前布局。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Don't be shy; step away from your screen to network in person, engineer serendipitous encounters, and build genuine, non-transactional friendships with high-caliber people. Focus on infinitely scalable digital or tech products positioned for trends five years ahead.

advice_items.summary_zh: 先交朋友不谈生意，以非功利真心建立人脉
advice_items.summary_en: Approach wealthy and successful people non-transactionally to build genuine human friendships before talking business.
advice_items.quote: make friends be a non-transactional person... start humanizing the relationships first and then once you create a human to human relationship with the wealthiest people they'll take you everywhere
advice_items.video_title: Asking Dubai Moguls How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 绝不要害羞，多开口推销才能抓住商业机会
advice_items.summary_en: Overcome introversion and shyness, speak up, and actively pitch yourself and your ideas to win big opportunities.
advice_items.quote: life is too damn short to be shy... you want to make it and you want to make it big run your mouth... a closed mouth does not get fed
advice_items.video_title: Asking Dubai Moguls How They Got Rich!

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.summary_zh: 别追逐现有热点，提前五年布局AI与深科技
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid chasing current trends and instead build deep-tech solutions in AI, automation, and supporting infrastructure for problems 5 years ahead.
advice_items.quote: think about the problem that needs to be solved in 5 years from now and invest in it from right now... don't follow Trends... invest in deep Tech... future of AI and automation
advice_items.video_title: Asking Dubai Moguls How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 枯燥但刚需的传统垂直行业往往最赚钱
advice_items.summary_en: Boring businesses like mortgage tech are often among the most profitable and reliable investments.
advice_items.quote: mortgage Tech I know it sounds boring but boring businesses are really really great businesses to invest in
advice_items.video_title: Asking Dubai Moguls How They Got Rich!

guests.wealth_detail: $1.5M highest single year; became a millionaire at 21
guests.first_money_or_break: 曾靠跑Uber Eats和Instacart维生，21岁时把握疫情期间市场流动性充裕的窗口期全职交易赚到第一个100万美元，随后学会授权并组建团队，单年最高赚到150万美元。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: After scraping by delivering for Uber Eats and Instacart, he traded full-time during the pandemic liquidity boom at age 21 to make his first $1 million, then learned to delegate and build a team to reach a peak single-year income of $1.5 million.
guests.zero_start_advice: 有想法就立刻执行，别花两周纠结Logo等细节，在行动中边做边调整；同时尽早学会授权，高薪善待优秀团队成员。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Execute on ideas immediately and adjust on the fly instead of spending two weeks agonizing over details like a logo. Learn to delegate early and pay great team members well.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH! (Las Vegas)

appearances.video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH! (Las Vegas)

advice_items.summary_zh: 学会授权并高薪善待团队才突破七位数
advice_items.summary_en: Delegate what you are not best at, pay great people well, and give them room to grow.
advice_items.quote: I wasn't in seven figures until I did delegate. You can't do it all yourself... treat people very well, pay people very well, and have opportunities of growth within the company.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH! (Las Vegas)

advice_items.summary_zh: 保持感情稳定以减少外界干扰，专注事业
advice_items.summary_en: Build a stable personal life to eliminate outside distractions and stay focused on your goals.
advice_items.quote: A lot of successful people that I see are married... when you're married and you're not focused on everything outside, you're so focused.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH! (Las Vegas)

advice_items.summary_zh: 以信仰为根基，把挑战当成必经的功课
advice_items.summary_en: Keep faith as your foundation and embrace the hard lessons required to build a seven-figure business.
advice_items.quote: God has to be the foundation of everything... I asked God, 'I want a seven-figure business' and he threw a bunch of lessons at me that I had to learn.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH! (Las Vegas)

advice_items.summary_zh: 有想法立刻执行边干边改，别纠结完美
advice_items.summary_en: Execute on ideas immediately and fix issues as you go rather than waiting for perfection.
advice_items.quote: I have an idea, let's execute, let's figure it out on the way... I'm not going to spend two weeks on a logo. You got to take action.

guests.guest_name: Las Vegas Convention Center Lamborghini Real Estate Investor
guests.wealth_detail: Tens of millions of dollars in annual revenue (multiple 8-figure entrepreneur)
guests.first_money_or_break: 1岁时父亲离家，由母亲独自抚养长大且高中辍学未上大学；靠敢于开口又谦卑地向有能力的人求助撬动资源，深耕拉斯维加斯房地产近20年，做到年营收数千万美元。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Abandoned by his father at age 1, raised by a single mother, and a high school dropout who never attended college, he leveraged resources by having the courage and humility to ask capable people for help, spending nearly 20 years in Las Vegas real estate to build tens of millions in annual revenue.
guests.zero_start_advice: 不要抱怨缺乏背景资源，鼓起勇气谦卑向能帮你的人开口；戒掉酒精与消费娱乐等麻痹野心的习惯，专注提高赚钱能力并用现金买入收租房产。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Stop complaining about lacking connections or resources, and muster the courage and humility to ask people who can help you. Cut out ambition-numbing habits like alcohol and consumer entertainment, focus on raising your earning power, and buy cash-flowing rental properties with cash.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH! (Las Vegas)

appearances.video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH! (Las Vegas)

advice_items.summary_zh: 有勇气又谦卑地向高手求助，善于调动资源
advice_items.summary_en: Have the courage and humility to ask capable people for help—you lack resourcefulness, not resources.
advice_items.quote: It starts with the balls and the humility to look at that person and say, 'Will you help me?' ... We don't lack resources, we just lack resourcefulness.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH! (Las Vegas)

advice_items.summary_zh: 买入能持续产生现金流的出租房产
advice_items.summary_en: Build lasting wealth by purchasing cash-flowing assets, especially rental real estate.
advice_items.quote: I'm a big believer in buying cash flowing assets... and the asset that I like to buy is rental properties.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH! (Las Vegas)

advice_items.summary_zh: 远离酒精与娱乐政治等麻痹野心的干扰
advice_items.summary_en: Cut out alcohol, sports obsession, and political distractions that numb your natural drive to create.
advice_items.quote: Politics keeps people broke, football keeps people broke, all the distraction keeps people broke, alcohol keeps people broke... we are creators by default, but with no distraction.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH! (Las Vegas)

advice_items.summary_zh: 成大事需极度投入，甘愿为目标承受牺牲
advice_items.summary_en: Be willing to endure extreme sacrifice and total commitment to build extraordinary wealth.
advice_items.quote: I sacrificed my health, I sacrificed my friend groups, I sacrificed my family, I sacrificed my sanity... every single part of my life, and I look back now and I'm grateful that I did.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH! (Las Vegas)

guests.wealth_detail: Nearly $7M generated last year; ~$400k first calendar year; became a millionaire at 20
guests.first_money_or_break: 疫情期间失业、身上仅剩20美元，决心摆脱按小时卖时间的保姆工作；借助商业信用启动Airbnb短租业务，几个月内月收入从3千美元飙升至6万美元，首年营收近40万美元，20岁成为百万富翁，去年业务营收近700万美元。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Unemployed during the pandemic with only $20 to his name and determined to quit trading hours for money as a nanny, he used business credit to launch an Airbnb short-term rental business that jumped from $3,000 to $60,000 in monthly revenue within months. He hit nearly $400,000 in year one, became a millionaire at 20, and generated close to $7 million in revenue last year.
guests.zero_start_advice: 若手头没有大笔本金，可用现有工作收入或研究商业信用（Business Credit）启动能带来被动收入的生意；做Airbnb不一定要先买房，可从租下第一套房源轻资产起步，跑通盈利模型后当作数字游戏持续复制扩张。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: If you don't have big savings, use your current job income or learn business credit to launch a passive-income venture. You don't need to buy property to start on Airbnb; lease your first unit asset-light, prove the profitable model, and treat expansion like a numbers game.

advice_items.summary_zh: 跳出用时间换钱的局限，建立可复制资产
advice_items.summary_en: Break free from trading hours for dollars by working for yourself and building assets that pay you.
advice_items.quote: It was still such a time for money exchange... I just realized if I can work for myself and allow my money to make money for me then I'll probably see more success.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH! (Las Vegas)

advice_items.canonical_tag: Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)
advice_items.summary_zh: 善用商业信用作为启动杠杆，而非死等存钱
advice_items.summary_en: Leverage business credit to launch a cash-flowing business instead of waiting until you save huge cash reserves.
advice_items.quote: I think a lot of people think that they need a ton of cash to start businesses... look into business credit and use business credit to start a business that will pay you.

advice_items.summary_zh: 尝试多种项目后专注押注跑通的单一赛道
advice_items.summary_en: Test until you find a model that gains traction, then commit fully to that winning vehicle.
advice_items.quote: I tried pretty much everything like everything you see on Facebook and TikTok, I tried it all, and Airbnb is what worked for me first so I just went with it.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH! (Las Vegas)

advice_items.summary_zh: 前期租房轻资产启动，跑通后不断复制扩张
advice_items.summary_en: Start lean by renting your first property rather than buying, then systematically scale winning properties.
advice_items.quote: If you don't have the means to buy, that's perfectly fine, you can start off by renting your first property... it's a numbers game, just continue scaling as long as you find winning properties.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH! (Las Vegas)

guests.role_or_title: Founder & Owner (8 Businesses / Promotional Products & Medical Supplies)
guests.wealth_detail: $69M peak single-year revenue; core promotional products business at $35M
guests.first_money_or_break: 16岁开始卖保险，大学期间以每小时5美元在酒吧打工后独立创业；2020年疫情导致原促销品业务崩溃后，依托在中国积累的10年供应链经验迅速转型进口医疗物资并直接致电医院销售，一年内营收翻5倍至6900万美元，随后核心促销品业务也翻倍至3500万美元。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: He started selling insurance at 16 and worked at a bar for $5 an hour in college before striking out on his own; when the 2020 pandemic wiped out his promotional products business, he leveraged 10 years of China supply chain experience to import medical supplies and cold-call hospitals, 5x-ing revenue to $69 million in one year before his core promo business also doubled to $35 million.
guests.zero_start_advice: 销售是解决一切问题的关键，要学会通过连续提问消除客户异议并降低付款门槛；创业成功90%取决于心态，要向内建立绝对自信。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Sales solves everything, so learn to ask consecutive questions that dissolve customer objections and lower the barrier to payment. Ninety percent of entrepreneurial success comes down to mindset, so build unshakable self-confidence from within.
recommended_books_or_mentors: First Mentor (gave him Think and Grow Rich at age 18)

advice_items.summary_en: Master sales by asking targeted questions until no objections remain, then make payment options effortless.

advice_items.summary_zh: 多读经典好书，创业九成胜负在于心态

advice_items.quote: It was Think and Grow Rich from Napoleon Hill But Here Comes The Clue 90% in your mind and 10% financially so mindset is very important no mindset no Financial Freedom
advice_items.video_title: Asking Dubai Billionaires How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 保持对上帝的信仰与人生希望
advice_items.summary_en: Maintain faith and hope as your ultimate anchor when navigating hard times.

advice_items.summary_zh: 坚定自信并用积极语言引导潜意识
advice_items.summary_en: Believe in yourself unconditionally and practice positive self-talk so your subconscious mind aligns with your words.
advice_items.quote: not believing in yourself is the most selfish thing that you can do... speak good to yourself because your subconscious mind will reflect it... your mind will follow your words
advice_items.video_title: Asking Dubai Billionaires How They Got RICH!

guests.wealth_detail: 10 billion dirhams max single-year earnings; billionaire (owns 6 Rolls-Royces)
guests.zero_start_advice: 白手起家无需启动资金，关键在于创意、工作文化与创新；若零资金想进入房地产行业，建议先从高佣金（如迪拜5%）的房产经纪做起，积累资金后再转型成为开发商。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Starting from scratch doesn't require capital; it comes down to ideas, work culture, and innovation. If you want to enter real estate with zero money, start as a broker in a high-commission market like Dubai at 5% to build capital before transitioning into development.

advice_items.summary_zh: 销售核心是倾听需求、匹配产品并讲清回报

advice_items.summary_zh: 拥有无论被丢到哪里都能凭销售和商业本能白手起家的绝对自信
advice_items.summary_en: Have total confidence in your sales and business instincts to create value from zero anywhere.

guests.first_money_or_break_en: Starting a tanning spa franchise in 2009, he focused on scaling a single business to over 75 locations across 13 states, generating millions in annual revenue.
guests.zero_start_advice: 新手别盲目追求多份副业收入，应集中精力把一件事规模化，足以替代主业后再拓展新业务。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Don't chase multiple side hustles when starting out; focus on scaling one thing until it replaces your day job before branching out into new ventures.

guests.zero_start_advice: 洞察人性心理、不要强推，保持高风险承受力并敢于在试错中学习，赚钱后注意落袋为安。

advice_items.summary_zh: 创业者要有魄力，看准机会果断出手

advice_items.summary_zh: 勇敢行动并允许试错，在犯错中不断学习
advice_items.summary_en: Jump in, make mistakes, and treat them as lessons to get smarter.

guests.role_or_title: Former CEO (Public Business Services Company, 42,000-43,000 Employees)
guests.wealth_detail: Host cites $12B+ net worth; led multi-billion dollar/yr revenue public company for 18 years as CEO
guests.first_money_or_break: 整个职业生涯深耕同一家上市商业服务公司，靠每天主动向上司请求分担额外任务并高质量交付，一步步升任总裁和CEO，掌舵18年管理4.2万至4.3万名员工。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Scott spent his entire career at a single public business services company, asking his boss for extra work every day and delivering high-quality results. He rose through the ranks to become president and CEO, leading 42,000 to 43,000 employees over an 18-year tenure.
guests.zero_start_advice: 挑一家有上升空间和好文化的公司长期扎根；每天做完本职后主动帮老板分忧、借此学习上位者工作，同时不断提升承压能力。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Pick a company with strong culture and room for growth, and commit to staying there long term. Finish your own work each day, then ask your boss what you can take off their plate so you can learn higher-level roles while building your tolerance for pressure.

They sold it the first time for over $100 million, then brought in new partners and management systems to sell it again for over $400 million.

guests.zero_start_advice_en: Start from scratch when you already have the skills and tools, or enter through an acquisition if you lack industry access and key talent. Set up formal corporate structures and processes early on, and invest your profits into real estate.

guests.wealth_detail: Sold Twitch to Amazon in 2014 for $970M (previously walked away from ~$1B Google offer)

guests.first_money_or_break_en: Raised middle-class by a self-made immigrant mother, Justin Kan launched his first startup at 20 and built his own live-streaming tech in college to co-found Justin.tv. guests.zero_start_advice: 选择即便失败也不觉得浪费时间的事业；面对质疑时保持坚定信念；谈判时多留退路和备选方案；在AI让软件趋于免费时，去打造受益于免费软件的相邻产品（如软硬结合的硬件）。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Work on something that wouldn't feel like a waste of time even if it fails, stay convicted when others doubt you, and always keep backup options in negotiations. As AI drives the cost of software toward zero, build adjacent products like integrated hardware that benefit from free software.

guests.role_or_title: Tech Founder, Investor & Owner of the Sacramento Kings

guests.zero_start_advice_en: Surround yourself with people smarter than you and attract them with a clear mission, relentless execution, and 100% conviction. Learn to digest bad news like chewing cactus, stay hungry and foolish, and never be afraid to cross into new fields.

advice_items.summary_zh: 经商重在品格诚信与善待下属伙伴
advice_items.summary_en: Prioritize character, integrity, and treating subordinates well rather than focusing solely on revenue.
advice_items.quote: The best businessmen are men with character and integrity... care about your character and how you treat people that you are in business with, especially people who work beneath you.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Black Millionaires How They Got Rich! (Atlanta)

advice_items.summary_zh: 没有人能独自登顶，需善待身边人
advice_items.summary_en: Recognize that reaching the top and becoming your best self requires healthy relationships with others.
advice_items.quote: Nobody gets to the top by themselves, and nobody becomes their best self by themselves.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Black Millionaires How They Got Rich! (Atlanta)

guests.guest_name: Atlanta Waffle House Franchisee & Hotel Owner
guests.role_or_title: Waffle House Franchisee (14 Locations), Hotel & Home Furnishings Owner
guests.first_money_or_break: 出身工薪阶层，22岁成为华夫饼屋（Waffle House）加盟商并发展到14家门店，随后家族涉足酒店业并进一步拓展至家居行业。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: From a working-class background, he became a Waffle House franchisee at 22 and grew to 14 locations, before his family expanded into hotels and later the home furnishings industry.
guests.zero_start_advice: 找到自己热爱且能赚钱的正确事业，每天亲力亲为并关注运营细节，确保收支平衡与正向现金流。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Find the right business that you genuinely enjoy and that makes money. Stay hands-on with daily operations and keep a close eye on the details to ensure positive cash flow.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich! (Atlanta)

appearances.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich! (Atlanta)

advice_items.summary_zh: 选择热爱且能盈利的正确赛道
advice_items.summary_en: Pursue work you genuinely love and find the right vehicle that aligns passion with profitability.
advice_items.quote: Do what you love. And I think you got to find the right thing because if you chase the wrong thing, it's not going to work for you.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich! (Atlanta)

advice_items.summary_zh: 每天坚持工作并紧盯业务运营细节
advice_items.summary_en: Scale multi-location businesses by showing up daily and staying closely attentive to operations.
advice_items.quote: You got to work every day and make sure you pay attention to what's going on.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich! (Atlanta)

advice_items.summary_zh: 确保正向现金流并维持高产出
advice_items.summary_en: Keep finances tight by ensuring positive cash flow, covering expenses, and remaining productive.
advice_items.quote: Make sure you make ends meet. Make sure that you cash flow and make sure that you stay productive.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Wealthy Americans How They Got Rich! (Atlanta)

guests.wealth_detail: First million at age 24 ($1.6M); $3.2M peak single-year income
guests.first_money_or_break: 1997年毕业时家族企业被出售，不得不从零开始；考取Series 7牌照进入经纪行业，在1998-1999年牛市推销亚马逊股票（9美元翻倍至18美元）并筹集巨额资金，24岁赚到首个160万美元，单年最高收入达320万美元（后在2000年互联网泡沫破裂时经历重创）。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Forced to start from scratch when her family business was sold upon her 1997 graduation, she earned her Series 7 license and rode the 1998-1999 bull market pitching Amazon stock as it doubled from $9 to $18. She made her first $1.6 million at 24 and peaked at $3.2 million in a single year before taking a major hit in the 2000 dot-com crash.
guests.zero_start_advice: 不要眼里只盯着钱，而要立志成为所在领域的第一名；在销售与谈判中学会少说多问，精准捕捉并满足对方的核心需求；同时永远对他人保持善意。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Don't chase money blindly; aim to be #1 in your field, and always treat people with kindness. In sales and negotiations, talk less, ask more questions, and pinpoint what the other person truly needs.
guests.primary_video_title: Inside Texas’s Billionaire Town (Highland Park)

appearances.video_title: Inside Texas’s Billionaire Town (Highland Park)

advice_items.summary_zh: 专注做到行业顶尖而非追逐金钱，财富自来
advice_items.summary_en: Focus on becoming number one at your craft rather than chasing money; wealth follows excellence.
advice_items.quote: Nobody in the world that makes a fortune cares about the money. They care about being the best that they could be at what they do... The money then comes.
advice_items.video_title: Inside Texas’s Billionaire Town (Highland Park)

advice_items.summary_zh: 无视质疑与失败，把挫折化为赢家的燃料
advice_items.summary_en: Use doubt and setbacks as fuel to prove critics wrong and bounce back stronger.
advice_items.quote: Everybody doubted me. I was a loser. A winner is only a loser that gets angry.
advice_items.video_title: Inside Texas’s Billionaire Town (Highland Park)

advice_items.summary_zh: 销售时少谈自己多提问，倾听并满足客户需求
advice_items.summary_en: In sales and negotiation, talk less about yourself and ask questions so clients reveal their needs, then fulfill them.
advice_items.quote: Let someone talk about themselves... Don't talk about you. Ask them questions, let them talk so I know what they want, what they need, and then provide that for them.
advice_items.video_title: Inside Texas’s Billionaire Town (Highland Park)

guests.first_money_or_break: 大学学政治学却于1990年代加入苹果公司担任工程总监近20年，通过长期持有苹果股票实现财富爆发。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Despite studying political science in college, he joined Apple in the 1990s and served as an engineering director for nearly 20 years, building immense wealth by holding Apple stock long term.
guests.zero_start_advice: 明智地投入时间并找到真正热爱的事，进入能做伟大产品的平台设定高标准，同时学会逆向思考与长期投资。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Invest your time wisely in work you genuinely love, and join a place building great products where the bar is set high. Learn to think like a contrarian and invest for the long term.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got Rich! (Silicon Valley)

appearances.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got Rich! (Silicon Valley)

advice_tags: Work Under a Winner First Before Starting

advice_items.canonical_tag: Work Under a Winner First Before Starting
advice_items.summary_zh: 加入顶尖平台并做到极致卓越
advice_items.summary_en: Join an extraordinary company where top-tier work is possible and execute exceptionally well.
advice_items.quote: It was the only place that you could do the great work that we did... Did a great job.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got Rich! (Silicon Valley)

advice_items.summary_zh: 长期投资优质股票静待复利爆发
advice_items.summary_en: Invest consistently in strong equities like your company's stock and hold long-term for compounding.
advice_items.quote: You invest and all of a sudden it takes off. ... Apple stock. ... almost 20 years.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got Rich! (Silicon Valley)

advice_items.summary_zh: 明智分配时间，找到热爱之事
advice_items.summary_en: Spend your time intentionally and find work you genuinely love.
advice_items.quote: Invest your time wisely and find something you love.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got Rich! (Silicon Valley)

guests.guest_name: Silicon Valley Plastic Surgeon (Former Illinois Farm Boy)
guests.first_money_or_break: 出身伊利诺伊州农场家庭，早年一度荒废青春，后受整形外科导师启发从骨科转行，在硅谷通过扎实工作与高患者满意度成名致富。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Born into an Illinois farming family, he drifted in his early years before a plastic surgery mentor inspired him to switch from orthopedics. He went on to build a thriving, lucrative practice in Silicon Valley through dedicated work and exceptional patient satisfaction.
guests.zero_start_advice: 做真实的自己并享受工作，专注为自己和他人创造快乐，同时努力精进技艺并积极采用新技术。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Be your authentic self, enjoy what you do, and focus on bringing joy to yourself and others. At the same time, keep sharpening your craft and embrace new technologies.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got Rich! (Silicon Valley)

appearances.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got Rich! (Silicon Valley)

advice_items.summary_zh: 努力工作并让客户满意，回报自来
advice_items.summary_en: Work hard and focus on making your patients or customers genuinely happy, and the rewards will follow.
advice_items.quote: I just worked hard. I made my patients happy and they rewarded me and it was great.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got Rich! (Silicon Valley)

advice_items.summary_zh: 听从良师指引，做自己并享受过程
advice_items.summary_en: Be open to mentors who steer you onto the right path and remind you to be yourself and enjoy your craft.
advice_items.quote: He told me just to be you and enjoy it.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got Rich! (Silicon Valley)

advice_items.summary_zh: 热爱并精通本职，快乐比金钱重要
advice_items.summary_en: Enjoy your work, master your craft, and create happiness around you—fulfillment outweighs money.
advice_items.quote: When you enjoy what you do and you're good at it, you can succeed. ... I would argue that the happiness is more than the money.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got Rich! (Silicon Valley)

guests.guest_name: Tampa Medical Sleep Testing Company Owner
guests.role_or_title: Owner of Largest Medical Sleep Testing Company in the US
guests.wealth_detail: Multiple 8 figures peak single-year income
guests.first_money_or_break: 创业约28年，9年前银行账户一度只剩78美元，通过专注学习销售与授权管理，在全美医疗睡眠检测行业击败大型老牌竞争对手并做到行业第一。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: An entrepreneur for roughly 28 years, he was down to $78 in his bank account 9 years ago before mastering sales and delegation. He went on to beat massive legacy competitors and become #1 in the U.S. medical sleep testing industry.
guests.zero_start_advice: 只向结果比你更好的人请教钱和生意；不要害怕竞争激烈的市场，在多数人松懈时保持狠劲就能赢。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Only take money and business advice from people who have better results than you. Never fear a crowded market; when everyone else gets comfortable, staying relentless is how you win.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH! (Florida)

appearances.video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH! (Florida)

advice_tags: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market

advice_items.summary_zh: 只向比自己更富有、生意更大的人请教
advice_items.summary_en: Only take financial and business advice from people who have achieved greater results than you.
advice_items.quote: Never get money advice from somebody that makes less money than you, never get business advice from somebody who's got a smaller business than you.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH! (Florida)

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.summary_zh: 拥抱竞争激烈的赛道，人多代表市场大
advice_items.summary_en: Seek out competitive markets because high competition proves strong customer demand and opportunity.
advice_items.quote: Every industry is competitive and I actually salivate at the mouth when I find out an industry is competitive because it means there's a lot of people in it.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH! (Florida)

advice_items.summary_zh: 在竞争市场里拼命苦干就能击败懈怠者
advice_items.summary_en: Outwork complacent competitors relentlessly to dominate any competitive industry.
advice_items.quote: If you're willing to grind like a gorilla in the markets that are competitive you're always going to win.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH! (Florida)

guests.guest_name: Tampa Digital Assets Hedge Fund Founder
guests.role_or_title: Founder of a Digital Assets Hedge Fund
guests.wealth_detail: $4.5M peak single-year income
guests.first_money_or_break: 创业10至11年，经营加密数字资产对冲基金并涉足多家企业，曾遭数家十亿美元级公司起诉但凭借商业保险与坚持胜诉，峰值年收入达450万美元。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Over 10 to 11 years as an entrepreneur, he launched a digital assets hedge fund and multiple other ventures, reaching peak annual earnings of $4.5 million. He even fended off lawsuits from billion-dollar corporations and prevailed thanks to solid business insurance and sheer persistence.
guests.zero_start_advice: 别等别人施舍，靠超强野心、自信与拼劲自己摸索并把钱投回生意；同时配置好商业保险，做好承受高压的准备。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Don't wait for handouts; pair fierce ambition, confidence, and grit with self-education, and reinvest your profits back into the business. Make sure you carry proper business insurance and brace yourself for intense pressure.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH! (Florida)

appearances.video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH! (Florida)

advice_items.summary_zh: 预设成交并逗笑客户，让人喜欢你就难拒绝
advice_items.summary_en: Assume the sale from the start and build likability through humor so prospects want to say yes.
advice_items.quote: Assume the close... if you're trying to close somebody make that person laugh cuz nobody's going to say no to someone that they like.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH! (Florida)

advice_items.summary_zh: 没人会白给你机会，靠狠劲与野心自己破局
advice_items.summary_en: Nothing is handed to you; figure things out independently and outwork everyone with high ambition and confidence.
advice_items.quote: Figure it the out... work like a son of a, this shit's not going to be given.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH! (Florida)

advice_items.summary_zh: 把赚到的利润持续再投资到事业中滚大
advice_items.summary_en: Reinvest your profits back into the business rather than taking everything out early.
advice_items.quote: Reinvest the money, it's not rocket science... I just had a very high level of ambition in myself and confidence in myself and work ethic in myself.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Supercar Owners How They Got RICH! (Florida)

guests.first_money_or_break: 从好莱坞演员转型硅谷风险投资人，通过结识Mark Cuban、Ron Conway、Marc Benioff、Jason Calacanis等硅谷顶尖人物并慷慨助人、虚心请教，逐渐成长为硅谷最成功的投资人之一。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Transitioning from Hollywood actor to Silicon Valley venture capitalist, he connected with top figures like Mark Cuban, Ron Conway, Marc Benioff, and Jason Calacanis, helping them generously and learning eagerly to become one of Silicon Valley's most successful investors.
guests.zero_start_advice: 主动接触优秀的人并尽可能慷慨地帮助他们，保持好奇心向他们请教看待世界的方式；同时建立由伴侣或家人组成的支持体系，在遭遇失败时帮你重新站起来。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Seek out exceptional people, help them as generously as you can, and stay curious about how they see the world. Build a strong support system of a partner or family to help you get back up when you fall.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Tech Billionaires How They Got Rich!

appearances.video_title: Asking Tech Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 结交高人脉并慷慨助人，借力看见成功捷径
advice_items.summary_en: Be generous and helpful to sharp people; knowing the right people opens your eyes to shortcuts and what is possible.
advice_items.quote: I just try to be generous with them and be as helpful to them as I possibly can... when you know the right people, they will show you the shortcut.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Tech Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 保持好奇心，主动向顶尖成功人士请教学习
advice_items.summary_en: Approach accomplished leaders with genuine curiosity and ask how they view the world so you can learn directly from them.
advice_items.quote: I met these people that were seeing the world in a different way. And I was just curious enough to ask them what that way was. And they taught me a lot of things.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Tech Billionaires How They Got Rich!

advice_items.summary_zh: 爱人如己，以善意与同理心待人是根本之道
advice_items.summary_en: Live by the principle of loving your neighbor as yourself; everything else is secondary.
advice_items.quote: Love thy neighbor as thyself. It's about the only thing there is. Everything else is commentary.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Tech Billionaires How They Got Rich!

guests.guest_name: UAE Offshore Energy & Marine Services Co-Owner
guests.role_or_title: Co-Owner of Offshore Energy & Marine Services Business
guests.wealth_detail: Sold 100% family-owned offshore energy & marine services business (with father) for ~$1.8B
guests.first_money_or_break: 在阿联酋家族企业起步，与父亲共同全资拥有离岸能源与海事服务公司，后来以约18亿美元出售第一代公司，并创办第二代公司与原公司协同合作。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Starting in his family's business in the UAE, he co-owned a 100% family-held offshore energy and marine services company with his father, later selling that first venture for around $1.8 billion. He then launched a second company that operates in partnership with the original firm.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Billionaires How Much They Pay In Taxes!

appearances.video_title: Asking Billionaires How Much They Pay In Taxes!

advice_tags: Be Careful Who You Partner With

advice_items.summary_zh: 成本控制是盈利核心，低采购成本才能穿越周期
advice_items.summary_en: Control your buying and underlying costs rigorously; low cost structure lets you sell profitably in any market condition.
advice_items.quote: Cost management is key to everything. It's not about how much you sell it for, it's about how much you're willing to buy the product and your underlying cost. If you can manage your cost, you can manage to sell it in any condition.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How Much They Pay In Taxes!

advice_items.canonical_tag: Be Careful Who You Partner With
advice_items.summary_zh: 与家人合伙极具挑战，必须公私分明以事业为重
advice_items.summary_en: Working with family is very tough; separate personal feelings from business discipline and stay aligned on the company's greater purpose.
advice_items.quote: Working with family is extremely difficult, for sure... when he was getting tough on me, it wasn't coming from a place that's personal, but rather because there's an ambition for a greater purpose here, which was the company.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How Much They Pay In Taxes!

advice_items.summary_zh: 善用低税友好营商环境，同时自觉回馈所在社区
advice_items.summary_en: Take advantage of pro-business tax jurisdictions like the UAE while choosing personally to give back to your community.
advice_items.quote: We didn't have to pay the taxes. Of course, there are other ways where you have to pay back to your community, but I think that's personal choice of ours that we do.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Billionaires How Much They Pay In Taxes!

guests.role_or_title: Real Estate Developer (21 Years, 5,000+ Units Developed)
guests.wealth_detail: $50M highest single-year business earnings; developed over 5,000 units
guests.first_money_or_break: 童年曾无家可归睡在桥下；服青年役期间经朋友介绍偶然接触房产中介，完成第一笔销售后起步转型做房地产开发，21年间累计开发超5000套住房。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Homeless as a child and once forced to sleep under a bridge, he stumbled into real estate brokerage through a friend during his youth service and closed his first sale. From there he pivoted into development, building over 5,000 homes across 21 years.
guests.zero_start_advice: 把个人信誉当成最大资本，绝不为短期利润毁掉名声；不要把钱闲置在银行，要持续积累土地和房产等实物资产，同时重视持续打广告与品牌曝光。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Treat your personal reputation as your greatest capital and never burn it for short-term profit. Don't leave cash sitting in the bank; keep acquiring hard assets like land and real estate while investing consistently in advertising and brand visibility.
recommended_books_or_mentors: Unspecified Nigerian Mentors (advised on Coca-Cola/visibility and protecting ones sparkling white name)
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Nigerian Billionaires How They Got RICH!

appearances.video_title: Asking Nigerian Billionaires How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 少承诺多交付，保证产品高质量
advice_items.summary_en: Underpromise and consistently overdeliver on product quality for every client.
advice_items.quote: Underpromise, overdeliver... if you tell people you deliver quality houses for them, deliver quality houses.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Nigerian Billionaires How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 别让钱闲在银行，多配置土地房产
advice_items.summary_en: Don't leave cash sitting idle in banks; build a large portfolio of built or unbuilt real estate assets.
advice_items.quote: Banks love everybody to keep their money idle in the banks rather than money working for them... you need to have a huge portfolio of assets, landed assets, whether built or unbuilt.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Nigerian Billionaires How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 誓死捍卫个人信誉，勿为小利败名声
advice_items.summary_en: Protect your reputation above quick profit—keep your word because your name enters every room before you do.
advice_items.quote: This sparkling white name should not be tainted for immediate profit because your name will precede you in every room.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Nigerian Billionaires How They Got RICH!

guests.wealth_detail: $25M in a single year; became a millionaire at age 24
guests.first_money_or_break: 18岁开始创业进入娱乐行业，曾经经历过破产/身无分文，24岁成为百万富翁，单年最高赚取2500万美元。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: He entered the entertainment business as an entrepreneur at 18, survived going broke, became a millionaire by 24, and went on to earn up to $25 million in a single year.
guests.zero_start_advice: 尽早接受良好的教育以获得更好的决策工具，勇于承担风险抓住机会，并建立坚定不移的自信。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Get a solid education early to equip yourself with better decision-making tools. Take calculated risks, seize opportunities, and build unshakable self-confidence.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Yacht Owners How They Got RICH!

appearances.video_title: Asking Yacht Owners How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 趁早多读书受教育，提升决策能力
advice_items.summary_en: Invest in getting a strong education early; while a degree is not required, education equips you to make better decisions faster.
advice_items.quote: get a better education if I had a better education it be a lot further along a lot younger... college degree is definitely not necessary to be successful but it gives you the tools to make better decisions
advice_items.video_title: Asking Yacht Owners How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 敢于承担风险，不冒风险就没有回报
advice_items.summary_en: You cannot earn big rewards without taking risks; take the leap or lose the opportunity.
advice_items.quote: take the risk can't take the risk and not going to get the reward that's what it comes down to take the risk or lose the chance
advice_items.video_title: Asking Yacht Owners How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 培养无人能替的强大自信，相信自己
advice_items.summary_en: Unshakable self-belief is the one essential trait nobody else can teach you.
advice_items.quote: that is one denominator we just can't teach you have to believe in yourself

guests.first_money_or_break_en: Making $150,000 a year in sales at age 21, he walked away for a $30,000 job just to learn the right skills. The foundation he built from ages 21 to 29 enabled him to earn more in year 30 than in the previous nine years combined.
guests.zero_start_advice: 年轻时不要只追逐高薪工作，把时间和金钱全部投入学习知识、课程与智囊团，承担全部责任并立刻下场行动，技能的复利会带来爆发式回报。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Do not chase high-paying jobs when you are young; invest your time and money into education, courses, and masterminds instead. Take full ownership, get into the game immediately, and let the compounding of your skills drive explosive returns.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Orlando Millionaire’s How They Got RICH!

appearances.video_title: Asking Orlando Millionaire’s How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 人生要打进攻战，敢于下大注并押注自己
advice_items.summary_en: Play life on offense instead of merely cutting costs—take big swings and bet on yourself to avoid future regret.
advice_items.quote: if you play your whole life on defense saving and just trying to cut costs and cut Corners you'll look back and you'll really regret how you played your life... play Big roll the dice on yourself
advice_items.video_title: Asking Orlando Millionaire’s How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 年轻时投资知识、课程与智囊团，让技能产生复利
advice_items.summary_en: Prioritize learning skills over chasing short-term pay when young by investing time and money in courses, videos, and masterminds so skills compound.
advice_items.quote: take every bit of time that you have every dollar that you have at a young age invest in knowledge information masterminds YouTube video online courses
advice_items.video_title: Asking Orlando Millionaire’s How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 清醒认识到一切靠自己，放下手机立刻下场行动
advice_items.summary_en: Own full responsibility for your life, put down the phone, study, and immediately get in the game.
advice_items.quote: look yourself in the mirror and know it's all on you it's on no one else out here so get your ass off the phone open up some books watch some courses and get your ass in the game
advice_items.video_title: Asking Orlando Millionaire’s How They Got RICH!

guests.first_money_or_break: 从小跟随父亲做小型房屋翻新工程入行，在私营建筑承包领域深耕27年并取得丰厚回报。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: He entered the trade as a kid doing small home renovations with his father and spent 27 years in private contracting with tremendous financial success.
guests.zero_start_advice: 创业初期一定要拼命投入长时间工作、规律健身保持状态；舍得花钱投资顶级工具与优秀工人来扩张生意，把工程品质做到极致并找一位好伴侣。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Put in relentless hours early on and work out regularly to stay sharp. Reinvest in top-tier tools and skilled workers to scale, deliver uncompromising workmanship, and choose a great life partner.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Luxury Shoppers How They Got RICH! (Miami)

appearances.video_title: Asking Luxury Shoppers How They Got RICH! (Miami)

advice_items.summary_zh: 把产品和服务做到极致，好口碑自然吸引客户
advice_items.summary_en: Consistently deliver top-quality work; when your product is exceptional, clients will seek you out.
advice_items.quote: always produce a perfect product if you do great work they'll find you it's that simple
advice_items.video_title: Asking Luxury Shoppers How They Got RICH! (Miami)

advice_items.summary_zh: 把利润再投资于顶级工具和优秀团队以做大生意
advice_items.summary_en: Reinvest money back into top-tier tools and skilled team members in order to grow your business.
advice_items.quote: you got to spend money to make money... you need top of the line tools you need top of the line labor the labor forces are very important you need good guys on your team
advice_items.video_title: Asking Luxury Shoppers How They Got RICH! (Miami)

advice_items.summary_zh: 起步阶段拼命工作，打磨自己并保持健身自律
advice_items.summary_en: Outwork everyone in the early years, put in long hours, hit the gym, and get your life in order.
advice_items.quote: the best advice I mean I wish I knew 20 years ago was hustle hard at the beginning hustle hard work on yourself work hard work long hours do your thing get into a gym get your stuff together
advice_items.video_title: Asking Luxury Shoppers How They Got RICH! (Miami)

guests.wealth_detail: $8M in a single year
guests.first_money_or_break: 因为一直想自己当老板、不愿为别人打工，大约20年前创办了自己的金融信贷公司（经营抵押贷款、个人贷款与信用卡业务），单年最高收入达到800万美元。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Determined to be his own boss, he founded his finance and lending company (covering mortgages, personal loans, and credit cards) about 20 years ago, reaching a peak annual income of $8 million.
guests.zero_start_advice: 要从六位数迈向七位数收入，必须在努力工作的同时学会放权与信任团队；去任何公司都要主动向业绩最好的销冠学习，并不断锤炼销售能力。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: To jump from six to seven figures, you must work hard while learning to delegate and trust your team. Wherever you work, study the top-performing salespeople and continuously sharpen your sales skills.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Luxury Shoppers How They Got RICH! (Miami)

appearances.video_title: Asking Luxury Shoppers How They Got RICH! (Miami)

advice_items.summary_zh: 努力工作并学会信任和授权，才能把企业做大
advice_items.summary_en: Work relentlessly and learn to trust and delegate responsibilities to others so your business can scale to hundreds or thousands of employees.
advice_items.quote: always work their butt off and learn how to delegate to be an entrepreneur you have to trust other people to do the job for you
advice_items.video_title: Asking Luxury Shoppers How They Got RICH! (Miami)

advice_items.summary_zh: 世上万物皆为销售，掌握销售技能永不过时
advice_items.summary_en: Recognize that everything in life is a sale and master selling as the most recession-proof skill in the world.
advice_items.quote: sales to me is the number one job in the world because there's always something to sell... everything in life is a sale
advice_items.video_title: Asking Luxury Shoppers How They Got RICH! (Miami)

advice_items.summary_zh: 去公司找到业绩第一的销冠，坐在他身边学习
advice_items.summary_en: Trust yourself and intentionally sit next to and learn from the top producer at your company.
advice_items.quote: they just gotta trust himself... and learn from the best go when you go to a company ask the question who's the top producer here that's the guy you want to sit next to
advice_items.video_title: Asking Luxury Shoppers How They Got RICH! (Miami)

guests.guest_name: Wine & Spirits Brand Partner (Former LVMH Executive)
guests.role_or_title: Partner, Wine & Spirits Brand (Former Luxury Executive)
guests.first_money_or_break: 曾在路易威登（Louis Vuitton）等法国奢侈品集团担任高管多年，先后追随7位身家数十亿的行业巨头工作了20年，如今成为自有酒水品牌的合伙人并重新亲自带头开拓客户。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: After years as an executive at French luxury groups including Louis Vuitton and spending 20 years working under seven billionaire industry titans, he became a partner in his own wine and spirits brand and is back on the front lines winning clients.
guests.zero_start_advice: 在职业生涯早期要慎重选择老板并考察其背景，尽量在行业巨头手下积累无可替代的经验，同时关注薪酬包、成长空间和股权机会；自己创业后则要做好卷起袖子从零一瓶瓶推销的准备。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Early in your career, vet your bosses carefully and seek irreplaceable experience under industry titans while weighing compensation, growth, and equity. Once you launch your own venture, be ready to roll up your sleeves and sell it one bottle at a time from scratch.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Luxury Shoppers How They Got RICH! (Miami)

appearances.video_title: Asking Luxury Shoppers How They Got RICH! (Miami)

Work Under a Winner First Before Starting

advice_items.summary_zh: 做老板真正的辛苦才刚开始，必须亲力亲为
advice_items.summary_en: Understand that for a small business owner, the real work begins where employees stop—you must roll up your sleeves and execute.
advice_items.quote: when you're a business owner the real work begins where others end... if you're a small business you have to roll up your sleeves and actually put in that actual work
advice_items.video_title: Asking Luxury Shoppers How They Got RICH! (Miami)

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.summary_zh: 择业要看重长期成长空间与持股分红的机会
advice_items.summary_en: Evaluate career roles for resume value, growth trajectory, and opportunities to own equity or buy shares.
advice_items.quote: you got to look at packages you have to look at what looks good on paper for your resume... opportunities for growth you have within that organization if there's opportunity for Equity buying shares
advice_items.video_title: Asking Luxury Shoppers How They Got RICH! (Miami)

advice_items.canonical_tag: Work Under a Winner First Before Starting
advice_items.summary_zh: 先去为顶尖大佬和好老板工作，积累无价经验
advice_items.summary_en: Scrutinize your boss's credentials and work under elite industry titans to gain irreplaceable experience before running your own brand.
advice_items.quote: most importantly you've got to get an awesome boss you have to look at their credentials just as much as they scrutinize yours... that experience that I gained from working for these individuals I could never replicate in a lifetime
advice_items.video_title: Asking Luxury Shoppers How They Got RICH! (Miami)

guests.wealth_detail: $11.2M max gross in a single year; $1M max in a single day ("eight-figure entrepreneur")
guests.first_money_or_break: 早期年收入仅1.6万至2万美元，后通过电商促销、联合推广与产品发布实现首次年入百万，进而单年最高总收入达1120万美元。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Starting out making just $16,000 to $20,000 a year, he hit his first $1 million through e-commerce promotions, joint ventures, and product launches, eventually reaching a peak annual gross revenue of $11.2 million.
guests.zero_start_advice: 不要试图重新发明轮子，直接模仿已被验证有效的模式（WWAD：苹果会怎么做）；通过分析竞品1-3星差评和4-5星好评，集中解决客户痛点以实现远超竞争对手的价值。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Do not reinvent the wheel; model what already works (WWAD: What Would Apple Do?). Study competitors' 1-3 star and 4-5 star reviews to solve customer pain points directly and deliver far greater value.
recommended_books_or_mentors: Naveen Jain (referred to as Naveen James)
The One Thing by Gary Keller
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Austin)

appearances.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Austin)

advice_tags: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.summary_zh: 分析差评痛点提供极致价值
advice_items.summary_en: Out-value competitors by systematically analyzing 1-to-3-star customer reviews and solving the complaints and missing features.
advice_items.quote: price is only an issue when value is absent so my key the secret sauce is to out value the competition... categorize one star to three star reviews... solve those problems
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Austin)

advice_items.summary_zh: 外包低价值工作专注高产
advice_items.summary_en: Delegate low-leverage minimum-wage tasks instead of wearing every hat so you can focus on high-income activities.
advice_items.quote: I was able to scale from seven to eight figures to focus on mitigating and delegating mwa activities which are minimum wage activities... so I can focus on high income earning activities
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Austin)

advice_items.summary_zh: 聚焦核心一事并做到极致
advice_items.summary_en: Apply the 80/20 rule to find the single highest-leverage driver and go all-in on it instead of scattering effort.
advice_items.quote: in that 80 20 rule kind of like Gary Keller's book The one thing... test a bunch of things identify that one thing and then exhaust that thing
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Austin)

guests.wealth_detail: Hundreds of millions AUM; over 1M sq ft under construction (~$2.5B fully developed over next 4 years); described as "nine figure entrepreneur"
guests.first_money_or_break: 原本是一名执业律师，后来迅速转入从小就立志从事的商业地产行业；目前管理数亿美元资产，正在奥斯汀开发超100万平方英尺项目（未来四年完全建成后总价值约25亿美元）。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Originally a practicing attorney, he quickly pivoted into commercial real estate, the field he had wanted to pursue since childhood. Today he manages hundreds of millions in assets and is developing over 1 million square feet in Austin, projected at roughly $2.5 billion upon full buildout over the next four years.
guests.zero_start_advice: 从20多岁开始，无论预算每月50、100还是1000美元，都要定投自动买入追踪股票市场的指数基金并长期持有，让复利在时间的作用下呈J型曲线增长；在销售与募资中要真诚关心客户并保证利益一致。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Starting in your 20s, automate monthly investments of $50, $100, or $1,000 into broad stock market index funds and hold long-term so compounding creates a J-curve over time. In sales and fundraising, genuinely care about your clients and keep your interests aligned.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Austin)

appearances.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Austin)

advice_items.summary_zh: 趁早定投指数基金吃复利
advice_items.summary_en: Automate regular contributions into broad equity index funds starting in your 20s so long-term compounding builds millions.
advice_items.quote: go find an index fund that spreads along the equity markets and automate money and put it aside... you start doing that in your 20s in your 60s it's millions
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Austin)

advice_items.summary_zh: 用真诚深耕建立客户信任
advice_items.summary_en: Win in sales and deal-making by building deep, genuine relationships with brokers, investors, and bankers.
advice_items.quote: personal relationships and actually giving a [ __ ] about the people that you deal with like whether broker investors Bankers like actually building deeper relationships
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Austin)

advice_items.summary_zh: 与客户利益绑定并严控风险
advice_items.summary_en: Earn investor trust through strong risk controls, putting your own capital in alongside clients, and getting paid on performance rather than fees.
advice_items.quote: showing them that you have great risk controls that you do care that your money's invested... your interests are aligned and not being in the [ __ ] fee business... we're in the performance business
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaires How They Got RICH! (Austin)

guests.role_or_title: Clothing Brand Founder, Musician & Brand Consultant
guests.wealth_detail: $180,000 in a single year
guests.first_money_or_break: 来自芝加哥，早年痛失双胞胎兄弟后被迫早早创业，依靠做服装品牌、音乐及品牌咨询白手起家，单年最高合法收入达18万美元。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Originally from Chicago, he was pushed into entrepreneurship early after losing his twin brother, building from scratch through a clothing brand, music, and brand consulting to reach a peak legitimate annual income of $180,000.
guests.zero_start_advice: 少说多做，用实际行动兑现承诺；专注做自己真正热爱的事并保持绝对自信，不要盲目追钱，让金钱自然随价值而来。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Talk less, do more, and back up your word with action. Focus on what you truly love with unwavering confidence, and stop chasing money so it naturally follows the value you create.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Miami Luxury Shoppers How They Got Rich

appearances.video_title: Asking Miami Luxury Shoppers How They Got Rich

advice_items.summary_zh: 做真正热爱的事并以此变现
advice_items.summary_en: Do work you genuinely love and build a career where people pay you for your passion.
advice_items.quote: I do what I do because I love to do what I just love to do, but people got to pay me to do what they want me to do.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Miami Luxury Shoppers How They Got Rich

advice_items.summary_zh: 少说废话，用实际行动去执行
advice_items.summary_en: Stop talking about your plans and prove yourself through immediate action.
advice_items.quote: Don't talk about what you're gonna do and just do it. Put your actions where your mouth is.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Miami Luxury Shoppers How They Got Rich

advice_items.summary_zh: 保持绝对自信才能赢得成功
advice_items.summary_en: Maintain strong self-confidence, because doubting yourself keeps you from achieving success.
advice_items.quote: Anybody that's feeling less confident, then success is just not meant for you.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Miami Luxury Shoppers How They Got Rich

guests.wealth_detail: North of 7 figures/yr ($1M+/yr)
guests.first_money_or_break: 依托整形外科医学背景自己开设诊所，在高客单价的医美整形赛道中开业第一年即实现七位数年收入，现于卡拉巴萨斯和比佛利山庄拥有两家诊所。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: Leveraging his plastic surgery background, he launched his own high-ticket cosmetic surgery practice and hit seven figures in his very first year, now owning two clinics in Calabasas and Beverly Hills.
guests.zero_start_advice: 选择高客单价行业并立志做到顶尖而非随波逐流；找到能让人全情投入的事业，同时保持开放心态，根据自身真正擅长的方向调整职业轨道。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Choose a high-ticket industry and aim to be the best rather than blending in with the crowd. Find work you can pour yourself into, while staying open-minded enough to pivot toward where your true strengths lie.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Calabasas Millionaires How They Got RICH!

appearances.video_title: Asking Calabasas Millionaires How They Got RICH!

advice_tags: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.summary_zh: 选择高客单价赛道并依托专业壁垒
advice_items.summary_en: Combine strong specialized credentials with a high-ticket industry to scale earnings quickly.
advice_items.quote: part of it is it's a high ticket industry part of it's my background
advice_items.video_title: Asking Calabasas Millionaires How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 你本身才是核心资产，豪车只是努力的映射
advice_items.summary_en: Remember that you—not material status symbols—are the true asset, and luxury rewards are merely a byproduct of hard work.
advice_items.quote: the car is nothing the Lamborghini is nothing you're the Lamborghini it's you so you know the car is just reflection of your hard work
advice_items.video_title: Asking Calabasas Millionaires How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 找到真正热爱且愿全情投入的事业
advice_items.summary_en: Find work you are genuinely passionate enough to live and breathe every single day.
advice_items.quote: you live and breathe it so you need to just find whatever you're passionate about and pursue that
advice_items.video_title: Asking Calabasas Millionaires How They Got RICH!

guests.zero_start_advice: 在职场上逐步晋升时，务必争取所在公司的股权（如股票期权或虚拟股权），因为工资只能维持生活，唯有所有权才能真正积累财富。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: As you climb the corporate ladder, always negotiate for equity such as stock options or phantom stock. A salary pays the bills, but ownership is what builds real wealth.

Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.summary_zh: 争取公司股权，靠所有权而非死工资致富
advice_items.summary_en: Seek equity or stock options in your company because ownership, not salary, builds wealth.
advice_items.quote: Get equity in your company—either stock options, phantom stock, own a piece of whatever you're working for—because you can live off of a salary, but equity builds wealth.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaire Golfers How They Got RICH!

advice_items.canonical_tag: Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)
advice_items.summary_zh: 长投勿用短贷，融资期限必须匹配投资周期
advice_items.summary_en: Match long-term investments with long-term financing; never fund a long-term venture with short-term debt.
advice_items.quote: You don't borrow short-term money on a long-term venture. If you have a long-term investment, you better have long-term financing.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaire Golfers How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 诚信是成功者共同特质，商业中务必信守承诺
advice_items.summary_en: Integrity and keeping your word in business are the defining traits of highly successful people.
advice_items.quote: Integrity. How important is it to keep your word in business? Very.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaire Golfers How They Got RICH!

guests.wealth_detail: $110M net worth; main company valued at ~$130M
guests.first_money_or_break: 大学毕业后做过两年表现很差的股票经纪人，14年前转行做医疗器械销售，随后创办分销公司，最终自筹资金创立了自己的医疗器械公司。
guests.first_money_or_break_en: After two struggling years as a stockbroker out of college, he pivoted to medical device sales 14 years ago, launched a distributorship, and eventually bootstrapped his own medical device company.
guests.zero_start_advice: 先大胆尝试不同领域，发现真正看好的方向后把所有资金押注在自己身上并保持控制权；通过持续倾听客户痛点打磨产品，用可复制的模式稳健扩张。
guests.zero_start_advice_en: Experiment broadly first, then bet everything on yourself and retain control once you find the right opportunity. Refine your product by constantly listening to customer pain points and scale steadily with a repeatable model.
guests.primary_video_title: Asking Millionaire Golfers How They Got RICH!

appearances.video_title: Asking Millionaire Golfers How They Got RICH!

advice_tags: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value

advice_items.summary_zh: 先验证单点盈利模式，再系统化复制到全国
advice_items.summary_en: Prove a turnkey business model in one market, then bring in sales reps to systematically duplicate it across new markets.
advice_items.quote: You prove the model and then you duplicate it—copy paste, copy paste. We did this in one state, bring in the sales reps, and now we're in 43 states.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaire Golfers How They Got RICH!

advice_items.summary_zh: 多走出去尝试不同行业，从中寻找契机
advice_items.summary_en: Try different paths early on and pivot quickly if something isn't a fit until you find your lane.
advice_items.quote: You got to go out there and try a bunch of stuff. I was a stock broker for two years out of college and I was horrible, so I went into medical device.
advice_items.video_title: Asking Millionaire Golfers How They Got RICH!

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.summary_zh: 深入客户痛点打磨产品，让需求自然找上门
